heading: Aries Season and Aries New Moon: Actions and Intentions
body: s Create an altar – During Aries season it is a good time to create a sacred space for Mars, the planetary ruler of Aries. To create an altar, you can gather items with personal meaning or significance. You might also want to collect items that symbolize Mars and Aries. Set up the altar where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. <Insert Page # for where you can find the altar> Observe – Observe and record any symbolisms or messages you notice during this full moon. A journal is like a magick portal to your innermost thoughts and dreams; and invites you to explore, reflect, and express yourself meaningfully. Collect items – Grab a pen, paper, candles, incense, herbs, and symbolic objects to represent Mars/Aries, like The Tower, The Emperor tarot cards, and The Planetary Kamea for Mars. Celebrate your existence – Use affirmations like "I am worthy" and "I am deserving of love and abundance" to acknowledge and embrace your worth. Embrace your inner warrior – Take time to read books or engage in activities that cultivate a warrior mentality, such as "The Art of War" and "Never Split the Difference: Negotiating As If Your Life Depended On It." These resources can help you to position yourself for success and embrace your inner strength. Take action to step into your authority and own your power – This might involve setting boundaries, speaking up for yourself, or taking charge of your own life. Embrace new beginnings – Take bold steps towards achieving your goals. This might involve setting new goals, taking a new class or hobby, or trying something new. Embrace your unique identity – Embody it with confidence and pride. This might involve dressing in a way that feels authentic, expressing your true thoughts and feelings, or owning your strengths and quirks. Connect with your spirit – embrace your divine right to exist in the physical plane. This might involve practicing mindfulness, engaging in spiritual practices, or spending time in nature to connect with the natural world. Setting goals for the coming month or year – This intention involves taking the time to reflect on what you want to achieve in the near future and making a plan to work towards those goals. Consider setting both long-term and short-term goals and breaking them down into smaller, achievable steps. Building confidence and self-assertiveness – If you've been feeling uncertain or unsure of yourself, the Aries new moon is a great time to build your confidence and self-assurance. This might involve setting boundaries, learning to speak up for yourself, or practicing self-care to boost your self-esteem. Setting boundaries and taking care of one's own needs – It's important to ensure that you are taking care of your own needs and setting boundaries to protect your time and energy. This might involve saying "no" to unreasonable requests, setting limits on your availability, or taking time for yourself to recharge. Taking action to pursue a new project or idea – If you have a dream or idea that you've wanted to pursue, the Aries new moon is a great time to take the first steps towards making it a reality. This might involve researching and gathering information, networking, or taking small actions to move forward. Taking risks and stepping out of one's comfort zone – The Aries's new moon is a time to be bold and take risks to grow and learn. This might involve trying something new, stepping out of your comfort zone, or taking on a challenge that pushes you to your limits. Being more courageous and bold in pursuing one's dreams – If you have a dream or goal that you've wanted to pursue, the Aries new moon is a great time to take the first steps towards making it a reality. This might involve setting a plan in motion, taking risks, or stepping out of your comfort zone to achieve what you desire. Aries Season and Aries New Moon Affirmations I am worthy and capable of stepping into my authority and taking charge of my life. I am strong and capable of advocating and fighting for my needs, and I know that I deserve to have my needs met. I reclaim my energy, set boundaries to protect my time and energy, and prioritize my well-being. I permit myself to evolve and grow, and I embrace the process of personal growth and change. I am confident and empowered to take control of my life and create my desired future. I am confident and assertive in setting healthy boundaries for myself and others. I respect my own needs and desires and communicate them clearly and respectfully. I am open to the boundaries of others and honor them in my interactions. I am empowered to create a balance between my own needs and the needs of those around me, and I am committed to maintaining a healthy and harmonious environment for all involved. The New Moon in Aries: Fanning the Flames of Individuality & Claiming Your Power Aries energy represents the zodiac's starting point, new beginnings, and karmic cycles. Placements in your natal chart, whether planets or houses, signify the divinity within you and where you can shine the brightest. The Aries New Moon marks a new cycle and the birth of a new celestial year. The changing seasons stir within us as the fiery energy of the Ram awakens us from our winter hibernation. Aries initiates new beginnings in some areas of life. You may feel as though you're starting from scratch in some areas of your life, but the month calls you to embrace your strength and authority. The New Moon's energy is prime for planting new seeds of intention, and the energy of Aries is best used to manifest coming back into your power. Take steps to actualize your dreams and intentions, but be mindful of feelings of impulsivity, anger, and selfishness as you step forward. The changing seasons serve as a visual reminder that new beginnings are happening around you, and it's time for you to take charge and shape the year to come. You'll feel the power of the Ram igniting a spark in your soul, pushing you forward to step into your authority and most authentic self. This is a time to take the lead and take control of your own story. Be mindful and reflect on your feelings, especially any feelings of impulsivity, anger, and selfishness, as you step forward. In your reflections, consider what the energy of Pisces season had you release and what areas of your life need some rekindling. This month provides you with the discipline, motivation, and direction to take action on your desires. If challenges arise, remember to call upon your warrior spirit and find the inner strength to keep you moving forward. Aries is associated with the Emperor in the tarot, representing the resources at your disposal. This month offers you the resources to use your power and authority wisely. It's time to take control of your life and make the decisions to help you reach your goals. Seek counsel when needed and remember that we are interconnected beings, that no one is an island. Consider the proverb that states, "Without counsel, purposes are disappointed, but in the multitude of counselors, they are established" (Proverbs 15:22 KJV). An affirmation for this month could be: "My potential for success is limitless." Your ability to take action on a decision, project, or dream is your strength. This action allows you to gain new feedback and insight. This season ignites a fire within you, propelling you forward and taking an active role in your experiences. You have the authority over your life and decisions (and indecisions) and complete control over your thoughts and reactions. The Aries's new moon brings about a strong sense of motivation and a desire to take action on new projects and goals. It brings about a renewed sense of self-confidence and courage. It's a powerful time to set intentions related to the Aries themes of self-assertion, independence, and leadership and focus on starting new projects or taking bold actions.

heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes For The Aries New Moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology with writing personalized horoscopes. You can use different techniques to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a variation of a 6-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Aries Season, the Sun (The Sun) and Moon (High Priestess) are in Aries (Emperor). Begin by finding the Sun (Sun), High Priestess (Moon), and The Emperor (Aries), and place the Sun in position 1, High Priestess in position 2, and The Emperor in position 3. For positions 4 and 5, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the full moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 6th position, select a card from the second pile containing the court cards and the Minor Arcana. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. Tarotscope Key 3. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in Ex: The Emperor (Aries) during Aries new moon 5. The tarot card that corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries 1. The Sun (Sun) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 4. The tarot card that corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house 6. The tarot card corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign or a supporting card from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance Aries (March 21st - April 19th) & Aries Rising - New moon in the 1st House The Aries new moon activates your 1st house of Self, a time to reclaim yourself, energy, and power. Happy birthday Aries! It's your birthday month, and this new moon is all about you. Don't let anyone make you feel guilty for taking the time to focus on yourself and your needs. The planning you do this week sets you up for the year ahead. Others might consider you selfish for focusing as much on yourself right now. However, your external reality is a reflection of your inner reality. If you don't take the time to get yourself sorted, you can't fully be there for yourself or others later. This new moon in your home sign creates dynamic tension in expressing a new vision of yourself. The time has come for a complete makeover of your identity and how you show up to the world. Become clear about what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take your life. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize how to face and solve any challenges. The new moon in the 1st house is a time of new beginnings, rebirth, and redirection. This moon is a reminder that sometimes all you need is a fresh start. A chance to go down a different path, try something new, or redirect your life. Embrace this opportunity, step into a new version of yourself, make a change and explore the possibilities of what could be. The first house is ruled by Aries and corresponds to the Emperor in the Major Arcana. How would it feel to believe in your authority and proceed fearlessly? When you align with your true Self, you will be on the correct path, and your obstacles will be overcome. If you allow yourself to be influenced by others, acting out of alignment with your authentic Self, you may experience friction and roadblocks. The 1st house is ruled by Aries and corresponds to The Emperor in the Major Arcana. Aries ruler, Mars, corresponds to the Tower in the tarot. With both The Emperor and The Tower energy present, this new moon cracks your shell, and forces you to emerge raw, fragile, uninhibited, and authentically seen. The Aries new moon is a reminder that the only constant in life is change, and the more you cling to your ego, the more the Universe will humble you with shocking displays of power. The Tower is divided into two halves with seven stories (each level pays homage to one of the ancient planetary gods) above and seven stories below, representing the higher and lower consciousness of man. It symbolizes the human spine, with each ring representing the chakras that kundalini energy must pass through in order to reach enlightenment at the crown chakra, which sits at the top. The Tower reveals a basic fact of spiritual life: the Universe may strike unexpectedly, bringing you insights and awareness, in order to break down all the long-established patterns and assumptions that are no longer working; that has been taken for granted or ignored. When the shock abates, you may find a sense of release and liberation, perceiving a divine logic at work. Repeat this affirmation every morning and night until it becomes second nature - "I am strong and capable. I am never moved nor shaken by the outside environment." Aries & Aries Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) in Aries (The Emperor), illuminating the 1st House (Aries/The Emperor - leave blank, since the card is used in position 4), with ruling planet Mars (The Tower). For the 6th position, place one card from the minor arcana to give you further insight. 3. The Emperor (Aries) 1. The Sun (Sun) 5. The Tower (Mars) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 6. [extra card] 4. Blank - The Emperor (Aries) is used in position 3 Pisces (Feb 19th - March 20th) & Pisces Rising - New moon in the 2nd House The Aries's new moon activates your 2nd house of disposable income and foundation. Aries asks that you advocate for your time and talent. There has been a lot of activity in your sign over the last few weeks and you are emerging with a new sense of who you are and what direction you want to take in life. How much you value yourself is apparent in what you are manifesting externally, so keep showing up for yourself and believing in your talents, beauty, compassion, and creativity. Any behind-the-scenes work you have been doing will also soon be noticed. This month and Aries New Moon is about reconnecting to your resources, finances, security, and your sense of self-worth. You have a great opportunity this week to either close a deal that leads towards success or come up with an idea that can help you generate money (towards your financial success). Use this time to connect to your spiritual and artistic side. While you focus on these opportunities, remain grounded and in the moment with your personal relationships. Take time to realign with your values for the sake of your emotional well-being. You are being pushed to explore how to create a solid foundation under your feet, and to define what foundation and comfort mean for you at this time. Remember — your external reality is a reflection of your inner reality. “Even when my patience is tested, I find strength in envisioning my future goals.” The second house is ruled by Taurus (The Hierophant), with Venus (The Empress) as its planetary ruler. The Empress symbolizes everything in life that grows and flourishes; she embodies the transformative energy that imbues the mysterious process from seed to fruition. With both Venus (Empress) and Taurus (The Hierophant) energy grounds your focus back down to earth. This is a time to put your energy into tangible projects and skills. It's possible that this is a time in which you're being asked to tend to multiple projects at once and to engage multiple talents. The Hierophant is often seen as the embodiment of structure and consistency— two powerful ingredients in achieving success and financial stability. Think of the Hierophant as your guide or mentor — someone who has the experience and knowledge to get you on the path to success. Your mentor can help you stay focused by helping you set clear goals and providing guidance, support, and motivation when things aren’t going your way. By having a mentor, or financial advisor to lean on, you can save time and effort because instead of making costly mistakes along the way, you’ll have someone there to show you the right way. So if you’re looking for help in setting up proper financial goals, perhaps it's time to seek out a Hierophant-type figure who can provide much-needed direction and assistance. The more you commit to yourself in the next six months, the more you’ll see your investments, income, and self-worth grow. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) in Aries (The Emperor), illuminating the 2nd House (The Hierophant/Taurus), with ruling planet Venus (The Empress). For the 7th position, place your sun sign, Pisces (The Moon), and/ or one card from the minor arcana to give you further insight. 3. The Emperor (Aries) 1. The Sun (Sun) 5. The Empress (Venus) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 4. Hierophant (Taurus) 6. The Moon (Pisces), or an extra card Aquarius (Jan 20th - Feb 18th) & Aquarius Rising - New moon in the 3rd House The Aries new moon activates your 3rd house of early education, how to process information, and communicate with your community, siblings, and neighbors. Your mind is on fire and ideas are being downloaded at light speed. It is a good time to share these ideas with others because networking will be successful for you now. Be sure to take that creative energy and use it on something that you can offer others. Focus on yourself, not on what others have or do. You have lots to share, so remember that competition leads to disharmony while collaboration fosters connection. Gossiping will only lead to anger and hurt, so be mindful of your words now. The words you choose to communicate with carry weight. They make an impact and leave an impression. If you grew up feeling like your voice didn't matter, it could be hard as an adult to remember that your words have power. If you've been feeling stuck with any writing projects, this new moon signals to make a push to get these projects off the ground. Aries is ruled by Mars, which gives the gift of energy to push through challenges. The more intention you put into these projects, the more significant their impact will be. The third house is ruled by Gemini (The Lovers) with Mercury (The Magician) as its planetary ruler. The Lovers and The Magician alludes to the magick and power of unions. It’s the energy that inspires covens: to come together and combine efforts to raise energy to achieve a goal. We all need a little extra support sometimes, or it's possible some project, tasks, and life goals can only be achieved by a group effort. The new moon in the 3rd house invites you to seek support in your local community. Connect with friends, family, and neighbors to provide support and receive help in return. Whether it's to take on a new challenge, spark a creative idea, or just find someone to talk to who understands. If you're fortunate enough to have your needs met and still have the capacity to give back, then why not share it with your local community? With the new moon in the 3rd house, make the choice to find those who can help keep your energetic momentum growing creating a harmonious flow of energy. The Star (Aquarius), or an extra card Capricorn (Dec. 22nd - Jan. 21st) & Capricorn Rising - New moon in the 4th House The Aries's new moon activates your 4th house of home, roots, and family. It is critical to examine the roots of your life to ascertain your connections to family, home, and parents and what keeps you rooted. You might be feeling more reclusive during this New Moon, but it’s helping you to get clear on your inner process. You might also be thinking about exploring inner conflicts around what you need to feel happy and stable. Perhaps there are some changes occurring in your home and family situation right now, or you are assessing what provides you with a sense of comfort and security. This is a time when your emotional needs are being renegotiated. The fourth house is ruled by Cancer (The Chariot) with Luna (The High Priestess) as its planetary ruler. The Chariot symbolizes being active, in control, and taking direction of one's life, needing to take control of one's emotions, and forward motion. The Chariot can represent an actual vehicle, or represent a symbolic metaphor for the transportation of energy. The Chariot, like all vehicles, requires maintenance - be it emotional, spiritual or tangible parts that need fine-tuning or replacing. The new moon in the 4th house is a time for maintenance, of your emotions and emotional body. Take time to check in and feel, you cannot think your way out of emotion. Allow yourself to feel angry, scared or overwhelmed; to cry, rage and process any emotions you’re holding inside — this will help you move forward. Letting these feelings build up over time, can be damaging. It weighs down your emotional vehicle, making your journey more cumbersome Here's an important truth about facing your emotions: it's hard and it takes courage. But doing the work is worth it. By acknowledging and confronting your anger, grief, and fears head-on, you can process them before they manifest in unhealthy ways. Taking the time to express your emotions actively helps you to move the energy through you and out. When you acknowledge your feelings and express them in a healthy way, you are able to move through your emotions and come out the other side with wisdom, understanding, growth & awareness. Just like a river flowing, you can confront your anger, grief, and fears head-on – allowing yourself to feel and process them before they manifest or consume you. The Chariot can symbolize an emotional, spiritual or physical journey. Or, the courage, dedication, drive and motivation to reach one's goal or destination. This could be a time of focused and emotional discipline to remain dedicated to your current journey. The Chariot can symbolize an arrival: that of a pregnancy, a guest or unexpected news. Love, relationships, children, creativity, and self-expression are at the forefront of this New Moon. How you identify with these areas will reshape you. Consider how you are expressing yourself and how it is being received by those around you. It is important for you to stay connected to what you love. Returning to an old hobby or joyful pastime could help lift your mood. “I am most fulfilled when I am appreciated for my spark and creativity.” The 5th house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the Major Arcana. The Strength card reminds you of a sacred power, grounded in inner strength and trust, that comes from emotional mastery. The Strength card of the Golden Eclipse tarot illustrates the Fool sitting poised, channeling the energy of the Universe. The lion is a metaphor for the primal energies of the emotional body, the flames referencing its burning passions. Strength symbolizes being in tune with your inner creative flow when time seems to stand still. It symbolizes the power of channeling Source. When you focus on creating from a place of pure presence, you can tap into a field of awareness that unlocks all the infinite possibilities of creation. Your work will come alive and flow through you—not just by you. The Aries new moon and Strength guide you to set intentions to infuse any projects or ideas with a new spark of creativity. Art can challenge your own thinking and spark your imagination. It’s a powerful tool that can be used to explore ideas, create new concepts, and challenge your existing beliefs. Whether it’s painting, drawing, sculpting, writing, or any other form of art, it’s the perfect way to open up your mind to new possibilities and perspectives. Strength can also suggest a time of connecting with animals, inviting a new pet to your home, possibly fostering a pet, or volunteering at a rescue. Animals can be a great source of comfort, laughter, and love. Sagittarius & Sagittarius Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. The Strength (Leo / 5th House) Scorpio (Oct 23rd - Nov 21st) & Scorpio Rising - New moon in the 6th House The Aries new moon activates your 6th house of health and being of service. You need to create a new self-care regimen that will give you more energy, and create more stability and routine in your life. This includes your work environment and learning to balance work with self-care. If you feel like you are not being acknowledged, this feeling will pass. However, this does not mean ignoring negative feelings as unexpressed anger will find its way into your body and can create health issues. Find a way to express it, and if you have the opening, communicate your boundaries and needs to others in a way where they can receive what you have to say. “I transform and know myself more through a structured approach to my self-care.” The new moon is the perfect time to set intentions to introduce activities that can help you channel Aries energy towards better health. Running is a great way to do this, as it increases blood circulation to the brain, improving your mood. Running and walking can also be forms of meditation, connecting your mind and body, clearing your mind, and keeping you present in the moment, which can help reduce anxiety. The 6th house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit teaches you to master the Self by practicing silence, meditation, and seclusion. In this stage of the journey, you're being asked to be more attentive to details, looking at how you give too much of yourself and are left feeling drained and under-appreciated. The New moon in the 6th house teaches you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals link to your overall health and wellness. Death (Scorpio) {and/or an extra card} Libra (Sept 23rd - Oct 22nd) & Libra Rising - New moon in the 7th House The Aries new moon activates your 7th house of relationships. Relationships in work and love are the emphasis for you now, as well as the need to balance your own needs with the needs of others. This New Moon gives you the opportunity to make changes that will help you evolve both as a person and partner as issues and imbalances that have not been dealt with will arise for discussion or resolution. Perhaps you are finding that your people-pleasing behavior does not create a win-win situation. Face the fears that are coming up around commitment or abandonment, and work through them with support. Be honest about what you need from others and yourself; it is a liberating act. Make truth a priority in all your relationships and get it all out on the table. Some information might cause a little jolt or pain, but see it as a necessary step toward intimacy or separation. Aries energy is heated, and this is an optimal time to set intentions and create a ritual to Venus to bring more passion and heat into your relationships. The 7th house is ruled by Libra and corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice symbolizes cause and effect, the consequences or rewards of past actions, a favorable outcome of judicial matters, responsible conduct, making well-balanced choices, having integrity, and cultivating peace of mind. The Aries new moon in the 7th house can signal a time when you take action to cut certain people or elements out of your life; either to protect your relationship, protect your ability to create a relationship; or remove elements that do not align with your integrity. Integrity is not a one-time decision – it’s an ongoing choice that requires commitment and dedication. Having a strong sense of integrity means not giving in to anything or anyone that doesn’t align with your values. You stand firm and don’t compromise on the things that you know matter most. Justices reminds you that when you stick to your own integrity, you can live life with a clear conscience. No matter the situation, compromising your integrity, whether it be to avoid conflict, and loneliness, or to advance your career or make more money, will take a toll on you in more ways than one - from your sense of self-respect to your professional reputation and trustworthiness. Justice also symbolizes balance. What you need and want from others, needs to be balanced with what they want and need from you in return. If that balance cannot be struck, it will be time for major changes. This new moon is asking you to determine what your emotional needs are, and make sure they’re being met. This new moon is the perfect time to take a deep dive into your love life and make sure that you're connecting with those who have the capacity to understand, accept, and love all of you. If you're partnered, now is a time to look at any areas where integrity may have been lacking in your relationship. And most importantly, be sure to have conversations covering all aspects of the relationship - no topic should remain off limits. Here's to taking an honest look at what it means to deepen your relationships, with integrity and honest communication. Libra & Libra Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Your focus this New Moon will be areas of intimacy and shared resources, as you are challenged to look within and trust the inner resources of you were previously unaware of. Step to the edge of discomfort, and let go of the small version of yourself; do not fear what you might transform into. You are exploring topics of loss, control, surrender, and delving into your inner resources to cope in this time of uncertainty. Remember that fear can be a gift — even the fear of letting go, that nothing will come in its place, and that the space will not be filled. Trust yourself first, and everything else will align. There is nothing wrong with taking small steps, but no step at all will keep you stuck. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the Major Arcana. The New moon in the eighth house can represent a 'death' from one's old Self or old life and a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle. Getting caught up in internal thoughts and life's battles is easy. But if you take a moment to create a tiny altar in your space, it can help you remember what's important and where to focus your attention. Your new moon intention, “security is an inner construct that I have some control over. I build trust in myself and trust outside myself naturally follows. Use this Aries New Moon to broaden your horizons both internally and externally, helping you see life in a new and fresh way. Traveling will help to give you perspective in situations in your life that feel clogged and stifled. Your creativity is ignited and you're ready to share your gifts with others through performance or teaching. In relationships, re-frame any debates or conflicts of interest as opportunities to find common ground, rather than focusing on what’s not working. Teaching, sharing, communicating, and learning are the best uses of your time during this New Moon. Your new moon intentions, “creative collaboration dissolves all dissonance.” The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance guides you to find the balance between the Mundane & Spiritual Worlds. If you live too anchored in the mundane, invite in more of lifes mysteries. If you find yourself deep into Spiritual studies, anchor yourself to earthly matter. f you can successfully find that perfect balance between your spiritual pursuits and your life on the ground, you can use the wisdom to unlock the mysteries to live an enchanted life. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering our purpose or meaning, mindfulness of overindulging or drinking, moderation, the balance of passion and reason, and cultivating patience. The Aries new moon signals a time of rebirth, renewal, and belief systems. What you believe shapes your thoughts, behavior, and ultimately, your outcomes in life. It's time to question your core beliefs and see if they need some upgrading. The Aries new moon in your 9th house is also a time to explore different belief systems, religions, and ideologies- and find out what resonates most with you. Right now, your career is your main focus. As you discover more about yourself, you might be wondering if your current work situation honors all these different parts. This question might eventually lead you to take on a new career path, or a promotion in your current one. You do not always like being in leadership roles, but now you are seeing that taking on some extra responsibility, whether that be in your current work or on your own, will be fulfilling. You are pushing through some old limitations around personal accomplishments. If you feel like you are taking a step back, it might be needed in order to help you reflect on what is most important to you, and what will help you achieve the long-term goal of success. Use this time to figure out which direction you want to take in your career and move forward. Your new moon intentions, “I try on a new skin as a leader of my own destiny and reality. The comfort of leading others will soon settle in as I move past my comfort zone.” The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil/Capricorn speaks to any false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. The Devil usually symbolizes struggles with a moral problem — a choice between lust or love; and it’s important to identify and stay clear of any romantic obsessions or fantasies within the workplace that could potentially thwart your means of financial freedom. The Devil/Capricorn reminds you that you have agency in your life and that no matter what our current circumstances may be, we always have the power to create change. The Devil/Capricorn also signifies feelings of being overwhelmed with an overthinking or an international struggle. It’s possible you may realize a shift in your values and beliefs, or realize that you have taken on the views of others that are misleading you of your fulfillment. This is a time to set the intention to align your career with your core values and interests. If you’ve ever struggled with ambition, life direction, status, public identity, life mission, authority, or responsibility then this Aries new moon is a time to renew and rebirth who you are. It’s time for a personal quest that will lead you to discover what matters most to you and how you can use your strengths to help others. It’s time to stop waiting for someone else to give you permission and start taking ownership of your life. Take time each day to unpack how you want to show up. What story do you want? What experience do you want? Redefine your core values and make sure everything that comes after aligns with those values. Aspire to grow in ways that are genuine and meaningful so your ambition isn't just a means to an end but part of a larger purpose. Friends, community, and networking with others are opening for you at this time, so engage with your community to see where your gifts can be offered. Your ideas should be shared. You are naturally a talker and this New Moon is bringing that out more in you. Surround yourself with friends and people who share your same values and vision, and stay close to those you trust. If conflict is showing up for you now, try to be a conduit for cohesion and finding common ground regardless of whether or not you contributed to it. If that is not possible, consider moving on from the person or people causing this disruption. Avoid gossip. Instead, stay focused on what is working in your projects and relationships, and gently tend to what is not working. Integrating your ability to think practically and outside the box is needed now. The 11th house is ruled by Aquarius which corresponds to The Star in the Major Arcana. The star symbolizes a wish granted, hope, inspiration, and faith. The star brings with it strength and the free flow of energy that is necessary to connect with the soul. Let it remind you of the beauty surrounding us and the broader vision of the future. The Star is a card of one's wish being granted, as she rules over the Law of Attraction. You possess the power to create your reality, and that can start with being intentional with your thoughts, feelings, and who you surround yourself with. If you are an artist: writer, musician, artist, actor, etc. this is a time to set the intention to have yourself and your work seen. If you have an established network, use it. If you are starting to build your network and community - put energy into being seen, and discovered for your art and talents. The Star is asking you to re-align with your spark — something deeper than simply relaxing, or "taking space." You're being asked to take the steps to work on the inner parts of yourself that need your attention and that you've been deflecting or ignoring. The Aries new moon in the 11th house signals a time of rebirth or renewal in your social networks. This is a time to set intentions to create connections and find strength in numbers. You can create positive connections with people who share your interests, and together you can learn, grow and build forms of support. Surround yourself with individuals who inspire you, and don't forget to be an active part of the conversations. I am a teacher for the teachers.” Gemini & Gemini Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. This New Moon is in your 12th House, which means that dreams, creativity, illusions, and loss are surrounding you now. Clarity may come in time, but for now, focus on your creative expression. If you feel like you are underwater, know that it will pass soon, and use this time to connect to your spiritual and artistic side. Let yourself dream, meditate, and be inspired by all that is coming through to you right now. Try not to make any solid decisions because not all is what it seems. You may be receiving downloads of information from past lifetimes or ancestral lineage, or trauma that needs to be healed and cleared. Focus on how this makes you feel, including feelings of loss and grief, in order to move through this. It will also be helpful to turn to your spiritual practices and faith to help get you through any challenges. The twelfth house of the zodiac is ruled by Pisces, represented by The Moon in the Tarot. The Moon represents this Law of Rhythm that governs over the natural cycles of life, the changing of the seasons, and the different stages of development. She embodies this rhythm in her lunar phases of mounting and diminishing waxing and waning energies. Pisces ancient planetary ruler is Jupiter, which corresponds to by The Hanged Man. The Moon reflects the natural rhythm and cycles of life, while The Hanged Man represents enlightenment, pause, meditation, and intuition. This new moon reminds you that enlightenment is often found when you surrender your mind to intuition and meditation. So listen, dive deep within, and discover what wisdom lies in your sacred inner realms. Your new moon intentions, “I contain multitudes within each sensation I experience. The Moon (Pisces) New Moon Ritual Timing The Aries New Moon brings the power of manifestation to give something form. It brings a new cycle and the energy of new possibilities. It is time to set your intentions for what you want to bring into your life. Each new moon is a new beginning. With each new beginning, we are asked to release unfinished business, draining distractions from the past, which must be neutralized before the new cycle's manifestation. New Moons often mean beginnings and planting new seeds, and it is time to set your intentions. Write down your desire to manifest over the next six to eighteen months. The best use of the Aries's new moon is to set intentions to come back into your power. Be mindful of the power of your words and actions, taking steps to actualize your dreams and intentions. To power, your intentions with this New Moon, select a time after the New Moon alignment, not before. The eight-hour window that follows the exact moon alignment is the most powerful manifesting period. This is because the goal is to have the moon waxing or growing as you speak, write, and set your intentions. Even if you cannot perform your ritual within the first eight hours, you still have 60 hours after the New Moon alignment for manifesting. Aries Season's Suggested New Moon Ritual Fig 59. Top view of an altar to Mars & Aries [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Mars and your ritual candle(s) for Mars on the placement for Mars. Place The Tower and The Emperor tarot card on your altar, as well as symbols (Sword) an offerings to Mars. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration Bay Leaves, Garnet) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – Ask Mars, the planetary ruler of Aries, to assist with matters such as your vital health, energy, sexual energy, passion, energy towards stagnant projects, cultivating personal strength, bashing adversaries, hexes, and protection. Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. Exploring Aries Season and New Moon Through Journaling Aries is the sign of the self, representing our personal growth and development. During Aries season or an Aries full moon, the universe may bring up issues related to your personal identity and what drives you to succeed. You can use tarot as a way to inspire journaling. Select a spread or layout that resonates with your current focus or intention. Shuffle the deck and draw a card, then reflect on its meaning and symbolism. Use the card as a starting point for your journaling and allow its imagery and message to inspire your thoughts and feelings. Explore the card's themes and messages in greater depth and consider how they relate to your experiences and challenges. Reflect on how the card may offer guidance or insights for your current situation and how you can integrate its message into your life. Light a red candle and create an energizing atmosphere by using invigorating scents and upbeat music. Visualize yourself embracing your inner fire and drawing strength from your own determination and ambition. Take this opportunity to reflect on what motivates you and what you want to achieve in your life. Open your journal and begin writing about your goals and aspirations. You may also want to consider any challenges or obstacles you have faced in pursuing your dreams, and brainstorm ways to overcome them. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you explore these themes. As you journey through Aries season, it's a great time to reflect on your personal identity and what drives you to succeed. By taking some time to journal about these topics, you can gain a deeper understanding of yourself and your motivations. Here are some prompts to get you started: ● What are your goals and aspirations? What steps are you taking to achieve them? ● What motivates you in life? What gives you energy and drive? ● Are there any areas of your life where you feel stuck or uncertain? How can you tap into your own determination and ambition to move forward? ● How do you handle challenges or obstacles that arise on your journey? What strategies have been effective for you in the past? ● What do you want to accomplish during this Aries season? How can you use your determination and ambition to make progress towards your goals? ● What new beginnings or fresh starts are you ready to embrace during this new moon phase? How can you set yourself up for success? ● How can you tap into the energy of Aries to take bold, courageous actions in your life? What small steps can you take to make big changes? ● How can you use this new moon phase to set intentions and make a plan for the coming month? What specific goals can you work towards? ● What do you need to feel more confident and self-assured in your pursuits? How can you cultivate a sense of self-belief and determination? Sun in Aries (The Emperor) / 1st House Full Moon in Libra (Justice) / 7th House Exploring the Aries/Libra Axis: Individuality vs. Relationship The polarity of Aries/Libra is balancing boundaries, relationships, and self-image to balance "me" (i.e., Aries) with "we" (i.e., Libra). Each zodiac season brings its own unique energy, highlighting the full moon and sun polarities. During Aries season, you are reminded of the balancing act between the individual (Aries) and the collective (Libra). Oppositions help you understand the delicate balance between your own needs and those of the relationship or group, as well as highlight your strengths and weaknesses. Often, finding a happy balance requires negotiation and compromise. However, if balance cannot be achieved, this energy may also call for separation or an ending. Aries teaches you that your divine connection to Spirit is the most important relationship you have. But with the introduction of Libra, you are reminded that you cannot truly understand yourself without acknowledging the existence of others. The combination of Aries and Libra helps you reclaim your lost self and establish a healthy balance between the self and others. These two signs are also represented by the Warrior and Peacemaker archetypes - without the Warrior, there would be no need for justice and peace. And without peace, the Warrior would be consumed by destruction. By working together, the just freedom fighter who is "fighting for peace" can emerge. Aries' fire also gives movement to the just cause embodied by Libra. The Aries/Libra axis asks you to embrace the duality between these two signs and rise above their opposition. Aries and the 1st house represent the self, while Libra and the 7th house represent others. This Self/Other polarity offers opportunities to release tensions in partnerships, especially those related to home and family. You must find a balance between what you need and want from others, and what they need and want from you. If this balance cannot be struck, it may be a time for major changes. Libra Full Moon: Let Go, Find Harmony Full Moons are powerful and amplifying times, providing an opportunity to celebrate and harvest the intentions set during the previous New Moon or make energetic adjustments to better align with your goals. It is also a time of gathering, syncing the lunar cycle with community, nature, and Spirit. The purpose of the Full Moon is to clear and raise energy, gain clarity, set intentions, process symbols, and connect with nature, the Divine, and your Higher Self. The Libra Full Moon reminds you that your journey through life is not meant to be undertaken alone, but rather shared with others. As you walk hand in hand with those you hold dear, your travels become richer, more fulfilling. The Libra Full Moon is a reminder of the sacred dance of balance and joy within our relationships. But it is important to remember that each person's journey is unique and personal. This Full Moon asks you to find harmony in both your external and internal relationships, the ones you share with others, and the one you have with yourself. Whether you are currently experiencing the joys of companionship or feeling the weight of a lost connection, it’s important to remember that the power to cultivate and nurture love resides within you. You are the chalice of love, capable of fulfilling your deepest desires. You hold the power to nourish the love within yourself and to share it with others. If you neglect your own needs and desires, you risk losing balance that this Libra Full Moon so deeply requires. As Libra, the celestial ruler of partnership, casts its light upon you, it invites you to seek balance and harmony in all your relationships. Take a moment to reflect upon the ones you hold dear and ask yourself: "Are we in alignment? Are we walking the same path, or have we strayed from one another?" Through these connections, you will discover the richness of meaning and purpose in your journey. The Libra Full Moon reminds us that relationships are a sacred aspect of our path, but we must also tend to our own well-being and inner balance in order to fully embrace and weave together fulfilling connections. But this Full Moon also serves as a reminder that, in order to nurture and foster deep connections with others, you must let go of that which holds you back. The past grievances, the lingering resentments, the fear of vulnerability. These are heavy burdens that must be let go, like the melting snow revealing the first signs of spring, in order to find a balance, a place of compromise, and understanding. It invites you to find a common ground, rather than working against one another. For it is through cooperation and collaboration that true harmony can be found. The illuminating light of this Full Moon will guide you on your journey toward creating relationships that are rooted in mutual understanding and cooperation, like the blossoming crocus signaling the arrival of spring after a long, harsh winter. The opposition of the Sun in Aries and the Full Moon in Libra casts a brilliant light upon the ancient struggle of balancing boundaries, relationships, and self-image. As the two celestial bodies dance in the heavens, they remind you of the intricate dance of independence and collaboration that is so essential to the human experience. Aries season marks the beginning of a new twelve-month cycle of spiritual evolution, a time when the embers of rebirth are fanned into a raging flame. The Aries energy of this season, when combined with the wisdom of the Libra Full Moon, can result in burning bridges and ending relationships that no longer balance and nurture each other's journeys. But this is not a time for mourning or lamentation. This Full Moon is a time to look upon the ashes of the past and see the opportunity for renewal and growth. It is a time to release what no longer serves you and to create space for balanced relationships in your life. Collectively, we must restructure what was not working and create a fresh foundation for the coming Taurus season. May the light of this Full Moon illuminates the path before us, as we strive to find balance, harmony, and a deeper understanding of ourselves and each other. Embrace this transformative energy, open your heart, and allow yourself to be guided on the path of deeper connections and growth that awaits you.

heading: Libra Full Moon: Actions and Intentions
body: s During this Libra Full Moon, it's a great time to tap into the energy of Libra and focus on finding harmony and balance in your relationships. Invoke Venus, the planetary ruler for Libra, to celebrate the relationships in your life or to bring supportive, loving energy to heal and release any relationships or memories from past relationships that are holding you back. As you set your full moon intentions, consider what might be blocking you from achieving this balance, and consider what you want to release or let go of in order to create more harmony in your life. Remember to be specific and focus on what you truly want to manifest. Writing down your intentions and keeping them somewhere visible can be a helpful reminder to focus on them during the full moon phase. This is a powerful time to set your intentions and work towards creating more balance and harmony in your life. Create an altar – Take some time for yourself, create a space that is meaningful to you and honors Libra, and enjoy the peace and serenity it brings. Link to altar Observe – Observe and record any symbolisms or messages you notice during this full moon. A journal is like a magick portal to your innermost thoughts and dreams. Every page is an invitation to explore, reflect, and express yourself meaningfully. Collect items – Grab a pen, paper, candles, incense, herbs, and symbolic objects to represent Libra/Venus, like The Justice or Empress tarot cards. Reflect on where you were six months ago – What you were manifesting and striving for. Take stock of your progress and make any necessary adjustments. Connect with others – Libras love connecting with others and exploring all types of relationships. Whether it's a family bond, a friendship, or a romantic partnership, there is much to gain from connecting with others. So don't be afraid to explore, take chances and embrace all types of relationships. You never know what beautiful connections you'll make during this full moon. Seek Balance – Relationships are built on commonalities - shared values, perspectives, and goals. If you want to create strong and lasting connections, it's important to seek things that bring people together. That's why finding common ground is essential to healthy relationships. It's the foundation that allows you to grow and nurture your connections. Appreciate Art – Embrace your inner Venus! She encourages you to seek beauty in all its forms and to appreciate art, music, and love. Find joy in all the little things that make life special, and take time to appreciate what surrounds you. Speak the truth – Trust starts with you. When you practice self-love, honesty, and self-care, it builds trust within yourself, which can help create more trust and harmony in your relationships. The more you invest in yourself, the more secure you will feel in any relationship. Write intentions – Life is all about balance. So take a moment to ask yourself: how can I create more balance in my life? What relationships do I need to adjust or release to make room for peace and harmony? It's ok to take a step back and acknowledge what's not serving you to make space for the things that do.

heading: Libra Full Moon Affirmations
body: I release the need to constantly strive for balance and harmony in my life. I embrace the natural ups and downs that are a part of life and understand that it is okay to not always be in perfect balance. I also release the need to please others at the expense of my own needs and boundaries. I prioritize my own well-being and set boundaries to protect my time and energy. I release the need for external validation and instead trust in my worth and value. I understand that my worth is not determined by others and that it is important to believe in myself and my own abilities. I release the need for perfection in my relationships and instead embrace vulnerability and authenticity. I understand that it is important to be genuine and open in my interactions with others and to let go of the need to be perfect. I release the fear of conflict and instead cultivate open and honest communication. I understand that conflict is a natural part of life and that it is important to address issues in a healthy and constructive way. I also release the need to compare myself to others and instead cultivate self-love and self-acceptance. I understand that it is important to love and accept myself as I am and to not compare myself to others. I release the need to hide my true self and embrace my authenticity. I understand that hiding my true self is not healthy or authentic, and I am brave enough to be my true self in all aspects of my life. I embrace my authenticity and know that it is a source of strength and empowerment.

heading: Libra full moon horoscopes & tarotscopes
body: s The Libra full moon asks that you appreciate and reflect on self-love, balance, harmony, and beauty. Libra is the peaceful mediator and has the innate ability to relate to anyone, about anything, at any time. With the Sun in Aries (Self) and the full moon in (Libra), themes seek harmony and balance in the relationships in your life. You've heard the saying, "the middle path is the best path," but what does that really mean? It's about striking a balance between independence and connectedness. You need to be strong enough to stand on your own, and stand up for your beliefs while being open enough to form meaningful relationships. That's why it's important to remember that harmony comes from understanding and respecting yourself and others. When you can find harmony between the two, you can create relationships full of respect, love, growth, and fulfillment. This full moon also highlights what needs to be released to create nurtured and connected relationships, finding harmony in the relationship between self and other. The Libra full moon is a reminder that life is best lived when you create shared experiences and meaningful partnerships. It reminds you that life is about the journey you share with others and that true fulfillment comes from healthy partnerships with those around you. Take a moment to reflect on your relationships, how you can nurture them, and find a middle ground to live and grow together in connection; while honoring your needs in these relationships. When the moon is at its fullest, lunar qualities of emotions and instincts are at their full strength. Use this increased emotional awareness to tackle any surfacing relationship issues. You can use your horoscope as a guide to what area of your life is being illuminated and use that as a guide for your full moon ritual. If you are unfamiliar with the twelve houses and what it means to have your 1st or 2nd house illuminated by the new or full moon, read foundation two for the fundamentals.

heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Libra full moon
body: n Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes, the one I favor is to select tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there are other significant planetary movements, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Begin by finding The Sun (Sun), The Emperor (Aries), High Priestess (Moon), and then The Lovers (Libra). Second, select the tarot cars from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Aries Season, the sun is in Aries (The Emperor), opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Libra (The Lovers). For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the full moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 7th position, select either a card that represents your sun sign or a card from the second pile, which contains the court cards and the Minor Arcana. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. Tarotscope Key 2. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the sun is in Ex: The Emperor (Aries), during Aries season 1. The Sun (Sun) 4. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in 6. The tarot card the corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house Ex: The Lovers (Libra), during Libra full moon Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries 3. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house 7. The tarot card the corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign or a supporting card, from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance Libra (Sept 23rd - Oct 22nd) & Libra Rising, Full moon in the 1st House The Libra full moon is an opportunity to embrace what makes you unique. As the energies of this full moon wash over you and activate your first house, they will provide energy toward healing and acceptance. As you will discover, this cannot be found inside yourself. As this full moon shines a brilliant light, you are asked to look at your relationship with your self-care, how you compromise with others, and your relationship with social freedom and beauty. The Libra full moon in the 1st house is a powerful time for self-reflection and finding balance. The 1st house, ruled by Aries, corresponds to The Emperor in the Major Arcana and represents the self, identity, and leadership. With Mars, the ruler of Aries, corresponding to the Tower in the tarot, this full moon may bring unexpected change and challenges that force you to let go of your ego and embrace balance. The Tower, a powerful tarot card, represents the journey to enlightenment through the human spine and chakras. The Tower is divided into two halves, seven stories above and seven stories below, representing man's higher and lower consciousness. Each tower ring represents a chakra, which kundalini energy must pass through to reach enlightenment at the crown chakra. The Tower reveals a basic fact of spiritual life: the Universe may strike unexpectedly, bringing insights and awareness to break down all the long-established patterns and assumptions that are no longer working. However, when the shock abates, you may find a sense of release and liberation, perceiving a divine logic at work. This is where the Libra full moon comes into play, bringing balance and harmony to the powerful energy of the Tower. It's a reminder to find balance in your life, let go of the things holding you back, and embrace change with an open mind and heart. To help you navigate this time, repeating this affirmation every morning and night is useful until it becomes second nature: "I am strong and capable. I am never moved nor shaken by the outside environment." This affirmation will remind you of your inner strength and resilience during this change and uncertainty. The Sun is in your transformative eighth house of Aries, and the full moon is in your 2nd house of values, bringing lessons of ancestral healing surrounding money blocks, finances, self-worth, and value. This is a time to release any false beliefs passed down from your ancestors that might be preventing financial success and stability; namely, the three most common ancestral abundance-blocking states: scarcity mindset; that net worth equals self-worth; and the mindset that compares you to others. The Hierophant can be considered a mentor or guide, someone with the experience and knowledge to help you navigate the path to success. If you're seeking help setting proper financial goals, it may be beneficial to seek a mentor or financial advisor who can provide direction and assistance.
