If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: ● Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. ● Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. ● Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. ● Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. *** Gemini Season: May 20th - June 20th 3rd House. Mercury Planetary Ruler Communication & Unity Planetary Ruler – Mercury New Moon – Gemini Full Moon – Sagittarius Day of the Week – Wednesday (ruled by Mercury) Archetype – Twins/The Messenger Element – Air Tarot – The Lovers (Gemini), The Magician (Mercury) Body – Lungs, arms, hands (parts of the body that are in two’s) Affirmation – I think, I express myself. I express my highest truth. I seek knowledge and learning Theme – Duality and Flexibility, Writing, Communication and Ideas, Business, Negotiation and Networking, Marketing and Facilitating Communication, Advertising and Sales, Marketing, Building Community, Linguistics, and Siblings As we enter into Gemini Season, we are urged to embrace the reconciliation of seemingly conflicting forces. This includes recognizing the delicate balance between the masculine and feminine energies within ourselves, as well as the various dualities that manifest in our daily lives. The celestial lovers, Mars and Venus, govern Aries and Taurus, respectively, further emphasizing this theme of union. The tarot correspondence of Gemini, The Lovers, serves as a reminder of the power of connection and partnership. The Twins, represented by the glyph of Gemini, remind us to use the gifts of intelligence and communication bestowed by the ruler Mercury to navigate and bring together the diverse aspects of ourselves. Gemini utilizes the deity's strengths of intelligence and communication to negotiate the merging of these opposing energies. Gemini season brings opportunities to deepen communication, clarify your message and bring about harmony and union. It is during this season that Mercury, Geminis’ planetary ruler, teaches of the voice's power to speak into existence; in other words, manifesting into reality. This bridging of the two dimensions — thoughts and words being actualized onto the physical plane — is exactly what the Hermetic Principle refers to: "As above, so below." The missing puzzle piece? Gemini is the connector. Gemini's connective role can be seen in its pictographic symbol wherein ♊ two pillars ( ) exchange information. In manifesting, this indicates energy transfer from the heavenly realm into our material realm of human experience. The theme is continued after the Gemini New Moon with the polarity of the Sagittarius Full Moon, continuing the theme of juxtaposed polarities becoming whole. Gemini and Sagittarius, signs positioned as polar opposites in the zodiac sphere, paint a vivid picture of the manifold ways we interact with, and comprehend, the world around us. Together, they form a powerful axis of intellectual pursuit, a celestial highway that facilitates learning, gathering, and integrating knowledge. Gemini is driven by an insatiable curiosity. This air sign thrives in ideas, swiftly flitting from one thought to another, deftly weaving narratives, and exploring varied perspectives. Gemini's strength lies in its agility and adaptability, its capacity to juggle multiple pieces of information and its ceaseless quest for knowledge. On the other axis, Sagittarius, the philosophical fire sign, brings a different energy to the equation. Sagittarius seeks to find meaning and purpose, to make sense of the world by sifting through the intricacies of experience and connecting the dots. Sagittarius embodies the expansive nature of fire, radiating a desire to explore beyond the known and venture into the realm of wisdom and profound truth. Though these signs may seem to approach the world from divergent angles, their ultimate quest converges on a singular, shared destination: the pursuit of truth. They each offer unique paths to understanding, acting as complementary forces that drive us towards a more holistic perspective of our universe and our place within it. Through the dance of Gemini's curiosity and Sagittarius's wisdom, we are reminded that various pathways can lead us to the same universal truth. The collective focus for Gemini Season is to communicate with intention in the name of harmony, union, and manifestation. Remember the affirmation, "I am a direct channel to universal consciousness. If I can think it, I can speak it into existence." Gemini Season Questions to Focus On: How can I shed identities that no longer resonate with my spirit? Where is the imbalance in my thoughts? Have I expressed what I need to say to others, my partner, and to myself? Do I have the information available to negotiate and make honest choices?

heading: Gemini Light and Shadow
body: Unevolved Gemini energy can be gossipy, flaky, and sometimes two-faced. Without a connection to Spirit, this lack of follow-through manifests as the "all talk, no commitment" personality. But in a high-vibration expression, evolved Gemini energy comes through with the traits of its planetary ruler, Mercury: as a messenger, negotiator, connector, and peace-maker. These skills are needed to fulfill the deity's legacy as he communicates and opens doors. In this evolved expression, Gemini can leverage the abilities of Mercury — the creator of language, tarot, and magick — to manifest through the evocative power of the voice. Gemini Light & Strength – Invocation, Communication, Negotiation, Education, The Messenger Gemini Shadow & Weakness – Putting words over action, not following through, flaky The 3rd house, and Mercury Planetary Ruler The third house represents your communication, education, siblings, and short-distance travel. It shows how you gather and process information and your relationships with those in your immediate environment. The element of Air, symbolizing communication and the exchange of ideas, governs the third house. It reveals your communication style, relationships with siblings and neighbors, and approach to learning and education. The third house also represents your adaptability and mental agility, your desire for new experiences, and your willingness to explore your surroundings. Mercury, the planet of communication, intelligence, and adaptability, rules the third house. It represents how you think, learn, and communicate and is associated with the Roman god Mercury, the messenger of the gods known for his speed and quick thinking. Mercury symbolizes the mind and how we process and disseminate information. Gemini / The Lovers The Lovers is the sixth key of the Major Arcana, where the Fool learns of choice. The Lovers represent the union between the divine masculine and the divine feminine, the sacred marriage, and the transformation of the sexual energies required for this inner union. Planetary Ruler – ☿ Mercury Symbolism – The Lovers depicts a woman and a man, with the woman's hand placed upon his lower abdomen — stirring up the primal forces, but also notably the front of the region where kundalini energy is stored at the base of the spine. Their embrace represents the unification of the masculine and feminine energies, the joining of opposites that catalyzes awakening. Cupid, known to the Greeks as Eros, floats above The Lovers. The god of love is not depicted with his usual bow and arrow, but with his hands outstretched to the left and right of his body to invoke two of the three energy channels for a kundalini awakening. Cupid self represents the center pillar. The Star above Cupid’s head depicts the merging of the sun and the crescent moon, another nod to the meeting of polar forces that initiates the process of God-realization. The Lovers represent a choice between short-lived, earthly pleasure (i.e., the apple) or the eternal divine (i.e., paradise). It is said that when you allow kundalini energy to flow into the higher chakras (i.e., throat, third eye, crown), you can experience the divine energy of the heart chakra. Astrology – The Lovers correspond to Gemini. Gemini focuses on the union of Aries (i.e., Mars and the masculine) and Taurus (i.e., Venus and the feminine). Ruled by the planetary god Mercury, Gemini uses intelligence and communication to negotiate and merge the opposing masculine and feminine energies, catalyzing evolution and growth. Gemini teaches you how to communicate, to identify your message, and bring about harmony and union. The glyph of Gemini represents the twins: the duality of masculine and feminine energy that makes up the whole. Upright Meaning – Choice, compromise, union, duality, partnership: love or business, intimate relationship, divine love, marriage, choice commitment, negotiating, harmonious flow of energy, a connection, support from a lover Reversed – Sexual addiction, selfishness, disharmony, non-committal, pining for a past relationship, unrequited love, unbalance in relationships, emotionally unavailable, distracted by obsessive sexual or romantic fantasies dominating one's thoughts

heading: Gemini Season and Gemini New Moon: Actions and Intentions
body: s I am confident and expressive in my communication. I am curious and open-minded, always seeking new opportunities and experiences. I am adaptable and flexible, able to navigate change with grace and ease. I am curious and always seeking to learn and grow. I am an excellent communicator, able to clearly and effectively express my thoughts and ideas. I am confident in my abilities and embrace my unique voice and perspective. Create an altar – Gemini season is a good time to create a sacred space for Mercury, the planetary ruler of Gemini. To create an altar, you can gather items that have personal meaning or significance to you. You might also collect items that symbolize Mercury and Gemini. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Observe – Observe and record any symbolisms or messages you notice during this full moon. A journal is like a magick portal to your innermost thoughts and dreams. Every page invites you to explore, reflect, and express yourself meaningfully. Collect items – Grab a pen, paper, candles, incense, herbs, and symbolic objects to represent Mercury/Gemini, like The Magician, The Lovers tarot cards, and the Planetary Kamea for Mercury. Use lavender – The use of lavender can be seen in the following ways: Place lavender in your home, on your bed, or on your altar. Gemini energy can be hyperactive, and lavender lends a sense of calm to overactive minds. Affirm – As you communicate and express yourself, acknowledge your thoughts and voice and affirm, "I express myself." This can help you to feel more confident and empowered in your self-expression. Breathwork – Practice breathwork to strengthen your lungs and improve your overall well-being. Deep, rhythmic breathing can help to clear away physical, mental, and emotional blockages, enhance mental clarity and reduce stress. It can also help you to connect with your inner self and deepen your spiritual connections. Open Communication / Waxing Moon Intentions – As the moon grows in the sky, set intentions around fostering open communication and creating new opportunities. This is a great time to reach out to others and make connections, as well as to work towards realizing your goals and ideas. Reconnect & Revisit / Waning Moon Intentions – As the moon's light begins to wane, it's a good time to revisit old opportunities and reconnect with people you have fallen out of touch with. This is also a great time to review and edit your writing, and to take stock of where you are and where you want to go in the future. The Gemini New Moon: Building Connections New Moons are the perfect time to set intentions and plant the seeds for a new cycle of manifestation. As Gemini's ruling deity, Mercury's gift teaches that you possess the ability to speak into existence — the power of manifestation. This Gemini New Moon, as the moon's light builds in the sky, you can harness Gemini's energy by setting intentions to encourage communication between you and another, to open doors, and to create new opportunities. You can additionally set the intention for your thoughts and communications to be infused with harmony-promoting kindness, clarity, maturity, and sensitivity to yourself and those around you. Remember that words and thoughts have power, and you can choose how you communicate and what you focus on. Yet, it's crucial for you to understand that Gemini's energetic chase for knowledge, if not grounded and balanced, can occasionally lead to perceptions of inconsistency, superficiality, and contradiction. While you may admire the Gemini Twins for their insatiable hunger for knowledge, their versatility, and their vibrant communication skills, it's just as vital for you to maintain self-awareness. As you embrace the Gemini spirit of learning and sharing, be mindful of how your actions and decisions impact those around you. As you attune yourself to the energies of this New Moon, your thoughts, perceptions, and modes of communication will be oriented toward finding a delicate balance between your emotional needs and your responsibilities. This balance might become particularly noticeable in various areas of your life—whether that's within the realms of family, academia, professional life, or in the intricate process of discerning how your identity fits within these domains. During this New Moon, communication might present hurdles. You might feel hesitant to lay bare your emotions, seeking shelter behind a protective barrier to avoid vulnerability. Conversely, you may be caught in a whirlwind of intense emotions, rendering clear expression difficult. It is possible that new information comes through that is painful to hear, causing you to review past choices and decide to act differently moving forward. This growth-oriented mentality is what opens up the space to heal and nurture yourself and others. Take this time to reflect on the ways you communicate and process information. From the words you choose to your body language to your online footprint, this is the time to clarify your message, consider your self-expression, and improve alignment between the two. This New Moon encourages patience, introspection, and empathy as you navigate these intricate complexities. The key to managing this lies in comprehending your emotions and expressing them effectively, thus encouraging personal growth and nurturing healthier relationships. Gemini new moon & Tarotscopes New moons often signal the beginning of a new cycle and the planting of new seeds. The new moon in Gemini is a time to approach life with playfulness, curiosity, and childlike wonder. Let the light of your life be transformed with ritual. The new moon is a great time to set intentions and focus on what you wish to bring into your life. By looking at where the new moon is activating in your chart, you can gain insight into which area of your life is ripe for manifestation. Use these horoscopes to guide your new moon goals and intentions. If you are still getting familiar with the 12 houses. and what it means to have your 1st or 2nd house illuminated by the new or full moon, read the chapter: foundation two for the fundamentals.

heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Gemini new moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. You can use different techniques to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 6-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Gemini's new moon, the sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) are in Gemini (The Lovers). Then, find the Sun (Sun), High Priestess (Moon), and then The Lovers (Gemini). For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the full moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 6th position, select either a card representing your sun sign or a card from the second pile, which contains the court cards and the Minor Arcana; use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. Tarotscope Key 3. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in Ex: The Lovers (Gemini) during the Gemini new moon 1. The Sun (Sun) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The tarot card that corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries 4. The tarot card that corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house 6. The tarot card corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign or a supporting card from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance Gemini (May 21 - June 20) & Gemini Rising - New moon in the 1st House Happy Birthday Gemini, this Gemini new moon illuminates your 1st house of Self. This is the time to clarify what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize how to face and solve any challenges. The 1st house is ruled by Aries (The Emperor), with the ruling planet Mars (The Tower). Aries represents new beginnings and karmic cycles, while the Emperor asks you to find and assert your individuality apart from external, socially defined norms. This is a time to step firmly into your authority and power, cultivating a healthy self-image and personal responsibility. The Taurus new moon wants you to be your source of recognition and control; instead of letting others dictate your worth and value. Concentrate on how you picture yourself rather than how others see you; draw upon your wellspring of internal support. With a New Moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This is a time of rebirth and redirection. Your new moon intention is, “I seek to know myself in all aspects of myself.”

Think of the Hierophant as your guide or mentor — someone with the experience and knowledge to get you on the path to success. Your mentor can help you stay focused by helping you set clear goals and providing guidance, support, and motivation when things aren’t going your way. Having a mentor or financial advisor to lean on can save time and effort because instead of making costly mistakes along the way, you’ll have someone there to show you the right way. It’s a time of transformation and trusting in the unfolding of life. Areas of Intimacy and shared resources are your focus as you learn to trust in yourself most of all. You’re exploring topics of loss, control, surrender, and delving into your inner resources to help you get through this time of uncertainty. Your natural ability to dive deep into the underworld/unknown will help you navigate through any uncertainty or darkness. What you thought gave you security may not be so anymore as you learn to access your deeper inner resources to pull you through challenges. Fear can be a gift. Fear of letting go, fear that nothing will come, fear that space won't be filled? Step to that edge of discomfort and let go of that small version of yourself. Trust yourself first and most, and everything else will align. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the major arcana. This energy can manifest as a separation or 'death' from one's old self or old life, a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle, or a time to explore your shadow and fears to allow for release and transformation. This is a time to set the intention to explore the mysteries of life. Now is the time to follow that path if you feel called to shamanism, astrology, tarot, or psychology. You may even decide to become a healer or a teacher. At any moment, you can find the brighter side of even the darkest topics and add a little lightness to the conversation. Use this New Moon to broaden your horizons both internally and externally to help you see life in a new and fresh way. Creativity is ignited and you're ready to share your gifts with others through performance or teaching. Any debates or conflicts of interest are an opportunity to find common ground instead of focusing on what’s not working. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering our purpose or meaning, mindfulness of overindulging or drinking, moderation, the balance of passion and reason, and cultivating patience. It’s possible you aspire to understand the truth and wisdom behind the mysteries. It's possible that you are struggling, seeking to understand the greater meanings of life, asking questions like, “What is life? What did my soul come to learn this lifetime?” You are looking for greater meaning in the mundane world of the day-to-day, perhaps through something spiritual. The search for true wisdom isn't linear, but diving into the mysteries of life can bring tremendous rewards. Temperance, on a spiritual level, speaks of the potential for true communication with your Higher Self. When you are open to fate and curious about synchronicities, your Higher self can make its presence known. The planetary ruler of Sagittarius/Temperance is Jupiter, which corresponds to The Wheel of Fortune. The Wheel of Fortune themes includes a change of fate, luck, expansion, fate, destiny, positive karma, and the beginning or end of a cycle. This new moon encourages you to remain curious and open-minded to new chance encounters and invites unexpected opportunities. You know that feeling when the Universe is conspiring in your favor? This is the essence of the Aquarius new moon in the 9th house. This is a moment when saying ‘yes’ to a new opportunity, interview, helping someone, or a vacation could lead you on an adventure where you'll discover your new best friend, new career, life partner, new residency or something else entirely. This new moon reminds me of the saying, be careful what you wish for - you must just be limited yourself. This new moon’s energy is the perfect time to take a leap of faith and say yes to new opportunities, adventures, and people life has in store for you. Career is your main focus now. You’re discovering more and more about yourself on a daily basis and wondering if all the different parts of yourself are being honored and acknowledged in your career. Sudden changes in status, responsibility, or direction will further your growth, even if it’s unclear how at the moment. Take a step back from this current timeline and focus on the long-range details. Make sure that whatever you put your energy into, it aligns with your values and is building toward your future. How can you support yourself with podcasts, books, or finding a mentor to empower you to expand and step more into a public role? This question might eventually lead you to take on a new career path or maybe even a promotion. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil/Capricorn speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. The Devil symbolizes struggles with a moral problem — or feeling overwhelmed with an international struggle. Gemini, in its shadow, is prone to gossip; and it’s important during this new moon to not succumb to gossip within the workplace. Set the intention to surround yourself with networks and colleagues who have integrity and to avoid office drama. Virgo & Virgo Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. You’re a natural leader, and this New Moon is bringing that out more in you. Network, connect, and create community. Your ideas should be shared and collaborated with others. Community and networking is a big focus for you now. Friendships may be changing, and you might find yourself working with groups that are new and different for you. This is good to help you explore new sides of yourself and get exposed to new ideas and visions. It's time to be present, connect with others, and become a conduit for connection and kindness. Give someone an encouraging word and help them feel connected and less alone. With the new moon, you are guided to bring hope and compassion back into your shared experience. Attend parties with an open heart, and open mind, and let your Light shine. The 11th house is ruled by Aquarius (The Star) with planetary rulers Saturn (The World) and Uranus (The Fool). The Star symbolizes one's wish granted, as it rules over the Law of Attraction. Whatever you put your intention towards, you can bring into your reality. If you are looking to be discovered and seen for your art and talents - now is the time to take action and set those intentions. This starts with being intentional with your thoughts, feelings, and who you surround yourself with. If you are an artist: writer, musician, artist, actor, etc., this is a time to set the intention to have yourself and your work seen. If you have an established network, use it. Cancer, Luna is your ruler. This New Moon is in your 12th house, the Pisces house. If you feel like you’re underwater, know that this will pass soon and use this time to connect to your spiritual and artistic side. Let yourself dream, meditate, and be inspired by all that’s coming through to you right now. You may be receiving downloads of information from past lifetimes or ancestral lineage, a trauma that needs to be healed and cleared. Focus on how this makes you feel. You need to move and feel your way through this information. The new moon in the 12th house also represents rest and reflection - this is a good idea to take some time for yourself and regenerate. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces, with the ancient ruler of Jupiter corresponding to the Wheel of Fortune in the Major Arcana. This cosmic wheel symbolizes the ever-changing cycles of life and the endings that come with them. You can tap into its fortune if you remain in alignment with Universal energy but resist it, and you can experience turbulent waters. Life is all about flow, so remember to center yourself within this infinite energy and trust that it will guide you. Cancer and Cancer Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space. Clear your mind, position the cards, and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (The High Priestess) in Gemini (The Lovers), illuminating the 12th House (Pisces/The Moon), with the ruling planet Neptune (The Hanged Man) or Jupiter (The Wheel of Fortune). The Moon (Pisces/12th House) Gemini's New Moon Ritual Timing The power of manifestation to give something form. A new cycle. The energy of new possibilities. Time to set your intentions for what you want to bring into your life. Each new moon is a new beginning. With each new beginning, we are asked to release unfinished business, draining distractions from the past - these must be neutralized or integrated into the new cycle for a healthy culmination and manifestation. New Moons often mean beginnings and planting new seeds. Write down what you desire to manifest over the next six (6) to eighteen (18) months. Gemini themes such as writing projects, short travels, connecting with your local community, as well as practicing automatic writing and telepathic communication. To align your intentions with the new moon, select a time after the new moon alignment. Not before. Your desire is to have the moon ‘waxing’ / growing as you speak, write, and set your intentions. The most powerful manifesting period is the eight ( 8 ) hour window* that follows the exact new moon alignment. * if you cannot perform your ritual within the first 8 hours. You still have 60 hours after the exact New Moon alignment for manifesting Gemini Season New Moon Ritual Fig 62. Top view of an altar Mercury & Gemini [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Mercury and your ritual candle(s) for Mercury on the placement for Mercury. Place The Magician & The Lovers tarot cards on your altar, as well as symbols for Mercury and offerings to Mercury. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration Dill, Cinnamon, Labradorite) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition: Looking for a way to open up doors of opportunity? You can petition Mercury, the planetary ruler of Gemini, to work on your behalf. Mercury is the planetary ruler of Gemini and holds the power of communication, travel, job seeking, marketing, and quick cash. But that's not all. Mercury also brings mental focus and luck - a boost in whatever you strive for. Plus, Mercury can work with other planetary influences to give you even more outstanding results. Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: ● Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. ● Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. ● Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. ● Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can manifest in three days, three weeks, or three months. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. Exploring Gemini Season and New Moon through Journaling Gemini is a sign of communication and learning, representing our ability to adapt and connect with others. During Gemini season or a Gemini full moon, the universe may bring up issues related to your relationships and how you communicate with others. You can use tarot as a way to inspire journaling. Select a spread or layout that resonates with your current focus or intention. Shuffle the deck and draw a card, then reflect on its meaning and symbolism. Use the card as a starting point for your journaling and allow its imagery and message to inspire your thoughts and feelings. Explore the card's themes and messages in greater depth and consider how they relate to your experiences and challenges. Reflect on how the card may offer guidance or insights for your current situation and how you can integrate its message into your life. Light an orange candle and create a stimulating atmosphere by using fresh scents and lively music. Visualize yourself open and receptive to new ideas and perspectives, and draw strength from your ability to connect with others. Take this opportunity to reflect on your relationships and how you communicate with others. Open your journal and begin writing about your relationships and communication style. You may also want to consider any challenges or obstacles you have faced in connecting with others and brainstorm ways to overcome them. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you explore these themes. As you journey through Gemini season, it's a great time to reflect on your relationships and communication style. By taking some time to journal about these topics, you can gain a deeper understanding of yourself and your interactions with others. Here are some prompts to get you started: How do you communicate with others? What are your strengths and weaknesses in this area? ● Reflecting on your communication style and how it may affect your relationships with others. Do you tend to be more direct or indirect? Do you listen well or do you tend to dominate conversations? ● Thinking about any challenges you face when communicating with others, and how you work to overcome them. ● Reflect on any past communication failures or misunderstandings, and what you've learned from them. ● Consider any skills or habits you could work on to improve your communication with others. What do you value in your relationships? How do you show appreciation and support for the people in your life? ● Reflect on the qualities you appreciate in the people you're close to, and why these qualities are important to you. ● Think about the ways you show appreciation and support for the people in your life, and how these actions align with your values. ● Consider any changes you might make in your relationships to better align with your values. Are there any areas of your life where you feel isolated or disconnected? How can you work to build stronger connections with others? ● Consider any factors that may contribute to feelings of isolation or disconnection in your life (e.g. living far from loved ones, difficulty making friends, etc.) ● Think about steps you could take to build stronger connections with others and combat feelings of isolation. How do you handle conflicts or misunderstandings in your relationships? What strategies have been effective for you in the past? ● Reflect on past conflicts or misunderstandings you've experienced in your relationships and how you dealt with them. ● Consider any strategies or techniques you've found to be effective in resolving conflicts or misunderstandings, and why you think they were successful. ● Think about any changes you could make to your approach to conflicts or misunderstandings in the future to improve your relationships. heading: Exploring the Gemini/Sagittarius Polar Axis
body: It is significant to note that each zodiac season highlights the polarities of the season and of the full moon. Gemini season will allow you to explore the polarity between the Twins, Gemini, and the Archer/Centaur, Sagittarius. The signs Gemini and Sagittarius represent different methods of absorbing information and gaining an understanding of the world. The Gemini/Sagittarius polarity is associated with learning, collecting, and assimilating information. As Sagittarius observes the big picture, the sandbox Gemini focuses on the details that make up that picture, the grains of sand. In both cases, the objective is the same: to find the truth. Gemini is a dualistic sign. The Twins symbolize the interconnectedness of all things, and how we're never really separate. Gemini are Twins, the Two which are One. Gemini rules siblings, early environments, elementary education, your first language(s), and your neighborhood. Gemini teaches us about the activity of the mind, how we take in new experiences, the everyday magick of communication and expression. Gemini uses language to give names to objects, creating two (the object + name) from the one (object). Gemini relates bringing order to the chaos. Gemini teaches Sagittarius how to communicate. Sagittarius teaches us about Two becoming One. Sagittarius is the Centaur. The half-man, half-horse archer; symbolizes the Two as One. Sagittarius rules foreigners, foreign languages, education, and philosophy and guides you on a journey to expand your worldview. Sagittarius depicts the truth we create for ourselves and the journey we take to discover this truth. Sagittarius reminds Gemini not to lose sight of the big picture. This Sagittarius full moon brings together the energies of Gemini (sun) and Sagittarius (moon). As a result of the Gemini sun, you are encouraged to pay attention to details and make distinctions. As a result of Sagittarius's influence, you can remain open-minded, expand your thinking, and tap into your intuition to process events as they unfold. Balancing this energetic axis involves releasing the lower vibrational tendencies associated with each sign. Gemini's propensity for overthinking and becoming dispersed, and Sagittarius' tendency to over-rely on logic or sway towards excessive idealism, must be acknowledged and released. By aligning yourself with their higher frequencies, you're able to blend reason with intuition harmoniously, facilitating a more well-rounded worldview. It's an invitation to intimately acquaint yourself with these dual aspects of self—the logical mind and intuitive wisdom. By bridging these formidable energies, you empower yourself with the ability to perceive the world with a greater depth of understanding and insight. It's through this connection, this divine dance of duality, that you'll gain profound clarity about your unique role in the universe. Let this moment of cosmic alignment inspire you to harness the best of both energies. You're not just an analytical thinker or an intuitive feeler, but a harmonious blend of both, capable of perceiving and interacting with the world in a manner that enriches your life experience. Sagittarius Full Moon Full moons are high tides of power, amplifying and creative. The full moon is a time to celebrate and harvest our previous new moon intentions; otherwise, the full moon is a time to make energetic adjustments to align ourselves to call in our intentions. The full moon is a time of celebration and gathering. We sync to the cycle with community, nature, and Spirit. We gather to clear energy, raise energy, gain clarity, set intentions, process symbols, and connect with nature, the Divine, and our Higher Self. Sagittarius represents lifes’ awareness. A natural philosopher, Sagittarius embarks on a relentless pursuit to unravel the truth and wisdom nestled within life's mysteries. This sign is synonymous with intellectual exploration, consistently probing the essence of reality and viewing the world through a variety of perspectives. During the Sagittarius Full Moon, we are beckoned to reflect upon the puzzles woven into our own life stories. It's a celestial invitation to learn from our experiences, opening doors for healing, breakthroughs, and fresh directions of awareness. This Full Moon illuminates our minds and charts our paths, aiding our quest for deeper meaning from past wounds or fears. It guides us in unraveling the larger vision and spiritual lessons embedded within these experiences. Consider the instance of a past relationship that ended in heartbreak, leaving you with lingering emotional wounds. The pain felt immense, the memories probably still vivid. The Full Moon in Sagittarius, however, encourages you to re-examine such an experience from a different perspective. While it was undoubtedly painful, this experience, when seen through the lens of wisdom, can reveal profound lessons. Perhaps it taught you about your emotional needs, giving you a clearer understanding of what you value in a relationship. Or maybe it underscored the importance of open communication, prompting you to prioritize dialogue and mutual understanding in your future relationships. Perhaps it even helped you discover an inner strength you didn't know you possessed, the fortitude to recover, rebuild, and open your heart to love again. Each of these epiphanies serves as a vital chapter in your personal story. They stand as the silver linings amid the storms, the concealed treasures mined from the bedrock of challenges. Such transformative revelations are precisely what the Sagittarius Full Moon calls forth. This phase represents a time when the metaphorical flames of the Sagittarius Full Moon serve to light up the shadowy corners of our lives that are often overlooked or sidestepped. Like a torchbearer guiding us through the darkness, this Full Moon enables us to seek out and discover the hidden wisdom, if we only dare to question and explore. Sagittarius, the celestial storyteller, is governed by the expansive planet Jupiter. As such, this phase is energized with the qualities of truth, prosperity, and expansion. Under the illuminating glow of this Full Moon, we are gifted with the opportunity to reflect on our soul’s journey and narrative. It's a time to ask, "What is the story I wish my life to tell?" Step into the role of the narrator of your own life's tale. Define your intentions and bravely articulate your truth, breathing life into the story you envision for your journey. Under the illuminating influence of this Full Moon, let go of any limiting narratives you may have internalized, those stories that hinder your spiritual and intellectual growth. Voice your intentions clearly, and unapologetically express your truth. During this Full Moon phase, seize the opportunity to dismantle any self-imposed barriers that may have been limiting your spiritual and intellectual growth. These might be internalized beliefs about your abilities, preconceived notions about what you can achieve, or even fears about stepping outside of your comfort zone. This is the moment to challenge these barriers, to question their validity, and to liberate yourself from their constraining grasp. This Full Moon presents you with an opportunity to harness the inquisitive energy of Sagittarius—to investigate, question, and expand—propelling your understanding of life and your distinct role within the grand cosmic ballet. This might involve diving into subjects you've always been curious about, asking probing questions about the world around you, or seeking growth through new experiences. For example, you might have been curious about the culture of a far-off country. This could be your chance to read books about it, talk to people from there, learn the language or even plan a future visit. Perhaps you've been fascinated by a philosophical question. Why not dive into texts or discussions that could provide insights, or simply meditate on the question and listen to your own intuition? The spirit of Sagittarius encourages you to let your curiosity lead the way, like an internal compass guiding you towards new discoveries. It pushes you to draw upon your wisdom, gained through your unique life experiences, to inform and shape your future path. This isn't about conforming to someone else's idea of what your life should be, but about shaping a path that's authentic and resonates with your true self. And, just as every Sagittarius is a natural storyteller, let your story unfold in its own, unique way. Maybe it's a story of resilience, of a deep-seated curiosity, of a quest for wisdom, or a combination of all three. The vibrant colors of your life experiences, the depth of your personal growth, and the breadth of your explorations—all these elements contribute to your one-of-a-kind narrative. This Sagittarius Full Moon is the perfect stage to honor your story, embrace your personal evolution, and celebrate the vibrant hue of your unique life.

heading: Sagittarius Full Moon Actions & Intentions
body: During the Sagittarius full moon, you have the opportunity to delve into your spirituality, examine your philosophies on life, speak your truth, and consider the concept of reincarnation. This is also a time to release any triggers from this life or past lives that may be holding you back. By doing this inner work, you can gain a deeper understanding of yourself and your place in the world. Take some time to sit with the question of what you can release in your life to create more space and abundance. This might include physical possessions, unhealthy habits, or negative thought patterns. Be honest with yourself about what is truly serving you and what is holding you back. I release the belief that there is not enough for me and cultivate an abundance mindset. I understand that there is more than enough abundance in the world for me to thrive and be successful. I am grateful for the abundance that surrounds me and I trust in the abundance that is yet to come. I am worthy and deserving of abundance in all areas of my life and I release any limiting beliefs or blocks that prevent me from experiencing abundance. I am confident in my ability to attract abundance into my life and I am open and receptive to all the abundance that is coming my way. Connect with the Jupiter energy – During Sagittarius season, you can align yourself with the energies of Jupiter, the planetary ruler of Sagittarius. Jupiter is associated with expansion, growth, and abundance. Take some time to connect with the energy of Jupiter and set intentions around growth, abundance, and expansion. Create an altar – To create an altar; you can gather items that have personal meaning or significance. You might also include symbols that represent your intentions or desires. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Reflect on where you were six months ago – What you were manifesting and striving for Take stock of your progress and make any necessary adjustments. Be mindful – Observing your thoughts, experiences, and observations in a journal can be a powerful way to gain insights into your own inner landscape. You might also consider using tarot cards or other divination tools to help you explore your inner world. Collecting items – Pens, paper, tarot cards, candles, incense, and herbs can be a way to create a sense of ritual and intention as you work through your full moon intentions. You might consider incorporating other elements, like crystals or sound healing tools, into your altar. Set the intention to speak and live in truth – Speaking your truth is an important aspect of self-expression and authenticity. During this season, make an effort to be mindful of the words you use and the messages you are conveying. Avoid lying or speaking with omission, and see how your world changes when you are more honest and authentic in your interactions. Consider how you can tell your truth more fully. This might involve speaking up for yourself in situations where you have felt silenced, sharing your thoughts and feelings with others, or simply being more authentic in your interactions. Set intentions to expand your horizons – Exploring different cultures, foreign foods, and foreign languages can be a way to expand your mind and broaden your horizons. You might consider traveling to a new place, trying new foods, or learning a new language. All of these experiences can help you see the world in new and exciting ways. Reflect on your beliefs and values – Sagittarius is a sign of exploration and seeking truth. Take some time to reflect on your beliefs and values and consider whether they are still serving you. Are there any beliefs or values that you need to let go of in order to align with your true self? Set intentions for personal growth and self-improvement – A time for expansive thinking, creating opportunities, and blessings by clearing any mental or emotional barriers that may be holding you back from realizing your full potential. What areas of your life do you want to focus on improving? What steps can you take to support your growth and development? Set intentions to release a scarcity mindset and welcome abundance – A time for wealth, long-term success, and abundance (not quick cash) by releasing any limiting thoughts or behaviors that may be standing in the way of your financial prosperity. Embrace adventure and exploration – Sagittarius is a sign of adventure and exploration, and this is a great time to embrace new experiences and adventures. Whether it's traveling to a new place, trying a new hobby, or simply stepping outside your comfort zone, take some time to embrace new experiences and expand your horizons. Release limiting beliefs – Sagittarius is a sign of expansion and growth, and this is a great time to let go of any limiting beliefs or thoughts that are holding you back. Set the intention to release any beliefs that are no longer serving you and embrace a mindset of growth and abundance. Cultivate gratitude – Sagittarius is a sign of abundance, and this is a great time to cultivate a sense of gratitude for all that you have. Take some time to reflect on the things in your life that you are grateful for and set the intention to cultivate an attitude of gratitude. Connect with your higher purpose – Sagittarius is a sign of meaning and purpose, and this is a great time to connect with your higher purpose. Take some time to reflect on your passions and interests and consider how you can align your actions with your higher purpose. Find a mentor – A time to find a mentor, teacher, knowledge, and pursue higher education by letting go of any doubts or fears that may be preventing you from seeking out these opportunities. Explore the mysteries of life and re-incarnation – A time to explore re-incarnation, past life rituals, and past life meditations by releasing any past traumas or negative experiences that may be impacting your present life.

heading: Sagittarius full moon horoscopes & tarotscopes
body: s Full moons illuminate that unconscious and that which is unseen. The full moon shines a light on the shadows of self. What you wish to avoid repeating needs to be released now. Forgive yourself for what you didn't know how to do and didn't know you held power to do until now. Forgiving yourself for any generational conditioning that was passed down to you. Sagittarius seeks the truth. Ruled by Jupiter, this Sagittarius full moon awakens the old soul within you and moves you to seek adventure, wisdom, and the deeper meaning behind life and your purpose. With the Sagittarius full moon's opposition to the Sun in Gemini, your thinking is called to expand and optimize your opportunities. As with Gemini, Sagittarius encourages you to explore. It urges you to travel, open your mind to new worlds, and embrace new cultures. The optimistic and cheerful Sagittarius spirit inspires you to think of the world as one connected whole. With Sagittarius's high-end energy, you can view life as a never-ending quest for knowledge. There is always something to discover, learn, and new adventures awaiting. Currently, you are experiencing opposing energies, with the Sun in Gemini and the full moon in Sagittarius. As the Sun sits in Gemini and the full moon sits in Sagittarius, you can shed their shadows and integrate their higher vibration. With the power of this full moon, you can shift stagnant energy that kept you in any thought loops, blocking your efforts to grow and manifest your intentions. The energy shadow of Sagittarius can make you lose trust in yourself, your journeys, and the universe. Slipping into the shadow of Sagittarius, you can lose faith in your path and experience an existential crisis, worrying whether your life has a purpose and whether everything you've experienced has a deeper meaning. The Sagittarius full moon brings teachings that life's journey is not about ignoring the problematic parts of life but about finding peace in them. Your life is a constant journey toward growth, which means there will always be some challenges and growing pains along the way. But through that pain, you can find wisdom and learning. You're constantly evolving, and life is continually changing. So, rather than resisting those dynamics or feeling helpless, embrace them. Find the lessons, grow from the experience, and emerge with a stronger faith and belief in your internal flame and drive. This full moon in Sagittarius is about facing your fears and transforming them into wisdom. Rather than running from them, use them as an opportunity to grow. Fear is a normal part of being human, but it doesn't have to control you. Fear can live in your body, a powerful subconscious motivator, teaching you more about yourself and your blocks. Fear can bring you wisdom, helping you understand yourself more deeply. Fear can sometimes be an insidious force, working its way into your life and stopping you from living your fullest potential. But when you let it, it can also lead you to a path of growth and wisdom. The full moon in Sagittarius is a time to tap into your intuition and higher guidance. May you embrace the power of this moon and allow it to guide you toward transformation and expansion. This full moon is when you can dig deep and uncover any fears holding you back. Once you identify these fears, you can work to release them and replace them with more supportive beliefs. The Sagittarius full moon can help you determine which fears you must let go of and which can lead you astray from life's adventure. It also sheds light on your limiting beliefs, allowing you to reframe any negative self-talk that holds you back from embracing your sense of wonder and adventure and believing that the best is yet to come over the horizon. You can use your horoscope as a guide to what area of your life is being illuminated and use that as a guide for your full moon ritual. If you are unfamiliar with the twelve houses and what it means to have your 1st or 2nd house illuminated by the new or full moon, read foundation two for the fundamentals.

heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Sagittarius full moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cars from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Gemini Season, the sun is in Gemini (The Lovers), opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Sagittarius (Temperance). Begin by finding the Sun (Sun), The Lovers (Gemini), High Priestess (Moon), and then Temperance (Sagittarius). For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the full moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 7th position, select either a card representing your sun sign or a card from the second pile, which contains the court cards and the Minor Arcana; use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. Tarotscope Key 2. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the sun is in 4. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in 6. The tarot card the corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house 7. The tarot card the corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign Ex: The Lovers (Gemini), during Gemini season Ex: Temperance (Sagittarius), during Sagittarius full moon Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries 1. The Sun (Sun) 3. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated or a supporting card, from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house Sagittarius (Nov. 22 - Dec. 21) & Sagittarius Rising - Full moon in the 1st House The Sagittarius full moon is illuminating your 1st House of Self. It's time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. Focus on how you see yourself rather than how others see you. With this Sagittarius full moon's opposition to the Sun in Gemini, you are being called to expand any rigid, limiting, outdated thoughts that have held you back. full moons are a time of illumination, shining a light even into the depths of your shadow, allowing you to witness your whole self. This full moon may bring a deeper understanding of the parts of yourself you've been hiding, who you are, and who you have grown into. This is a time of celebration, an ideal time to celebrate all that you are. Aries rules the 1st house and corresponds to the Emperor in major arcana. Aries grants you the energy, courage, and wisdom to tackle any challenge. Use this energy on the full moon to face your fears, overcome adversity, and commit to one path and intention until it's fully manifested. Then move on to your following intention and goal. This will help expand your spirit to your full potential. Sagittarius & Sagittarius Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this full moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) in Gemini (The Lovers) opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Sagittarius (Temperance), illuminating the 1st House (The Emperor/Aries), with ruling planet Mars (The Tower). For the 7th position, place one card from the Minor Arcana to give you further insight. 2. The Lovers (Gemini) 4. Temperance (Sagittarius) 6. The Tower (Mars) 1. The Sun (Sun) 3. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The Emperor (Aries/1st house) 7. {extra card} Scorpio (Oct. 23 - Nov. 21) & Scorpio Rising - Full moon in the 2nd House The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 2nd House of Disposable Income and Foundation. Sagittarius is a truth-seeker, and the truth is it's time to do some accounting. Take stock of the financial lessons (positive and negative) you've learned these past six months. The full moon in the second house is an opportunity to reflect on your income and security and to re-examine your views on money, finances, and debt. The full moon shines a spotlight on your wallet and budget, showing you where you can make gains or need to make necessary adjustments. You may be reassessing how secure you feel financially, and take this time to see what steps you need to take to create more of a supportive financial foundation. The full moon guides you to shift and let go of critical thoughts that sabotage your self-worth and self-esteem. The more you commit to yourself in the next six months, the more you'll see your investments and income growth. Taurus rules the 2nd house, and with the Sagittarius moon activating your second house, you realize you need a firm foundation to expand. This is a powerful time to remember that your self-worth comes from within. If you're feeling stuck, you must create a strong foundation. This month you thrive with routine and rituals, reinforcing your subconscious that your self-worth comes from knowing that you can always rely on yourself. So long as you feel worthy of it, you have the potential to be abundant in any energy. Scorpio & Scorpio Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this full moon. The full moon illuminates, and in the third house, this energy can manifest as a change in your local environment: renovation, renovation to your favorite shop/coffee house/store or gym, or perhaps one of your local destinations closes its doors. Sagittarius seeks the truth, and this full moon can illuminate or highlight communication/information/gossip previously in the shadows. This is a beautiful week to celebrate your siblings and/or social media accomplishments (especially if you're in marketing). This is also an excellent time to communicate and clear up any misunderstandings or falling-outs you may have had with your siblings. Gemini rules the third house and corresponds to The Lovers in the Major Arcana. This is a great time to associate with expanding knowledge. You have an innate thirst for information and love to share what you've learned with others. During this Sagittarius full moon, you may have an insatiable desire to learn and to share what you've learned with others. So you must remember that not everyone agrees with your passions, but those who do could be your biggest supporters. Don't be afraid to put yourself out there. Share your ideas and listen to your partners in theirs so you can all work together to expand. Libra & Libra Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this full moon. The energy can manifest in challenging family dynamics and healing between family members. It's also possible that your family may need more for you. Sagittarius is the truth seeker and storyteller. This full moon is here to help you better learn, understand, and hopefully heal a wound from your past, childhood, or family history. The 4th house is a Karmic house, bringing family situations to the surface for more profound understanding to learn and then release. It's also possible you recently moved, need to move closer to family, or are settling into a new home. This Sagittarius moon asks you to expand and leverage your Virgo qualities of cleaning and organizing your space to grow. Over these next six months, cultivate actions that facilitate peace in your home and family environments. The Sagittarius full moon in the 4th house brings positive movement and expansion when you channel your energy to cultivate a healthy home life. During this full moon, focus on things that feel like home to expand your energy. Different places feel like home at different times. Experiment. You grow through quiet time in the right environment and with supportive people. During this full moon, whether biological or soul family, family is important to you. Full moons are also a time of celebration; celebrate ad cherish the people in your life and rely on them to pull you out of your cave or welcome them in; if the weather isn't right for an outing. Buried emotions surface as you re-evaluate what brings you creative and emotional fulfillment. Jupiter, the planetary ruler of Sagittarius, asks that you expand, take up space, and think big. Whatever resistance you feel towards being seen, lean into it and figure out what there is to learn. This full moon illuminates the importance of believing in your divine creative gifts and visions. You're sourcing inspiration from your past to create your present and future. Be uniquely yourself, and build trust in the process of your creative self-expression. The fifth house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the major arcana. The Sagittarius full moon in the fifth house asks that you honor your Strength, power, and potential as a leader. On this full moon, dare to show your heart. If you dare to be yourself and follow your heart, you can step into your most authentic self. Hermits are the keeper of wisdom. A true teacher shows how to find the answers within oneself instead of giving the answer. The full moon in Sagittarius is a time to trust yourself and what you have to offer. Trust yourself, and trust in the healing power of your presence and touch. You have the power now to break free from any conditioning and embrace your true potential. Take time to reflect on any debt or shared resources holding you back, and take steps and address how you can free yourself from these obligations. This full moon illuminates how you've healed and how this healing has transformed you. This is a time to prioritize your mental, emotional, and physical health over the next six months. This full moon, ruled by Jupiter, asks you to expand; continue to let go of that small version of yourself. Don't fear what you might transform into. You are much more expansive and empowered than you realize. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the major arcana. This energy can manifest as a separation or 'death' from one's old self or old life, a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle, or a time to explore your shadow and fears to allow for release and transformation. In your 8th house, the Sagittarius full moon is a time to reflect upon your fears. It's a time to delve deep into the mysteries of life and explore all the hidden corners of your soul. Now is the time to follow that path if you're feeling called to shamanism, astrology, tarot, or psychology. You may even decide to become a healer or a teacher. At any moment, you can find the brighter side of even the darkest topics and add a little lightness to the conversation. On this full moon, meditate on your fears and notice how they affect your mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Notice which fears hold you back and which are limiting you. Once you identify these fears, take steps to strengthen your belief in yourself and your intuition. Let yourself be guided and inspired by your own intuition. Honor your sacredness, and embrace the wisdom and power that flows from within. Let it remind you that you're here to grow, evolve, and expand. This can leave you confused and uncertain, but that's also what makes it so attractive. It makes you question. This full moon illuminates the importance of those you surround yourself with. You seek community and friendship, and you're ready to release any false friends or networks that do not support your purpose or the purpose of the greater good. Stay focused on what's working in your projects and relationships, and gently release anything that is not working. This full moon gifts awareness of the social structure you have cultivated for yourself and a time to enjoy those you choose to surround yourself with. The 11th house is ruled by Aquarius, your sign, and corresponds to The Star in the major arcana. This full moon teaches you to expand through unique experiences, embracing your unconventional ideas, which you do naturally. You can reach your full potential by embracing and sharing these ideas with the world. You may start a business that helps the world innovate with new technology and progressive ideas. The full moon lets you release the fear of stepping into your uniqueness and full potential. Aquarius & Aquarius Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this full moon. This may be a more emotional time than usual, as dreams, creativity, illusions, and loss surround you now. You may receive downloads of information from past lifetimes/ancestral lineage and the trauma that needs to be healed, cleared, and released. This full Moon signals a time for stillness within yourself and observation. Reflect on any deep purging you've done, and reflect on what you want to call in to fill the space. Release your need to be in control, and allow yourself to flow with the current of whatever is unfolding. No time is wasted when you are in flow with the Universe and being guided towards a life built on truth and your greater and true happiness. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces and corresponds to the Moon in the major arcana. The Moon symbolizes mysticism, lunar rituals, and being drawn to the magick of the Moon. With the Sagittarius full moon in your 12th house, you are asked to expand spiritually, connect with your divine wisdom, and heal others. Pisces gives access to the unseen worlds in which healing and regeneration occur, allowing you to be still within the oneness of the cosmos, remembering that you are more than just a physical being. If you're feeling blocked or uninspired, try cleansing your energy and creating an altar to honor your magick. Doing so will recharge your spiritual batteries and provide you with much-needed inspiration. Stay open, be still, and surrender — you never know what wisdom and healing you might receive.
