heading: Sagittarius Full Moon Ritual
body: “I release everything either known or unknown to me that has been blocking me from receiving, feeling, and walking in my strength and authority. I trust and discover strength in my body, mind, self, and spirit. I call in my power and walk in my strength.” - A prayer for release Fig 63. Top view of an altar to Jupiter and Sagittarius [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Jupiter and your ritual candle(s) for Jupiter on the placement for Jupiter. Place The Wheel of Fortune, Temperance tarot cards on your altar, as well as an offering to Jupiter. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration St. Johns wort) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – Petition Jupiter, the planetary ruler of Sagittarius, when asking for justice, legal matters/contracts, to be seen fairly, for blessings both material and spiritual, good fortune, health and prosperity. Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: ● Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. ● Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. ● Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. ● Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. *** Cancer Season: June 21 – July 22nd The 4th House, Luna the Planetary Ruler Empathy, Nurturing your Inner Child “If you want others to be happy, practice compassion. If you want to be happy, practice compassion.” - Dalai Lama Cancer season activates our instinctive need to feel safe, and seek the places where we belong. The energies of Cancer reconnects us with our emotional body and the Universal womb of our collective becoming. Here we will learn how to better nurture and mother ourselves. This is a time of rebirthing. Planetary Ruler – Luna / The Moon New Moon – Cancer Full Moon – Capricorn Day of the Week – Monday (ruled by Luna) Archetype – The Mother Element – Water Tarot – The Chariot Body – Womb, Stomach, Breasts, Ribs Affirmation – I feel … Welcome to Cancer season, a time to reflect on the messages and information learned in Gemini season. Cancer, ruled by Mother Moon/Luna, teaches how to reflect upon and integrate the information gathered. Ask yourself how you feel, and what things mean to you. Cancer, after all, corresponds to the flowing energy of oceans, streams, and rivers; this continual movement reflects the continual task of tending to our own inner currents. Emotions come in waves and you are asked to surrender to them. Just as the gentle moon tugs at the tides, Cancer encourages you to tune into the ebb and flow of your own emotions. Like the rhythmic movement of oceans, streams, and rivers, this astrological sign mirrors the dynamic energy of constant motion, symbolizing the perpetual task of tending to your inner currents. Your emotions, much like the waves, crest and crash upon the shores of your being, urging you to surrender to their transformative power. During this season, it is vital to ask yourself how you truly feel and to explore the deeper significance of your experiences. Cancer's intuitive energy beckons you to dive beneath the surface, delving into the depths of your emotions and nurturing a profound understanding of their meaning in your life. Just as the moon guides the tides, Cancer guides you in navigating the vast ocean of your own inner world. It is through this surrender to your emotions, by allowing yourself to be carried by their currents, that you can truly honor the essence of Cancer season. Embracing the ebb and flow of your feelings, you discover the wisdom and insight they hold, enabling you to navigate the ever-changing landscape of your emotional terrain. So, as you embark on this sacred journey through Cancer season, immerse yourself in the watery realm of emotions, surrendering to their transformative power. Through reflection, integration, and gentle surrender, you honor the flowing essence of Cancer and nurture the nourishing waters of your own soul. Cancer season is also a time to acknowledge the four elements. Aries season brought the awareness of the fire element; Taurus season's earth element brought knowledge of the physical body; the mind became the focus during Gemini's air season; and now, a deeper awareness of the emotional body comes with Cancer's water element. Now, through the alignment of all four elements, you learn to create an emotional container that serves as, a happy home for manifesting. Following Gemini season's union of Aries' Martian masculine and Taurus' Venusian, Cancer season teaches the importance of the emotionally-secure container we call home. Think of the Cancerian crab that seeks refuge in its shell; here is where the right emotional vibration is cultivated to birth your manifestations. Cancer, and Mother Moon, gift lessons to increase the capacity to emotionally nurture, nest, and embody unconditional love and compassion — qualities that come more naturally from the sense of home afforded by an emotionally secure space. This is a time to gently and lovingly surrender to the truth of what is, allowing the mystery to unfold. Cancer is the Queen of the zodiac, a gently nurturing Universal mother that creates a safe space. Her energy and teachings help you to access deeper capacities for unconditional love. This is also an ideal time to help heal family dynamics. Often, at this time, the Universe will ask you to work through childhood memories that may be hindering your advancement. In your natal chart, Cancer indicates where you feel deeply, focusing on nurturing, developing life tools, and creating a safe and supportive environment for your advancement. It is the 4th sign in the twelve-wheel Cosmic being, when themes of home, family, self-care, self-love, empathy, and nurturing ourselves, our relationships, and the emotional body. The season teaches that by nurturing space and generating love and compassion, you, too, can birth your intentions. The collective focus for Cancer Season is to rediscover how to nurture yourself and others. When you take the time to heal your emotional bodies, what is that you desire to feel about yourself and your life? “Feel everything, because you’re healing. And, you are allowed to experience all your emotions at once or in waves. Feelings give you the permission to start the process of making your way back home to yourself.” - Alex Elle How can I shed any identities that no longer resonate with my spirit? Where is the imbalance in my thoughts? What qualities make a good mom? Why are these important? How can I better listen to my body, gut feelings, and emotions? Where do I feel most at home? When and where do feelings of insecurity and emotional vulnerability surface? I set the intention to learn the necessary life skills to re-parent and nurture myself. Cancer Light and Shadow Be mindful of lingering in the energies of Cancer's shadow. Unevolved Cancerian energy can be codependent, oversensitive, and prone to the victim mentality — blaming others and complaining. Without a connection to Spirit, this can mean manipulative, passive aggressive behaviors and the sort of overbearing overprotectiveness that keeps others dependent on you (rather than learning to do for themselves). Yet at the evolved end, Cancer energy is the ultimate mother figure: nurturing and caring while maintaining healthy boundaries and without sacrificing self-care. ​ Cancer Light & Strength — Self-Care, Motherhood, Nurturing Cancer Shadow & Weakness — Emotional manipulation, passive aggression, overbearing overprotectiveness that keeps others dependent on you ♋ Cancer Season, Solstice, The 4th House And Luna ♊ The symbol of Cancer ( ) bears a resemblance to that of Gemini ( ): two circles connected by two pathways bridging the heavens with the material world. (As above, so below.) However, Cancer's symbol separates the pathways to signify the creation of space necessary for you to nurture the seed of manifestation. This is where the energy of manifestation, still unformed, can gestate in the Universal Womb - a cocoon of security and unconditional love in which to nurture a healthy emotional body. This is also where masculine and feminine energies come together to create the space - or home - for manifestation. It is a time of not knowing and trusting the process: it is unknown whether the seed will take root and mature, only that Cancer teaches you to create the optimal space for it to do so. The fourth house, also known as the "angle of the foundation," represents your home, family, and roots. It is associated with the element of Water, which symbolizes emotions and the unconscious mind. This house reveals your sense of belonging, family dynamics and upbringing, and relationship with home. It also represents your emotional foundation and sense of security. Luna is the Planetary Rule for Cancer season. Luna is the messenger of our subconscious; she is our creative source and connection to the dream world. Mondays are ruled by Luna. We set our intentions by the moon. She is our emotions. Mondays can set the emotional tone and rhythm of the week. Mondays and the hour of the moon are good times for resting, taking a break, meditation, and setting your intentions and emotional compass. Our understanding of time first began with observation and teachings of Luna and her relationship with Sol. We can observe the sun and moon (Day and Night. Light & Shadow). Then, we can observe the moon and quarter the lunar cycle: full moon, new moon, and two-quarter moons. From this quartering of the lunar cycle, we arrive at the 7-day week. This relationship and her phases are the archetypes for all cycles of a relationship. Witnessing her many phases and interpreting the dance and relationship with the Sun; she taught us about the natural Law of Rhythm and the Path of Unfoldment. The Law ruling over the natural cycles of life: birth, growth, death, decay. We see rhythms all around us in nature. We see it in the seasons and the different stages of natural development. The Moon represents the Law of Rhythm, the Law ruling over the natural cycles of life: birth, growth, death, and decay. We can see how the moon represents the Law of Rhythm with her lunar phases: waxing and waning, evolving and diminishing energies. She has the power over the cycle of the tides, and our emotional currents, manifestations, and growth cycles. On the solstice, you honor and celebrate the light. During the spring, the light of Sol ascends, reaching up towards the North Star (Spirit/Heaven/Divinity). During the summer solstice, it reaches the cosmic gateway and begins to turn, gifting you the longest day of light. As the sun turns, it begins its course of "light descending." As light descends to earth, it gives physical form to this light (the incarnation of Spirit, entering into the womb to take form). The planetary ruler of Cancer is Mother Moon. Like the moon, the female body has a natural rhythm that is often in sync with the moon (known as menstruation, moon cycles, etc.). As you pass through the gateway of the summer solstice, it is the gateway of incarnation. The solstice is a time to reflect, like the moon, which is a mirror, on where you came from. Reflect on your mother, childhood, Spirit, and source. Mother Moon holds up a mirror for you, asking you to look at yourself and connect with your true identity. To connect deeper with your emotional body and soul. She asks if you can heal the parts of yourself that cling to memories and emotions that have taken hold of you. What separates you from feeling and resting in your body, your emotional body, and your Spirit. Cancer welcomes a time of rebirth and reorienting yourself, like the turning of the Sol/Sun. No longer running away, it instead brings you back home. Back into your body and the place where you feel most like yourself. The fifth house asks you to rediscover and remember who you are. Cancer / The Chariot The Chariot is the seventh key of the Major Arcana. Here the Fool learns how to wield discipline to control her emotions and to make decisions based on the right action. Planetary Ruler – ☽︎ Luna Symbolism – The biga is the name for the two-horse chariot used in ancient Rome. On the day of his triumph, an army commander would ride through the streets of Rome in his chariot. Thus, the Chariot represents a spiritual victory. Cancer, associated with all mystical journeys on the quest to self-actualization, is the sign of the zodiac associated with the Chariot. In the sky, the constellation for Cancer looks like a 'Y'; a letter in Alchemy refers to the fusion of duality into oneness or the integration of opposites. Looking deeper, the moon and its ever-changing phases further reference duality and the impermanence of creation. The chariot's wheels each have eight spokes and is the same wheel seen in the Wheel of Fortune card. This reveals that the Chariot is imbued with right action, dedication, and energy; a symbol of how the exertion of free will can change the course of fate. The horses represent your animal drives which must be mastered at this time. Here, The Fool learns that the higher, divine nature is tempered by the lower, animalistic impulses. This push-and-pull is reflected in the pair of horses: the golden horse rears its head upwards towards ascension to the divine, while the darker horse pulls downwards towards the earthly, material realm. Their dark and light pairing indicates that the charioteer is teaching the Fool and each of you that opposing forces must be united to move forward. Astrology – The Chariot corresponds to Cancer. Cancer teaches the importance of creating an emotionally secure container or home and that, like the charioteer, you must learn to bridle your emotions. If you hold the reins of your emotions too tightly, you will be pent-up and rigid; if you hold the reins carelessly, you might lose control. Yet understanding and managing our emotions allows you to react according to the path we are on — which right action dictates is one that aligns with your inner values and truth — navigating forward with ease. By understanding your underlying motives and the driving forces that stir your emotions, you are better equipped to do so. Upright Meaning – Being active, in control, and taking the direction of one's life, needing to take control of one's emotions, forward motion, emotional control, willpower, direction, focus, ambition, willpower to overcome, progress, self-discipline, travel, victory, forward motion, taking direction in one's life, pregnancy, an arrival: guest or news, symbolizes a car or vehicle by land, new car, transportation & commuting, carpooling. Reversed – Being a passenger and allowing others to take control of their life, passive, lack of direction, lack of momentum or stuck, lack of control: emotional, physical and mental, emotional instability, a bumpy road, blaming others for your decisions or place in life, transportation or automotive troubles, needing a mechanic, symbolizes a car or any vehicle by land

heading: Cancer Season and Cancer New Moon: Actions and Intentions
body: I am deeply connected to the world around me, and I am seen and supported by those who matter to me. I am worthy of love and respect, and I choose to focus on cultivating a strong sense of self-love and self-worth. I am determined to follow my passions and pursue my dreams with enthusiasm, and I value the relationships in my life that bring joy and growth. I strive to be generous and kind towards others, and I actively work to let go of negativity and embrace a positive mindset. I believe in my own worth and my ability to create a fulfilling and meaningful life. Create an altar – Cancer season is a good time to create a sacred space for Luna, the planetary ruler of Cancer. To create an altar, you can gather items with personal meaning or significance. You might also collect items that symbolize Cancer and Luna. Set up the altar where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Observe – Record any symbolisms or messages you notice during this full moon. A journal is like a magick portal to your innermost thoughts and dreams. Every page is an invitation to explore, reflect, and express yourself meaningfully. Collect items – Grab a pen, paper, candles, incense, herbs, and symbolic objects to represent Cancer/Luna, like The Chariot, The High Priestess tarot cards, and the Planetary Kamea for Luna. Honor the Summer Solstice – Light a bonfire or campfire, especially near the ocean or a large body of water. This can be a meaningful and symbolic way to celebrate the longest day of the year. Connect with the Moon – Align yourself with the energies of Luna, Cancer's planetary ruler, on Mondays. You might do this by meditating on the Moon, keeping track of the phases of the Moon, or incorporating lunar symbols and imagery into your altar. Creating a safe and nurturing environment - Take time to cleanse your home, bedroom, car, and office, both physically and energetically. This can help to clear out any negative or stagnant energy and create a fresh, welcoming environment. Keep a dream journal – Record your dreams, thoughts, experiences, and observations in a journal every Monday. This can be a helpful way to track your progress and insights during Cancer season. Trust your gut – Trusting your gut instincts and listening to your body's needs means paying attention to your inner wisdom and taking care of yourself physically and emotionally. This may involve setting aside time for self-care, listening to your body's cues for rest and nourishment, and following your instincts even when it feels uncomfortable. Process your emotions – Find a healthy balance between your emotions and your thoughts. Allowing yourself to feel and process your emotions in a healthy way, rather than suppressing them or letting them control you. This may involve seeking support from friends, loved ones, or a therapist and finding healthy outlets for your emotions, like exercise or creative expression. Take a moment to listen to your body and emotions. Pay attention to what is holding you back and where you feel most at home. Remember to have patience with yourself and your journey during this time – Allow yourself the emotional space to process, release, learn, develop, and heal. Acknowledge and honor your emotions, and take care of yourself as you navigate through this emotional season. Nurture family relationships – During this time of the Cancer full moon, focus on nurturing your family relationships and creating lasting memories. Remember that family relationships are built on love and care, so make time for the people who matter most to you. Cancer New Moon: Embracing Emotions and Emotional Security The Cancer New Moon gifts us an energetic Universal womb to rebirth our emotional body. Ask yourself, “how can I free myself from distraction? Can I keep my own company and give myself space to feel my emotions?” Happy Cancer new moon. Cancer is the giver of the zodiac, it represents our emotional security, and how we nurture ourselves and others. It represents the mother, our home and family life, and our early childhood emotional conditioning. Which affects the balance of give and take in our relationships. Cancer can be prone to co-dependency, oversensitivity, blaming, complaining, and victim mentality when out of balance. Be mindful of lingering in the energies of Cancer’s shadow: emotional manipulation, being passive-aggressive, overprotection (overprotection where you do not share knowledge or life skills necessary for others “to do for themselves.” When in balance, Cancer is the ultimate mother figure; giving care and nurturance while maintaining healthy boundaries while maintaining self-care. This new moon will increase the intensity of these highlighted themes. During the Cancer new moon emotions are high, as we renegotiate our needs and open our hearts more deeply to what’s in front of us. Any cracks in the foundations of our relationships, work, and home environment will be brought to our attention; so we can make the necessary adjustments to create something stronger. This Cancer new moon highlights the importance of listening and validating emotions and asks that you try something new. Instead of saying, “It could have been worse,” instead say to yourself and others: “I can see you’re really upset,” “That must have been really hard," or “I’m here for you” When you invalidate feelings it creates a disconnect with your emotional body, self and a disconnect with those around you. Cancer season and the Cancer new moon, activate your instinctive need to feel safe and seek the places where you belong. During the Cancer new moon emotions are high, as you renegotiate your needs and open your heart more deeply to what’s in front of you. An essential source of information, to identify your true needs is listening to, and understanding your feelings. When you reject, ignore, or judge your feelings you invalidate them. Emotional invalidation can make you feel irrational, worthless, and unimportant. Sometimes we unintentionally emotionally invalidate ourselves and others when we try to lighten a stressful situation, “it could be worse" or "everything happens for a reason." While you and others may do this with good intentions, it can remove the space and time necessary to process, understand and identify your and others' emotions. If you feel as if your emotions have been invalidated, it could be because the other person is unable to process their own emotions, is distracted with their own problems, avoids responsibility, or is emotionally unavailable. None of these things make emotional invalidation less hurtful or confusing. Especially if you are doing it to yourself, and invalidating your own feelings. This Cancer New Moon asks that you make space for your emotions and others' emotions to exist. Any cracks in the foundations of your relationships, work, and home environment will be brought to your attention; so you can make the necessary adjustments to create something stronger. New information may come through, which could be painful to hear. This is most likely the case, as the news each day is more shocking. Cancer, ruled by Luna herself, is our Universal Mother; encouraging you to review past choices and see how you can make mature choices in the present and future moments. The Cancer new moon opens up space to heal and nurture yourself and others. Where in your bodies do you hold pain? Where in your bodies do you hold your emotions? Where in your bodies do you hold the pain of others? Take time during this new moon to feel and listen to your emotional body. If s/ he needs to cry, allow it. Allow the tears to flow, wash over, and cleanse your Spirit. The Cancer new moon welcomes you to experience rebirthing and to reorient yourself. No longer running away, instead brings you back home. Back into your body, and the place where you feel most like your true self. The energies of Cancer reconnect you with your emotional body and the Universal womb of your collective becoming. Now is a time when you will learn how to better nurture and mother yourself. This is a time of rebirthing. Our collective focus for this Cancer new moon is to rediscover how to nurture ourselves and others. How can you take the time to heal your emotional body? What do you desire to feel about yourself and your life? How can you heal the parts of yourself that cling onto memories and emotions that have taken hold of you - that separate you from feeling and resting in your body, emotional body, and Spirit? During this Cancer new moon, let's explore how we communicate, and process information. How are you expressing yourself? From the words you use, body language, and online social footprint. Take this time to reflect on and update your message. Enjoy the playfulness and maturity that this new moon is ushering in. We are gifted this season to re-discover and remember who we are. We seek what truly nourishes us, no longer seeking distractions that keep us separate from our emotions, Spirit, and Self. New moons are a perfect time to set intentions and plant seeds for a new cycle of growth. The intention for the Cancer new moon is to gently and lovingly surrender to the truth of what is, and allow the mystery to unfold and like the waves of the ocean, guide you forward. Be mindful of lingering in the energies of Cancer’s Shadow: Emotional manipulation, passive-aggressive, overprotection (overprotection where they do not share knowledge or life skills necessary for others “to do for themselves.” Cancer new moon & Tarotscopes Luna is the planetary ruler of Cancer, and this Cancer new moon may feel more significantly emotional. Cancer's essence is nurturing, caring, protecting, and supporting others. Cancer is ruled by the watery element of emotions. Everyone has emotions, but sometimes they overrule them with logic or thought. Emotions are powerful forces that can change your life. When you let your emotions guide you with compassion and understanding rather than judgment, they can lead you to people and places that can feel like home. They can guide you when you feel what your feelings are honestly telling you. Let the light of your life be transformed with ritual. The new moon is a great time to set intentions and focus on what you wish to bring into your life. By looking at where the new moon is activating in your chart, you can gain insight into which area of your life is ripe for manifestation. Use these horoscopes as a guide when setting your new moon goals and intentions. If you are still getting familiar with the 12 houses. and what it means to have your 1st or 2nd house illuminated by the new or full moon, read the chapter: foundation two for the fundamentals.

heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Cancer new moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes. I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 6-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Begin by finding the Sun (Sun), The High Priestess (Moon), and then The Chariot (Cancer). Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Cancer Season, the sun (Sun) and the moon (High Priestess) are in Cancer (The Chariot). For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the new moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 6th position, select either a card representing your sun sign or a card from the second pile containing the court cards and the Minor Arcana. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. Tarotscope Key 2. The tarot card that corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in, Cancer (The Chariot) Ex: The Chariot (Cancer), during Cancer full moon 1. The Sun (Sun) 3. The High Priestess (Moon) 6. The tarot card that corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house 7. The tarot card that corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries or a supporting card, from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance 5. The tarot card that corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house Cancer (June 21 – July 22nd) & Cancer Rising - New moon in the 1st House Happy Birthday Cancer! The Cancer new moon shines alight upon you, illuminating your 1st House of Self. This New Moon in your home sign creates some dynamic tension on how you communicate a new vision of yourself. Big changes are in store for you now in relationships and how you express yourself. The time has come for a full makeover of your identity and how you meet the world. This is the time to clarify what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take in life. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize on how to face and solve any challenges. With a New Moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This is a time of rebirth and redirection. Your intention for this New Moon is “to trust where your emotional and intuitive compass is taking you and be true to your inner guidance.” The 1st house is ruled by Aries (The Emperor), with the ruling planet Mars (The Tower). The Cancer (The Chariot) new moon in the 1st house can signal a time when you’re being Divinely guided, through symbols or dreams, to reconsider how you navigate and show up in the world. Cancer corresponds to The Chariot in the Major Arcana. The Chariot symbolizes being active, in control, and taking direction of one's life, as well as needing to take control of one's emotions. Aries represent new beginnings and karmic cycles. While the Emperor asks you to find and assert your individuality apart from external, socially defined norms, you may struggle with discomfort in exerting your individuality. The Cancer new moon is a time to set intentions to step firmly into your authority and power, cultivating a healthy self-image and personal responsibility. The new moon wants you to be your own source of recognition and control; instead of letting others dictate your worth and value. The Cancer new moon is a time to set intentions to control your actions, reactions, and momentum. Concentrate on how you picture yourself rather than how others see you; draw upon your own wellspring of internal support. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The sun (Sun) and moon (High Priestess) in Cancer (The Chariot); illuminating the 1st House (The Emperor/Aries), with ruling planet Mars (The Tower). For the 6th position, place one card from the minor arcana to give you further insight. 3. The Chariot (Cancer) 1. The Sun (Sun) 5. The Tower (Mars) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 6. Supporting card 4. The Emperor (Aries/The 1st House) Gemini (May 20th - June 20th) & Gemini Rising - New moon in the 2nd House The Cancer new moon illuminates your 2nd house of disposable income and foundation. There’s been a lot of activity in your sign over the last few weeks, and you are emerging with a new sense of who you are and what direction you want to take. Any behind-the-scenes work you’ve been doing will soon be noticed. This month and new moon are about reconnecting to your resources, finances, security, and your sense of self-worth. Taking time to realign your values is critical to your emotional well-being. Figure out what you value most, and find a way to allow yourself to receive both emotional connection and love, and physical support and abundance. Honoring your values, reworking your finances, and exploring your senses and sensuality is most important to you now. Your intention for this New Moon is “To explore value of healthy pleasure and sensation, and trust in the wisdom of my body” Money is more than just a physical exchange for your efforts - it's a representation of your worth, too. If you want to be successful, whether it means achieving your goals or creating a healthy, fulfilling life, you have to believe that you are worth it. It's time to start internalizing that you are worthy of financial and emotional stability and that success is achievable. And if you're having trouble believing in yourself, don't be afraid to ask for a mentor who can help guide you. The second house corresponds to The Hierophant in Major Arcana. The Hierophant teaches that there is more than just the material world; there is a divine ruler. As the High Priestess taught the Fool to discover spiritual wisdom from within, the Hierophant teaches the Fool to find spiritual wisdom from external sources: Spiritual leaders, mentors, ancestors, and community. The Hierophant's links to religion, knowledge, and traditions passed down through oral teachings parallel the "fixed" teachings that comprise our social and religious framework. The Hierophant teaches you to return to tradition; you may have expanded your horizons past your comfort zone, and now it's time to return to the familiar to re-frame your focus. Venus is the planetary ruler of the 2nd house, which corresponds to The Empress in the Major Arcana. During this new moon, you would benefit from the guidance of a financial planner, estate lawyer, or therapist. It's also possible your mother could play a significant role (alive or in memory) during this Cancer new moon. Gemini & Gemini Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. There's possibly a big reveal happening in your life at this time, and communication, perspective shifts, and new information stream into and swirl around you now. This information is to bring peace and clarity into your home, especially if it means making big changes in who's allowed in it. The third house is ruled by Gemini (The Lovers), with Mercury (The Magician) as its planetary ruler. The Lovers and The Magician alludes to the magick of connections. The new moon in the 3rd house invites you to seek support in your local community. Connect with friends, family, and neighbors to provide support and receive help in return. Whether it's to take on a new challenge, spark a creative idea, or just find someone to talk to who understands. If you're fortunate enough to have your needs fulfilled and still have something more to give, consider showing some kindness to those around you. With the new moon in the 3rd house, make the choice to find those who can help keep your energetic momentum growing - creating a harmonious flow of energy. Your intention for this New Moon is “to allow the flow of information to help remold and communicate your values and emotional expression.” Taurus & Taurus Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. The Hierophant (Taurus) and / extra card Aries (March 21st - April 19th) & Aries Rising - New moon in the 4th House The Cancer new moon highlights your 4th house and brings awareness of home, family, and security. You could be seeing some changes to your home and family situation right now, or assessing what provides you with a sense of comfort and security. Emotional security as well as physical security. You may be feeling more reclusive during this New Moon, but it’s helping you get clear on your own internal emotional process. Take this time to consider how family fits into your future and what steps you can take toward cultivating deeper and healthier family connections. You can't rewrite your family history, but you can become a source of strength and love for your loved ones. This Cancer New Moon is a reminder of the importance of understanding the dynamics of your family - so that you can learn from them, unburden them and be a support system for each other. Let's recognize what's arising, find healing within and show up for your loved ones during this time. The 4th house is ruled by Cancer and corresponds to The Chariot in the Major Arcana. The Chariot symbolizes being active, in control, and taking direction of one's life, as well as needing to take control of one's emotions. The Chariot is a powerful reminder that you control your actions, reactions, and momentum. And, for many, your Chariot is an extension of your home; where you transport your Self and things from one life event to another. The Chariot symbolizes the importance of having a safe and secure container to navigate life successfully. Your intention for this New Moon is, “to come back to your inner home and internal sense of safety and security. Here is where your power lies.” Aries & Aries Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. What fuels your spirit fuels your body.” - Carolyn Myss Intimacy, romance, children, and creativity are themes for this Cancer new moon in your 5th house. Love, relationships, children, creativity, and self-expression are at the forefront of this New Moon for you. How you identify with them will reshape you. Are you abandoning a part of yourself in order to receive love and validation? Intense feelings about your own worth and value may cause temporary emotional conflict. Returning to an old hobby or joyful pastime can help lift your mood. It’s important for you to stay connected to what you love. Having fun and enjoying yourself is your top priority. Let yourself play and remember what it’s like to be a child with curiosity. The 5th house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the Major Arcana. The Strength card reminds you of a sacred power, grounded in inner strength and trust, that comes from emotional mastery. The Strength card of the Golden Eclipse tarot illustrates the Fool sitting poised, channeling the energy of the Universe. The lion is a metaphor for the primal energies of the emotional body, the flames referencing its burning passions. Strength symbolizes being in tune with your inner creative flow when time seems to stand still. It symbolizes the power of channeling Source. When you focus on creating from a place of pure presence, you can tap into a field of awareness that unlocks all the infinite possibilities of creation. Your work will come alive and flow through you—not just by you. Your intention for this New Moon is “Use your natural charm, faith, and courage to express to those you love, you feel. Discover your inner child and nurture them in all the ways they wish. This allows true self-love and love of others to unfold naturally.” Pisces & Pisces Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. If you’ve been giving too much, now’s the time to focus on yourself. Pushing yourself ahead when it’s not your time to move will only slow you down in the long run. Anything arising right now is to help you break through disharmony and find your way back to health and a more balanced lifestyle. This includes your work environment and learning to balance work and self-care. The Cancer new moon, in your 6th house, reminds you that you always have the power to make new choices in your daily activities. Do you want to become a morning person? You can do it. You can also shift your daily commute to the office to incorporate a hybrid or fully work-from-home instead. The power is in your choice to choose. The Cancer moon reminds you that you can still find joy in your work, routines, and day-to-day life. If you feel unmotivated or disconnected from life, this full moon encourages you to incorporate daily habits to balance your body and mind. Reconnect with what inspires you and create daily practices that bring the spark and magick back into your life. The 6th house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit teaches you that the key to mastering the Self is to observe, be still, and practice silence. The full moon in your 6th house is a reminder that small, daily commitments and short-term goals are essential for overall health and wellness. You can learn a lot from observing your daily ritual, routines, and habits. The Magician, ruler of your 6th house, represents the power of manifestation through intention and action. Your 6th house, guided by Virgo and The Hermit, reminds you to focus on yourself, be mindful of your daily rituals, and use your willpower to create positive change in your life. Relationships in work and love are at the forefront for you now. Any issues and imbalances that haven’t been dealt with, will finally arise for resolution, or at least discussion. Truth is a priority in all relationships and now’s a good time to get all things out on the table. Some information might cause a little jolt or pain, but see it as a necessary step toward intimacy, or towards separation. The Cancer new moon in the seventh house is an excellent time to re-examine your relationship's current situation. Libra rules the 7th house and corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice wants you to find clarity, emotional balance, and fairness in relationships. Sometimes it's easier to be more compassionate to those in your intimate relationship than yourself. You can lend a sounding ear to your partner but then judge and criticize yourself for feeling emotional. Feeling bad is complicated enough on its own. Trying to repress or suppress those feelings only makes things worse. Instead, try accepting your emotions. Give yourself the same emotional support you would give another. Don't try to change or suppress your emotions - just allow them to be and allow yourself to feel them. Free up space to let your feelings pass through you without holding on to them or judging yourself for their intensity. If you're feeling stuck, ask yourself where you might be avoiding or denying the truth in your emotions. Then, take some time to look inside and get to the root of these issues. You can do this with the support of your friends and family and with a bit of self-compassion. Capricorn & Capricorn Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. You’re exploring topics of loss, control, surrender, and delving into your inner resources to help you get through a time of uncertainty. What you thought gave you security, may not be so anymore as you learn to access your deeper inner resources to pull you through challenges. The Cancer new moon is in your 8th house of transformation. It’s a time of transformation and trust in the unfolding of life. Areas of Intimacy and shared resources are your focus as you learn to trust in yourself most of all. Power dynamics may force you to look inside yourself and access that well of inner power and strength you may not have known you have. Step to that edge of discomfort, and let go of that small version of yourself. Build trust in yourself and trust outside yourself will naturally follow. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to the Death card in the Major Arcana. The 8th house also contains themes of occult studies, symbolism, and searching for the meaning behind signs and symbols. However, sometimes, searching for meaning in everything is a coping mechanism against the fear of uncertainty. It's human nature to dislike uncertainty. It's tempting to want everything to have an order and a purpose, but that's impossible. Life can be unpredictable, And uncertainty is an inevitable part of life. How you cope makes all the difference. Accepting smaller moments of uncertainty, you can learn to build your courage and inner strength to help you face it confidently when uncertainty arrives in big ways—as it will eventually. You’re pushing through some old limitations around personal accomplishments. If you feel like you’re taking a step back, it may be needed in order to help you reflect on what’s most important to you, and what you need most to help the long-term goal of success. Do they offer security, support, and an environment that will promote your well-being? Surveying the landscape of possibilities can help put you in the driving seat when it comes to making a wise career move. After all, only you know what will make you happy and fulfilled in the long run - so go with what works for you. The Cancer new moon is also a time to set intentions surrounding work-life balance. You can tap into its fortune if you remain in alignment with Universal energy but resist it, and you can experience turbulent waters. Life is all about flow, so remember to center yourself within this infinite energy and trust that it will guide you. Time to set your intentions for what you want to bring into your life. Each new moon is a new beginning. With each new beginning, we are asked to release unfinished business, draining distractions from the past - these are required to be neutralized or integrated into the new cycle for a healthy culmination and manifestation. New Moons often mean beginnings and planting new seeds. Write down what you desire to manifest over the next six (6) to eighteen (18) months. <> themes such as – nurturing family relationships, emotional awareness, nourishing, nurturing, belonging, healing, family & ancestor wounds, fertility, birth, motherhood, family, home, emotions, compassion, nurturing, self-care, and finding your “home”. To align your intentions with the new moon, select a time after the new moon alignment. Not before. Your desire is to have the moon ‘waxing’ / growing as you speak, write, and set your intentions. The most powerful manifesting period is the eight ( 8 ) hour window* that follows the exact new moon alignment. * if you cannot perform your ritual within the first 8 hours. You still have 60 hours after the exact New Moon alignment for manifesting

heading: Cancer New Moon Ritual
body: “Cancer season activates your instinctive need to feel safe, and seek the places where you belong. The energies of Cancer reconnect you with your emotional body and the Universal womb of the collective becoming. Here we will learn how to better nurture and mother ourselves. This is a time of rebirthing.” - Marie Satori Fig 64. Top view of an altar to Luna & Cancer [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place your ritual candle in the placement for Luna. Next to the ritual candle, place the Kamea for Luna, The High Priestess and The Chariot from the Golden Eclipse Tarot. Place items that correspond to Cancer. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration lavender) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – Petition Luna to set intentions. Luna assists with fertility, intuition, illusion, dreams & glamour – being seen as you’d desire. Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, dispose of the items appropriately. Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: ● Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. ● Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. ● Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. ● Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. Refill Your Emotional Cup Using Moon Water As you enter Cancer season, it's important to focus on nourishing and replenishing your energy. Cancer is the fourth sign of the zodiac and is associated with emotion, nurture, and self-care. To tap into the energy of Cancer, consider using moon water to cleanse and refill your energetic cup. To use moon water, start by placing it in an area of your home or life where Cancer rules in your natal chart. You can use astrology software to determine which house Cancer rules in your chart. Some examples include: Cancer in the natal 1st house: If Cancer is in your first house, place moon water into your bath and immerse yourself in it. This can help you connect with your emotions and promote self-care. Cancer in the natal 2nd house: If Cancer is in your second house, or work and resources, place moon water in a glass on your desk. This can help you focus on your financial and material needs while also connecting with your emotions. Cancer in the natal 3rd house: If Cancer is in your third house, drink a glass of moon water before important conversations to emphasize your communication and business skills. This can help you connect with your emotions and express them in a clear and effective way. Cancer in the natal 4th house: If Cancer is in your fourth house, nurture your home and family by placing moon water in your living room and kitchen. If you are female, you can also place it on your womb space. This can help you connect with your emotions and create a comfortable and nurturing environment for yourself and your loved ones. Cancer in the natal 5th house: If Cancer is in your fifth house, gift moon water to your children. Spray yourself with moon water before playing any water sports. Drink moon water before going to bed, to activate the creativity that lies within your subconscious. This can help you connect with your emotions and creativity. Cancer in the natal 6th house: If Cancer is in your sixth house, you do your best work when you feel comfortable. You are naturally empathic and easily absorb other people's energies. Use moon water to cleanse your home, work environment, and body regularly. This can help you connect with your emotions and create a comfortable and supportive work environment. Cancer in the natal 7th house: If Cancer is in your seventh house, relationships are important to you, and you gravitate to people with whom you can be of comfort too. Be mindful of over-mothering your significant other. Place moon water in your bedroom to enhance the energies of your significant relationships. This can help you connect with your emotions and create strong and nurturing relationships. Cancer in the natal 8th house: If Cancer is in your eighth house, place moon water on your altar to connect with the energies of astrology, the occult, and ritual. This can help you connect with your emotions and spiritual practices. Cancer in the natal 9th house: If Cancer is in your ninth house, place moon water on a book, photo, or map of a place that has called to you or that you are studying, and drink the water to absorb the energy from the subject matter. This can help you connect with your emotions and expand your knowledge and understanding of different cultures and subjects. Cancer in the natal 10th House: You are asked to connect emotionally to your work. You find success when there is meaning behind the work you do - you seek to fulfill your purpose and be of service to others, the community, by the avenue of the work you put out into the Universe. Place moon water on your desk, near your laptop (don’t spill it!). Cancer in the natal 11th House: Friendships and the emotional connections you foster from these relationships fulfill you. Gift moon water to close friends with whom you wish to deeper nurture your emotional connections. Cancer in the natal 12th House: The twelfth house is the house of karma. You may have had a challenging relationship with your mother, family members, or motherhood itself. During Cancer Season, focus on using moon water to heal patterns, reframe old narratives, and be your own mother. Use moon water as a spiritual tool for cleansing, and healing, drink it before meditation and place it next to your journal. Exploring Cancer Season And The New Moon Through Journaling Cancer is the sign of the Universal Mother, representing the energetic support and lessons that help us improve and heal our family relationships. During Cancer season or a Cancer full moon, the universe may bring up childhood memories and ask you to work through any issues that may be holding you back. You can use tarot as a way to inspire journaling. Select a spread or layout that resonates with your current focus or intention. Shuffle the deck and draw a card, then reflect on its meaning and symbolism. Use the card as a starting point for your journaling and allow its imagery and message to inspire your thoughts and feelings. Explore the card's themes and messages in greater depth and consider how they relate to your experiences and challenges. Reflect on how the card may offer guidance or insights for your current situation and how you can integrate its message into your life. Light a white candle and create a calming atmosphere by using incense and music. Visualize yourself channeling healing light from the moon down to the spirit and essence of your mother. Take this opportunity to forgive her for any mistakes she may have made, intentionally or unintentionally. Then, express gratitude for the role she played in bringing you into the world. After your visualization, open your journal and begin writing your letter to your mother. You do not need to send this letter, but the act of writing can be a powerful way to connect with your emotions and let go of any lingering pain or resentment. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you work through this process. As you journey through Cancer season, it's a wonderful opportunity to reflect on your relationships with your mother and the role that they have played in your life. By taking some time to journal about your experiences with your mothers, we can gain greater insight and understanding about yourself and your relationships. Here are some prompts to get you started: Exploring What Makes a Good Mother: What qualities do you believe make a good mother, and why are these important to you? Reflecting on Changes in Perception: How have your perceptions of your mother changed over the years, and how have the names and nicknames you've used for her evolved? Remembering Moments of Joy: What makes your mother happy, and can you recall specific memories of her laughing or smiling? Examining Familiar Phrases: What phrases or expressions does your mother always use, and how do they make you feel? Recalling Early Memories: Reflect on your earliest memories of your mother - what stands out to you the most about these memories? Expressing Unsaid Thoughts: Is there something you've always wanted to say to your mother but haven't had the chance to? Celebrating Support and Nurture: How has your mother supported and nurtured you throughout your life, and what skills or lessons has she taught you? Rewriting Difficult Memories: Write about a memory where you feel your mother could have done things differently, and then re-write the memory with a more positive outcome. Forgiving and Letting Go: Take some time to forgive your mother for any mistakes or missteps she may have made, and express this forgiveness in writing. Expressing Gratitude in a Thank You Letter: Write a thank you letter to your mother, expressing your gratitude for all that she's done for you. Write A Letter To Your Mother Journal, and write a letter to your mother as a way to heal and connect with your emotions. Take some time on a Monday, when the energies of Luna are strong, to focus on this exercise. Even if your mother is no longer living, you can still benefit from the process of writing a letter to her. If you have a photo of your mother, consider placing it in front of you as a visual anchor. Exploring the Qualities of a Good Mother: Take some time to reflect on your relationship with your mother (or mother figure). What are the most important memories you have with her? How has she influenced your life and who you are today? Writing a Letter to Your Mother: Write a letter to your mother (even if she is no longer alive) expressing your love and gratitude for her. You can also include any forgiveness or understanding that you feel is necessary. Reflecting on Your Upbringing and Family Dynamics: Consider how your upbringing and family dynamic has shaped your emotional world. What patterns or behaviors do you carry with you that are rooted in your family history? Embracing Your Role as a Caregiver and Nurturer: Reflect on your own role as a caregiver or nurturer. How do you tend to the emotional needs of others, and how do you prioritize your own emotional well-being? The Power of Memory and Emotion: Spend some time journaling about the role of memory and emotion in your life. How do you process and cope with difficult emotions, and how do you honor and celebrate the happy memories in your life? Meditate On Your Family Dynamics For this meditation, focus on sending compassion and kindness to both your conscious self and your inner child. This can be an extension of a Loving Kindness Meditation, repeating phrases like: May I be happy. May I be peaceful. May I be free from suffering. You can perform this ritual and meditation anytime you feel called to do so, or when your 4th house is illuminated, or on Mondays (ruled by the moon). Take some time to reflect on your family dynamics in your journal and see what insights come up for you. How can you bring more unconditional love and compassion into your relationships? heading: Exploring the Cancer / Capricorn Polar Axis
body: During the Cancer/Capricorn polarity, you are reminded of the importance of emotional and physical security in your life. We will explore the polarity between Mother Moon/Cancer and Father Time/Saturn/Capricorn. Cancer represents the emotional foundation and nurturing that you need in order to feel safe and fulfilled. On the other hand, Capricorn represents the external structures and discipline that provide you with stability and security. Both of these signs are concerned with the passage of time, cycles, and the marking of endings and beginnings. Both signs are Solstice's points, as Cancer prepares us on the energetic teachings of giving birth, signaling summer. Capricorn teaches us about the discipline necessary to survive, as he signals the arrival of cold harsh winters. The polarity of the Cancer/Capricorn is the axis of foundation, security, external and internal structures that support our development. Cancer is the emotional foundation, while Capricorn is the outer structure. Solid foundations and boundaries are both necessary for one to feel emotionally safe and fulfilled. Both signs seek the same thing: security. If Cancer seeks emotional security, Capricorn seeks the security created by structure. This polarity asks us to look at the relationships and objects in our lives and determine whether they are emotionally, mentally, or physically fulfilling. If they are not, Cancer encourages us to nurture and care for them in order to bring them back into balance. If they are not emotionally, mentally, or physically fulfilling, mother Cancer asks us to nurture the relationship; if the relationship or energetic connection cannot be healed, father time/Capricorn teaches us to recognize “their time has passed”. Showing us, by example, the discipline and maturity needed to let go and move forward. We discover balance when we release what is decaying, giving back to the earth as fertilizer and a foundation for us to begin anew. Capricorn Full Moon Full moons are high tides of power, amplifying and creative. The full moon is a time to celebrate and harvest our previous new moon intentions; otherwise, the full moon is a time to make energetic adjustments to align ourselves to call in our intentions. The full moon is a time of celebration and gathering. We sync to the cycle with community, nature, and Spirit. We gather to clear energy, raise energy, gain clarity, set intentions, process symbols, connect with nature, the Divine, and our Higher Self. Capricorn is the sign of hard work and determination. It is the archetype of the Mountain Goat, climbing slowly and steadily towards their goal, tackling whatever obstacle or boulder gets in their way. Evolution is inevitable, and with Capricorn, we are being asked to take charge and create the change we want, and release habits and thought patterns that block us from committing to our great journey and vision. During a Capricorn Full Moon the emphasis will be on home/career balance, respect for our elders/living our own truths, patriarchy/women, and bullies/victims' rights. We may also be getting a maturity upgrade, which could manifest as taking on more responsibility in some of the areas of health, home, work, or authority issues. Full Moons are often a time of celebration, and hopefully, you’re being recognized for the hard work you’ve done during this lunation. Or, you could be being forced to mature out of the mere fear or resistance to change that you’ve been holding onto for too long. The Capricorn full moon may also illuminate the karma of past actions which could also be forcing you to mature and take on the responsibility that you may have been avoiding. The Capricorn full moon takes on an emotional tone that is a little more somber and a little more reserved and serious. Abandonment issues might arise, and you may be feeling as if you are alone and only have yourself to lean on for support; this is what Capricorn energy does, it pushes you to mature. Structures in our lives are getting reorganized to build on a solid foundation. Full Moons are a perfect time to release extra baggage and what’s no longer working. The planetary energies for this Full Moon intention might look something like this: For this Capricorn full moon, I set the intention to gently release, with awareness and love, anything that is blocking me from maturing into my truest and fullest potential.

heading: Capricorn Full Moon Actions & Intentions
body: s With this Full Moon in Capricorn, it is an opportunity to consider the eternal struggle between your career and emotional needs. On one hand, you have your goals and ambitions - your desire for success and the structures you have created to achieve it. This is represented by the Capricorn Full Moon. On the other hand, you have your sense of family and home, and the emotional security and nurturing you receive from these relationships. This is represented by the Sun in Cancer. Finding balance between these two aspects in your life can be a challenge, particularly when you are trying to juggle your career goals with your emotional needs. But it is important to remember that you do not have to choose one over the other. By setting the intention to release any limiting beliefs or behaviors that may be preventing you from achieving this balance, you can strive towards a harmonious integration of the material and spiritual in our lives. It is possible to have a successful career and a fulfilling home life - it is just a matter of finding the right balance for you. During this Capricorn full moon, I set the intention to let go of any limitations or limiting beliefs that are holding me back from reaching my goals and achieving success. I release the need for perfection and embrace the process of growth and learning. I release the fear of failure and trust in my ability to overcome obstacles and challenges. I honor my dedication and hard work, and trust in the abundance and prosperity that is waiting for me. I embrace my own power and take control of my life, setting myself up for long-term success and stability. Connect with Saturn’s energy – Use the energy of Saturn to focus on your ambitions and the structures you have in place to achieve success. To further connect with Saturn's energy, take advantage of the special days during Capricorn season when you can align yourself with the powers of Saturn, which fall on Saturdays. This can be a time to reflect on the lessons and blessings that Saturn brings, and how you can incorporate them into your life. Create an altar – During the Capricorn full moon, it is a good time to create a sacred space for Saturn, the planetary ruler of Capricorn. To create an altar, you can gather items that have personal meaning or significance to you. You might also collect items that symbolize Saturn and Capricorn, such as pen and paper, tarot cards, candles, incense, coins, herbs, and the Devil tarot card. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Reflect on where you were six months ago – What you were manifesting and striving for Take stock of your progress and make any necessary adjustments. Be mindful – Observing your thoughts, experiences, and observations in a journal can be a powerful way to gain insights into your own inner landscape. You might also consider using tarot cards or other divination tools to help you explore your inner world. Collecting items – Pen, paper, tarot cards, candles, incense, and herbs can be a way to create a sense of ritual and intention as you work through your full moon intentions. You might also consider incorporating other elements, like crystals or sound healing tools, into your altar. Consider the role of Saturn in your life – What structures or systems do you have in place to support your goals and ambitions? How can you further your career and reach your goals? Reflect on the balance between your professional goals and your emotional needs – How can you honor both aspects of your life and find harmony between them? Set an intention to release any limiting beliefs or behaviors that may be preventing you from achieving this balance. Reflect on the importance of emotional well-being and nurturing relationships – How can you cultivate a sense of emotional security and fulfillment in your life? Use the energy of the Capricorn full moon to focus on achieving success and reaching your goals, while also taking care of your emotional needs – Reflect on the current balance between your career goals and your emotional needs. How have you been prioritizing these areas in your life? Consider what you can release or let go of in order to create more balance and harmony between these two energies. This might include old beliefs about success or expectations for yourself that no longer serve you. Increase productivity and focus on work – Consider setting an intention to increase your productivity and focus on your work. This may involve setting clear goals and creating a plan to achieve them, as well as finding ways to eliminate distractions and stay motivated. Set the intention to create more balance and harmony between your career and home life – This might involve setting boundaries, finding ways to integrate your professional and personal passions, or seeking out supportive relationships that can help you achieve your goals. Remember that success is not just about achieving professional goals, but also about feeling fulfilled and satisfied in all areas of your life. Prioritize your emotional well-being and seek out opportunities for self-care and connection with loved ones. Capricorn Full Moon Affirmations I acknowledge the ambition and drive within me to succeed and achieve my goals, but I also recognize the importance of my emotional well-being and the relationships that nurture and support me. I release any limiting beliefs or behaviors that may be preventing me from finding harmony between my professional and personal lives. I trust in my ability to create a successful career and a fulfilling home life, and I am open to the abundance and opportunities that come my way as I strive for this balance. I am confident in my ability to manifest my desires and I trust in the natural flow of life to bring me what I need. I am grateful for the balance and harmony that I am able to create in my life." I am open and receptive to new opportunities and experiences. I release any fear or hesitation that holds me back from embracing change. I trust in the natural flow of life and release the need to control every outcome. I have faith that everything happens for a reason and I am guided by a higher power. I focus on progress and self-improvement and release the need for perfection. I understand that perfection is an unattainable goal, and I am proud of my own journey and the progress I have made.

heading: Capricorn full moon horoscopes & tarotscopes
body: s Full moons are about illuminating that unconscious and that which is unseen. This full moon shines a light on the shadows of self-responsibility, our commitments, and our limitations. What you wish to avoid repeating needs to be released now. Capricorn themes surround reputation, career, and professional social standing. Ruled by Saturn, Capricorn focuses on the basic necessities and practical goals such as saving money for a down payment on a house or saving for a rainy day. Capricorn's practical nature also comes with a responsibility to care for ourselves and others. The Moon in Capricorn opposes the Sun in Cancer and calls for a balance between the practical goals of Capricorn and the emotional needs of Cancer. It's important to find a middle ground between the two energies to maintain a healthy work-life balance; ensure your long-term goals don't get neglected in favor of more immediate emotional concerns. If you're feeling overwhelmed by either work or home responsibilities, take a step back and assess what's really important to you. Don't hesitate to delegate or ask for help when needed. And above all, remember to take care of yourself physically and emotionally. When you do, you'll be better equipped to handle whatever comes your way. You can use your horoscope as a guide to what area of your life is being illuminated and use that as a guide for your full moon ritual. If you are unfamiliar with the twelve houses and what it means to have your 1st or 2nd house illuminated by the new or full moon, read foundation two for the fundamentals.
