heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Capricorn full moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cars from the Major Arcana pile that corresponds to the current planetary places. For example, during Capricorn Season, the Sun is in Capricorn (The Devil), opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Cancer (The Chariot). Begin by finding the Sun (Sun), The Devil (Capricorn), High Priestess (Moon), and The Chariot (Cancer), and place the Sun in position 1, The Devil in position 2, the High Priestess in position 3, and the Chariot in position 4. For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the full moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 7th position, select a card from the second pile, which contains the court cards and the Minor Arcana. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. Tarotscope Key 2. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the sun is in 4. This is a time of celebration, an ideal time to celebrate all that you are. It's time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. Focus on how you see yourself rather than how others see you. With this Capricorn full moon's opposition to the Sun in Cancer, you are seeking emotional security and exploring how the structure or lack of structure you've created supports or undermines your emotional well-being. Can you give yourself more structure and emotional support? Similar to this lunation, you have been growing these past six months, from the new moon in Capricorn to this full moon in your sign. What has shifted in the past six months that asks you to step into more responsibility? How are you being guided to accept more responsibility and mature yourself?

body: Create your own tarotscopes for this full moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) in Cancer (The Chariot) opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Capricorn (The Devil), illuminating the 1st House (The Emperor/Aries), with ruling planet Mars (The Tower). The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The Emperor (Aries/1st house) 7. {extra card} Sagittarius (Nov. 22 - Dec. 21) & Sagittarius Rising - Full moon in the 2nd House The Capricorn full moon shines its light on your 2nd House of Finances and Foundation, bringing attention to your hard work, responsibility, and determination in the areas of self-worth, foundation, and financial security. Take stock of the financial lessons you've learned in the past six months, since the new moon in Capricorn, and re-examine your views on money, finances, and debt. As the full moon opposes the Sun in Cancer, you may be exploring the connection between emotional security and the structure or lack of structure in your financial foundation. Consider how the structure you have created supports or undermines your emotional well-being. Take this time to see what steps you need to take to create a more supportive foundation for yourself, including self-worth, financial stability, and skill set that will support your career. The Capricorn full moon guides you to let go of any negative thoughts or limiting beliefs that may be holding you back from achieving financial stability and self-worth. The more you commit to yourself and take action in the next six months, the more you will see your income, investments, and self-worth grow. The 2nd House of Finances and Foundation is ruled by Taurus and corresponds to The Hierophant in the Major Arcana of Tarot. The Hierophant represents structure, consistency, and guidance - all essential elements in achieving financial stability and success. The Hierophant can be considered a mentor or guide, someone with the experience and knowledge to help you navigate the path to success. If you're seeking help setting proper financial goals, it may be beneficial to seek a mentor or financial advisor who can provide direction and assistance. This is an excellent time to release any daily habits or activities that harm your overall well-being. Perhaps create a list and see where you can introduce new structures to help you organize and automate your day-to-day to streamline and optimize your time. This full moon highlights the need to create a new self-care regimen to bring stability and routine. Take a moment and see what tasks, obligations, and activities bring you the most resistance and distraction, and take steps to improve the process; drop the avoidance and worry, and reclaim the mental real estate in your head. It's easy to get caught up in the challenges of everyday life and forget that they're usually just temporary. It's important to stay patient and consistent and to remember that there is always a bigger picture. The challenges you face now will fade, but the lessons you learn will remain. The full moon in the 6th house teaches you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals link to your greater vision. Take note of what you have achieved. Honor the work, effort, and labor you have put into your work and self. Your full moon intention, "Slow down and focus on the details of health, work, and daily habits." The Capricorn full moon takes on an emotional tone that is a little more somber, reserved, and serious. Abandonment issues might arise, and you may feel alone and only have yourself to lean on for support; this is what Capricorn energy does. It pushes you to review your life, mature and set boundaries. If you want your relationship to thrive, you need to set some ground rules. That means having open and honest communication about what you both want and need. It also means having respect for each other to stick to those agreements. When everyone is on the same page, it makes it easier to navigate through life's ups and downs. So sit down with your partner and figure out what you need to feel safe, respected, and loved. It's the foundation on which all great relationships are built. Without this agreement, your connection will be sabotaged before it even has a chance to begin. The full moon in the seventh house can signal a time to celebrate relationships that are in balance, entering deeper into a level of commitment (marriage, engagement, moving in together, starting a business), and the relationships where there is a lack of balance result in endings. This full moon helps you recognize the gift of committing to others; and asks that you honor the commitment you made with others as well as the commitment you make to yourself. Any relationships and commitments that have hit limitations or need to be released can be at this time. Cancer & Cancer Rising Tarotscopes Create your own tarotscopes for this full moon. The full moon in the eight house illuminates what others have given to support you (or didn't give support) and signals a time when you can give back to those who have helped you along your journey or let go of the baggage that was given that you no longer need to carry. We all carry with us the weight of our ancestors' generational conditioning. But it's time to learn to forgive yourself for everything you didn't know how to do or didn't know you had the power to do until now. Then take the time to reflect on any debt or shared resources holding you back, and take steps to free yourself from these obligations. You deserve to live a life unencumbered by the past. If you feel like your life is in flux, don't worry - it's all part of the process. Things are being rearranged so that you can build on a more solid foundation. You may also be getting a maturity upgrade, which could manifest as taking on more responsibility in health, home, work, or more authority in your life. Don't fear what you might mature into. You are much more responsible than you realize. The full moon in the 8th house signals a time of transformation. Some are big and noticeable, while others are small and more personal. But all of these transformations require you to let go of your old self and embrace the destiny meant for you. Gemini & Gemini Rising Tarotscopes Create your own tarotscopes for this full moon. This past year has been very challenging for you and has you questioning spirituality, philosophy, fairness (or lack of justice of life), and if there is Divine logic. Jupiter, the planetary ruler of the 9th house, is known for its expansive capacities, shifting your thoughts to personal growth, faith, and the philosophy of life. The Capricorn full moon in the 9th house pushes you to seek religion and philosophy as a framework for creating a life of well-being. If you're feeling lost or questioning your faith during this full moon, consider picking up a philosophy book. It can help you to reflect deeply on your current situation and find meaning in even the most difficult experiences. Henri Bergson's theory of creativity is especially relevant, as it reminds you that you are the creator of your own life. Additionally, Epicurus reminds you that happiness comes from within, a peaceful body and soul. So you shouldn't seek it from external sources. And finally, Stoicism teaches you to accept what you cannot change and not be defeated by outside forces. This full moon is a reminder that faith is not static. Like all relationships, it's a process. The journey of faith is a complex line. It ebbs and flows. There are times of growth and progress, as well as times of restriction and discouragement. But even in tough times, it's essential to trust the process. The full moon reminds you to stay committed to your path and overcome setbacks by prioritizing your spiritual and emotional wellness. Losing faith is part of questioning, understanding, and building trust in something greater. This full moon asks that you trust your process, remain committed to your path, and overcome setbacks until you regain momentum. Take this time to meditate, deepen your relationship with your Higher Self and prioritize your spiritual and emotional wellness. This full moon signals a time of honor, and to honor and appreciate all the spiritual work you have done for yourself and the humbling in knowing lessons and learnings are part of your journey. This full moon asks that you step into your greater purpose and take on more responsibility, whether in your current work or forging a path on your own. You know who you are and what you're worth, Aries. This self-actualization will ultimately lead to an ascension in your career and public status. full moons are often a time of celebration, and hopefully, you're being recognized for the hard work you've put into your career in the last six months during this lunation. Sometimes it can be challenging to keep your priorities straight amid work pressures and career building. Between juggling responsibilities at home and work, it's easy to feel like you're spread too thin and aren't giving your full attention to anything. But, if you don't slow down to check in with your emotions, you'll be ignoring your needs, missing out on opportunities, and falling into unfulfilling patterns that lead you further away from emotional fulfillment. When you don't give yourself a chance to thrive, you're robbing yourself of the opportunity to reach your full potential. This is a time to release any resistance to responsibility, feelings of imposture syndrome, self-sabotaging (what's the worst that can happen?), and impulsive tendencies that hold you back from maturing into your "adult" life and greater purpose. Listen to yourself, and give yourself the time you need to feel whole and emotionally centered. Explore what a mature and successful work-life balance feels like for you and if you feel you still need to create it, take actionable steps toward it. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil/Capricorn speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. The Devil usually symbolizes struggles with a moral problem — a choice between lust or love; but mostly, it means you're overwhelmed with an international struggle. You may haven't defined your values or beliefs and have taken on the views of others that are misleading you of your fulfillment. This is a time to release any aspects of your career that do not align with your core values and interests. Aries & Aries Rising Tarotscopes Create your own tarotscopes for this full moon. Good friends are good for your health, and this full moon illuminates the importance of those you surround yourself with. The close friends and networks in your life can help you cope with traumas, such as a job loss, serious illness, divorce, or the death of a loved one. The friendships and networks in your life can encourage you to change or avoid unhealthy lifestyle habits, such as excessive spending, drinking, or lack of exercise. Just as good friends are good for your health, toxic relationships harm your overall well-being and drain you emotionally and mentally. Long-term unhealthy relationships weaken your immune system, and living in a constantly hostile environment pumps your body's cortisol levels, leading to adrenal fatigue. This full moon encourages you to make responsible decisions and review who you allow having access to your energy. You seek community and friendship, and you're ready to release any false friends and networks that are restricting and do not support your growth. This full moon asks that you mature and show that you can be trusted and build trust in others. Trust is built on respect, being responsible, dependable, and forming strong bonds. Keep personal information shared with you in good faith by others private. Keep to your commitments and arrive on time; seek the same level of response from others. Stay focused on what's working in your projects and relationships, and gently release anything that is not working. This full moon gifts you awareness of the social structure you have cultivated for yourself and time to celebrate those you choose to surround yourself with. heading: Capricorn Full Moon Ritual
body: “I release everything either known or unknown to me that has been blocking me from receiving, feeling, and walking in my strength and authority. I trust and discover strength in my body, mind, self, and spirit. I call in my power and walk in my strength.” - A prayer for release Fig 65. Top view of an altar to Saturn & Capricorn [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Saturn and your ritual candle(s) for Saturn on the placement for Saturn. Place the World and The Devil tarot card on your altar, as well as an offering to Saturn. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration elm and black tourmaline) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – Petition Saturn for discipline, structure, to bind yourself to a commitment, to keep a promise, focus/discipline/study, to stop gossip, to bind or restrict another person/or situation from doing you or a loved one harm. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. Give Thanks. 11. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: ● Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. ● Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. ● Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. ● Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. *** Leo Season: July 23rd - Aug 22nd 5th House and Sol the Planetary Ruler Light is Love, Stoking your Spiritual Fire “Some women fear the fire. Some women simply become it.” — R.H. SIN “Leo brings welcomed warmth and inspiration to our lives. Leo is a heart-centered leader, With the Sun as it’s ruler, Leo ignites a fire. Leo likes to be in the spotlight and to shine his creative and passionate fire. He reminds us that creativity is an inherent part of our being, which deserves time and space to be expressed. By ⁠fully embodying the essence of your heart, and opening to Leo’s LIGHT gives others permission to do the same.” Planetary Ruler – Sol / The Sun New Moon – Leo (Ruled by Sol) Full Moon – Aquarius (Co-Ruled by Saturn and Uranus) Day of the Week – Sunday (ruled by Sol) Archetype – The King Element – Fire Tarot – The Strength Card (Leo), Sun card (Sol) Body – Heart & Spine Affirmation – I Will. In this season, we are invited to awaken our creative essence, to see the world through innocent and awe-filled eyes, embracing the joy and wonder that lie at the core of our being. Just as the sun radiates its vibrant light, Leo season urges us to step into our own brilliance and become the rulers of our own realms. It's a time to embrace our unique gifts and talents, allowing our authentic selves to shine forth without inhibition. We are called to take center stage, honoring our individuality and expressing our true essence with confidence and passion. Leo Season is a time when we celebrate life. Have you been feeling more confident, passionate, and outgoing lately? These are all traits of Leo. Sol, the sun, is Leos’ planetary ruler. And it is during Leo season that we possess the capacity to cultivate and channel Light. Leo teaches self-confidence, creativity, and the connection to the spiritual. During Leo season, we embrace a return to generosity, playfulness, self-love, passion, and romanticism. We are reminded to connect to our hearts, create, play, laugh, and remember who we are at our core. Should the need for healing

heading: arise, we can harness the transformative power of the Leo/Aquarius polar axis, particularly during
body: the Aquarius Full Moon. This celestial alignment offers a powerful opportunity to align our minds with our hearts and spirits. By tapping into the higher mental capacities of Aquarius, we can adopt an unemotional and objective viewpoint that is necessary for healing past emotional wounds. Through this detached perspective, we can navigate the intricate landscapes of our inner selves, unveiling the paths toward holistic healing solutions. In the radiant embrace of Leo season, we embark on a profound journey of self-discovery, unveiling the truth that our essence is inherently intertwined with Love and Light. Throughout the past four months, we have traversed the path of integration, actively or passively, as we immersed ourselves in the transformative energies of the four elements: fire, earth, air, and water. During Aries season, the fire element ignited our awareness, awakening the spark within us. In Taurus season, we delved into the grounding energy of earth, becoming intimately connected with our physical bodies and the world around us. In Gemini season, the element of air expanded our consciousness, inviting us to explore the vast landscape of our minds. Finally, in Cancer season, we immersed ourselves in the realm of water, deepening our understanding of our emotional bodies and integrating the nourishing power of this element. Now, having recognized and integrated the wisdom of the four elements, we are poised to embody the transformative lessons of Leo season. Symbolizing the fifth sign on the cosmic wheel, Leo represents the fifth element, known as Spirit, Aether, or Quintessence. It is the culmination of the harmonious integration and embodiment of fire, earth, air, and water. As we embrace the essence of Leo season, we tap into the magnificent energy of Spirit, realizing that we are more than the sum of our parts. We become vessels of divine light and love, radiating our unique brilliance into the world. This season invites us to embody our innate creative power, to shine with unapologetic authenticity, and to express the radiant love that resides within us. In this sacred dance of the elements, we are reminded that we are spiritual beings having a human experience. We honor the interconnectedness of all things, recognizing that our journey of integration and embodiment brings us closer to the divine essence that permeates the universe. So, as we traverse the transformative energies of Leo season, let us embrace the fullness of who we are, embodying the harmonious unity of the four elements within us. May we radiate our unique light and love, illuminating the world around us and igniting the flame of divine consciousness. In the gentle transition from Cancer to Leo season, we embark on a profound journey of self-discovery and self-expression. Cancer season called upon us to reflect, to introspect, and to explore the inner realms of our being. Now, as we step into the radiant realm of Leo season, guided by the majestic Sun, we are invited to take the wisdom gained from our inner sojourn and let our luminous essence radiate outward. Just as the Sun governs Leo, it stands as the embodiment of the universal life force and the radiant source of light. In the same way, Leo rules over the heart, the sacred sanctuary within us that comprises four chambers, symbolizing the completeness of our being. As we embody the four elements—fire, earth, air, and water—that converge to form the fifth element of Spirit, we align ourselves with the expansive teachings of Leo. As the Sun illuminates the heavens above, it serves as the center and source of universal light, connecting every living energy on our planet. Likewise, our hearts, governed by Leo, represent the core of our physical existence and the wellspring of our spiritual radiance. By embracing the profound lessons that Leo imparts, we understand that the Light of the Sun, known as Sol or Spirit, is intrinsically intertwined with the essence of Love residing within our hearts. The principle of "As above, so below" resonates deeply in the realm of Leo. Just as the celestial Sun shines upon the cosmos, infusing it with life-giving energy, our hearts reflect that brilliance, becoming the center of our own personal universe. It is through the lessons of Leo that we discover the profound truth that Light, representing the eternal essence of Spirit, is indistinguishable from Love, the eternal essence of the Heart. Leo invites us to embrace the divine interplay between the Sun's cosmic radiance and the luminosity within our hearts. Let us honor the connection between the universal light above and our individual brilliance within. As we assimilate the teachings of Leo, may we courageously let our light shine forth, illuminating the world with the warmth, generosity, and authenticity of our own unique expression of love. By embracing all that Leo has to teach us, we learn that Light (Sol/Spirit) is Love (Heart). “Love is the light of your soul.” How can I shed any identities that no longer resonate with my spirit? heading: Leo Light & Shadow
body: As we move into the season of Leo, it's a time to reflect on how we are showing up in the world and how we are expressing ourselves. Are you operating from a place of ego, seeking attention and validation for yourself, or are you able to connect with your heart and use your talents and abilities to inspire and uplift others? It's important to remember that the energies of Leo can be both positive and negative, and it's up to us to choose how we want to use them. Leo is the sign of the Sun, and as such, represents your sense of self and your need to be seen and recognized. When you are in touch with your evolved Leo energy, you are confident and self-assured, able to step into the spotlight and embrace your unique talents and abilities. However, when you are disconnected from Spirit and are operating in Leo's shadow, you may become overly focused on yourself, becoming egotistical, narcissistic, and self-centered. It's important to remember that Leo is not just about the ego, but also about the heart. When you are able to connect with the love and light of Spirit, you can channel your Leo energy into creativity, playfulness, and self-expression. You can learn to embrace your unique talents and abilities and use them to inspire and uplift others, rather than seeking attention and validation for yourself. As you navigate the push and pull of Leo's energy, it's important to be mindful of your motivations and to strive for balance. By finding a healthy balance between your need for recognition and your desire to serve and uplift others, you can tap into the full potential of your evolved Leo energy and become shining examples of the power of Spirit. Un-evolved Leo energy can be egotistical, narcissistic, dramatic, controlling, and self-centered. Leo, in his shadow, does not have the ability to stand outside of one's own perspective in order to see things/oneself objectively. Be mindful of lingering in the energies of Leo’s Shadow. The Sun either assists us in the playful nature of being Seen, on the stage of life. Or, in its shadow without a connection to Spirit - un-evolved Leo energy can create melodrama, by our delusions of self (narcissistic & selfish behavior). At the high end, evolved Leo energy is the 5th element (Spirit); we learn that Light (Sol/Spirit) is Love (Heart). ​ ​ ​ ​ Leo Light & Strength – Light is Love. Self-Confidence, Creativity, Heart-Chakra, Building inner strength, childlike curiosity, and connection to Spirit. Leo Shadow & Weakness – Egotistical, Narcissism, Dramatic, Controlling. Self-centeredness. Inability to stand outside one's own perspective in order to see things/oneself objectively. Leo Season, The 5th House And Sol As The Planetary Ruler Sol - The Universal and central heartbeat. The animating force of all life. The majesty of Leo Rules 5th house, the realm of the inner child, the source of joy and whimsy within us all. This house, ruled by Leo, represents our connection to leisure and passion, reminding us to take a respite from the burdens of the world and revel in the pleasures of the moment. The positions of the celestial bodies within the 5th house, or the ruling of the house by a particular sign, offer insight into how we approach creativity and self-expression. They offer a window into the very essence of our being, a glimpse into the soul's capacity for artistic expression and imaginative play. The 5th house beckons us to practice self-compassion and self-care, to nurture and cultivate the light within. No one can extinguish the inner strength and light that burns within us, and through mindfulness and self-reflection, we can make it burn even brighter. Leo is a time of pride and empowerment, a time when we are encouraged to recognize and celebrate our unique gifts and abilities. So let your light shine, and let the warmth of your inner strength guide you on your journey. Leo / Strength Strength is the eighth key of the Major Arcana. body: s During Leo season, you can focus on building self-confidence, recognizing and developing your leadership skills, and burning away, with the Flame of Sol, any feelings of depression. This is a time to be seen and to have your voice heard and respected. To strengthen yourself, you can practice inhaling golden light into your heart chakra and exhaling the shadow of your sorrows and disillusions. According to Agrippa, the Sun is a "lucid flame" that can help you to connect with your inner light and strength. By tapping into this energy and focusing on these intentions, you can work towards feeling more confident, self-assured, and able to step into your leadership roles with grace and determination. I am confident and courageous, radiating my unique light and authenticity. I am self-assured and self-expressive, embracing my talents and abilities. I am generous and giving, sharing my abundance and warmth with others. I am a leader, inspiring and guiding those around me with grace and kindness. I am worthy and deserving of love, respect, and abundance in all areas of my life. To create an altar, you can gather items that have personal meaning or significance to you. You might also collect items that symbolize Sol and Leo. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Every page is an invitation to explore, reflect, and express yourself in a meaningful way. Sunday is a day ruled by the Sun and is a perfect day to do things that bring you joy and light you up, as well as to connect with your higher self and seek guidance from your spirit guides. I Will – Acknowledge your power, strength, and determination during this time. Remember that you have the ability to create positive change and to achieve your goals. Inhale Golden Light – To strengthen yourself during Leo season, try visualizing yourself inhaling golden light into your heart chakra, and exhaling the shadow of your sorrows and disillusions. This practice can help you to tap into the energy of the Sun and to connect with the "lucid flame" of the solar energy. By focusing on this inner light and strength, you can cultivate a sense of confidence and self-assurance. Cultivate a sense of self-love and self-worth – Take some time to reflect on what makes you unique and special, and set an intention to cultivate a deeper sense of self-love and self-worth. This may involve setting healthy boundaries, engaging in self-care practices, or finding ways to express your creativity and individuality. Follow your passions and pursue your creativity – Reflect on what truly lights you up and makes you feel alive, and set an intention to pursue your passions and dreams with determination and enthusiasm. This may involve setting clear goals and taking small steps towards achieving them, or seeking out new opportunities that align with your passions. Foster strong, supportive relationships – Consider setting an intention to strengthen and nurture the relationships that bring joy and growth into your life. This may involve being more present and attentive in your interactions, showing appreciation and gratitude towards others, or making an effort to reconnect with loved ones who may have drifted apart. Practice generosity and kindness – Take inspiration from the Leo full moon's association with the sun, and set an intention to be more generous and kind in your interactions with others. This may involve finding ways to give back to your community, being more patient and understanding with those around you, or simply showing more appreciation and gratitude towards the people in your life. Some possible intentions for Leo season, and the Leo new moon might include: Seeking recognition or attention from others Boosting physical and mental energy levels Increasing motivation and discipline around exercise and dieting Improving self-confidence and self-worth Enhancing overall well-being and happiness Strengthening relationships and connection with loved ones Creating a positive and uplifting atmosphere Relieving feelings of sadness or depression Boosting performance and presence in public settings Leo New Moon: Light is Love, Stoking your Spiritual Fire New Moons are about new beginnings. A time to bring your intentions into clear focus and send them out into the Universe with a clear vision and actionable goals towards manifestation. Leo the Lion, the majestic and charismatic ruler of the zodiac, calls upon you during this new moon to embody the bold, beautiful, and heart-centered qualities of his essence. As you align with Leo's energy, you are invited to embrace love in all areas of your life and recognize the divine spark of creation within yourself. However, it is important to be mindful of potential pitfalls such as ego conflicts, unnecessary drama, entitlement, and selfishness that may arise and impact your relationships. By remaining aware and conscious of your behaviors, you can navigate these challenges with grace and cultivate a harmonious connection with others. During Cancer season, which you have recently experienced, you were reminded of the significance of acknowledging your feelings and needs and the importance of communicating them within a safe and nurturing space for your healing. As you enter this Leo new moon phase, it becomes crucial to identify those individuals who truly see, love, and accept you for who you are. By surrounding yourself with a supportive network, you create an environment where you can feel secure and at ease, allowing your creativity to flourish. In this state of relaxation and self-assurance, you can engage with yourself and others in a calm, curious, and playful manner. You can freely express your authentic self without fear of judgment or rejection. This transition from Cancer to Leo season signifies the birth of a new self within the shelter of safety, granting you the opportunity to explore and cultivate love for this newfound aspect of yourself. The positive expression of this potent Leo new moon energy lies in the understanding and healing of your emotional triggers, past traumas, and feelings of inadequacy. You can harness the power of what arises now as fuel for your creative endeavors and projects. Conversely, you may also encounter frustrations stemming from a lack of recognition, appreciation, or validation for your creative work. Should you find yourself expressing inner or outer tantrums, this energy supports you in connecting with the part of yourself that seeks acknowledgment. Can you offer yourself the recognition, love, and kindness that you crave? Can you grant permission to that vulnerable part of yourself to feel its emotions without judgment or expectation? Leo activates the confidence within you that is necessary to transcend external criticism and validation, allowing you to fully step into your unapologetic and authentic self. During this Leo new moon, let yourself embrace the transformative power of love and creativity. With an open heart and courageous spirit, you can navigate any challenges that arise, heal old wounds, and manifest your creative visions. May you honor and celebrate the radiant essence of Leo within yourself and others, shining your light unapologetically and embodying the fullness of who you truly are.

body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. You can use different techniques to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on Earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during the Leo new moon, the sun (Sun) and moon (The High Priestess) are in Leo (Strength). Then find the Sun (Sun), The High Priestess (Moon), and then Strength (Leo). For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the new moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 6th position, select either a card representing your sun sign or a card from the second pile containing the court cards and the Minor Arcana; use this placement to gain more insight into working with this planetary energy. When these animalistic drives are not centered, they can fuel emotions like anger, jealousy, greed, and fear; hence, personal development entails a degree of self-mastery. The 6th house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit teaches you to master the Self by practicing silence, meditation, and seclusion. In this stage of the journey, you're being asked to be more attentive to details, looking at how you give too much of yourself and are left feeling drained and under-appreciated. You may often think about how to be a source of Strength for others but forget about the importance of taking care of yourself. If you don’t protect your own energy during moments when you are giving more than you are receiving, it will severely deplete you and make you unable to help those around you. During this new moon, take intentional actions to safeguard your energy and prevent yourself from over-giving and ending up drained. The New moon in the 6th house teaches you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals link to your overall health and wellness. Your New Moon intention is, “To tend to yourself first so that you can better serve others. Your health improves, and opportunities open when you leave self-sacrifice tendencies behind. Make health and creativity your primary focus now. Work issues will work themselves out when you focus on yourself for a bit.” Pisces & Pisces Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) in Leo (Strength), illuminating the 6th House, The Hermit (Virgo/6th house), with the ruling planet Mercury (The Magician). For the 6th position, place your Sun sign, Pisces (The Moon), and/or one card from the minor arcana to give you further insight. 3. Strength (Leo) 1. The Sun (Sun) 5. The Magician (Mercury) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 4. The Hermit (Virgo/6th house) 6. The Moon (Pisces) or extra card Aquarius (Jan 20th - Feb 18th) & Aquarius Rising - New moon in the 7th House Relationships in work and love are at the forefront for you now. Any issues and imbalances that haven’t been dealt with, will finally arise for resolution or at least discussion. Be honest about what you need from others and yourself. Honesty is a liberating act. This new moon is giving you the opportunity to make the necessary changes to help you evolve as a person and as a partner. The 7th house is ruled by Libra and corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice symbolizes cause and effect, the workings of destiny or karma, the consequences or rewards of past actions, law, trial, justice, truth, balance, achieving balance after tribulations, retribution, the law on your side, favorable outcome of judicial matters, responsible conduct, making well-balanced choices, and integrity. The Justice card indicates that you may be wrestling with handling an unjust situation appropriately, or struggling with hurt pride. You don’t always have to wait for someone else to bring justice. You can take the initiative to create it yourself. When faced with injustice, sometimes the best course of action may be simply to acknowledge mistreatment and move on. Other times, however, you can approach a situation with an open heart, and talking points that honor your personal values and make sure those who wronged you are held accountable. You can achieve justice, correct the scales and find balance without having to wait for others. Leo corresponds to the Strength card. The Strength card reminds you to tap into your inner power, which comes from emotional mastery - the strength to control your passion and temperaments rather than be controlled by them. Remember, you have the capacity to make decisions that come from a place of trust within yourself. Leo provides a perfect example of this strength in their determination, fearlessness, courage, and self-expression. We can all draw from their courage and trust that no matter what comes our way, we are capable of handling it with grace, poise, and dignity. Your New Moon intention is, “To tend to your heart in relationship matters and trust in the cycles of endings and beginnings. A new life is right around the corner for you. Anchor into yourself while sharing all the gifts that partnerships and co-creating have to bring. The tension will make you stronger, regardless of the outcome.” Aquarius & Aquarius Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) in Leo (Strength), illuminating the 7th House (Libra/Justice), with the ruling planet Venus (The Empress). For the 6th position, your sun sign, Aquarius (The Start), and/ or one card from the minor arcana to give you further insight. 3. Strength (Leo) 1. The Sun (Sun) 5. The Empress (Venus) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 4. Justice (Libra/7th house) 6. The Star (Aquarius) and/or extra card Capricorn (Dec. 22nd - Jan. 21st) & Capricorn Rising - New moon in the 8th House You’re exploring topics of loss, control, surrender, and delving into your inner resources to help you get through this time of uncertainty. What you thought gave you security, may not be so anymore as you learn to access your deeper inner resources to pull you through challenges. Fear can be a gift. Fear of letting go, fear that nothing will come, fear that space won't be filled? Trust yourself first, and everything else will align. There’s nothing wrong with small steps either, but no step at all will keep you stuck. This season and new moon, you’ll be exploring the most intimate spaces of your own soul. Don’t fear what you might transform into. You are much more expansive and empowered than you realize, and being in connection with another may remind you of this whether it’s birthed out of a deep connection, or a lesson of disempowerment. Power dynamics that haven’t been addressed are now arising, asking for changes in your relationships. Be open to new solutions to old patterns, however uncomfortable or painful the solutions may seem. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the tarot. The new moon in the 8th house is an invitation to explore and understand the mysteries of life. It's a call to tap into your inner wisdom and use it to transform your life. This energy can manifest as the death of your old self and the birth of a new one. It's a chance to delve into topics like shamanism, astrology, tarot, or psychology in order to learn, and heal yourself and help others. If you're feeling called to become a healer or a teacher - now is the perfect time to set your intentions and follow this path. Capricorn & Capricorn Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) in Leo (Strength), illuminating the 8th House (Scorpio/Death), with ruling planet Pluto (Judgement/Modern), or Mars (Tower/Ancient). For the 6th position, place your sun sign Capricorn (The Devil) and/or one card from the minor arcana to give you further insight. Create sacred space. 3. Strength (Leo) 1. The Sun (Sun) 5. The Tower (Mars/Ancient) / Judgement (Pluto/Modern) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 4. Death (8th house/Scorpio) 6. The Devil (Capricorn) or extra card Sagittarius (Nov 22nd - Dec 21st) & Sagittarius Rising - New moon in the 9th House It’s time to take your passion for travel and the spotlight and put it into action. Foreign cultures, places, and higher learning is calling for you and you find some of your deepest desires being nurtured there. Keep your mind open to new perspectives and new worlds begin to open up. Traveling helps give you perspective in situations in your life that may feel clogged and stifled. Use this New Moon to broaden your horizons both internally and externally to help you see life in a new and fresh way. Creativity is ignited and you're ready to share your gifts with others through performance or through teaching. It’s important that you don’t get too caught up in a need for validation and satisfaction. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance guides you to find the balance between the Mundane & Spiritual Worlds. If you live too anchored in the mundane, invite in more of life's mysteries. If you find yourself deep into Spiritual studies, ground yourself back down to earthly matters. If you can successfully find that perfect balance between your spiritual pursuits and your life on the ground, you can use the wisdom to unlock the mysteries to live an enchanted life. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering your purpose. Temperance invites you to balance ego and humility. Your intention for this New Moon is “to allow your perspective to be opened, and allow new truths and understandings to feed your spirit. Reflect on the rigidity of your creativity, perspective, and ideals - and use them as a means to connect with others - not a means to create distance or conflict.” Sagittarius & Sagittarius Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) in Leo (Strength), illuminating the 9th House (Sagittarius/Temperance), with ruling planet Jupiter (The Wheel of Fortune). For the 6th position, place one card from the minor arcana to give you further insight. 3. Strength (Leo) 1. The Sun (Sun) 5. The Wheel of Fortune (Jupiter) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 4. Temperance (Sagittarius/9th house) 6. Temperance (Sagittarius) or extra card Scorpio & Scorpio Rising (Oct 23rd - Nov 21st) - New moon in the 10th House Career is your main focus now. You’re discovering more and more about yourself on a daily basis and wondering if all the different parts of yourself are being honored and acknowledged in your work. This question might eventually lead you to take on a new career path, or maybe even a promotion. You don’t always like being in leadership roles, but now you’re seeing that taking on some extra responsibility, whether that be in your current work, or forging a path on your own, is a necessary step to feeling fulfilled. Sudden changes in status, responsibility, or direction will further your growth, even if it’s unclear how at the moment. Your ability to feel secure and confident in your work will determine the outcome. Avoid scattered thinking. Take a step back from this current timeline and focus on the long-range details. Make sure that whatever you put your energy into, aligns with your values and is building toward your future. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil/Capricorn speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. The Devil usually symbolizes struggles with a moral problem — a choice between lust or love; but mostly, it means you're overwhelmed with an international struggle. You may haven't defined your values or beliefs and have taken on the beliefs of others that are misleading you of your fulfillment. Perhaps you prefer to switch careers to focus more energy on your family. Maybe you prefer not to have children and find fulfillment in other areas of your life. Perhaps you have no idea what you want, and you need to take this time to listen to your heart and reconnect to your core values. Scorpio & Scorpio Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) in Leo (Strength), illuminating the 10th House (Capricorn/The Devil), with ruling planet Saturn (The World). For the 6th position, place your Sun sign, Scorpio (Death), and/or one card from the minor arcana to give you further insight. 3. Strength (Leo) 1. The Sun (Sun) 5. The World (Saturn) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 6. Death (Scorpio) or extra card 4. The Devil (Capricorn/10th house) Libra (Sept 23rd - Oct 22nd) & Libra Rising - New moon in the 11th House Friends, community, and networking with others is changing and opening for you. See where your gifts can be offered and offer them. Network, connect, and create community. Your ideas should be shared and collaborated with others. Surround yourself with friends and people who share your same values and vision for the future community and networking is a big focus for you now. There is something magical that happens when you share the same space with people who understand the intricate stories of your life. It's like finding a little piece of yourself amongst a group of people – they become family. Sometimes, it just takes one person to remind you of who you are and what matters most. It's a reminder that our shared experiences bind us together in ways that defy distance or time. The Leo new moon wants you to hold your friends close in your heart, even when life takes you far away. The New Moon in the 11th house may signal a time when your friendships may be changing, and you might find yourself working with groups that are new and different for you. This is good to help you explore new sides of yourself and get exposed to new ideas and visions. Your New Moon intention is, “To allow your unique gifts to be a source of nurturing support for yourself and for others. Focus on your vision for the future and how you’re friends, community, and creativity can fit together. You can bring harmony to all aspects by staying true to yourself.” Libra & Libra Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) in Leo (Strength), illuminating the 11th House (Aquarius/The Star), with the ruling planet Saturn (Judgement). For the 6th position, place your Sun sign, Libra (Justice), and/or one card from the minor arcana to give you further insight. 3. Strength (Leo) 1. The Sun (Sun) 5. The World (Saturn) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 6. Justice (Libra) or extra card 4. The Star (Aquarius/11th house) Virgo (Aug 23rd - Sept 22nd) & Virgo Rising - New moon in the 12th House Dreams, creativity, illusions, and loss are surrounding you now. Clarity may come in time, for now, focus on your creative expression. This New Moon is in your 12th house, the Pisces house. If you feel like you’re underwater, know that this will pass soon, and use this time to connect to your spiritual and artistic side. Let yourself dream, meditate, and be inspired by all that’s coming through to you right now. Try not to make any solid decisions because not all is what it seems with the new moon in the 12th house. This energy is more about exploring your internal landscape and expressing it through creative means as a manifestation of the divine. You may be receiving downloads of information from past lifetimes or ancestral lineage, trauma that needs to be healed and cleared. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces and corresponds to the Moon in the major arcana. The Moon symbolizes mysticism, lunar rituals, and being drawn to the magick of the Moon. With the Leo new moon in your 12th house, set intentions to connect with your divine wisdom. The 12th house gives access to the unseen worlds in which healing and regeneration occur, allowing you to be still within the oneness of the cosmos, remembering that you are more than just a physical being. If you're feeling blocked or uninspired, try cleansing your energy and creating an altar to honor your magick. Doing so will recharge your spiritual batteries and provide you with much-needed inspiration. Stay open, be still, and surrender — you never know what wisdom and healing you might receive. Leo is Light. When we look at the sky, it looks blue, it is actually all colors, and reflects back a light wave of blue. Leos’ light absorbs all signs and reflects back Leo. The house in which you have Leo, and your sun sign, are the areas in your life where you are asked to cultivate leadership, to channel energy to that area of your life with an open heart. To focus on, and develop these areas of yourself, and become a great beacon of Light. Your New Moon intention is, “To allow the cycle of endings and beginnings to unfold without grasping at the expectation of the dream. Your faith, trust, and creative expression will nurture you. Relax into the creative wisdom that is bigger than yourself, and let it guide you instead of getting lost in the unknown. You are being re-created.” Virgo & Virgo Rising Tarotscopes Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) in Leo (Strength), illuminating the 12th House (Pisces/The Moon), with the ruling planet Neptune (The Hanged Man) or Jupiter (The Wheel of Fortune). For the 6th position, place your Sun sign, Virgo (The Hermit), and/or put one card from the Minor Arcana to give you further insight. Create sacred space. 3. Strength (Leo) 1. The Sun (Sun) 5. Wheel of Fortune (Jupiter) / The Hanged Man (Neptune) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 6. The Hermit (Virgo) Or extra card 4. -BlankThe Moon (Pisces/12th House) ​ New Moon Ritual Timing The power of manifestation, to give something form. A new cycle. The energy of new possibilities. Time to set your intentions for what you want to bring into your life. Each new moon is a new beginning. With each new beginning, we are asked to release unfinished business, draining distractions from the past - these are required to be neutralized or integrated into the new cycle for a healthy culmination and manifestation. New Moons often mean beginnings and planting new seeds. Write down what you desire to manifest over the next six (6) to eighteen (18) months. <> themes such as – Light is Love. Self-Confidence, Creativity, Heart-Chakra, Building inner strength, childlike curiosity, and connection to Spirit.The Sun either assists us in the playful nature of being Seen on the stage of life. Or, in its shadow - we create melodrama through our delusions of self (narcissistic & selfish behavior). To align your intentions with the new moon, select a time after the new moon alignment. Not before. Your desire is to have the moon ‘waxing’ / growing as you speak, write, and set your intentions. The most powerful manifesting period is the eight ( 8 ) hour window* that follows the exact new moon alignment. * if you cannot perform your ritual within the first 8 hours. You still have 60 hours after the exact New Moon alignment for manifesting Leo New Moon Ritual Fig 66. Top view of an altar to Sol & Leo [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Sol and your ritual candle(s) for Sol on the placement for Sol. Place The Sun & Strength tarot cards on your altar, as well as symbols for Leo and offerings to Sol. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration Bay Leaves, Garnet) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – You can petition Sol to ask for rejuvenating your spirit, elevate your mood, combating the winter doldrums, re-build or build self-esteem, be ‘seen’ by others, be adored and in the spotlight. The ritual for Leo season will be focused on building self-confidence, recognizing and developing leadership, burning away depression, assisting in recognition, and being “seen”, having our voices heard and respected. We strengthen ourselves by inhaling golden light into our heart chakra and exhaling the shadow of our sorrows and disillusions. Agrippa calls the Sun, the “lucid flame”. ● ● ● ● ● ● ● ● ● To be recognized or noticed by others To increase physical and mental energy levels To increase motivation and ability to exercise and diet effectively To improve self-confidence and self-worth To enhance overall well-being and contentment To improve relationships and happiness with loved ones To create a positive and uplifting atmosphere To alleviate feelings of sadness or depression To enhance performance and presence in public settings 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. Give Thanks. 11. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: ● Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. ● Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. ● Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. ● Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. Exploring Leo Season And The New Moon Through Journaling Leo is a sign of self-expression and creativity, representing our ability to shine and be true to ourselves. During Leo season or a Leo full moon, the universe may bring up issues related to your personal authenticity and how you express yourself. You can use tarot as a way to inspire journaling. Select a spread or layout that resonates with your current focus or intention. Shuffle the deck and draw a card, then reflect on its meaning and symbolism. Use the card as a starting point for your journaling and allow its imagery and message to inspire your thoughts and feelings. Explore the card's themes and messages in greater depth and consider how they relate to your experiences and challenges. Reflect on how the card may offer guidance or insights for your current situation and how you can integrate its message into your life. Light a yellow candle and create a vibrant atmosphere by using lively scents and energetic music. Visualize yourself embracing your unique talents and gifts, and drawing strength from your own self-expression. Take this opportunity to reflect on your personal authenticity and how you express yourself. Open your journal and begin writing about your self-expression and creativity. You may also want to consider any challenges or obstacles you have faced in being true to yourself and brainstorm ways to overcome them. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you explore these themes. As you journey through Leo season, it's a great time to reflect on your personal authenticity and self-expression. By taking some time to journal about these topics, you can gain a deeper understanding of yourself and your passions. Here are some prompts to get you started: ● What makes you unique and special? How do you express your individuality? ● What are your creative passions and how do you pursue them? ● Are there any areas of your life where you feel like you are not being true to yourself? How can you work to be more authentic in these areas? ● How do you handle criticism or self-doubt in your pursuit of self-expression? What strategies have been effective for you in the past? A Letter To Your Father Leo, the sign of the king, personifies the father. This month, set the intention to write a letter to your father. This exercise is a powerful healing tool that can be done multiple times throughout the month, ideally on a Sunday (also known as "Sun's Day") to leverage the energies of the sun. This exercise can be done whether your father is living or deceased. If you have a photo of your father, place it in front of you as a visual anchor. To begin, light a white candle and create a calming atmosphere by using incense and soothing music. Visualize yourself channeling healing light from the sun down to the spirit and essence of your father. Take this opportunity to forgive him for any mistakes he may have made, intentionally or unintentionally. Then, express gratitude for the role he played in your life, whether as a father figure, authority figure, or provider. Show him all the respect and love that you can. After your visualization, open your journal and begin writing your letter to your father. You do not need to send this letter, but the act of writing can be a powerful way to connect with your emotions and let go of any lingering pain or resentment. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you work through this process. *If writing to your father is too triggering at this time, you can write a letter to someone who is a father figure Qualities of a Good Father: ● What qualities do you admire in your father or other good fathers that you know? ● What qualities do you think are essential for a father to have in order to be supportive and loving towards his children? ● How have these qualities impacted your relationship with your father and your overall well-being? ● In what ways do you hope to embody these qualities as a father (if applicable)? Names for Father: ● What are some of the different names that you have called your father throughout your life? How have these changed as you have grown and your relationship with your father has evolved? ● What nicknames does your father call you, and how did they come about? Do these names hold any special meaning or significance for you? ● How do these different names reflect your relationship with your father and your feelings towards him? Your Father's Joys: ● What brings your father joy and makes him happy? ● Can you recall any specific memories of your father laughing or smiling? What was happening in these moments and how did they make you feel? ● How does your father's joy and happiness impact your relationship with him and your own sense of well-being? Your Father's Words: ● What are some things that your father always says or repeats often? ● How do these words make you feel? Do they provide comfort, guidance, or inspiration? ● In what ways do your father's words reflect his values and beliefs, and how have they influenced your own? Early Memories: ● What is one of your earliest memories of your father? ● How old were you in this memory and what was happening? ● How does this memory make you feel and what does it say about your relationship with your father at that time? Unsaid Words to your Father: ● Is there something that you have always wanted to tell your father but haven't had the chance to? ● Why have you not said this to him yet and how do you feel about not having said it? ● How do you think expressing these words to your father would impact your relationship with him? Father's Support and Protection: ● How has your father supported and protected you throughout your life? ● Can you think of any specific examples of times when your father has been there for you and helped guide or shelter you? ● How have these actions impacted your well-being and your relationship with your father? Lessons from Father: ● What important lesson or skill has your father taught you? ● How has this lesson or skill impacted your life and who you are today? heading: Exploring the Leo/Aquarius Polar Axis
body: “If we can stay with the tension of opposites long enough—sustain it, be true to it—we can sometimes become vessels within which the divine opposites come together and give birth to a new reality.” ― Marie-Louise von Franz The Full Moon brings to light the polarities that exist within each season, offering us a chance to find a balance between these opposing forces. As we explore the polarity of the Leo/Aquarius axis, we are called to explore the tension between the individual and the community, authority and freedom, the self and duty, and the heart and mind. The energies of the Sun and Uranus, the ruling planets of Leo and Aquarius, respectively, guide us on this quest for equilibrium. The Sun, as the ruler of Leo, represents the power of the individual, the king or leader, the performer, and the heart. Uranus, the ruler of Aquarius, represents the collective, the community, the audience, freedom, and the mind. Together, they offer a powerful opportunity to align our inner selves with the greater good of the community and find a balance between our personal desires and the needs of the collective. Leo rules the heart and the spine - the center of our own physical being and source of own spiritual Light. By embracing all that Leo has to teach us, we learn that Light (Sol/Spirit) is Love (Heart). Aquarius rules the nervous system - sending messages from the brain (air) to different parts of the body. The Leo/Aquarius axis is a time to align your mind with your heart and spirit. It is time to channel Aquarius higher mental capacities, and adopt the unemotional and objective collective view to see past the emotional wounds, to discover healing solutions. Both Leo and Aquarius want to shine a light on humanity, celebrate our differences (Aquarius), and share Light/Love (Leo). Leo reminds us of our expansiveness, our generosity and our great capacity to love. Aquarius reminds us that we are all connected to each other, and that our minds have incredible healing power. It is during Leo season where we can connect deeper with our passion. The creative expression of the Leo can fuel Aquarian intuition and progressive thinking. The spark (fire) that can be channeled by Aquarius’ mental (air) framework. By harmonizing the energies of the individual self and the collective community, we have the ability to bring about change on both a personal and communal level. It is through aligning and balancing the polarities of Leo and Aquarius that we come to understand our own power as creators, healers, and leaders of our own lives. Aquarius Full Moon Full moons are high tides of power, amplifying and creative. The full moon is a time to celebrate and harvest our previous new moon intentions; otherwise, the full moon is a time to make energetic adjustments to align ourselves to call in our intentions. The full moon is a time of celebration and gathering. We sync to the cycle with community, nature, and Spirit. We gather to clear energy, raise energy, gain clarity, set intentions, process symbols, connect with nature, the Divine, and our Higher Self. The full moon illuminates the depths of your unconscious emotions, bringing them to the surface for reflection and release. This is a time of celebration and chaos, fulfillment and spontaneity. The Aquarius full moon blends the energies of moon in Aquarius and the sun in Leo, infusing your soul with a quirky, spontaneous, and visionary spirit. You are reminded of the positive qualities of Aquarius, such as intelligence, uniqueness, and connection to information, technology, and community. Aquarius energy embodies a future-minded perspective, always pushing the boundaries and refusing to be confined. They seek freedom and space to be true to themselves, unapologetically. As you tap into this energy, you may also be reminded of the shadow side of Aquarius - a tendency to neglect emotions, be detached, and lack of sensitivity. Instead, during this full moon, embrace the positive qualities of Aquarius, while also being mindful of the shadow side, and work to integrate it in a balanced way. The energy of Aquarius can bring forth a sense of detachment and aloofness towards emotions. This sign can sometimes be seen as selfish, unpredictable, rash, stubborn and even mean. Uranus, which rules Aquarius, is also associated with sudden and shocking traumas that can have a separating or electric quality to them. These traumatic experiences can cause dissociation, disconnection from one's physical body and difficulties in connecting with others. It can also have an impact on the nervous system, leaving one in a state of fight, flight or freeze as a survival mechanism. This mental connection can sometimes translate as downloads of psychic or spiritual information. Aquarius has a unique ability to tune into different frequencies and receive information that is beyond what we can normally physically see and hear. Aquarius often has the stigma of being alien or bizarre, when in reality they are just accessing information that they eventually express outwardly. Sometimes this can even be in the form of dreams or insights that eventually end up as new innovations, inventions, and technologies. The positive outcome of a more aloof or disconnected state is that sometimes this can give us more perspective and take things less personally. We may be experiencing sudden and shocking events that trigger core wounds. This could be happening on a personal and collective level as Aquarius is associated with the greater community. We may come face to face with some social injustices and/or core wounds that are needing attention. Aquarius can help us find new solutions to long term problems and give us the opportunity to heal, empathize, connect, and create a more sustainable and compassionate existence. New information that was previously hidden may be surfacing that disrupts our stability and security, but also offers opportunity to heal and find connection again. This could include areas of friendships, creative projects, children, finances, values, and love relationships that impact our own sense of self-worth. This is often at the root of Aquarius’s aloofness and disconnection as there’s a general sense of lack of safety and security from past events that caused one to retreat inside, away from others, often into the mind and creative process. Aquarius is an Air sign after all. It could also mean that there’s a big positive breakthrough happening in these areas of your life. You’re expanding past old limitations and boundaries that have previously kept you safe and stagnant. There’s nothing stagnating about Uranus/Aquarius, and if you’re having some big inspiration, you could gain a lot by taking action, even if it feels unsafe and unpredictable. Full Moons bring our unconscious emotions to light and because the full moon is a an opposition, challenges typically arise between our own needs and the needs of others. We are working to find harmony through exploring opposing needs and values. The energy of Aquarius demands freedom, individual expression and space, and if we feel restricted or smothered in any situation, this is likely the time to take a temporary or permanent break. We may also look within to explore why we feel smothered and if we can respond by opening up and connecting if it feels safe. We are also working with the Fixed signs of the Zodiac, which brings the potential for stubbornness and unwavering perspectives. This also means that we may have the determination and persistence to keep working through challenges to grow and gain deeper connections. But make sure that what you're committing to is in your highest good and serving you, not just holding on because you fear change. The Leo/Aquarius axis is a time to align our mind with our heart and spirit. It's a time to channel Aquarius' higher mental capacities and adopt an unemotional and objective collective view to discover healing solutions. We are reviewing patterns of aloofness and emotional disconnection and releasing the stories of trauma that are perpetuating these patterns. We are illuminating and transforming the dysfunctional collective patterns by awakening and healing one by one. Now is the time to practice present-moment awareness and patience. If we can find stillness amidst the chaos and go within, we will find a wealth of information and answers to help us heal. Not only is our body where we store our traumas, but it also holds the wisdom to help us heal them. Our body awareness and intuition are heightened, calling us to tend to our triggers with curiosity and compassion, instead of impulsivity, aggression, and disconnection. This is a time to reconnect with community and altruistic endeavors, as new opportunities may arise for us to shift our focus from a purely selfish perspective to a broader, collective awareness. As we delve deeper into the collective consciousness, we may find ourselves discovering a new identity within it - one that is focused on sharing our unique gifts for the greater good, with a sense of selflessness, joy, and open-hearted generosity. Let us embrace this energy, and allow it to guide us toward a brighter future for all. This Aquarian full moon is illuminating the messages that we need to pay attention to, and they're not subtle. The energy of Uranus is electric, eye-opening, sudden, and in your face. It's important to find grounding ways to take care of ourselves, or we may easily become overwhelmed by our nervous system. If you've been holding on to something out of fear, this full moon may force a break, allowing you to realign with a better and more joyful vision. Take this time to think about what you want for yourself in the future - what type of community and friendships do you want? How can you serve the greater collective? How are your own fears of connection and desires for freedom affecting your happiness? The Aquarius full moon is about making personal, communal, and collective breakthroughs that serve to heal and support us. Before acting, take some time for reflection, support your nervous system, and don't let this dynamic and expansive energy pass you by.
