heading: The Exploring the Virgo/Pisces Polar Axis
body: The decisions and actions you take today, are the building blocks of your future. Virgo contains the discipline necessary to create Heaven here on earth. Virgo takes what is ethereal (Pisces), a thought or day dream (seeds of literal potential), and gets to down to work; working this dream into a reality. Virgo has the discipline and focus to make day to day decisions, create routine and habits, to build - step by step. Virgo keeps us focused, and committed to stay the course, on the path towards manifestation. Each Zodiac Season highlights a Full Moon / Sun polarity. Not only are we learning the lessons of Virgo season, but we are also gifted an opportunity to achieve an energetic balance between the Virgo/Pisces axis. We will explore the polarity between Virgo/Pisces and Mercury/Neptune. The polarity of the Virgo/Pisces is considered one of the most challenging and karmic axes in astrology. This polarity is about balancing order (Virgo) and chaos (Pisces). From disorganization to organization, we seek stability within the rise and fall of the emotional waves. Virgo contains the discipline necessary to create Heaven (Pisces) here on earth (Virgo). Virgo takes what is ethereal (Pisces), a thought or daydream (seeds of potential), and gets to work, working this dream and this thought - and bringing it down into a reality. Virgo has the discipline and focuses to create routines and habits, to plan and build - step by step. Virgo keeps us committed to stay the course, on the path to manifest our dream. It is by embracing all that Virgo has to teach us, we learn that we can create healthy routines and boundaries for self-care. Virgo season teaches us to create new habits that support the manifestation of the dreams the Pisces Full Moon brings. Virgo’s discipline and organization skills can assist the energy of Pisces to create a space for organized manifestation. When we properly balance and channel the Virgo/Pisces energies, we are able to manifest Heaven (Pisces) on Earth (Virgo). Pisces Full Moon: Dream (Pisces) and Reality (Virgo) As the full moon rises in Pisces, the night sky transforms into a canvas of ethereal beauty. A serene and powerful spiritual and psychic energy permeates the air, illuminating the darkness like a beacon of light. This is a perfect time for divination work, such as reading tarot or interpreting astrology, as the energy of Pisces is one of introspection and self-reflection. To fully embrace this energy, it is best to focus on solitary rituals, rather than large gatherings. During this moon's transit, the senses are heightened and one may find themselves more in tune with beauty and art. Creativity flows freely, like a river of inspiration. This is a time to trust your intuition and be open to receiving messages from the universe. Emotions may run deep, like a vast ocean, and it's important to let yourself swim in those feelings, but be mindful not to drown in them. The full moon is a time of celebration, gathering, and raising energy. We can use it to align ourselves with our intention or make adjustments if needed. It is a time to clear energy, gain clarity, set intentions, and connect with nature, the Divine, and our Higher Self. We have the sun in practical, reality-grounded Virgo and the moon in dreamy Pisces. You will see a striking dichotomy between your emotional world (Moon in Pisces), and the details that make up your physical reality (Sun in Virgo). This push to look at how you “feel” about the world vs. how you actually experience it may be overwhelming, pushing you to seek substance or sleep. Pisces is expansive, connected, compassionate, empathic, creative, intuitive, and caring. Pisces gives us access to the unseen worlds in which healing and regeneration occur. It allows us to be still within the oneness of the cosmos, and remember that we are more than just physical beings. Pisces is the sign of dreams. Great dreams create great realities. Dreamers hold the keys to future achievement because they preserve the hopes of their ancestors and those of future generations. This full moon is a reminder that dreamers must be safeguarded. We come from a place of love and beauty and will return to that when our time here in physical form is complete. Pisces reminds us to slow down, take time for ourselves, meditate, rejuvenate, and heal from any emotional or physical challenges we’ve experienced. Pisces is about clearing up karma and emotional wounding. During this Pisces full moon, the depths of your unconscious are being stirred, urging you to confront the emotional aftermath of situations that you may have been avoiding. It is a powerful call to address the underlying emotional content that has been lingering beneath the surface. If you lack the necessary tools to navigate and process these emotions, you might find yourself in a state of denial or engaging in addictive behaviors as a means of escape. However, it is essential to recognize that the pain and grief that arise serve as both your teacher and your path towards breaking free from unhealthy patterns. This introspective journey may lead you to gain clarity regarding the projections or illusions you held about a person or situation. You could find yourself confronted with disappointment, hopelessness, and frustration as these illusions crumble. It is crucial to avoid solely placing blame on external factors or individuals. Instead, the invitation is to look in the mirror and honestly assess how you have contributed to your current circumstances. This process may reveal uncomfortable truths about your own actions and choices, more so than you might be willing to admit. As challenging as this self-reflection may be, it offers a profound opportunity for growth and transformation. By acknowledging your own role in the creation of your reality, you gain the power to make conscious choices and change the course of your life. It is through this honest self-appraisal that you can liberate yourself from patterns that no longer serve you and begin to cultivate a more authentic and fulfilling path. Each full moon highlights polarities, and this season we explore the Virgo / Pisces axis. We will see a striking dichotomy between our emotional world (moon in Pisces), and how we handle it, and our physical reality and its details (Sun in Virgo). Not only are we learning the lessons of Virgo, but we are also gifted an opportunity to achieve an energetic balance between these two polarities. For many, striking a balance between these two will feel overwhelming. For it asks that we look at how we “feel” (Pisces) about the world and how we actually experience and live in it - day to day (Virgo). Virgo season and the Pisces full moon is a great time to get into an exercise or diet program to balance out any emotional eating (or non-eating) habits that we have or too exercise moderation with alcohol or any other substance that alters our perceptions and can affect our health. Sleep, too much or not enough, can also be an issue that needs to be addressed this month. The rest we need versus the physical exercise our body needs is personal to each individual. Adjusting those needs will make a difference in our physical, mental and emotional health. The polarity of the Virgo/Pisces is considered one of the most challenging and karmic axes in astrology. This polarity is about balancing order (Virgo) and chaos (Pisces). From disorganization to organization, we seek stability within the rise and fall of the emotional waves. The Pisces full moon gifts us access to channel what swims in the depths of our unconsciousness. One of the most effective ways to influence positive change in your life is to work in tandem with your conscious and unconscious mind. The art of Lucid Dreaming allows one to work directly with one's mind; becoming self-aware, "awake," within a dream. As you develop this skill, you can adjust and create a shift in your unconscious, allowing for significant shifts on the surface. As you journey through the ebb and flow of the month, the balance between rest and rejuvenation and movement and activity may come into focus. Sleep, too much or too little, can be an issue that needs to be addressed and balanced. You have unique needs for rest and movement, and by listening to your body and adjusting accordingly, you can nurture your physical, mental, and emotional well-being. Dreams may be more vivid at this time as the subconscious communicates with you, revealing the deeper truths of your being. The Pisces full moon is loaded with dream symbolism. Dreams can alert us to health issues (Virgo) and give us warnings about the issues that we can’t or won’t acknowledge in our waking life. The language of dream symbolism is a lot simpler than one may expect if we are willing to let go of our attachments to the people and defense mechanisms in our lives; we open ourselves to the messages the universe is sending us. We tend to see what helps us get along with others instead of the truth. We often want to believe that everything is as it seems when interacting with others, but our dreams can reveal the subtle clues that we miss, showing us what we need to protect ourselves from. Society may teach us not to "rock the boat" and to believe that all people are good, but what about those who are not? This is where our dreams take over, they show us a projection through symbols of what we are missing and don't want to see. By understanding the symbols that appear in our dreams, both personally and collectively, we can use that information to navigate the path ahead with greater wisdom and insight, allowing us to make better decisions in our lives. During the Pisces full moon, the wall between our dreams and emotions and our reality may come crashing down forcing us to deal with unpleasant (though not always) issues and past traumas. This can be painful though it will be quite liberating, giving us all a chance to heal and make positive changes in our lives. The Pisces full moon asks that we wash away what no longer serves us. The ultimate release of our ego, emotional wounds, and old identity. Most importantly, during this full moon take time to rest and not push yourself. Listen to your intuition, focus - realistically- on your dreams and goals, and care for yourself. Create new habits that support the manifestation of your dreams. Go out in Nature, because in nature we get to see and experience with wonder Source’s perfect creation. Remember that you are also a manifestation of this perfection and interconnected with all. As the moon moves towards Aries, the mood shifts to more optimistic and outgoing energy. This is a time to reflect on the beauty and lessons of the past and anticipate new beginnings. Embrace the powerful energy present during this time and let it guide you on your spiritual journey. Allow the light of the full moon in Pisces to shine within you, illuminating the path ahead and guiding you toward inner peace and acceptance. With each step, the light grows stronger, illuminating the way to a brighter future.

heading: Pisces Full Moon Actions & Intentions
body: s Pisces full moon brings with it a call to explore the mysteries of the universe and tap into your intuition and creativity. Allow yourself to be guided by the moon's light and be inspired by the beauty and majesty of the natural world. Take time to connect with your emotions and be vulnerable and open as you immerse yourself in the magic of the cosmos. Let the Pisces full moon remind you of the power of connection and flow, and allow yourself to be filled with wonder and inspiration as you journey toward personal growth and self-discovery. The Pisces full moon is a time to reflect on your dreams and emotions. Envoke Luna, Jupiter (ancient planetary ruler), or Neptune to interpret the symbolism in your dreams and subconscious; and wash away what no longer serves you. Create an altar – During the Pisces full moon, it is a good time to create a sacred space for Jupiter, the ancient planetary ruler of Pisces. To create an altar, you can gather items that have personal meaning or significance to you. You might also collect items that symbolize Jupiter and Pisces. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Be mindful – Observing your thoughts, experiences, and observations in a journal can be a powerful way to gain insights into your own inner landscape. You might also consider using tarot cards or other divination tools to help you explore your inner world. Collecting items – pens, paper, tarot cards, candles, incense, and herbs can be a way to create a sense of ritual and intention as you work through your full moon intentions. You might also consider incorporating other elements, like crystals or sound healing tools, into your altar. Reflect on where you were six months ago – What you were manifesting and striving for Take stock of your progress and make any necessary adjustments. Explore your creativity and intuition – Set an intention to tap into your creativity and follow your intuition during this time. This may involve trying new artistic or creative endeavors, engaging in activities that bring you joy and relaxation, or simply taking time to reflect on your innermost thoughts and feelings. Dive into your emotions and be vulnerable – Take this opportunity to explore your emotions and allow yourself to be vulnerable and open. This may involve seeking out therapy or other forms of support, sharing your feelings with trusted friends or loved ones, or simply taking time to process your emotions and learn from them. Cultivate a sense of connection and flow – Set an intention to cultivate a sense of connection and flow in your life. This may involve finding ways to connect more deeply with others, aligning your actions with your values and goals, or simply taking time to be present and mindful in the moment. Let go of escapism and substance use – Reflect on any habits or behaviors that may be causing you to rely on escapism or substance use as a way to cope with negative thoughts or emotions. Consider setting an intention to let go of these habits and find healthier ways to manage stress and cope with negative emotions. This may involve finding alternative ways to relax and unwind, seeking support from friends or a therapist, or engaging in activities that bring you joy and fulfillment.

There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes; the one I favor is to select tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements; mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cars from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Leo Season, the sun is in Leo (Strength), opposite The Moon (High Priestess) in Aquarius (The Star). For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the full moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 7th position, select a card from the second pile, which contains the court cards and the Minor Arcana. heading: Pisces Full Moon Ritual
body: “I release everything either known or unknown to me that has been blocking me from receiving, feeling, and walking in my strength and authority. I trust and discover strength in my body, mind, self, and spirit. I call in my power and walk in my strength.” - A prayer for release Fig 68. Top view of an altar to Jupiter and Pisces [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Jupiter and your ritual candle(s) for Jupiter on the placement for Jupiter. Place The Wheel of Fortune, The Moon tarot cards on your altar, as well as an offering to Jupiter. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration St John’s wort) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – Petition Luna to set intentions. Luna assists with fertility, intuition, illusion, dreams, lucid dreaming, illusion & glamour – being seen as you’d desire. Envoke Luna, or Jupiter, to interpret the symbolism in your dreams and subconscious; wash away what no longer serves you. Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space not to be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, dispose of the items appropriately. Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. *** 999 Libra Season: Sept 23rd - Oct 22nd 7th house, Planetary Ruler Venus How can I deepen the relationships I have with myself and others? Relationships & Self Love New Moon – Libra Full Moon – Aries Planet – Venus Day of the Week – Friday (ruled by Venus) Element – Air Tarot – Justice Affirmation – I respect the needs, values, and views of the people in all of my relationships Step into the embrace of Libra season and the arrival of the Autumn Equinox! As the vibrant leaves gracefully descend, and daylight gradually retreats, we find ourselves at a delicate equilibrium between light and darkness, mirroring the harmonizing scales of Libra that seek balance within our inner and outer realms. It is a season of preservation, a time when we instinctively gather our resources, draw sustenance, and redirect our focus inward. Just as nature begings its phase of conserving energy and preparing for the colder months, we too are invited to turn our attention to self-care and introspection. The shifting energies of Libra season encourage us to examine the intricate balance between our personal needs and the demands of our external world. It is an opportunity to evaluate our relationships, partnerships, and the way we interact with others, seeking equilibrium and harmony in our connections. Libra is the sign of relationships and partnerships, this season is a time to focus on our relationships as we seek internal support and security. As we tend to our relationships, we also nourish ourselves and the relationships around us, just like the leaves that fall and gather on the ground, nurturing the soil and playing an important role in the cycle of growth and rejuvenation. Let us embrace this Libra energy to shift our focus to cultivating relationships that bring us internal support and security. As we nurture our relationships, we also nurture ourselves and the world around us, creating a harmonious and balanced existence. As we step into Libra season, we are called to take the lessons we learned during Virgo season and apply them to our relationships with others. Now that we have learned to value our own self-worth and accept our imperfections, we are more likely to meet others halfway and accept them as they are. Libra symbolizes relationships and partnerships, and this season is all about focusing on these connections in our lives. This is a time to examine the balance in our relationships, and to ensure that our needs and wants are being met in a way that is fair and equitable for all parties involved. The lessons we learned during Virgo season about valuing ourselves and accepting our imperfections provide a sturdy foundation upon which we can construct healthier, more fulfilling relationships. With this new perspective, we are more likely to cultivate connections that are marked by mutual respect, shared values, and a balanced interchange of love and support. 1000 As we navigate this Libra energy, we may make major changes in our relationships if the balance cannot be struck. But this is not a negative thing. Instead, it is an opportunity to identify where we are giving and receiving our energy and to make sure that we are in balance. Perhaps we find ourselves continually supporting a colleague emotionally, but never feel reciprocated when we require a listening ear. Libra season invites us to evaluate this dynamic and consider if we are both giving and receiving what is deserved. Like the scales of Libra, this season gifts us the chance to take a peek at the cosmic balance sheet and see if we are receiving and giving what is deserved. During this season, we may also find that the social mask comes off, and we can witness the truths in our lives. A relationship that might have seemed perfect on the surface could reveal its cracks, perhaps displaying a lack of emotional depth or mutual understanding. Or, we may uncover a hidden strength in a connection that we previously undervalued, encouraging us to nurture it further. This is a powerful time to rearrange what isn’t working, and to get “unstuck” out of any circumstances or relationships that hold us back from doing our very best for ourselves and others. As we journey through Libra season, we are called to find balance and harmony in all aspects of our lives, particularly in our relationships. This can be a challenging process, as it often means swinging to opposite extremes and experiencing the discomfort of conflict and not getting exactly what we want. But this journey is necessary, as it helps us understand and respect another's perspective, and ultimately leads to compassion for others. The Aries Full Moon brings with it a sense of intimacy as we become intimately aware of the disempowered and vulnerable parts of ourselves. This is a time to reclaim the parts of ourselves that we have abandoned out of shame and pain. The energy of this full moon may be a swift boot kick of tough love, redirecting us onto a path that serves not only ourselves but others as well. Remember that creating boundaries with others is a compassionate act for both parties. This Libra season is a reminder to take the time to understand and respect the perspectives of others, while also taking care of ourselves. By finding balance and harmony within ourselves, we can also create balance and harmony in our relationships. Remember that creating boundaries with others is a compassionate act for both. During Libra season, we will explore the polarity between Libra and Aries. This polarity is one of Fire and Air, both in the Cardinal modality. Aries represents the self and the 1st house, while Libra represents the other and the 7th house. The Aries-Libra axis is all about reclaiming the lost self and establishing the correct balance between the self and the other. Aries is all about disrupting the status quo, asserting itself and proving its worth. This is a time for coming back into our bodies and discovering and negotiating the boundary between "me" and "them." Balancing (Libra) our needs with another's is an act to be approached with curiosity, non-judgement, and kindness. This Libra season is a time to explore the balance between our own needs and the needs of others and to find harmony in our relationships. Remember to approach this journey with an open mind and a kind heart.

heading: Libra Light & Shadow
body: Libras, represented by the astrological sign of the scales, are known to value harmony and balance and may go to great lengths to maintain these in their relationships. However, this desire for balance, connection, and harmony can sometimes cause Libras to neglect their own needs and become overly focused on pleasing others. This can lead to a tendency to avoid conflict or 1001 discomfort in order to maintain peace, even if it means sacrificing their own well-being. Libra's desire for connection causes them to lose themselves in others, and neglect their own needs for the sake of the relationship. Libra energy can be people pleasing to a fault, avoiding conflict and discomfort, because they only want to experience harmony and connection. This season, be mindful of your actions and the tendency to step into Libras’ shadow. Unevolved Libra energy can be people-pleasing to a fault, avoidant of conflict and discomfort, because they only want to experience harmony and connection. Libra in his shadow, can lose themselves in others, and neglect his own needs for the sake of the relationship. At the high-vibrational end, evolved Libra energy is that of the peacemaker. Libra Light & Strength – Compassion, understanding, relating, creating harmony, leadership, coaching, teaching Libra Shadow & Weakness – People-pleasing, manipulative, codependent, clingy, avoiding conflict, hypersensitive to peer pressure, attention-seeking (regardless of positive or negative). Libra Season, The 7th House And Venus Planetary Ruler Venus - She who allures As the Planetary Ruler of Libra, Venus is a goddess of allurement, the patroness of beauty, art, and abundance. She is renowned for her appreciation of the material possessions that bring her joy, and on Fridays, which are ruled by Venus, you are likewise encouraged to indulge in the pleasures of fine dining, entertainment, and the arts. Venus also holds sway over the flow of cash and the formation of bonds, both between people and objects. She reveals to you the desires of your heart and how you might best manage and fulfill them, as well as the ways in which you approach and maintain connections with others. But beware the shadow of Venus, for it is said to be marked by vanity and gossip. The 7th house, ruled by Venus, is the realm of relationships and partnerships. It asks of you that you move beyond your own needs and consider the dynamics of human connection. How do you approach others? With openness and curiosity, or through the filter of preconceived notions? The 7th house is associated with marriage and long-term, committed partnerships, and it can provide insight into the qualities and traits that you value in a partner, as well as your attitudes towards commitment and monogamy. The Mirror of Relationships – Where you have Libra in your chart, highlights where you would benefit to have a mirror. A partner to help you reflect on this area in your life 1002 Libra / Justice Justice is the eleventh key of the Major Arcana and the halfway point of the Fool's journey. When the Fool arrives at the center of her / his/ their Journey. Here, the Fool looks within and weighs her conscience in order to inquire as to the truth of her existence. Planetary Ruler – ♀Venus Symbolism – Justice is one of the four cardinal virtues mentioned in the Book of Wisdom in The Old Testament. The illustration of the Justice in the Golden Eclipse tarot we find Justice standing between the sun, the moon, and two pillars representing duality — the crux of good and evil, light and dark, etc. She embodies the third pillar, alluding to the three energy channels of a kundalini awakening. The jewel on her crown refers to the pineal gland, a pinecone-shaped gland found within the brain but behind the third eye, which is activated during a kundalini awakening. Justice desires harmony, and with her sword, she cuts away all that is imbalanced and hinders the awakening process. The modern Lady Justice corresponds to the Greek goddess Themis, Roman Iustitia, and the Egyptian goddess Maat. Ancient Egyptian beliefs held that after death, the soul was judged in the Hall of Maat. The heart, or conscience, of the departed soul was weighed against the feather of Ma’at,an ostrich feather, on the scales of balance and justice. If their heart was heavier than the feather, they did not live a balanced or just life;if the scales were balanced, that meant that they lived a just life, and the soul gained eternal life. In ancient Greece, it was believed that the goddess Themis oversaw divine order and laws. While the Romain Iustitia carried a sword which cut through conflicts and punished the guilty. All variations of Justice weighed the truth on scales, represented on the card's illustration. Astrology – Justice corresponds to Libra, during whose season we experience the autumn equinox: a balancing point between the day and night. Libra is the sign of "the other," symbolizes relationships and partnerships, and asks that we seek harmony and balance in the relationships in our lives. What we need and want from others, needs to be balanced with what they want and need from us in return. If that balance cannot be struck, it will be time for major changes. This energy helps identify whom and where we are giving and receiving our energy; like the scales of Libra, asking us to weigh the energetic exchange - are we in balance? We get a look at the cosmic balance sheet to see if we are getting / giving what is deserved. This can be very positive when the social mask comes off, and we can witness the truths in our lives. Upright Meaning – Cause and effect, the workings of destiny or karma, the consequences or rewards of past actions, law, trial, justice, truth, balance, achieving balance after tribulations, 1003 retribution, the law on your side, favorable outcome of judicial matters, responsible conduct, making well balanced choices, integrity, peace of mind Reversed – Lying, not being truthful to oneself, dishonest dealings, ignoring or denying the true motivations of one's actions, judgment due to prejudice, injustice, unbalance, cheating, unfair, the law not on your side, being stuck due to a complex legal matter, mental abuse

heading: Libra Season and Libra New Moon: Actions and Intentions
body: During Libra season, you will focus on relationships and partnerships. As the sign of "the other," Libra encourages you to seek harmony and balance in your relationships. This includes cultivating a healthy relationship with yourself, which requires ongoing attention and effort. Just as you fall in and out of love with others, your relationship with yourself also needs nurturing, levity, honesty, balanced communication, and support. To create and maintain healthy relationships, it's important to regularly check in with yourself and ensure that you are taking care of your own needs and treating yourself with kindness and respect. Libras love connecting with others and exploring all kinds of relationships. However, sometimes their desire for connection causes them to lose themselves in others and neglect their own needs for the sake of the relationship. They can be prone to people-pleasing to a fault, avoiding conflict and discomfort because they only want to experience harmony and connection. The glyph of Libra represents the setting sun, reminding you that your past is always with you in the present. The scales represent balance, and if you find the scales unbalanced, you are compelled to correct this imbalance. I AM in balance and harmony with myself and my relationships. I AM open and honest in my communication, and I nurture and strengthen my connections with others. I AM confident in my self-love and self-trust, and I AM committed to creating trust and harmony in all of my relationships. Perform a ritual for self-love and relationships. Reflect on Relationships – Reflect on your relationships and identify areas where you may need to work on creating balance or harmony. Consider what you can do to improve communication, cooperation, and understanding with others. Seek out opportunities for connection – Collaboration with others, whether through socializing, networking, or participating in group activities. I move my awareness beyond my own needs and seek to meet others with openness and understanding. I strive for balance and harmony in all areas of my life. Nurture and Strengthen Healthy Relationships – Focus on building and maintaining healthy relationships, whether romantic, platonic, or professional. Take time to nurture and strengthen your connections with others. Speaking the truth –Trust starts with you. When you practice self-love, honesty, and self-care, it builds trust within yourself, which can help create more trust and harmony in your relationships. The more you invest in yourself, the more secure you will feel in any relationship. I speak my truth with honesty and self-love, fostering trust and harmony in my relationships. Consider seeking the guidance of a therapist or coach to help you work through any challenges you may be facing. Take time to meditate, journal, or practice other forms of self-reflection to help you stay centered and grounded during this time of heightened focus on relationships. Seeking Balance – I seek balance and common values in my relationships, creating a solid foundation for health and harmony. Appreciating Art – I appreciate the beauty and art in my life, and I seek out holistic remedies for healing and self-care. Embrace your inner Venus. Venus encourages you to seek out beauty in all its forms and revel in the appreciation of art, music, and love. Find joy in all the little things that make life special, and take time to appreciate what surrounds you. 1005 Libra New Moon: Harmonious Habits As we reach the balancing point between day and night, as we move from Summer into Fall and Light into Dark, we are called to conserve our energy and resources. This is a time when we focus on cultivating relationships for internal support and security, and begin to go inward. Libra symbolizes relationships and partnerships, and this season and month is all about focusing on these connections in our lives. Libra is the sign of "the other" and the upcoming Libra New Moon will ask us to seek harmony and balance in the relationships in our lives. This is a time to reflect on our relationships and examine the balance in them. Are we giving and receiving energy in a fair and equitable way? Are we in harmony with the people in our lives? Use this Libra energy to find balance and harmony in your relationships. Relationships have been a big focus, both intimate and business. Libra is playful, charismatic, charming, loving, and talkative. They love connecting with others and exploring all types of relationships. Libra's desire to connect causes them to lose themselves in others, and neglect their own needs for the sake of the relationship. This is the biggest challenge of Libra’s energy. During Libra Season, and the Libra New Moon - let's observe any people's pleasing behavior. Are you bending the truth, withholding information or outright lying - to keep balance, or avoid conflict and discomfort. Discomfort is where we grow and the truth and darkness will surface eventually. And now may be one of those times. The Libra new moon asks that we look at our codependency and trust issues, childhood wounds, and power dynamics. For some the outcome may look like a deepening commitment as fears are faced, overcome, and healed, and intimacy and trust increase. And for others the outcome may look like a separation or final parting of ways as the realization arises that things aren’t working out, values are different, and/or we are being treated poorly and disrespected. The balance of needs and the desire for harmony is a major Libra theme. The journey to finding balance and harmony sometimes means that we must swing to opposite extremes and experience the discomfort of conflict and not getting exactly what we want. This journey is to help us understand and respect another’s perspective and hopefully have compassion for them. If there’s a desire to continue the relationship, it means there’s a willingness to tell the truth no matter how much it disrupts harmony. It means being willing to meet in the middle and find a way where both needs can be met. If there’s no flexibility or desire to bend or give up certain needs, which is completely valid, then the relationship will likely dissolve or break for a time until there is willingness to change, or a change of circumstances occurs. If you are experiencing any of the below themes, it’s giving you the fuel to change the way you’ve been doing things and seek out happiness and love within yourself: New information might create sudden changes or insight. We may have a new awareness around our triggers and wounds. We may come face to face with our feelings of loneliness, abandonment, and rejection. Dysfunctional or abusive situations can be let go during this time to make way for a new version of yourself and a new vision of future relationships. ● Sacrificing your needs is ok on occasion, but the buildup of resentment when you neglect yourself will create serious challenges. ● ● ● ● 1006 With all the triggers and changes arising right now, remember that Libra’s strength is to find common values and perspectives and create a solid ground and foundation for healthy relationships. Keep asking yourself what you value and need above all else, and how that fits into the lives of those around. Honesty, self-love and self-care will help create trust and harmony in your relationships in the long run. And most of all it will help strengthen your own self-trust. 1007

heading: Libra new moon and Tarotscopes

Whether it be romantic, platonic, or professional, consider how you can bring a sense of fairness and equity to these connections. The new moon in Libra is also a time to focus on self-care and self-love. Take some time to pamper yourself and appreciate the beauty within and around you. Remember that true balance and harmony come from within, so take care of yourself first in order to be able to extend that balance to your relationships. Use these Libra new moon horoscopes to guide you in setting intentions around finding balance and harmony in your life, and embrace the peaceful, mediating energy of Libra to bring beauty and grace to all areas of your life. Use these horoscopes to guide your new moon goals and intentions. heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Libra new moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. You can use different techniques to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 6-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during the Libra new moon, the Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) are in Libra (Justice). 1008 Then, find the Sun (Sun), Justice (Libra), and The High Priestess (Moon), and place the Sun in position 1, High Priestess in position 2, and Death in position 3. For positions 4 and 5, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the new moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 6th position, select a card from the second pile containing the court cards and the Minor Arcana. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. Tarotscope Key 3. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in Ex: Justice (Libra) during Libra new moon 1. The Sun (Sun) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The tarot card that corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house 6. The tarot card corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries or a supporting card from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance 4. The tarot card that corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house 1009

heading: Libra (Sept 23rd - Oct 22nd) & Libra Rising - New moon in the 1st House
body: Happy solar return, dear Libra! This new moon in your home sign brings about a transformation in your communication and self-expression. You may feel a sense of tension as you try to figure out how best to present your new vision of yourself to the world. This is a time to reassess your relationships, career goals, and personal identity. Take the opportunity to set new intentions for the future and to take steps towards creating a vision of yourself that feels authentic and fulfilling. The Libra new moon in your first house, is like a phoenix rising from the ashes, bringing with it new beginnings and a chance for self-discovery. This is a time to dig deep and unearth your deepest desires and to be honest with yourself about what you truly want and need. Take the time to map out a plan for overcoming any challenges or setbacks of the past. Embrace your strengths and set intentions that align with your values and priorities. This new moon is a powerful opportunity for transformation and the birth of a new, authentic vision of yourself. 1st house, ruled by Aries, corresponds to the Emperor in the Major Arcana. Aries represents new beginnings and karmic cycles, while the Emperor asks you to find and assert your individuality apart from external, socially defined norms. This is a time to step firmly into your authority and power, cultivating a healthy self-image and personal responsibility. With a New Moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings. and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This is a time of rebirth and redirection. Your intention for this New Moon is, “To trust where your emotional and intuitive compass is taking you and be true to your inner guidance” 1010

heading: Virgo (Aug 23rd - Sept 22nd) & Virgo Rising - New moon in the 2nd House
body: The Libra new moon activates your 2nd House of Disposable Income and Foundation. There’s been a lot of activity in your sign over the last few weeks. You are emerging with a new sense of who you are and what direction you want to take. During this new moon, it's really important to learn to value your self-worth and to embrace any imperfections you might have. You may have been doing some behind-the-scenes work lately, and now is the time for that hard work to pay off. Keep showing up for yourself and believing in your talents. Trust me, your efforts will be noticed and appreciated. How much you value yourself is apparent in what you’re manifesting externally. This new moon serves as a wise counselor, guiding you toward a deeper understanding of your financial situation and potential for growth. Take heed of its advice and seek out new opportunities to increase your prosperity. Whether it's through diversifying your income streams, sharpening your skills, or becoming more mindful of your spending habits, this new moon urges you to take steps toward financial stability. It also reminds you to consider how you can bring value to your own life and the lives of others through your career, personal development or community involvement. Heed the counsel of this new moon and make it a turning point in your financial journey. The second house corresponds to The Hierophant in Major Arcana. The Hierophant teaches that there is more than just the material world; there is a divine ruler. As the High Priestess taught the Fool to discover spiritual wisdom from within, the Hierophant teaches the Fool to find spiritual wisdom from external sources: Spiritual leaders, mentors, ancestors, and community. The Hierophant's links to religion, knowledge, and traditions passed down through oral teachings parallel the "fixed" teachings that comprise our social and religious framework. The Hierophant teaches you to return to tradition; you may have expanded your horizons past your comfort zone, and now it's time to return to the familiar to re-frame your focus. Venus is the planetary ruler of the 2nd house, which corresponds to The Empress in the Major Arcana. During this full moon, you would benefit from the guidance of a financial planner, estate lawyer, or therapist. This new moon is about reconnecting to your resources, finances, security, and self-worth. Taking time to realign your values is critical to your emotional well-being. Engage in creative endeavors that stimulate you financially and intuitively. You’re exploring how to create a solid foundation under your feet. Discover what foundation and comfort mean for you at this time. Your intention for this New Moon is, “To explore the value of healthy pleasure and sensation and trust in the wisdom of your body.” 1012

heading: Leo (July 23rd - Aug 22nd) & Leo Rising - New moon in the 3rd House
body: The Libra new moon activates your 3rd House of communication, early education, processing information, community, siblings, and neighbors. The new moon in Libra also brings with it a strong sense of passion and excitement for your ideas and concepts. You may find yourself feeling particularly energized and enthusiastic about sharing information and knowledge with others. This could manifest in various ways such as starting a blog, leading a workshop, or taking on a mentor role. Embrace this energy and use it to connect with others, share your ideas and knowledge, and inspire others to do the same. Remember to be open-minded to others’ ideas and perspectives, and to seek out feedback and input to further refine and develop your own ideas. The new moon in Libra is a powerful time to bring new ideas to life. You may be feeling ready to start teaching or to return to school, and this is a great opportunity to use your creative energy to create something that you can offer to others. It's important to be mindful of your words during this time, as gossiping can lead to anger and hurt. Instead, focus on yourself and on what you have to share with the world. Don't get caught up in comparing yourself to others or focusing on what they have or do. You have a lot to offer, and this is the time to share it. Overall, the New Moon in Libra is a time to tap into your creative energy and to share your ideas and talents with the world. It's a time to focus on your own path and to let go of any tendencies to compare yourself to others. Trust in your abilities and take the time to create something meaningful and valuable. The third house is ruled by Gemini (The Lovers) and Mercury (The Magician) as its planetary ruler. The Lovers and The Magician allude to the magick and power of connections. The new moon in the 3rd house invites you to seek and give support in your local community. Connect with friends, family, and neighbors to provide support and receive help in return. Whether it's to take on a new project, open a local business, spark a creative idea, or just find someone to talk to who offers you a sense of belonging. Competition creates disharmony. Collaboration creates connection. Communication, perspective shifts, and information are streaming into you and swirling around you. Your intention for this New Moon is, “To allow the flow of information to help remold and communicate your values and emotional expression.” 1014

heading: Cancer (June 21 – July 22nd) & Cancer Rising - New moon in the 4th House
body: The Libra new moon activates your 4th house of home and family. As the New Moon in Libra illuminates your 4th house, it brings to light the emotional foundations of your life. This is a time to focus on the emotional needs that drive you and the role your home plays in fulfilling those needs. You may be feeling the urge to make changes to your living space, whether that means moving, redecorating or simply decluttering. This is an opportunity to create a sanctuary that brings you peace and contentment. It's also a time to reflect on the emotional ties that bind you to your family, loved ones, and your sense of home. Use this energy to cultivate deeper connections and a sense of belonging. The Libra new moon encourages you to create meaningful moments in your home. You could invite friends over for a cozy dinner party, rearrange your furniture to create fresh, new energy, or give your living space a splash of color with a fresh coat of paint. It doesn't have to be a grand gesture - it just needs to be something that feels special and significant. This is a great time to invest in your home and make new memories with the people you care about most. You might also notice changes in your home and family situation during this time, or you may be evaluating what brings you comfort and security. This could be both emotional security and physical security. It's possible that your family may need more from you than usual, which could bring up old wounds but also allow you to heal and move beyond old limitations. Take this opportunity to consider how your family fits into your future and how you can work towards cultivating deeper, healthier connections. The fourth house is ruled by Cancer, and corresponds to The Chariot in the Major Arcana; you may be feeling a strong desire to take control of your life and steer it in the direction you desire. The Chariot reminds you that you are in charge of your actions, reactions, and momentum and that you have the power to shape your own destiny. This is a time to focus on creating a sense of security and stability in your life, especially within your home. Your home is like a chariot, a safe and secure container that transports you and your belongings from one life event to another. It's important to have a strong foundation and a sense of belonging in order to navigate life successfully. The Chariot also asks you to take control of your emotions and to be mindful of how they influence your actions. This is a time to be proactive and to make conscious choices that align with your goals and values. Trust in your own strength and determination, and remember that you are the driver of your own life. The new moon in the fourth house is a time of new beginnings and a chance to take charge of your own path. Overall, the New Moon in Libra is a time to focus on your inner home and to find your sense of safety and security within yourself. This is where your power lies, and it's a great time to explore your emotional process and to create special moments in your home. Remember to take care of yourself and to invest in the people and things that bring you joy and comfort. As the night wears on and the moon continues to rise, you may find yourself feeling more connected to yourself and to those around you, nourished by the warmth and comfort of your own home. Your intention for this New Moon is, “To come back to your inner home and internal sense of safety and security. Here is where your power lies.” 1016

heading: Gemini (May 20th - June 20th) & Gemini Rising - New moon in the 5th House
body: The Libra new moon is in your 5th House of Fun, Children, and Creativity. During the New Moon in Libra, love, relationships, children, creativity, and self-expression may be at the forefront of your mind. This is a time to consider how you identify with these areas of your life and how they shape you. It's important to think about how you express yourself and how it's being received by others. Are you abandoning a part of yourself in order to receive love and validation? You may be feeling intense emotions about your worth and value, which could lead to temporary emotional conflict. One way to lift your mood during this time is to return to an old hobby or joyful pastime. It's important for you to stay connected to what you love and to have fun and enjoy yourself. Let yourself play and remember what it's like to be a child with curiosity. Nurturing your inner child can help you to cultivate self-love and love for others. The fifth house is ruled by the bold and fiery sign of Leo, you are invited to tap into your creativity and self-expression. This is a time to let go of any self-doubt or insecurity and embrace your unique talents and gifts. The Strength card of the Major Arcana reminds you of the sacred power that comes from emotional mastery. Close your eyes and visualize your inner creative fire like a flame, pulsing with vibrant energy and infinite possibilities. Allow yourself to become a channel for this creative force, and let your work radiate through you rather than simply being created by you. Trust in your ability to tap into this boundless source of inspiration and let it guide you. Embrace your humor, charisma, and optimism, and set an intention to magnetize love and new opportunities for connection into your life. Let your inner light shine brightly and trust in your ability to create and attract abundance. The new moon in Libra, in the fifth house, is a time of new beginnings and a chance to tap into your inner strength and creativity. Embrace your unique talents and let your light shine. The world is waiting for your unique spark to ignite and bring new and exciting possibilities into being. Your intention for this New Moon is to discover your inner child and nurture them in all the ways they wish. This will allow true self-love and love of others to unfold naturally. Remember to take care of yourself and to stay connected to what brings you joy and fulfillment. 1018

heading: Taurus (April 19th - May 20th) & Taurus Rising - New moon in the 6th House
body: The Libra new moon activates your 6th house of health, daily work, routine, and being of service. The New Moon in Libra signals a time to focus on creating a new self-care regimen that will help you feel more energized and bring more stability and routine to your life. This might include considering your work environment and finding ways to balance your responsibilities with self-care. It's important to be flexible and to embrace any challenges or changes that arise, as they are likely to help you break through disharmony and find your way back to health and service. If you've been giving too much of yourself lately, now is the time to focus on your own needs. Pushing yourself ahead when it's not the right time for you to move forward will only slow you down in the long run. On the other hand, if you've been obsessing too much about your health or work, it could be causing too much stress, and it's time to recalibrate and refocus your awareness. Your intention for this New Moon is to tend to yourself first so that you can better serve others. When you leave self-sacrifice tendencies behind and prioritize your own health and well-being, you'll find that opportunities open up and your overall health improves. Remember to focus on your own needs and to create a self-care regimen that helps you feel grounded and energized. This will allow you to better serve others and to move forward with confidence and clarity. The 6th house, ruled by the sign of Virgo, corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit teaches us to master the Self through practices such as silence, meditation, and analyzation. In this stage of your journey, you may be asked to be more attentive to details and to consider how you give too much of yourself, leaving you feeling drained and underappreciated. The new moon in the 6th house can teach you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals is essential for your overall health and wellness. Remember to focus on taking care of yourself and to be mindful of your own needs. This might include establishing a self-care routine or setting small, achievable goals that help you to feel grounded and energized. 1020

heading: Aries (March 21st - April 19th) & Aries Rising - New moon in the 7th House
body: The Libra new moon activates your 7th house of relationships. As the New Moon in Libra approaches, you may find that your relationships are reflecting back to you some important lessons about commitment and decision-making. This is a time to consider how your unwillingness to commit or make concrete decisions in the past may have led you down unhealthy roads and into unhealthy relationships. It's important to be honest with yourself and others about what you need from relationships. The 7th house is ruled by Libra, which corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice asks you to consider where you might be avoiding or denying the truth in your emotions and to take the time to look within and get to the root of any issues. It can be easy to be more compassionate towards others in your intimate relationships than towards yourself. You may lend a listening ear to your partner but then judge and criticize yourself for feeling emotional. Remember that feeling bad is complicated enough on its own and that trying to repress or suppress your emotions only makes things worse. Instead, try accepting your emotions and giving yourself the same emotional support that you would give to someone else. Allow yourself to feel your emotions without holding on to them or judging yourself for their intensity. If you're feeling stuck, consider reaching out to friends and family for support and practicing self-compassion. Take the time to explore your emotions and to get to the root of any issues. Remember that it's okay to feel a full range of emotions and that it's important to allow yourself to feel and process them in a healthy way. The new moon in the seventh house is a time of new beginnings and a chance to find balance and fairness in your relationships. Honesty can be a liberating act, and this New Moon offers an opportunity to make changes that will help you to evolve as a person and as a partner. Remember that truth is a priority in all relationships, and now is a good time to get everything out in the open. Some information might be a little jolting or painful, but try to see it as a necessary step towards greater intimacy or separation. During this time, you may also find that you're focusing on balancing your personal needs with the needs of others. You might see new relationships open up as others come to a close, and it's important to trust in the natural cycles of endings and beginnings. Your New Moon's intention is to tend to your heart in relationship matters and to trust in the cycles of life. Remember that a new life is always right around the corner, and take care of yourself as you navigate the ups and downs of relationships. 1022

heading: Pisces (Feb 19th - March 20th) & Pisces Rising - New moon in the 8th House
body: The Libra new moon activates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. It’s a time of transformation and trust in the unfolding of life. Areas of Intimacy and shared resources are your focus as you learn to trust in yourself. Power dynamics may force you to look inside yourself and access that well of inner power and strength you may not have known you have. Step to that edge of discomfort, and let go of that small version of yourself. Don’t fear what you might transform into. You are much more expansive and empowered than you realize. Being in connection with another may remind you of this, whether it’s birthed out of a deep connection or a lesson of disempowerment. Power dynamics that haven’t been addressed ask for changes in your relationships. Any unhealthy or abusive behaviors within yourself or from others need to be let go of, or you may experience some shocking moments which will force transformation. Be open to new solutions to old patterns, however uncomfortable or painful the solutions may seem. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the major arcana. This energy can manifest as a change in life, separation or 'death' from one's old self or old life, a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle, or a time to explore your shadow and fears to allow for release and transformation. In your 8th house, the Libra New Moon is a time to balance your fears with reason. Recognize the source of your fear. Fear can be a gift. Fear of letting go, fear that nothing will come, fear that space won't be filled. Trust yourself first, and everything else will align. There’s nothing wrong with small steps, but no step at all will keep you stuck. Is it based on real, present danger or is it a fear of the unknown or something that may happen in the future? By understanding where the fear is coming from, we can better assess whether it is warranted and take steps to address it. Seek out evidence to support or refute your fear. Is there evidence to support your fear or is it based on assumptions or beliefs that may not be accurate? Gather information and consider multiple viewpoints to help you see the situation more clearly. It's a time to delve deep into the mysteries of life and explore all the hidden corners of your soul. Now is the time to follow that path if you're feeling called to shamanism, astrology, tarot, or psychology. You may even decide to become a healer or a teacher. At any moment, you can find the brighter side of even the darkest topics and add a little lightness to the conversation. Your intention for this New Moon is, “Security is an inner construct that I have some control over. I build trust in myself and trust outside myself naturally follows. Even in the darkness, I find the light and power I hold within. I burn brighter with every step I take towards befriending my fears.” 1024

heading: Aquarius (Jan 20th - Feb 18th) & Aquarius Rising - New moon in the 9th House
body: The Libra new moon activates your 9th House of Higher Self, making it a time to push past your comfort zone and expand your horizons. Foreign cultures, places, and higher learning is calling for you, and you find some of your deepest desires being nurtured there. Traveling helps give you perspective in situations that may feel clogged and stifled. Use this New Moon to broaden your internal and external horizons to help you see life in a new and fresh way. Creativity is ignited, and you're ready to share your gifts with others through performance or through teaching. Any debates or conflicts of interest are an opportunity to find common ground instead of focusing on what’s not working. Stay connected to what feels true for you, and maybe even try on a few different “truths” to see which one resonates most for you. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance guides you to find the balance between the Mundane & Spiritual Worlds. If you live too anchored in the mundane, invite in more of life's mysteries. If you find yourself deep into Spiritual studies, ground yourself back down to earthly matters. If you can successfully find that perfect balance between your spiritual pursuits and your life on the ground, you can use the wisdom to unlock the mysteries to live an enchanted life. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering our purpose or meaning, mindfulness of overindulging or drinking, moderation, the balance of passion and reason, and cultivating patience. Your intention for this New Moon is, “To allow your perspective to be opened, and allow new truths and understandings to feed your spirit.” 1026

As you focus on what is working in your projects and relationships, take care to gently tend to what is not. This may require integrating your ability to think practically and outside the box.
