heading: Libra New Moon Ritual
body: Fig 69. Top view of an altar Venus & Libra [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Venus and your ritual candle(s) for Venus on the placement for Venus. Place The Empress and The Justice tarot cards on your altar, as well as symbols for Venus and Libra and offerings to Venus. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration Roses, Rose Quartz) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A 1035 bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. 1036 Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: ● Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. ● Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. ● Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. ● Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. 1037

heading: Exploring Libra Season and New Moon Through Journaling
body: Libra is the sign of balance and harmony, representing our ability to create and maintain healthy relationships. During Libra season or a Libra full moon, the universe may bring up issues related to your relationships and how you connect with others. You can use tarot as a way to inspire journaling. Select a spread or layout that resonates with your current focus or intention. Shuffle the deck and draw a card, then reflect on its meaning and symbolism. Use the card as a starting point for your journaling and allow its imagery and message to inspire your thoughts and feelings. Explore the card's themes and messages in greater depth and consider how they relate to your experiences and challenges. Reflect on how the card may offer guidance or insights for your current situation and how you can integrate its message into your life. Light a pink or white candle and create a peaceful atmosphere by using calming scents and soothing music. Visualize yourself seeking balance and harmony in your relationships and drawing strength from your ability to connect with others. Take this opportunity to reflect on your relationships and how you communicate with others. We all deserve to be in relationships that are based on mutual trust, love and respect. However, past experiences may have led you to believe that you are not worthy of such lasting connections. This can create a cycle where you stay in relationships that do not align with your own values and expectations, which subsequently lowers your self-esteem and perpetuates feelings of worthlessness. The first step in breaking this cycle is to become self-aware. Take the time to consider what you are looking for in a partner, both now and in the future, and what you have to offer. This will give you the confidence to seek out healthier relationships and set yourself up for success. Another important step is to nurture your relationship with yourself. Engage in positive self-talk and affirmations, invest in your education and career, and cultivate meaningful friendships. These actions will help bring out your authenticity and increase the likelihood that you will be able to build the loving relationship you deserve. It is also important to be aware of the ways in which low self-worth can manifest in your relationships. This may include giving people too many chances to hurt you, even when they have shown a pattern of unhealthy behavior. It may also include perceiving your partner's bad behavior as a reflection of yourself and feeling like you need to change in order to be loved. Low self-worth can also lead you to try and make someone love you when they show disinterest in commitment, even if it means sacrificing your own well-being and security. It is important to recognize these patterns and work on building your self-worth and setting healthy boundaries in your relationships. Open your journal and begin writing about your relationships, friendships and communication style. You may also want to consider any challenges or obstacles you have faced in maintaining healthy relationships, and brainstorm ways to overcome them. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you explore these themes: Ask yourself, why do I stay in relationships (family, friendships, romantic, career) that are not right for me? Have I settled for avoidance, dishonesty, and instability in my relationships? Do I give people too many chances to hurt me? Do I doubt myself and think I'm crazy instead of seeing an unhealthy situation clearly? As you journey through Libra season, it's a great time to reflect on your relationships and communication style. By taking some time to journal about these topics, you can gain a deeper 1038 understanding of yourself and your interactions with others. Here are some prompts to get you started: Reflecting on and letting go of past-releationships: ex-lover, ex-partner, ex-friend ● What unmet needs or wounds do I believe are being fulfilled by this person I believe is my "One and Only"? ● In what ways does this person represent love, validation, acceptance, or nurturance that I am seeking? ● Is there someone from my past (such as a parent) that this person reminds me of? ● Do I seek this person's approval and love more intensely because they represent someone from my past? ● What qualities or energy does this person possess that I admire but don't believe I can embody myself? ● How can I work on self-reliance and self-soothing to heal and move on from my past experiences? ● How does taking back my projections and realizing that I have the capacity to feel safe and resilient on my own empower me? Values in Relationships and Showing Appreciation What do you value in your relationships and how do you show appreciation and support for the people in your life? Creating Balance and Harmony in Relationships Are there any areas of your life where you feel like you are not achieving balance or harmony? How can you work to create more balance and harmony in these areas? Handling Conflicts and Misunderstandings How do you handle conflicts or misunderstandings in your relationships? What strategies have been effective for you in the past? Strengths in Communication and Building Connections What are your strengths in communication and how can you utilize them to build stronger connections with others? Improving and Maintaining Healthy Relationships How can you work to improve and maintain healthy relationships with the people in your life? Reflecting on Sudden Changes or Insights What new information or insights have come to your attention recently? How have these changes or insights impacted you and your relationships? What steps can you take to adapt and process these changes or insights? Examining Triggers and Wounds What are your triggers and wounds in relationships? 1039 How do these triggers and wounds affect your interactions with others? What can you do to heal and address these triggers and wounds? Dealing with Loneliness, Abandonment, and Rejection How do you feel when you experience loneliness, abandonment, or rejection? What are some ways that you cope with these feelings? How can you work to build self-love and self-acceptance in the face of these emotions? Letting Go of Dysfunctional or Abusive Situations Are there any dysfunctional or abusive relationships in your life that you need to let go of? How can you safely and effectively remove yourself from these situations? What support or resources do you need to move forward and create healthy relationships? Balancing Self-Care and Prioritizing Needs How do you prioritize your needs in relationships? How do you balance taking care of yourself with supporting and caring for others? What can you do to make sure that your own needs are being met in a healthy way? Dealing with Resentment from Neglecting Yourself How do you feel when you neglect your own needs in favor of others? How can you address and release any resentment that arises from neglecting yourself? What steps can you take to prioritize self-care and avoid resentment in the future? 1040 Sun in Libra (Justice) / 7th House Full Moon in Aries (Emperor) / 1st House

heading: Exploring Libra/Aries Polar Axis - Exploring the Polarity of Self and Other
body: During this Libra season, we will be exploring the polarity between Libra and Aries. As we balance the needs of self and others, we will be called to be both peacemakers and warriors. The energies of Libra and Aries, representing the signs of harmony and self-assertion, will guide us as we navigate the delicate dance of relationships. As we strive for balance and harmony in our connections with others, let us approach this journey with curiosity, non-judgement, and kindness. The polarity of the Libra/Aries is that of fire and air, both in cardinal modality. Aries was born to disrupt, assert itself, and prove its worth. Aries is all about coming back into your body and discovering and negotiating the boundary between "me" and "them." Balancing (Libra) your needs with another's is a dance that should be approached with curiosity, nonjudgement, and kindness. Our inner voice guides us in our daily lives and becomes even more crucial when we are in relationships with others. As we navigate this balance, it is important to understand and listen to our own needs and wants, while also being aware of the needs and wants of those around us. It's a delicate dance that requires a harmonious balance of skill and grace. The Aries-Libra combination helps guide us in this balance by helping us reclaim our lost selves and establish a healthy equilibrium between self and other. By being conscious of our own needs and wants, but also listening carefully to what others need from us, we can create more harmonious relationships in life. Finding inner peace and creating harmony with others is often a struggle, but with the right attitude, you can create the balance you need to be successful. There can be no recognition of self without the existence of other. The Aries-Libra combination is about reclaiming the lost self and establishing the correct balance between self and other. Aries and the 1st house represent "self," while Libra and the 7th house represent "other." The self and other polarity is an opportunity for you to reconcile and release any tensions in partnerships, especially those surrounding home and family. What you need and want from others 1041 must be balanced with what they want and need from you. If that balance cannot be struck, it will be time for major changes. The Aries-Libra axis can be further observed through the opposed warrior and peacemaker archetypes. Without the warrior, there would be no need to find justice and make peace. War would consume even the warrior in destruction and exhaustion. By uniting their efforts, the peacemaker and warrior can become the just freedom fighter, "fighting for peace." We cannot make change through wishful thinking; we need fire (Aries) to give direction to our justice cause (Libra). Libra symbolizes ideals of peace, love, justice, and harmony, and can provide the just cause when activated by the energies of the Aries warrior. The Aries-Libra axis asks that you rise above opposition while embracing duality. Aries was born to disrupt, to assert itself, and prove its worth. Aries is all about coming back into your body and discovering and negotiating the boundary between "me" and "them." Balancing your needs (Libra) with another's is a dance that should be approached with curiosity, nonjudgement, and kindness. Aries Full Moon Full moons are high tides of power, amplifying and creative. The full moon is a time to celebrate and harvest our previous new moon intentions; otherwise, the full moon is a time to make energetic adjustments to align ourselves to call in our intentions. The full moon is a time of celebration and gathering. We sync to the cycle with community, nature, and Spirit. We gather to clear energy, raise energy, gain clarity, set intentions, process symbols, connect with nature, the Divine, and our Higher Self. The Aries full moon is a powerful time of self-discovery and warrior-like courage. We are becoming intimately aware of the disempowered and vulnerable places within ourselves, and it is time to reclaim those parts of ourselves that we have abandoned or cast aside out of shame and pain. This energy is a swift kick of tough love, redirecting us onto a path that serves not only ourselves but others as well. We are called to be warriors of the self, to be brave and courageous in the face of our own vulnerabilities and reclaim our power. As warriors of the self, we embark on a path of self-empowerment and courage, embracing our vulnerabilities with strength and resilience. We no longer shy away from the wounded parts of ourselves but instead, embrace them as integral aspects of our journey. Through this process, we unlock our potential, tap into our authentic power, and create a ripple effect of transformation that extends beyond ourselves. Remember that creating boundaries with others is a compassionate act for all. The full moon is a powerful time of release and manifestation, and it signifies the need to let go of what no longer serves us. The abundance of emotional energies impacts us in the most intimate of ways in our personal lives. In astrology, the moon represents mother, family, home, and emotions. Aries, a cardinal fire sign, represents individual identity and the first spark of life. The Aries full moon can be described as loaded, like a weapon, and Aries represents the energy of self and Mars, the planet of action and assertion. This full moon takes place during Libra season, which represents the seventh sign of the zodiac and stands for relationships and how we relate to others. This Aries full moon is a powerful 1042 time to focus on our individual identity and how it relates to our relationships, and to release any patterns or habits that no longer serve us in these connections. This will upset many relationships, but for many this is a chance to reconcile and release any tensions in partnerships, especially those surrounding home and family. The Aries full moon shines a light on the most sensitive areas and relationships in our lives. This full moon is a reminder that what we need and want from others needs to be balanced with what they want and need from us. If that balance cannot be struck, it may be time for major changes. The Aries full moon helps us to identify whom and where we are giving and receiving our energy, giving us a glimpse into the cosmic balance sheet to see if we are receiving and giving what is deserved. Consider a partnership where one individual consistently places their own needs and desires above those of their partner, inadvertently neglecting their wants and needs. The Aries Full Moon serves as a potent catalyst, casting its illuminating light on the dynamics at play within the relationship. It brings to the forefront the underlying tensions and imbalances that have gone unaddressed. This lunar event becomes a pivotal moment for reflection and growth, urging the partners to confront the root causes of their discord. Through open and honest communication, they have the opportunity to express their grievances, seek understanding, and find common ground. By embracing this chance to reconcile, they can rebuild trust, redefine their boundaries, and cultivate a harmonious partnership where both individuals' needs are honored and respected. Now, envision a family struggling with unresolved conflicts that permeate their home life. These simmering tensions create an atmosphere of discord and unease. The Aries Full Moon shines its light upon the most sensitive areas of their relationships, exposing the underlying issues that have been left unaddressed. As a powerful catalyst for change, this Full Moon presents an opportunity for deep healing and release. It calls upon family members to come together, engage in heartfelt conversations, and confront the root causes of their conflicts. Through active listening, empathy, and a shared commitment to growth, they can rebuild their familial bonds, redefine their roles, and create a harmonious and loving home environment where each member feels valued and heard. In both scenarios, the Aries Full Moon acts as a transformative force, pushing individuals and groups to confront the imbalances and unresolved issues within their relationships. It becomes a moment of tension, reckoning, where deep healing, understanding, and growth can occur. By embracing conflict resolution, opportunity for reconciliation, open communication, and a willingness to address underlying tensions, individuals and families can navigate the complexities of their connections with newfound harmony, mutual respect, and a strengthened foundation of love and understanding. During the Aries full moon, the social mask comes off and we are forced to confront the truths in our lives. This is a powerful opportunity to rearrange what isn’t working and to break free from any circumstances that hold us back from doing our very best for ourselves and others. However, for those who like to be in control, this full moon may be somewhat uncomfortable as it brings unexpected change, and there is no way to predict where the pieces will land after this lunation. It's a time to let go of the need to control and trust that the universe is leading us to where we need to be. The Aries full moon is a reminder that the only true control we have is over ourselves and our reactions to what happens around us. Embrace the unknown and allow yourself to be guided by the energy of this powerful lunation. Trust that everything will fall into place as it should. 1043 Aries Full Moon Communal Intentions During this Aries Full Moon, it is important to tap into the energy of Aries and use it to come back into your own power. With the Sun in Libra, ruled by Mercury, be mindful of the power of your words and actions. This is a great time to be proactive and take charge of your life, but be sure to do so with clear and conscious intention. I release the need to doubt my worth and capability. I embrace the belief that I am worthy and capable of stepping into my authority and taking charge of my life. I recognize that I am strong and capable of advocating and fighting for my needs, and I know that I deserve to have my needs met. I reclaim my energy and set boundaries to protect my time and energy, and I prioritize my own well-being. I understand that it is important to take care of myself and set boundaries in order to maintain my own happiness and well-being. I also release the fear of change and evolution. I permit myself to evolve and grow, and I embrace the process of personal growth and change. I understand that growth and change are natural and necessary parts of life, and I am open to embracing new experiences and learning from them. Finally, I release any doubts or fears about my ability to take control of my life and create the future that I desire. I am confident and empowered to make the changes that I need in order to live the life that I want, and I trust in my own abilities and strength. Create an altar – During the Aries full moon, it is a good time to create a sacred space for Mars the planetary ruler of Aries. To create an altar, you can gather items that have personal meaning or significance to you. You might also collect items that symbolize Mars and Aries. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Be mindful – Observing your thoughts, experiences, and observations in a journal can be a powerful way to gain insights into your own inner landscape. You might also consider using tarot cards or other divination tools to help you explore your inner world. Collecting items – pen, paper, tarot cards, candles, incense, and herbs can be a way to create a sense of ritual and intention as you work through your full moon intentions. You might also consider incorporating other elements, like crystals or sound healing tools, into your altar. Reflect on where you were six months ago – What you were manifesting and striving for Take stock of your progress and make any necessary adjustments. Use a mantra – Consider using a mantra as a focus for your intentions and meditations. The mantra "Om Sri Angarakaya Namaha" (also written as "Om Shri Ahng-gahrah-kah-ya Nahm-ah-ha") is a powerful mantra for balancing the energies of Aries and Mars. This mantra can be repeated during meditation or used as a focus for setting intentions during the full moon phase. Set boundaries – Define your needs and boundaries and make sure they are clear to others. Reflect: Take some time to reflect on yourself and your behaviors. Consider whether you might be acting selfishly or stubbornly, and consider whether you could benefit from seeing another's perspective. 1044 Release any negative self-image or external influences that hold you back from expressing your authentic truth – This might involve therapy, journaling, or spending time alone to process and release these limiting beliefs. Be open to negotiation – Be open to the possibility of sharing and negotiating with others. Consider the possibility of finding a middle ground or finding a way to meet everyone's needs. Define your needs and boundaries – Make sure you are clear on what you need and what your boundaries are. Cut the cord – If you have determined that certain situations are not working for you, give yourself permission to let go and move on. 1045

heading: Aries full moon horoscopes & tarotscopes
body: Full moons are about illuminating that unconscious and that which is unseen. The full moon shines a light on Aries. What you wish to avoid repeating needs to be released now. Ruled by Mars, Aries teaches you to be self-assured, cultivate healthier boundaries, and liberate your self-image from external influences. The Aries's full moon is a time to release overthinking and trailblaze a new path with authority, confidence, and trust in gut impulses. This full moon in Aries might be better spent doing solo activities, as there is potential for tempers to flare. Aries is ruled by Mars, which can bring out more confrontational and aggressive tendencies. If you're feeling particularly sensitive, avoid situations or people that might cause unnecessary conflict and instead focus on your own needs. This doesn't mean you have to hole yourself up at home - instead, try to channel this full moon energy into positive outlets like physical activity, like going for a walk in nature or taking some time to relax. With the Sun in Libra (Relationships) opposite Luna in Aries (Self), themes of balancing priorities of work and your personal life, and what you need versus what you want, are brought into your focus the next two weeks following this lunation. This push-pull dichotomy can deplete your energy as you seek to reconnect with yourself and revalue your priorities. You can assess your relationships better with heightened subconscious awareness, detecting imbalanced dynamics or negative emotions that cause further disharmony and discord. When the moon is at its fullest, lunar qualities of emotions and instincts are at their full strength. Use this increased emotional awareness and intuition during this full moon to handle relationship issues. You can use your horoscope as a guide to what area of your life is being illuminated and use that as a guide for your full moon ritual. If you are unfamiliar with the twelve houses and what it means to have your 1st or 2nd house illuminated by the new or full moon, read foundation two for the fundamentals.

heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Aries full moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology with writing personalized horoscopes. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cars from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Libra Season, the Sun is in Libra (Justice), opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Aries (The Emperor). Then find the Sun (Sun), Justice (Libra), High Priestess (Moon), and The Emperor (Aries), and place the Sun in position 1, Justice in position 2, High Priestess in position 3, and The Emperor in position 4. For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the full moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 7th position, select a card from the second pile containing the court cards and the Minor Arcana. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. 1047 Tarotscope Key 2. The tarot card corresponds to the zodiac sign the sun is in 4. The tarot card corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in 6. The tarot card the corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house 7. The tarot card corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign Ex: Justice (Libra), during Libra season Ex: The Emperor (Aries), during Aries full moon Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries 1. The Sun (Sun) 3. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated or a supporting card from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house 1048

heading: Aries (March 21st - April 19th) & Aries Rising, Full moon in the 1st House
body: The Aries full moon illuminates your 1st house of Self, a time to reclaim yourself, energy, and power. The first step in reclaiming your power is acknowledging where you have given it away. The Aries's full moon signals a time to start taking back control of your life and your decisions. Aries teaches you to step into your authority. This full moon reminds you that your strength, power, and self-worth are within you. It encourages you to assert and express yourself and may bring awareness to your struggle regarding your appearance, self-esteem, and personality. Whether you're facing a personal or a more significant challenge, this moon supports you in overcoming obstacles and stepping into your authority. The full moon in the 1st house can bring challenges of me vs. them. Have you been feeling stuck in a relationship dynamic? It's time to take back your power and create some healthy boundaries. Your needs may clash if you're in a close relationship with someone. This can leave you feeling drained, both mentally and emotionally. First, communicate openly and honestly with the people involved. Second, set boundaries. It's okay to say "no" when you need to. Remember, you have a right to your own time and space. And finally, seek support from someone who isn't involved in the relationship dynamic and can offer a fresh perspective. You have a natural inclination to shake things up and keep them moving. You thrive on action and motion and can't stand being idle for too long. However, be mindful not to stir things up unnecessarily out of boredom or restlessness. It's important to find a balance between taking action and being at peace with stillness. Don't become an agitating force in your own life, and remember to pause and reflect on your actions. The first house is ruled by Aries and corresponds to the Emperor in the Major Arcana. How would it feel to believe in your authority and proceed fearlessly? When you align with your true Self, you will be on the correct path, and your obstacles will be overcome. If you allow yourself to be influenced by others, acting out of alignment with your authentic Self, you may experience friction and roadblocks. Embrace your inner warrior. Aries energy is all about pushing through. Remember that you're a fighter no matter what life throws at you during this full moon. 1049

heading: Pisces (Feb 19th - March 20th) & Pisces Rising, Full moon in the 2nd House
body: The Aries's full moon illuminates your 2nd house of disposable income and foundation. Aries asks that you advocate for your time and talent. This Aries full moon brings awareness around your worth. Accepting less than you are worth gives others the green light to do the same and can leave you feeling stuck and struggling. You may experience increased tension around salary, client fees, and advocating for your time and experience as you realize you may have been underselling yourself for a long time or others aren't honoring the value your talents bring. Advocating for yourself is an essential part of your financial career trajectory. Your self-advocacy strategies will differ between your first job and what they will be later in your career, and your system must change accordingly. Your manager may need more training, resources, or desire to invest in your career development. If you want to develop your career path, you must be your own advocate. You can only self-advocate if you know your value and worth; take time during this full moon to do a self-assessment backed with critical projects, peer review, facts, and figures. Have this information ready when advocating for a salary adjustment or promotion. If you are self-employed, know your worth. Articulating the value that you and your company bring is essential in any negotiation. Keep it professional. It can be difficult to self-advocate, but a crucial part of it is not letting your emotions get the better of you. The Aries full moon is a time for release, and if you're feeling taken advantage of, unappreciated, or unable to ask for what you need, this is the perfect time to work through and let go of those feelings. This is a time to assert your needs and to set the intention to be compensated for your efforts. If you've been holding back from asking for what you need, use this full moon to summon the courage to speak up. It's important to stay positive and not get bogged down by criticism of your current situation. Instead, focus on how you spend your energy, time, and your money. Make adjustments, curb your expenses, and focus on what you require in terms of resources and opportunities to help you grow and succeed. 1051

heading: Aquarius (Jan 20th - Feb 18th) & Aquarius Rising, Full moon in the 3rd House
body: The Aries full moon illuminates your 3rd house of early education, how to process information, and communicate with your community, siblings, and neighbors. Speaking your peace comes naturally to you. However, your outspoken nature can cause heated arguments during this full moon if you find your feelings hurt or caught up in your ego. If you disagree, take a step back and focus on your responsibilities in this dynamic. You'll be able to approach the situation with more clarity and integrity. You are constantly bombarded with messages - from the news, arts, friends, family, strangers, and social media. It can be tough to sift through everything and figure out what's important. But you receive a message that resonates with you every now and then. A sign or message that confirms what you already know deep down. No matter what life throws, you can choose how you react to the information. The messages you receive - whether in blessings or challenges - help define you and shape your life. These are the messages that stick with you and help to guide you on your path. During this full moon, kismet words will be exchanged. The messages you receive and conversations you hold will fill your hours, shape your decisions, and change the structure of your life and the lives around you. So it's essential to be open to whatever comes your way and to use it as an opportunity to grow and learn. What messages have you been receiving lately? The words you choose to communicate with carry weight. They make an impact and leave an impression. If you grew up feeling like your voice didn't matter, it could be hard as an adult to remember that your words have power. If you've been feeling stuck with any writing projects, this full moon signals to make a push to get these projects off the ground. Aries is ruled by Mars, which gives the gift of energy to push through challenges. The more intention you put into these projects, the more significant their impact will be. 1053

Now is the time to take stock of what you have and what you need to create a sense of security and belonging. The past six months have been a journey for you in terms of your relationships with relatives and where you live. This period has helped you clarify who and what's important and helped you find a more stable base and home within yourself. Take note of the parts of your past that are visiting you in the present. This Aries full moon also puts pressure on your career. Celebrate your successes and cut yourself some slack for the things that haven't worked out. Making progress can be something other than an all-or-nothing proposition. You can be thoughtful and deliberate in your actions toward career growth without sacrificing your home and personal life. 1055

heading: Sagittarius (Nov 22nd - Dec 21st) & Sagittarius Rising, Full moon in the 5th House
body: The full moon is a time of illumination and helpful if you feel stuck in the dark. This Aries full moon illuminates your 5th house of fun, heart-centeredness, and children. You're a natural optimist. Being an optimist doesn't mean you're always happy or that everything is perfect. It just means you know that life is an adventure, despite the challenges thrown your way, and things will eventually work out as long as you take the time to tend to what is needed and think things through. It can be easy to get caught up in the hustle and bustle of everyday life and forget to make time for yourself. But it's important to remember that you are worth your time and energy. If you're feeling lost, uninspired or unfulfilled in your romantic or creative life, take a step back and reassess. It might be time for a change. Every single event that occurs in your life is a reflection of your inner state. Set out on a local adventure, rediscover the beauty around you, and see things from a different perspective. It's also possible creative project you worked on earned success or recognition. After all, the sun is in your 11th house of community, putting you into the limelight. The energies of this lunation remind you that there is no such thing as too much positive attention. This is a great opportunity to start feeling more confident in your love life. Any buried emotions surrounding a fear of being "seen" or stepping into your power may surface for examination. Aries is a warrior, and the Aries's full moon reminds you that it's essential to be your own champion. You are your own best advocate and champion. This sometimes means advocating and loving yourself more than you were raised to, seeing yourself, and fighting for yourself in the ways you want others to defend and see you. 1057

heading: Scorpio (Oct 23rd - Nov 21st) & Scorpio Rising, Full moon in the 6th House
body: The Aries full moon illuminates your 6th house of health and being of service. This is an excellent time to release any daily habits or activities that hurt your overall health, energy, and well-being. This full moon's energy demonstrates that the quick wins in your life don't always last and sometimes are difficult to repeat. The challenges you are facing right now signal the weakness in your life's "system design." Take time to cultivate a system of habits that simplifies and strengthens the areas where more structure is needed (i.e., family, health, work, finances, morning routine, etc.). This full moon in Aries is a time to focus on releasing any built-up annoyances or frustrations in your day-to-day routine, especially at work. With the potential for tempers to flare, it's best to avoid any situations that could cause conflict. If this is a busy time for you, get ahead of the week by organizing your home, meal-prepping, or outsourcing some of your responsibilities to reduce cognitive overload and stress. Take a moment and see what tasks, obligations, and activities bring you the most resistance and distraction, and take steps to improve the process; drop the avoidance and worry, and reclaim the mental real estate in your head. The Aries full moon is the perfect time to get out and active. With this full moon activating your 6th house, this is also a time to introduce activities that can help you channel Aries energy towards better health. Running is a great way to do this, as it increases blood circulation to the brain, improving your mood. Running and walking can also be forms of meditation, connecting your mind and body, clearing your mind, and keeping you present in the moment, which can help reduce anxiety. The 6th house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit teaches you to master the Self by practicing silence, meditation, and seclusion. In this stage of the journey, you're being asked to be more attentive to details, looking at how you give too much of yourself and are left feeling drained and under-appreciated. The full moon in the 6th house teaches you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals link to your overall health and wellness. 1059

heading: Libra (Sept 23rd - Oct 22nd) & Libra Rising, Full moon in the 7th House
body: The Aries full moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. You sometimes attract what you are. Often times you attract those in desperate need of what you are. The full moon in Aries calls for you to step into your authority, and one of the most effective ways of doing so is by setting healthy boundaries with yourself and others. You may be spending time reflecting on your relationship choices and when the lack of boundaries left you feeling drained, emotionally and financially. You may also be processing a recent loss or contemplating the ending of a significant relationship; if healthy boundaries and a peaceful home cannot be reached. The full moon is a time to reflect on your most important relationships. It's an opportunity to examine the conflicts that arise and ask yourself what they're teaching you. If you're not showing up for your own life, you can't expect to show up for anyone else. That's why learning how to self-analyze and keep a journal is important. Writing down your thoughts and feelings can be a powerful tool for self-discovery. Taking the time to read back through what you've written can help you better understand yourself and your situation. Armed with this knowledge, you can make the necessary changes to help you become more present in your life. Aries is a passionate warrior, and the Aries full moon asks that you examine the fights/battles in your intimate relationships. It can be difficult to feel supported and loved by those around you, especially when they don't know how to show up for you; and when you don't understand each other's love language. Don't hold anger towards others when they can't or don't know how to support you; this only steals your focus and progress. Most people don't even know how to show up and support themselves. If you find yourself in this situation, don't get discouraged. We all have different love languages. If you feel like you're not giving or receiving the support you need in your relationships, ask yourself (or your partner) what that looks like. It may be a matter of learning how to communicate and express what support means to you. Use this as an opportunity to grow closer to those you care about. Not everyone in your life is going to be able to receive what you have to give. And that's okay. Just be conscious of what you expect from others, and be wary of wanting what they can't give and giving what they can't receive. Some people only know how to take, and others know how to receive. Be grateful for those who can welcome you with open hearts. Healthy relationships genuinely are the secret source to a life well lived. 1061

heading: Virgo (Aug 23rd - Sept 22nd) & Virgo Rising, Full moon in the 8th House
body: The Aries's full moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. The full moon in the eighth house is a time to reflect and reassess what you've been given and what you can give back. It's a chance to take stock of who has been supporting you and to show your appreciation for those who have helped you along your journey. It's also a reminder that it's okay to let go of the baggage that others gave you if it no longer serves you; or was never yours to carry. Know that you are valuable and worthy of love and connection. You have a keen eye for perfection, but your standards can become a prison. And it's too easy for your inner voice to become a critic and bully. It's time to change the way you talk to yourself. It's time to let go of the pain, the hurt, and the anger. Fill yourself with love and strength, and know you are worthy of healing and deep emotional fulfillment. The full moon in Aries may require facing internal demons or working through financial issues. Don't be surprised if anger arises during this full moon, as your thoughts may turn to old or current legal matters (lawsuits, divorce, custody battles, bankruptcy, etc.) Thinking about where you made mistakes, sabotaged, or didn't advocate for yourself; leaves you feeling that you need to address, correct or play catch-up now. Spending on the healing work and maturity you've done, you'll either come to acceptance and make shifts or continue to face challenges by sinking into anger or playing the victim. Be careful with debt and money during this time, and ensure you're handling your finances well. Be gentle as well as honest with yourself. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the Major Arcana. The full moon in the eighth house can represent a 'death' from one's old Self or old life and a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle. Getting caught up in internal thoughts and life's battles is easy. But if you take a moment to create a tiny altar in your space, it can help you remember what's important and where to focus your attention. 1063

heading: Leo (July 23rd - Aug 22nd) & Leo Rising, Full moon in the 9th House
body: The Aries full moon illuminates your 9th house of the higher self, philosophy, and greater wisdom. Ready to hit the road? This Aries full moon in the ninth house is the perfect time to satisfy your wanderlust. It's time to throw caution to the wind and book that spontaneous trip you've been dreaming of. Explore new places, experience different cultures, and shift your perspective. The more you experience, the more you realize how much there is still to learn and explore - and that's beautiful. Jupiter, the planetary ruler of the 9th house, is known for its expansive capacities, shifting your thoughts to personal growth and the philosophy of life. The Aries's full moon in the 9th house pushes you to seek philosophy as a framework for creating a life of well-being. Philosophy is often seen as complex and challenging, but it can be one of the most helpful tools to understand yourself and the world. Philosophy can help you to reflect deeply on your current situation and find meaning in even the most difficult experiences. Henri Bergson's theory of creativity is especially relevant, as it reminds you that you are the creator of your own life. Additionally, the Greek philosopher Epicurus reminds you that happiness comes from within, a peaceful body and soul. So you shouldn't seek it from external sources. And finally, Stoicism teaches you to accept what you cannot change and not be defeated by outside forces. If you're feeling lost or stuck during this full moon, consider picking up a philosophy book. It might change your life view. Philosophy is more than just a school of thought - it's a way of life. It challenges you to question your belief system and grow and evolve as a person. The beliefs you hold can have a great deal of power over you. They can influence your thoughts, emotions, and actions. You may hold onto beliefs without really questioning them. But when you take the time to examine your beliefs more closely, you can gain a new level of clarity. This clarity can help you make more thoughtful choices about what you believe and if any views were passed down that don't resonate with you. The starting point of Greek philosophy is, "Am I being true to myself?" It's a question that challenges you to examine everything around you and question what you believe. By questioning the world around you, you can find your own truth and build an authentic and meaningful life. In a constantly changing world, staying grounded in your values and beliefs is essential. It's a journey of self-discovery and re-discovery that can lead to a more authentic and fulfilling life. During this full moon, take some time to reflect on the beliefs you hold. As you examine your thoughts, pay attention to which ones encourage thoughtfulness and which encourage frenzied states. Choose wisely as you move forward. 1065

heading: Cancer (June 21st – July 22nd) & Cancer Rising, Full moon in the 10th house
body: The Aries full moon illuminates your 10th house of career and public recognition. Cancer, this full moon is affecting you in a big way. With the moon being your ruling planet, you're extra sensitive to its effects. The full moon is a time of illumination when you can see things more clearly. So use this time to take a good hard look at your career and work-life balance. If you're feeling stuck in your life, it might be time to break up with the worn-out values and ideologies holding you back. Stagnation is the enemy of evolution, so don't be afraid to shake things up and forge your own path. You can convince yourself that you're happy with your job, even though it's monotonous and creatively stifling. You can also tell yourself you're okay with a noncommittal partner. While accepting and being content with your current circumstances is good, complacency is not. To improve your situation, you must admit that you want more and fight for yourself. The first step is acknowledging your fears (fear of success, happiness) is the first step to conquering them. But once you can identify and face your fears head-on, you can start making real progress. It's easy to become complacent in life. You can get comfortable in your routines and stop striving for more. But complacency is a trap. It's not living - it's simply existing. If you're not careful, you'll look back on your life and realize you wasted it, being afraid to take risks and seize opportunities. If you're worried that speaking up for yourself will make you unlikeable, look around you. Many people advocate for themselves and are still likable (if not more so). Chances are, you admire them for their confidence and ability to inspire others. They're not afraid to ask for what they want, nor should you. If you feel like you're not being seen or valued at work, it's time to take a stand. The full moon in Aries reminds you to be brave and fight for what you want. Power struggles can be tough to navigate, and you're a compassionate soul, so confrontations can take a lot out of you. Remember to recenter yourself and connect with your element, water, when things get overwhelming. During this full moon, visualize your desired outcome and how you want to feel. Take deep breaths to calm your nerves, and communicate clearly and directly with your co-workers or colleagues. You should practice role-playing with a close friend to ensure you are being assertive and not coming across as aggressive. 1067

heading: Gemini (May 20th - June 20th) & Gemini Rising, Full moon in the 11th House
body: The Aries's full moon illuminates your 11th house of friendship. During this full moon, you will be exploring what community you feel most comfortable in and what you need to change in your life, not your Self, to feel like you can express your most authentic Self. This full moon asks that you surround yourself with people who challenge you to be the best version of yourself. If you surround yourself with people who are negative and bring you down, you need to make a change. Life can be challenging enough; invite people who fight for you, not against you. You may take a break from a significant friendship or network of friends; to give yourself distance from a challenging dynamic. To re-enter the relationship/network later with a different perspective. Take the time to sort through your differences and come to a fair assessment. Even when it's hard, being honest with each other is one of the most critical parts of any relationship. Keep going if you're facing a challenging situation with a friend. The Aries's full moon can signal abrupt endings, and you may be navigating the emotions of being ghosted by someone you care about. No matter what you call it, ghosting, stonewalling, or emotional abuse, it's never okay. It's a cowardly way to avoid conflict, leaving the other person feeling hurt, confused, and alone. If you can't have an honest conversation with someone, that's not the relationship you need to be in. After a ghosting experience, you're left in the dark and uncertain about what happened. Your brain wants certainty. It's natural to want answers in a situation like this, but sometimes you just have to accept that you may never know why things ended the way they did and just move on. You may feel overlooked and hurt and question everything about the situation, including your self-worth. A big lesson of this Aries full moon is that what other people choose to do - or not do isn't about you. It's not personal. It doesn't reflect on your worth as a person. It's just a choice they've made; how people treat others directly reflects how they feel about themselves. That is on them. It's not about you; once you embrace that knowledge, it's a liberating force. 1069

Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 1074 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. *** 1075 Scorpio Season: Oct 23rd - Nov 21st 8th House, Planetary ruler Scorpio Spirit Guides and Ancestors & 8th House New Moon – Scorpio Full Moon – Taurus Planet – Mars (ancient astrology) & Pluto (modern astrology) Day of the Week – Tuesday Element – Water Tarot Card – Death Theme – Transformation, Intimate / Sexual Expression, Healing & Empowerment. heading: Scorpio Light & Shadow
body: Scorpio is known for its dramatic and emotional energy, and we all have Scorpio somewhere in our charts, meaning we can all relate to this energy to some extent. Sometimes, out of fear of being alone, we may be inclined to engage in behaviors that are jealous, vengeful, or manipulative in order to get what we want. Over the next several weeks, we may be faced with our deepest and darkest desires and urges, and how we respond to them will shape the course of our future. At its unevolved level, Scorpio energy can be self-destructive, fixated, stalking, vengeful, and jealous. Without a connection to spirituality, unevolved Scorpio energy can cause us to hold onto painful pasts and make generalizations about people, leading to negativity and a difficulty in forgiving and forgetting. At its highest, most evolved level, Scorpio energy is intuitive, deep, committed, passionate, discriminating, and artistic. Scorpio Light & Strength: intuitive, deep, committed, passionate. heading: Scorpio Season and Scorpio New Moon: Actions and Intentions
body: During Scorpio season and the Scorpio new moon, you will be faced with the opportunity to explore the deeper aspects of your being, including your ancestors, death, and rebirth. This can be a change in seasons or daylight, and marks the beginning of our descent into the Underworld. In the second phase, you enter a state of not-knowing, a Zen-like state where the most power, joy, and healing can be found. As the Scorpio new moon rises, it beckons you to embark on a journey of transformation. Guided by the fierce energy of Mars and the mysterious realm of Pluto, you are given the courage to confront your fears and embrace the unknown. This is a time to delve into the depths of the Underworld, to connect with your ancestors, and confront the source of your deepest wounds. By facing the shadows within yourself, you unlock the potential for growth and healing. As you honor the legacy of your ancestors and draw upon their wisdom and strength, you emerge from the darkness with renewed understanding and power. But this journey is not for the faint of heart. Scorpio's Plutonian force is powerful and all-consuming, urging you to delve into the depths of your emotions and confront the parts of yourself that you may wish to keep hidden. It is a time of intense transformation, of shedding old skins and embracing the unknown. As you navigate this season of mystery and transformation, you are invited to consider the mysteries of others and how you connect and communicate intimately. The Scorpio new moon encourages you to release what no longer serves you and to embrace the power of rebirth. So let yourself embrace the Scorpio new moon with courage and determination, and allow yourself to be transformed by the depths of your own being. Happy Scorpio New Moon. Coupling the term "happy" with the archetype of Scorpio might feel odd, yet every new and full moon signifies a celebration. We celebrate another opportunity to be reinspired, to appreciate the physical manifestations of our efforts, and to review and recalibrate our intentions and goals. With the Scorpio new moon we take a dive into the depths of our being, a journey through the underworld of our deepest emotions and primal urges for survival and connection. The Scorpio new moon is a slow burn of an ancient fire that’s been smoldering beneath the surface of the ground, turning earth to ash, laying a foundation for new birth and growth to begin. This fire then catches a spark, and ignites a moment of raging flames that brings light into the darkness while scorching the earth above. Even though Scorpio encompases the element of water, which brings us into direct contact with our emotions, it also contains the destructive and transformative properties of fire, like the symbol of the Phoenix that is often associated with this sign. Scorpio thins the veils between physical and spiritual, present and past, and brings us in touch with our ancestral karma, with our rage, with our connection to power, and our ability to transform and shed that which no longer serves us. Scorpio is the force that brings light to the dark, unconscious parts inside of us that we typically avoid. It does this for us, in service to us, so that we can accept both shadow and light, and continue to grow towards our highest potential. During Scorpio season we go to the depths of our emotions, and often some situation outside of us is triggering this dive inward. We may be facing abusive or disempowering situations that suddenly feel intolerable. We may realize that we can no longer continue in this old version of ourselves, and a new path must be made. During the Scorpio new moon expect the unexpected. It’s a 1082 cliche term, but quite accurate for this new moon - which will blow our reality apart, and hopefully offer us a new, more exciting, more liberating path forward. Anxiety may flare as a result of this energy that is guiding us towards something new and undiscovered. We are in a fixed sign season, which doesn’t lend to a willingness to adjust to new experiences. If there’s a positive transformation occurring, remind yourself that you are worthy, as the Taurus full moon happening during this season asks us to reflect on our values and self-worth. We can easily self-sabotage when good things come to us because we feel we do not deserve it. During the Scorpio new moon, we are easily triggerable now as we feel past traumas and wounds on a visceral level. This energy can be erratic, manipulative, and potentially violent. Emotions that were simmering deep underground begin to surface now in unpredictable ways. Scorpio unearths and reveals. It penetrates to the core of our trauma, to the core of our issues, and the core of our power. Right now we have access to this raw power that will propel us forward into a new evolutionary state. We have the opportunity to clearly see and transform our fears and patterns around intimacy, face and share our deepest vulnerabilities with others with compassion. To get to this place of compassion, we may first need to move through some deep Scorpionic rage and anger over some injustice and abuse of power. We may face grief, sadness and shame over something we’ve done or witnessed others doing. Emotions get dredged up, this is natural with Scorpio, and how we handle them is what we have control over. In Scorpio, the truth will win out. Scorpio holds the mystery of life, and reminds us that the only thing we have control over is our emotions and response to challenging situations. Stay connected to those emotions, whether you take this journey alone, or in connection with another. We may experience pain, loss, and uncertainty, but the phoenix will always rise from the ashes and breathe new possibilities into seemingly impossible circumstances. Blessings to all our ancestors and the unlived parts within us. 1083

heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Scorpio new moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. You can use different techniques to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 6-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during the Scorpio new moon, the Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) are in Scorpio (Death). Then find the Sun (Sun), Death (Scorpio), High Priestess (Moon), and place the Sun in position 1, High Priestess in position 2, Death in position 3. For positions 4 and 5, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the new moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st 1085 house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 6th position, select a card from the second pile containing the court cards and the Minor Arcana. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. Tarotscope Key 3. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in Ex: Death (Scorpio) during Scorpio new moon 1. The Sun (Sun) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The tarot card that corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries 4. The tarot card that corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house 6. The tarot card corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign or a supporting card from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance 1086 Scorpio (Oct. 23 - Nov. 21) & Scorpio Rising - New moon in the 1st House Happy Birthday Scorpio! What can you feel ready to heal, release and accept about the past so you can live more fully in the present? Scorpio corresponds to Death in the major arcana. This energy can manifest as a separation or 'death' from one's old self or old life, a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle, or a time to explore your shadow and fears to allow for release and transformation. As you look back on this past year, how comfortable are you with the process and change that has occurred so far? What transformation are you in the midst of right now? These questions aren’t meant to make you doubt yourself, but rather invite you to see yourself without the lens of external validation, and fully embrace and honor the person you are becoming. Surrender to life's imperfections and disappointments and allow them to sculpt your character and nurture your heart. This New Moon in your home sign creates dynamic tension on how you communicate a new vision of yourself. Big changes are in store for you now in relationships and how you express yourself. The time has come for a rebirth of your identity and how you meet the world. This is the time to clarify what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take in life. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize how to face and solve any challenges. With a New Moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This is a time of rebirth and redirection. Your intention for this New Moon is “To trust where your emotional and intuitive compass is taking you and be true to your inner guidance” 1087

heading: Scorpio New Moon Ritual
body: Fig 71. Top view of an altar to Mars & Scorpio [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Mars and your ritual candle(s) for Mars on the placement for Mars. Place The Tower and Death tarot card on your altar, as well as symbols (skull) an offerings to Mars. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration Basil, Garnet) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – You can ask Mars to assist with your vital health, energy, sexual energy, passion, energy towards stagnant projects, cultivate personal strength, bashing adversaries, hexes, and protection – to become the warrior. Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), 1110 and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. 1111 Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. 1112

heading: Exploring Scorpio Season And New Moon Through Journaling
body: Scorpio is the sign of transformation and depth, representing our ability to delve into the shadows and uncover hidden truths. Use the card as a starting point for your journaling and allow its imagery and message to inspire your thoughts and feelings. Reflect on how the card may offer guidance or insights for your current situation and how you can integrate its message into your life. Light a red or white candle and create a intense atmosphere by using spicy scents and dark music. Visualize yourself embracing your power and strength as you delve into the depths of your psyche and uncover hidden truths about yourself.
