heading: Exploring the Scorpio/Taurus Polar Axis
body: As the Scorpio/Taurus axis comes into focus, you are reminded of the tension between transformation and stability. While Scorpio delves into the depths of transformation, teaching you about loss, the unknown, other people's money, and obsession, while Taurus focuses on money, talent, values, and self-worth. This opposition between the Scorpio sun and the Taurus full moon gives us the opportunity to examine the polarity between our inner sense of resource and security (Scorpio) and our external sense of resource and security (Taurus). During this time, we may be exploring themes such as love versus obsession, inner resources versus outer resources, debt versus abundance, sensual femininity versus intimate sexuality, groundedness versus the unknown, wickedness versus beauty, and trauma versus nurturance. As you navigate this axis, remember that both Scorpio and Taurus energy have their place in your life. Scorpio energy helps you to confront your shadows and facilitate growth and transformation, while Taurus energy helps you to find stability and security in the material world. By finding a balance between these two energies, you can use the transformative power of Scorpio to create a sense of stability and security for yourself. This is a time to be mindful of the balance between the opposing energies within yourself and the world around you, and to use this awareness to facilitate growth and transformation. 1115 Taurus Full Moon Full moons are high tides of power, amplifying and creative. The full moon is a time to celebrate and harvest our previous new moon intentions; otherwise, the full moon is a time to make energetic adjustments to align ourselves to call in our intentions. The full moon is a time of celebration and gathering. We sync to the cycle with community, nature, and Spirit. We gather to clear energy, raise energy, gain clarity, set intentions, process symbols, connect with nature, the Divine, and our Higher Self. The Taurus full moon illuminates the hidden aspects of ourselves, providing us with the grounding energy of Taurus to help us navigate the intense and transformative energies of Scorpio season. This Full Moon brings to the surface opposing perspectives and relationships, inviting us to find balance and compromise. As the light of the full moon shines on our unconscious, we are reminded that our emotions are powerful guides, even if they may be uncomfortable to confront and experience. Expect to see more shocking truths and systematic breakdowns. Breaking down in order to beak through. This full moon is full of surprises, that are meant to move stuck energy forward bringing change, liberation, new discoveries and new insights. Taurus reminds us to come home to our body and to ourselves to helps us find stability. It reminds us to enjoy the earthly pleasures of our senses through taste, touch, sound, and sight. Taurus reminds us that there is beauty to be found and created in every situation; that nature is a place where we can find sanctuary and comfort; that we are connected to the earth at all times and interconnected; that what we do to our self and to the earth ripples out and affects the collective. We may now see the seeds of the intentions we set during the last new moon begin to manifest. Taurus gives us the resources to keep moving towards our goals. It can also remind us of the resources we need to get there. The shadow side of Taurus is scarcity, focusing too much on the material, and becoming obsessed with attaining money and things to reflect our self worth. During this Taurus Full Moon we get clear about how valued we think we are. We see where we may put too much importance on using the external world as a measure of value for our own personal worth be careful of falling into this pitfall of thinking your are not worthy or valuable if you don’t have money or material possessions. Of course this is a lot easier said than done. Having money can make life less stressful. It provides us with a sense of security and comfort that can add to or even falsely replace internal security. Under a little more intensity than usual, this is a time to wrap things up financially, collect on projects that have come to fruition, and generally tie up loose ends. Focus your attention to making that final payment, final touches, and showcase the creative and mental efforts of these past 6 months. This is a time to either declare brainstorms and pipe dreams as either feasible or not. The ideas and projects that stood the test of time can remain, the rest is time to release. This can apply to personal beliefs, opinions on politics. This is a time to be righteous, but not self-righteous, opinionated by not judgmental. The opposition between the Scorpio Sun and this Taurus full moon gives us a chance to see the polarity between our inner sense of resource and security - Scorpio - and our external sense of resource and security - Taurus. Both or inherently valuable and useful. With Scorpio we can become too focused on using other people’s resources in order to further ourself. And with Taurus we can become too focused on acquiring money and possessions at the expense of connecting with others. Both ask us to look outside at what we value and consider important in our lives. And both require that we look inside at how much we value ourself and how we allow others to treat us. This 1116 opposition also highlights the places we may be stubborn and inflexible as opposed to the Scorpio quality of flowing with the unknown mystery. Both Taurus and Scorpio can hold onto control for dear life. Part of Scorpio’s lesson is to force us into letting go of that control and discovering that the only thing we can control are our decisions and actions. Taurus’ lesson is to let go of the need to control money and finances out of fear of lack or scarcity. During the Taurus full moon we can expect our career to be a focus now. Or perhaps just reflecting on the authority in our lives and if we are giving away too much of our power to others. Communication around relationships, shared resources, debt, and finances are sure to be a main theme as well. If we haven't been keeping track of our monetary situation, or things have gone out of control, we are definitely going to be reviewing these now. The ruler of this Full Moon, Venus, there will be a lot of emotional honesty - if we are holding on to a relationship out of guilt, sentiment or that of "should" feeling it may be a little painful to let go. However, we will need to reclaim our energy in order to move forward. Taurus enjoys sensual pleasures and Scorpio loves to impulsively indulge in them. Past lovers may come back, igniting a spark that you thought had past. Or perhaps you’re learning new information that helps bring healing and more intimacy or creates more distance and closure. Scorpio hangs out our dirty laundry for all to see. The Taurus full moon is similar to the KonMari Method method of tidying up and releasing what does not spark joy or serve a purpose. Where we all have to clean out our closets and let go of what we don’t need (Taurus) and don’t desire anymore (Scorpio) but is still costing us something and dragging us down. The Taurus full moon will give us a much needed overhaul of the financial and relationship areas of our life. It will also give us a much needed review on how we see and value ourself. Coming out of this full moon we will feel more connected to ourself, and empowered to make choices that reflect this new sense of value and self worth. This Scorpio season is creating a new identity of our choosing that is more in alignment with how we want to live life. Start envisioning it, and the Taurus full moon will create the space to call it in.

heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Taurus full moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology with writing personalized horoscopes. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes. I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during the Taurus full moon, the Sun is in Scorpio (Death), opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Taurus (The Hierophant). Then find the Sun (Sun), Death (Scorpio), High Priestess (Moon), and The Hierophant (Taurus), and place the Sun in position 1, Death in position 2, High Priestess in position 3, and The Hierophant in position 4. For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the full moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 7th position, select a card from the second pile containing the Court Cards and the Minor Arcana, or place the tarot card corresponding to your sun sign. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this full moon illumination. 1121 Tarotscope Key 2. The tarot card corresponding to the sun's zodiac sign is in 4. heading: Taurus (April 19th - May 20th) & Taurus Rising, Full moon in the 1st House
body: The Taurus full moon is illuminating your 1st house of Self. This full moon is a reminder to honor yourself and all that you are. Take this opportunity to reflect on your inner wealth and commit to elevating your self-esteem. After all, you are an alchemist! You have the power to transform your inner wealth into external material wealth. This full moon is a time to focus on fresh beginnings and eliminating old unhealthy patterns. You may be recovering from some physical or emotional trauma that transpired in the last six months. You've likely checked out of your body in some way, which is your psyche's natural defense response to trauma but can leave you fragmented and needing to heal and integrate. With this full moon energy building in Taurus, you now have a chance to ground back into your body through all five senses, taking a step towards wholeness once again. Your body is the anchor that keeps you rooted in reality while simultaneously a treasure chest that stores your emotions. You've had your fair share of setbacks this past year, but through it all, you've gained some invaluable wisdom. It's all about understanding that not getting what you want (or not getting it when you want it) is a normal part of life. The sooner you can let go of the desire for perfection and perfect timing, and accept that things will not always go as planned, the sooner you can start focusing on what's most important: the process of how you want to live your life. You will experience failures, and your expectation will not be met. Live your life. Do your work. Do both well. Recognition and rewards are just extra. The Taurus full moon is in your 1st house, ruled by Aries, and corresponds to the Emperor in the major arcana. Aries represents new beginnings and karmic cycles, while the Emperor asks you to find and assert your individuality apart from external, socially defined norms. This is a time to step firmly into your authority and power, cultivating a healthy self-image and personal responsibility. The Taurus full moon wants you to be your own source of recognition and control; instead of letting others dictate your worth and value. Concentrate on how you picture yourself rather than how others see you; draw upon your own wellspring of internal support. This full moon is an opportunity to take stock of everything you're grateful for. Taurus's full moon reminds you that you have the power to transform your inner wealth into external material wealth. Whether you're looking for love, career, or personal growth, this is the perfect opportunity to set (and keep!) some powerful intentions. 1123

heading: Aries (March 21st - April 19th) & Aries Rising, Full moon in the 2nd House
body: The Taurus full moon illuminates your 2nd house of disposable income and foundation. If you have yet to keep track of your monetary situation, or things have gone out of control, you will be pushed to review your finances' health. The full moon in the second house integrates the 2nd and 8th house axes. Taurus wants to preserve and create security, whereas Scorpio wants to risk it all to experience the exhilaration of being alive. The balancing of what you need vs. what you want. This full moon nudges you to become more aware of your value and the value you place on things. With this Taurus full moon energy, you may realize that you are more focused on material possessions and money, or lack of it, and finding ways to generate more. The full moon can have you fixated on the accumulation of external resources as a way to validate self-worth and make you feel secure. What is your relationship to money and material possessions? How much importance do you put upon them, and how do you let them reflect how you feel about yourself? You may reassess how financially secure you feel and take this time to see what steps you need to take to create more of a supportive financial foundation. The polarity with the Sun in Scorpio helps you focus on your inner resources as you confront your fears, insecurities, and lack of trust in the unknown. This full moon is a time to discover your path to feeling secure and safe when all else seems to be in crisis or transformation around you. Stay grounded and focused on the things that matter most to you. This Taurus full moon guides you in building the strength to anchor and depend on yourself rather than seek stability in others. You are learning to utilize your inner and outer resources to the fullest, to help you through a time of transformation. 1125

heading: Pisces (Feb 19th - March 20th) & Pisces Rising, Full moon in the 3rd House
body: The Taurus full moon illuminates your 3rd house of early education, communication, community, siblings, and neighbors. This is a time to explore the reality and depth of intimacy in your relationships, community, and the health of your boundaries. Life often presents you with moments of uncertainty, and it can be tempting to shrink away in fear. Are you expanding your hearts when faced with your insecurities and vulnerability, or are we contracting and retaliating in fear and pain? You have a deep longing for connection and to be connected and have your desires fulfilled by those close to you in your community. However, the fear of abandonment and denial of affection may be a pattern that holds you back from opening up. During this full moon, you have the opportunity to break down any barriers that you may have created in the past six months due to a sense of over-protection. By stepping out of your comfort zone and connecting with those in your community, you become more aware of your need for human connection, love, pleasure, and support from others. However, it is essential to strike a balance between seeking external validation and maintaining your independence. If you have been feeling disconnected from your siblings lately, the Taurus full moon in the third house may provide an opportunity to restore relationships or clear up any misunderstandings that may have arisen. Take advantage of this time to bridge any gaps in your relationships with your siblings and work towards a more harmonious connection. 1127

heading: Aquarius (Jan 20th - Feb 18th) & Aquarius Rising, Full moon in the 4th House
body: The Taurus full moon illuminates your 4th house of home and family. When the full moon is in the fourth house, it can signal a time when you're awareness shifts to your home, family, and root system. In addition, Taurian values enjoying life's simple pleasures and sharing these simple pleasures with those who share your home and are of family. During this full moon, you could feel the need to spend time with your family and loved ones - creating time to reconnect. Aquarius it's easy for you to tune in to the frequencies of others. The sun in Scorpio and the full moon in Taurus can signal a time when you are more aware of moments when you can't easily tend to your own needs, for you're too dialed into the needs of others. This is when unhealthy family dynamics need to be brought in or back into alignment. Venus, the planetary ruler of this full moon, is in the sign of her detriment in Scorpio. You are exploring the reality and depth of intimacy in your family relationships and the health of or lack of healthy boundaries. This full moon can signal a time to create space within your home and establish or re-establish house rules surrounding boundaries and freedom. Especially since you are likely to absorb the energies of those around you, you need to carve out a space where you can focus on your priorities and needs. At this time, your family members may require more of your attention, and you have the chance to empower them to develop skills to become self-sufficient. As a natural innovator, you have the best intentions in finding and providing solutions. However, it is essential to recognize that trying to fix someone else's problem, especially that of a family member, may not always be healthy. Life presents us with turning points to create change when something isn't working. By attempting to fix your family member's problem, you may deprive them of the opportunity to take responsibility for their own and your family's happiness. It's vital to understand the delicate balance between supporting your family and attempting to fix them. While it's wonderful to show them love and support, their emotional well-being ultimately remains their responsibility. The Taurus full moon encourages you to let go of fears and disempowering behaviors (Scorpio) within your family dynamics. Doing so just makes life easier. 1129

Your transformational journey continues, as the Taurus full moon in the fifth house is a time for self-expression. Any hidden emotions you are hiding from others or yourself will begin to emerge, directing you to your compassionate and creative heart again. Through art, you can explore your inner self, resolve inner conflicts or express internal joys. You may find yourself more inspired and creative during this full moon. Be sure to jot down any ideas that come to you, as they may be the seeds of your next book, screenplay, or business venture. Art can also help you cope with difficult situations, especially children's conflicts. As you are guided to understand yourself more intimately through creative expression, you'll continue to find answers to the question of what you came this lifetime to master and experience. Venus-ruled Taurus is sensual, earth-centered, strong-willed, and seeks comfort and security in the physical/material planes. This full moon is all about finding pleasure through your five senses. Indulging in touch, tastes, music, dance, art, or nature. It encourages you to connect with nature, plants, animal spirits, and planetary energies through your body. As you connect and align your physical self with nature, the natural laws, ebbs, and flows of the Universe, you can more fully trust in the unfolding of life. The Sun in Scorpio emphasizes the opposite polarity of absolute trust in life even when the physical/material world shifts and changes underneath you. 1131

heading: Sagittarius (Nov 22nd - Dec 21st) & Sagittarius Rising, Full moon in the 6th House
body: The Taurus full moon illuminates your 6th house of health and being of service. This is an excellent time to release any daily habits or activities that hurt your overall well-being. The 6th house is ruled by Virgo, which corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. Virgo asks that you purify and cleanse toxic habits; this full moon is a time for a spiritual fast, a soul cleansing as your body prepares for this magickal moment. The Hermit signals a time to take space and remove yourself from the noise, distraction, and opinions from the outside world, only to emerge for the most critical obligations. To be the best version of yourself, you need to take the time to “fill your cup first.” If you’ve been giving too much, now’s the time to focus on yourself. This full moon is a time of incubation when you can more easily listen to your inner intuitive voice and allow it to guide you in making important work and daily life changes. Teaching you to think outside the box or freeing yourself from the box entirely. This is also a time to re-evaluate any challenging situations, relationship dynamics, or personal goals that require your attention. Your needs and what keeps you in good health change over time, and the Taurus full moon encourages you to adapt and evolve with these changes. Anything arising right now is to help you break through disharmony and find stability, health, and being in balance, and service. “I am fully appreciated for the service and compassion I offer others.” 1133

body: Create your tarotscopes for this full moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) in Scorpio (Death) opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Taurus (The Hierophant), illuminating the 6th House, The Hermit (Virgo/6th house), with the ruling planet Mercury (The Magician). The Magician (Mercury) 1. The Sun (Sun) 3. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The Hermit (Virgo/6th house) 7. Death (Capricorn) {and/or an extra card} 1134 Scorpio (Oct 23rd - Nov 21st) & Scorpio Rising, Full moon in the 7th House of Self The Taurus full moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. The power of relationships is that they mirror your ongoing explorations of self. Libra rules the 7th house, and its planetary ruler is Venus. Venus corresponds to The Empress in the major arcana, signaling a time to enjoy fulfilling relationships with close friends and family. And to create space for a heart-centered home. While your ego may try to convince you that you are the focal point of your life’s story, in charge, and need to tackle life’s challenges alone, this full moon encourages you to be open to others. Allowing others to help you with your challenges. This full moon can also be an excellent time to reconnect with friends and family members you haven’t seen. You might also want to consider connecting with nature and spending time outdoors. Whether you connect with others or nature, this is a valuable time for cultivating connections. Currently, you are exploring the reality and depth of intimacy in your relationships and the health of the boundaries you have created. With the Scorpio sun and Taurus full moon evoke a strong desire for connection and the fulfillment of your desires. However, this desire may be blocked by a recurring pattern of fear and rejection of affection that leads to an inability to open up. As you face feelings of vulnerability and insecurity, it's important to consider whether you choose to expand your heart or contract your energy in fear and pain. This is a time to examine your patterns and find the courage to break free from limiting beliefs to embrace deeper connections and greater fulfillment. This full moon helps you recognize the gift of co-creating and commitment; it asks that you honor your promise to others and your commitment to yourself. Relationships evolve, and it’s possible you need to take this time to review your core values (having children, living close to family, stay-at-home mom or dad, selling your business, creating a non-for-profit, etc.) and see if the long-term relationship in your life has evolved with you. Scorpio season is a time for transformation, and you may be investing time in your healing journey. You may also be noticing that the people you cultivated relationships with aren’t as supportive of your healing. Perhaps not by words, but by their actions, especially if these actions require you to fall back into old habits and patterns, you’re putting effort into breaking. Everyone doesn’t need to change at the same pace as you do, but often people don’t change at all. If you desire to grow, you could discover that the other person in your relationship is committed in their ways. The relationship will likely grow apart; you will move further from those who want you to remain the same. If not, can you both navigate the path forward to reach a place of shared core values? With this Taurus full moon shining a guiding light on your way forward, emotions that were hidden that you are hiding from others or even from yourself will begin to emerge, directing you to more compassionate relationships. This full moon will bring more focus and clarity around your emotions and desires and help you choose which relationships serve your highest purpose and evolution and which to let go of. 1135

heading: Libra (Sept 23rd - Oct 22nd) & Libra Rising, Full moon in the 8th House
body: The Taurus full moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, Symbolism, and Other People's Money. The full moon in the 8th house reminds us that we're all connected. It's a time to reflect on what others have done to support you. Give back to those who have helped you on your journey. It's also an opportunity to let go of people's baggage that you no longer need to carry or never were yours to carry in the first place. Let the full moon be your guide in taking stock of what has been given and what needs to be released. Scorpio seasons bring passion, desire, and an energetic edge, with the Taurus full moon signaling the apex of this energy and magickal season. During this full moon, you could feel a strong desire to intimately connect with someone. Perhaps you have already experienced this firsthand, and if you have not yet felt the pull of this full moon, you will as it grows stronger. Venus-ruled Taurus is sensual and desires profound intimacy, especially when illuminating the erotic 8th house. You are a sexual being, and this full moon reminds you that sexual energy is profoundly healing and the most potent energy you can harness. Honor how you use it. This full moon is a time to express your desires and let go of any shame that inhibits you from experiencing the depths of love and connection you long for. You are here because of desire. It's what fuels you. To achieve a deep intimate connection, you must continue to be open to letting go of the unnecessary burdens that have been weighing you down. Scorpio season with the full moon in the 8th house can bring about a Spiritual Awakening, primarily when past events have not been fully dealt with; you must face them and learn and accept their spiritual lessons. If you haven't let go of outdated stories from your past or dealt with past issues, you can risk losing the life you're creating or the life and relationship you seek. What are you holding onto that isn't yours? Other people's emotions, judgments, and secrets? Scorpio unearths what you buried; long-held emotions, memories, and traumas may resurface at this time to be reflected upon and released. Since the sun in Scorpio is excellent at uncovering these issues and using them to transform you into a more empowered version of yourself. It is time to forgive past mistakes and release what you are holding onto that doesn't belong to you. This full moon is a time to honor the natural rhythms of death and rebirth by putting these outdated stories to rest. This Taurus full moon also signals a time for a much-needed reality check, asking you to review your values and life goals. This energy can manifest as a mid-life or end-of-life crisis, a time of completion, at a crossroads, or a spiritual awakening. Perhaps you are questioning your judgment, whether that means your choice in career, partners, investments, or friends. Overall, recall your past decisions and how they influence your current lifestyle. This is a time to ensure that your life goals are meaningful to you and not or were not a pursuit to make others proud. Dig deep into any fears you might have about following your gut instincts, especially if it means going against the opinions of others. Find the courage to be yourself and trust in yourself. Scorpio season asks that you go do it even afraid and find the strength to go off script, against others' opinions when necessary, into the unknown. The more you trust and rely on yourself, the more you build self-reliance and security. This full moon encourages you to be in balance, practice acceptance of your flaws as much as you do self-improvement, and know that security looks different when you view it from your perspective and not from the lens of another. Realize that nothing comes without effort and that everything worthwhile takes energy. Your magick grows more powerful whenever you refuse to outsource it. As you grow as a practitioner, your magick will grow with you. It will become more potent and effective. It will evolve into something that's uniquely your own. And with time, you'll see magick not as an escape from reality but as a means of shaping it. 1137

heading: Virgo (Aug 23rd - Sept 22nd) & Virgo Rising, Full moon in the 9th House
body: The Taurus full moon illuminates your 9th house of the higher self. For you, this past year has been a journey of self-discovery. A quest to find answers to some of life's biggest questions. Questions about spirituality, philosophy, fairness, and Divine logic. Faith is not static. Like all relationships, it is a process. It ebbs and flows. It includes periods of growth and advancement and times of restrictions and discouragements. Losing faith is part of questioning, understanding, and building trust in something greater. It is a natural part of the journey of self-discovery. When you try to find belief in something that can't be quantified, you will inevitably encounter moments where you lose faith. It happens to everyone, and it's not a sign that you are doing something wrong. It's a normal part of building trust in something greater. Finding faith in something greater is an iterative process, starting with nothing and working toward something. Trusting something greater than yourself means relying on something you can't see or measure. Fate has a way of shaking things up to teach you something new. This full moon ask yourself, what is fate teaching me about faith? The Taurus Full moon corresponds to The Hierophant in the tarot. The Hierophant links to religion, knowledge, and traditions passed down through oral teachings parallel the "fixed" teachings that comprise social and religious frameworks. The Hierophant's name can be interpreted as "he/she who shows [the holy]" from Greek. The Taurus full moon can indicate a time to discover spiritual wisdom from external sources: Spiritual leaders, mentors, ancestors, and community. As with all full moons, it signals a time to let go. When you let go of the things you're holding onto so tightly, you open yourself up to new experiences, ways of thinking, and ways of living. Letting go of your tightly held ideas, concepts, and theories is a crucial part of finding faith in something greater. The act of letting go doesn't have to be a negative experience. In fact, it can be a very positive one. Letting go doesn't mean you're giving up or don't believe in something. It means that you're open to something new. This full moon asks that you trust your process and remain committed to your path while remaining open to new avenues, and overcoming setbacks until you regain momentum. 1139

heading: Leo (July 23rd - Aug 22nd) & Leo Rising, Full moon in the 10th House
body: The Taurus full moon illuminates your 10th house of career and purpose. During the Taurus full moon, you can expect your career to be a focus now. Now is the perfect time to reflect on your authority over your life and career. Are you giving away too much of your power or yielding it? It's time to trust yourself and start taking control. Also, with all this, Scorpio energy may have you intensely focused on accomplishing a task to help propel your career, and the Taurus Full moon is just the time to see the material results of your efforts. Look at the big picture and ensure you're not neglecting your well-being. If you're going through a stressful time at work, make sure you're taking time to decompress and reset. If you have a big project due soon, start laying the groundwork to ensure you have time to complete it. The full moon in the 10th house can be a time of blessings, as you could be recognized for all the hard work and discipline you've invested in your career or project. If you have been projecting negative thoughts on your profession or feel overwhelmed - this could stem from an overactive mind and negative mental chatter from stuck energy. Utilize tools and resources to help you navigate and restructure negative thinking to constructive feedback, which better serves to give direction rather than depression. The 10th house is ruled by Saturn, who brings up karmic lessons to work through in the interest of personal growth. Saturn tests you with patience, restrictions, deep contemplation, perseverance, and commitment. You may have more responsibilities as you mature into your career. Still, you also have more wisdom and life experience to help you handle those responsibilities better. During this Taurus full moon, you're discovering more and more about yourself in relationship to your career daily; and wondering if all the different parts of yourself are being honored and acknowledged. You'll be more focused on the bigger picture of your job and may experience a few bumps in the road this time as you find your footing. This is a time of self-discovery as you try to understand who you are and what role you want to play in your career. You're a natural leader. Do you want to take on a more visible position? Or would you prefer to lead others by example? During this time, it's crucial to take care of yourself and focus on honoring your needs with a balance of high performance. This full moon asks that you step into your greater purpose and commit to a career that will equally commit to building a foundation for yourself. Whether in your current work or forging a path on your own. The Taurus full moon is a time to reflect on your self-worth and self-esteem, grounding yourself, and build and invest in skill sets that will support your career. Envoke Venus (planetary ruler for Taurus) to attract opportunity, people, and things to help you in this task. 1141

heading: Cancer (June 21 – July 22nd) & Cancer Rising, Full moon in the 11th House
body: The Taurus full moon illuminates your 11th house of friendship. Good friends are good for your health, and this full moon illuminates the importance of those you surround yourself with. Avoid spending time with toxic people or letting their words and actions penetrate your mindset. This full moon also helps you identify false friends and unhealthy relationships so you can make room for positive people. It’s time to cut the chord from toxic relationships that no longer serve you. These people harm your life and cause more hurt than good. If you struggle with releasing toxic relationships, you may seek therapy or self-care to help set healthy boundaries and heal from previous poisonous relationships. You can choose to think differently, and you can take action to change your circumstances and those who you surround yourself with. No matter what has happened in the past, you can choose to move forward and create healthier friendships and a brighter future. No matter your challenges, you can see them as opportunities to learn and grow. You can stay calm, relaxed, and open no matter how lonely your life gets. No matter how much pain and suffering exists in the world, you can also choose to focus on all the beauty and kindness. No matter how many negative thoughts you have, you can choose to focus on positive ones instead. No - in fact, you have to decide these things. Be the change you want to see in your world. The Taurus full moon in the 11th house can guide you in finding solutions in your life and the lives of others. This may be when you can make a difference in the lives of others by volunteering your time and skills. In the days ahead, you may want to reflect on how your work can positively impact the world; you may get involved in activities that help feed the less fortunate, assist the elderly, or work with children. You may also be inspired to create something new, such as a new social program/movement, a new piece of legislation, a new business venture, or a new form of artistic expression that can bring awareness to a humanitarian effort. You may be helping others acknowledge the roles that prejudice, bias, and stereotypes play in society and work towards collectively rejecting these false narratives. You may find purpose in motivating your community/network to collectively lift individuals up from their position of disadvantage. 1143

heading: Gemini (May 20th - June 20th) & Gemini Rising, Full moon in the 12th House
body: The Taurus full moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. With the sun in Scorpio and the Taurus full moon in your 12th house of the subconscious, this is a time of uncovering hidden mysteries and journeying through the deepest levels of your emotions, consciousness, and karmic pain and rewards. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces, whose planetary rules are Neptune/Modern (The Hanged Man) and Jupiter/Ancient (The Wheel of Fortune). The Hanged Man symbolizes a time to reflect and face what you may be avoiding. During this full moon, allow yourself to tune out the world and tune in to your body. The full moon in the 12th house can signal a time for self-reflection, a time to find yourself after you’ve gotten lost in the busyness of life, or numbing yourself by keeping busy. Being busy may be a way to avoid feelings of shame and guilt. Shame is the feeling that you are inadequate and unworthy of love. Guilt is the feeling that you have done something wrong and have put yourself or others in danger. Guilt is often connected to shame and is often linked to self-worth (Taurus). Being busy can be a form of self-medication. It’s much more challenging to see the connection between being overwhelmed with work and something else that’s emotionally bothering you if you are too busy to process your feelings. This is a time to release your fears of failure and success and the pressure you place on yourself. If you feel as if your emotions are too strong, find healthy ways to process these emotions. If you’re having difficulty handling the energy, find people and places that feel supportive. Find a partner, join a support group, make friends, or reach out to your family. Connecting with others and feeling understood is crucial to healing and letting go. Feeling alone makes it hard to see a way out of your situation. When you’re with others who understand you, you’re much more likely to find the strength to push past your current situation and make changes in your life that will make things better in the long term. During the Taurus full moon, it's essential to create a meaningful ritual that pays tribute to what has come to an end while welcoming new beginnings. Allow the situation and the thoughts surrounding it to settle and rest. This full moon presents a perfect opportunity to gain insight and guidance on what you should release and what you should embrace. Additionally, it's an ideal time to focus on healing any wounds that may have resulted from ending a relationship or situation. If you are experiencing a loss or ending, ask yourself what you need to do or acknowledge to accept your situation and find peace. Take time to journal, meditate, or pray if you need quiet time. If you’re working towards something and feel like you’re hitting a wall, try writing yourself a letter that you can read when you need a little push. If you’re trying to move on from something or someone, try burning some incense or lighting a candle to welcome in what you want to replace it. If you have something you want to come into your life, try keeping a lodestone with a handwritten note wrapped around it of what you want to bring into your life. This full moon is an opportunity to reflect on your deep purging and what you want to call in to fill the space. 1145

heading: Taurus Full Moon Ritual
body: “I release everything either known or unknown to me that has been blocking me from receiving, feeling, and walking in my strength and authority. I trust and discover strength in my body, mind, self, and spirit. I call in my power and walk in my strength.” - A prayer for release Fig 72. Top view of an altar Venus & Taurus [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Venus and your ritual candle(s) for Venus on the placement for Venus. Place The Empress and The Hierophant tarot cards on your altar, as well as symbols for Venus and The Hierophant and offerings to Venus. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern 1147 Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration Bay leaves, Malachite) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle 1148 flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. *** 1149 Sagittarius Season: Nov 22nd - Dec 21st 9th House, Jupiter Planetary Ruler Philosophy, Past Lives & Reincarnation “All perish, all live again, the same house of existence is ever building. All separate, all meet again, the ring of existence is ever true to itself. “Existence begins at every moment. Round each “here” rolls “there”. The middle is everywhere. The way of eternity is a curve”. - The Symbolism of the Tarot by P D. Ouspensky (1913) New Moon – Sagittarius (ruled by Jupiter) Full Moon – Gemini (ruled by Mercury) Planet – Jupiter Day of the Week – Thursday (ruled by Jupiter) Archetype – The Archer Element – Fire Tarot – Temperance Body – Legs and thighs Affirmation – I speak my truth Focus – Truth, Philosophy, Luck, Optimistic, Hope & Reincarnation As we enter Sagittarius season, the fire of adventure and exploration is rekindled within us. This is a time to break free from the confines of your comfort zone and explore your passions and dreams with reckless abandon. As the Sagittarius season begins, we are called to ignite the fire of adventure and exploration within us. Guided by the centaur's flaming arrow, we set out on a journey to uncover the truth and meaning in our lives. This is a time to break free from the constraints of our comfort zones, to push ourselves beyond our limits and chase our passions and dreams with wild abandon. This Sagittarian energy encourages you to seek out the truth and meaning in your life, to challenge yourself and grow in ways you never thought possible. It is a time for personal transformation, for aligning your actions with our values and beliefs. Embrace the season's call to broaden your understanding of the world around you and the world within you. As you head into the last few weeks of the year, it's the perfect time to shed any lies or illusions that have been holding you back. Instead, step into your truth, stand strong in your convictions, and enter the new year with strength and confidence. The Sun moving from Scorpio into Sagittarius marks a new season of possibility and potential. With Jupiter as Sagittarius’ ruling planet, this energy shift is full of expansion and abundance. Now is the time to take a look at your life and ask yourself what your greater purpose is. It’s an opportunity to explore how you can make your life bigger by connecting with your higher truth. This is the season of Sagittarius - the sign of storytellers and philosophers. Now's the time to take a look at the stories that have come to define your life. Think of yourself as a storyteller who is 1150 penning your own life’s narrative. It’s a magickal opportunity to examine the stories that have made you who you are and consider the ones you want to be telling in the future. Allow yourself this moment to pause and dive deep within to discover what that story looks like for you. Ask – what words will describe your journey? What will be the central themes constructing the emotional framework of your life? Look at the stories that have come to define your life: What milestones have you reached? Which memories have etched themselves indelibly into your being? How have these stories influenced your identity? This is an opportunity to reflect on your own journey, and explore what stories you want to tell about your life. Take a deep dive into understanding who you are and why it matters. What powerful tales do we want to tell of your journey, your adventure and your soul? Take this time to reflect on what these stories might be and how they will shape your experience going forward. In this extraordinary period, you have the unique opportunity to dive deeply into the stories of your life, consider their implications and ask yourself, “What story do I want to tell for my life?” As you approach the end of this season, take advantage of the Sagittarian energy and go on an adventure of self-discovery. It could lead you to create a beautiful and inspiring story worth telling. An essential question for Sagittarius season: What have you learned from your past, and past lives that can help shape the future? As you head into the winter holiday season and Sagittarius season, it's the perfect time to look back, reflect and take lessons from your past. Think about what you've gone through in your life - both successes and failures. What mistakes did you make? How did you learn from them? And how can you apply that wisdom to this life? Take a moment to be thankful for the lessons you've learnt and become aware of every moment as a learning experience. And when you look From understanding your motivations to blessing your current self and focusing on gratitude, recognize the power of looking back and learning from your journey. Sagittarius season is also a time for spiritual reflection, and having faith in something greater. As the sun enters Sagittarius season, take this time to reconnect with your spiritual side and tap into the abundance of energy Jupiter has to offer you. It's time to be the author of your own story – set your intentions, speak your truth. Manifesting the future you want starts with understanding what you want and envisioning how to get there. Put words to your dreams, call them into existence, and watch each unfold in its own magickal timing. It's time to be the author of your own story. Reflect on the past, take stock of the present, and plan for the future. Live intentionally and lead with an open heart. With the Sagittarius season upon you, now is the time to go within and embrace the fires of truth and knowledge. As you explore deeper truths that come with this season, your inner light will guide you towards new heights of wisdom and understanding. So take this time to discover yourself, try something new and unfamiliar, or delve into the world of philosophy and religion. Take off on an adventure and see where life leads you. Sagittarius season is all about truth, luck, higher education, religion, foreign cultures, and philosophy. Let's blaze a new trail of self-discovery and open your mind. to new possibilities. May your travels - either physical or through deep introspection - be guided by your inner wisdom and may you be heralded as a beacon of knowledge, no matter how far you wander. The arrow of Sagittarius is dipped in truth, ruling philosophy and religion, teaching you to accept your fears; and that the season before, Scorpio/Death, is not the end, but merely transformation. A new beginning – one which carries with it potential for greatness. Let the arrow of Sagittarius guide you through life's seasons, illuminating your path and showing you that through 1151 death comes rebirth. Embrace the cycles of life that will eventually bring about the integration of all that life has to offer us. Sagittarius message is one of courage and strength; be bold enough to ignite your own flame and lead yourself forward in life. By connecting with the energy of Sagittarius, you have the opportunity to break free from cycle, when you learn to integrate all that life on earth is trying to teach you. Sagittarius, the philosopher, wants you to confront your own truth. Confronting your truth is a journey inside yourself, not a battle with the outside world. This can be done by exploring what you truly believe, questioning why you believes it, and being open to the possibility of changing your beliefs if necessary. The next step is to identify and confront any areas of fear or discomfort. Fear and discomfort can often be the root of self-limiting beliefs and behaviors. It is important to take time to reflect on these areas and to explore potential solutions or steps to take in order to overcome them. Finally, it is important to take action based on your truth. It is not enough to simply acknowledge your truth; action must be taken in order to create positive change. Taking steps to move beyond your current situation and to create a better future. When the Sun is in Sagittarius, it is advantageous to speak truthfully and explore different cultures, languages, and perspectives.(♃) Jupiter, the great benevolent. heading: Sagittarius Light & Shadow
body: In its unevolved form, Sagittarius, in his shadow, can be deeply pessimistic if things don't go the way they wish. With a disconnection from the Spirit, they can become overbearing in their advice, insensitive in their words, slip easily into boredom, and a perpetual state of restlessness. Their desire for independence and adventure may develop into a lack of commitment in relationships and life choices. Their passion for freedom may cause them to become flighty and 1152 unreliable. To those who observe them, they seem stuck in a childlike state, unable to commit, take on responsibility, and always chase the next best thing. However, as they increase their vibration, they can become one of the most lovable signs, determined to achieve their goals and willing to share their wisdom with others. At the high-vibrational end, evolved Sagittarius energy seeks its truth and is excited about sharing it with others. Embarking on an adventure, seeking independence, telling great stories, and seeing life as "the glass half-full." Sagittarius aspires to understand the wisdom of life's mysteries eager to share their gathered knowledge with others. Sagittarius Light & Strength – Truth-seeking, truth-speaking, independent, adventurous, explorative Sagittarius Shadow & Weakness – Emotional unavailability, overbearing, insensitive, lack of perspective, self-indulgent, dishonest, opinionated Sagittarius Season, The 9th House And Jupiter Planetary Ruler Sagittarius, the ninth sign of the Zodiac, is a leader in matters of philosophy, religion, and spiritual reasoning. Ruled by Jupiter, the largest planet in our solar system, Sagittarius is associated with abundance and generosity. Jupiter generates more radiation than it receives from the Sun, and this natural state of giving is reflected in the jovial, uplifting energy it brings. The glyph of Sagittarius, the crescent dominating the cross, represents the expansion and growth that are possible when we make space in our lives - mentally, physically, and emotionally. Jupiter gifts us with an open mind, the freedom to question and learn, and the opportunity to grow and prosper. But what does it mean to expand and hold space for growth? And what qualities do we need to cultivate in order to do so? These are questions for the Sage, the King of Gods, whose domains include wealth, prosperity, good fortune, wisdom, luck, and progress. May the magnifying influence of Jupiter be with you as you seek answers and seek to expand and grow in all aspects of your life. 1153 Sagittarius / Temperance Temperance is the fourteenth spiritual key in the Major Arcana, when the Fool meets the angel of Peace in the form of Temperance. The Fool is now the seed for the creation of new life. Planetary Ruler – ♃ Jupiter Symbolism – Similarly to the Justice card, the jewel on the angel's crown references the pineal gland, which becomes activated during kundalini awakening. The upward pointing triangle on her chest represents the fire element and the spiritual flame within the body. Her legs symbolize the two pillars of polarity, with one foot is on land and the other in the water, inspired by the vision of apostle John, in the Book of Revelations. (10: 1-2): “I saw another strong angel coming down out of heaven, clothed with a cloud; and the rainbow was upon his head, and his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire; and he had in his hand a little book which was open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left on the land…” In her hands she holds two chalices, pouring the essence of life between them; the mixing water into wine. This alludes to the ancient alchemical symbolism in which the distillation of liquid between two flasks is a symbol for the awakening of kundalini. Astrology – After exploring the shadows of the Underworld, the Fool is illuminated by the fires of Sagittarius. Sagittarius assists in the search for meaning, truth, and wisdom from the darkness. The angel is a metaphor for the divine kundalini energy, teaching that death is not the end, but the transformation of energy. Greater spiritual meaning is learned through the teachings of reincarnation. The question of greater purpose in life is answered through the integration of lessons that must be mastered or repeated cyclically as karma. Temperance is one of the four cardinal virtues, with roots in the Old Testament. Upright – Meaning Balance, patience, the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering our purpose or meaning, mindfulness of over indulging or drinking, moderation, the balance of passion and reason, clairvoyance Reversed – Excess, impatience, lack of balance, over indulgence, alcoholic tendencies, living an unbalanced life, inability to resolve conflict, difficulty with compromise or working with others 1154

heading: Sagittarius Season and Sagittarius New Moon: Actions and Intentions
body: As the leaves begin to fall and the days grow shorter, it's time to ready yourself for the coming winter. Sagittarius season is a time to gather around the fire, share stories, and reflect on the deeper meaning and purpose of life. This is a time to be resourceful and to prepare for whatever challenges may come. The archer, Sagittarius, guides you in gathering the knowledge and skills you need to weather the winter months ahead. Prioritize self-care, with a focus on regular sleep and exercise. Sagittarius season is a perfect time to focus on strength training, particularly for the liver, hips, and thighs, to ensure you're physically ready for winter adventures and activities. Stay safe and stay warm as you navigate the changing seasons. Jupiter and Sagittarius expand what they touch, so it's important to be mindful of the energy and intention you are putting out into the world. Too much of anything can be overwhelming and stifling, which is the opposite of what Sagittarius desires. Instead, let's focus on cultivating harmony, abundance, and gratitude in your life, and watch as these positive energies expand and grow. A time to embrace the thrill of the unknown, To venture out and discover new horizons. To trust in the wisdom of my own intuition, And let go of any need for external validation. I speak my truth with courage and conviction, Expressing my beliefs and values boldly. I am focused on my own personal growth and expansion, Seeking to stretch myself both physically and spiritually. I embrace my adventurous spirit, Embracing all that the world has to offer. Create an altar – During the Sagittarius season it is a good time to create a sacred space for Jupiter, the planetary ruler of Sagittarius. To create an altar, you can gather items that have personal meaning or significance to you. You might also collect items that symbolize Jupiter and Sagittarius. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Observe – Observe and record any symbolisms or messages that you notice during this full moon. A journal is like a magick portal to your innermost thoughts and dreams. Every page is an invitation to explore, reflect, and express yourself in a meaningful way. Collect items – Grab a pen, paper, candles, incense, herbs, and symbolic objects to represent Jupiter/Sagittarius, like The Temperance tarot cards and the Planetary Kamea for Jupiter. Embrace the pioneering spirit – Embrace new experiences with curiosity and excitement. This might involve traveling to a new place, trying a new activity, or stepping outside your comfort zone. 1155 Gather around the fire: As the weather grows colder and winter draws near, it's time to huddle close with those you love. The chill of the night beckons for a pleasant gathering 'round the fire. Gather with your family and dearest friends. Unplug from the world and come together in the warm light of the flames to unplug and share tales; because this is one of the few experiences that bring you back to simpler times, bringing everyone close together. Speak the truth: The magick of Sagittarius brings the lessons of truth and knowledge. It's time to stop the game of smoke and mirrors. Accept the challenge and commit to being honest, open, and true to yourself and to those around you. One of the most important benefits is that it helps to build trust. Honesty is the foundation of any meaningful relationship. The benefit of not lying and being honest is that it builds trust in relationships. When you are honest with each other, it strengthens your bond and makes communication more effective. Honesty also helps build a sense of security and comfort in relationships, as you know that the other person is making decisions with full awareness. Picture how situations can improve if you communicate honestly and without omissions or deceptions. Take on this challenge this season starting on the Sagittarius New Moon commit to no lying and omissions and see how more authentic your life becomes. Expand your mind: We all want to be the best version of ourselves, right? Well, a great way to do that is by exploring different cultures, trying out new cuisines, and learning foreign languages. By stepping outside your comfort zone and immersing yourself in something foreign, you can gain a broader outlook on the world and learn more about yourself in the process. With a curious mindset, you can unlock uncharted paths for your mind to explore and have conversations that challenge your perspective - taking in the beauty of different cultures and locations, opening up new possibilities for growth; creating conversations that open you up to new perspectives. Explore Reincarnation: Have you ever wondered what came before or after this life? Sagittarius season is a time to explore Reincarnation, Past Life Rituals, and Past Life Meditations. Why not explore the mysteries of reincarnation with tarot and guided meditations and visualization techniques? You can gain a fascinating insight into your current life by diving into past life rituals, meditations, and theories. Many past life rituals and techniques help open your subconscious mind to explore our karmic pathways. By studying the philosophy of reincarnation, you can go deeper into your spiritual nature and deepen your understanding of the soul and its journey through this life and beyond. Support your liver: Your liver, hips, and thighs have worked hard this year, so why not show them some extra love? Sagittarius season is an excellent time for alcohol fast, making Dry November popular. Say goodbye to alcohol and drugs that can burden your liver. And if you're taking any prescription medications, you should talk to your doctor about cutting them back (if medically advisable). Start sipping on Liver Cleanse and Liver Support teas like dandelion greens/teas and milk thistle. This will help you take those first steps toward living a healthier and happier life. Strength train: Sagittarius rules the calves and legs. You seek the strength to reach your goals, but if your legs are not prepared, no amount of effort will propel you forward. To harden your limbs, perform some classic squats. For a more invigorating option, take to the outdoor realm and go 1156 skiing or snowboarding! You will become stronger, as well as appreciate the enchanting winter scenery of freshly-dusted snow-covered mountains. Study Philosophy: Philosophy helps you to think critically and analytically, and encourages you to ask questions and challenge assumptions. It also helps you to develop your own opinions and ideas and to think more deeply about the world around you. Experience other cultures: Learning other languages and cultures can help you appreciate the human experience's diversity. Study Religion: Studying and practicing religion can bring you closer to your spiritual self. Sagittarius New Moon: The Quest for Knowledge The Sagittarius new moon occurs during a transition in the Northern Hemisphere when it's no longer autumn but not yet winter. As the temperature drops, heat up your resolve and prepare for a new start and new year. Whether it's starting a journey of adventure, self-discovery, or spiritual growth, welcome the new year with an open heart. Take this as an opportunity to embrace your truth and sow the seeds of your future. Take this as an opportunity to embrace your truth and sow the seeds of your future. Whether it's starting a journey of adventure, self-discovery, or spiritual growth, use this transition season to prepare for a fresh start and welcome in the new year with an open heart. Sagittarius is a sign of transition, a bridge between two distinct energies. Mutable signs are always in flux and always in a state of change, and Sagittarius is no exception. Sagittarius serves as a reminder of the impermanence of life and the need to remain flexible and open to change to move forward. It is a sign of transformation and a reminder that change is the only constant in life. You are in a perpetual state of transition, yet it is only through a meaningful transformation that you can continue evolving and growing. The centaur, the symbol of Sagittarius, embodies this concept, demonstrating how you can be grounded and open-minded, moving between two worlds to better understand yourself and the universe. The Sagittarius spirit is one of ceaseless exploration, a never-ending quest for knowledge and understanding. It is a sign of generosity, hope, and desire to share its wisdom with the world. It is a sign of optimism, of believing that something wonderful awaits just around the corner. It is a sign of the open road, of the joy of discovery, of the thrill of the unknown. The Sagittarius new moon reminds you that life is filled with limitless possibilities. You stand in line between free will and fate every time you choose. Each choice you make propels you to a new destination - sometimes you choose to revisit a path, and other times somewhere unexpected. Neither is predictable. Even on the familiar path, you may come across something new or see things from a new perspective even though nothing has seemingly changed. But, no matter which direction you choose, you carry the lessons of your past experiences and the potential to learn something new even if nothing has changed around you. The concept of free will has long been a source of philosophical contemplation. Indeed, with each decision, you stand at a crossroads between fate and your agency. You are left to ponder the extent of your control and to ask yourself whether your choices only influence your mental and 1157 emotional landscape or something more. The Sagittarius season and the new moon offer you a chance to ponder this question further and assess your choices. With each choice, you reflect upon the past, thinking about the opportunities you seized and the times when you hesitated. This reflection shows how you arrived at where you are today, what can be done better tomorrow, and how to proceed with your next step. The new moon is a moment to recognize the power of free will, the importance of your autonomy, and the potential of your own volition. In this cosmic cycle, we are now shifting towards compassion and forgiveness. Forgiveness is another choice you are contemplating during this new moon, and it is only when you reach this stage of compassion that you can liberate yourself from the shackles of karma and past experiences. The sign of Sagittarius is one of the zodiac's most multifaceted and enigmatic, capable of embodying both the light and dark aspects of being. On the one hand, they possess an indomitable spirit and an impressive sense of determination, allowing them to break through any obstacle with cheerful defiance. On the other, they may become overwhelmed by their expectations, leading to an overbearing attitude and an inability to commit. Yet, in their darker moments, they can fall into stagnation and pessimism, struggling to find purpose and satisfaction in the world around them. Indeed, the Sagittarius season brings complexity, light, and shadow, which fascinates and perplexes you with this new moon. The last few weeks have been a powerful reminder of the strength and courage within you. This time has illuminated your ability to navigate challenging situations, find creative solutions, and turn your visions into reality. The journey ahead may be full of obstacles, yet the rewards of self-determination are invaluable. Jupiter and Sagittarius expand what they touch, so be clear on what energy you're putting out right now. Too much of anything will feel suffocating, which is the exact opposite of what Sagittarius desires. Jupiter and Sagittarian influence encourage you to recognize the power of your intentions. If you are mindful of what energy you are putting out, you can create a balance of harmony, abundance, and gratitude in your life, allowing them to thrive. Thanksgiving takes place during Sagittarius season. What a perfect blend of Jupiter and Venus to remind you to find gratitude for the abundance you all have, however little it may seem sometimes. At the same time, you must be wary of allowing this gluttonous combination to lead you to over-indulgence. And while this holiday is controversial for a good reason, you can turn it into a day of remembrance for the genocide that occurred; and recognize the difficulties of reconciling with this troubling history. The holiday season can bring up old hurts, but it can also be a chance to repair relationships. Remember to practice self-care and self-love, and don't be afraid to set boundaries. If you're not being treated well or taking on too much, feel free to say no. This Sagittarius new moon brings in an opportunity for healing, breakthroughs, and new awarenesses and direction. In the process, you may face old wounds or fears around change. You'll be navigating these themes and polarities during this new moon. One thing Sagittarius offers is the opportunity to create change in the direction of one's desire. Use what you learned during the last month to get inspired and light a fire under yourself to reach places you thought impossible. By being conscious of your role in the cosmic universe, you can expand the scope of your being and experience the fullness of life. You have the opportunity to take control of your life story and to create the ending that you desire. 1158 Is It Free Will Or Fate? As the Sagittarius season arrives, you are presented with an opportunity to explore the depths of philosophy, religion, and spiritual reasoning. You are encouraged to contemplate the age-old questions of fate and free will and to consider the implications of your choices and actions. This is Sagittarius's natural role: to be the leader of philosophical thought and challenge you to think more deeply. Have you ever asked yourself if you have control over your own life, or if it's all predetermined? It's a debate that's been around for centuries. You stand in the present moment, reflecting upon the past and the opportunities you have taken, and those you have missed or think you have missed. Life is a complex tapestry of possibilities, and you are constantly presented with choices that can shape your future. With each choice, you travel down a path, sometimes choosing one you have already taken, and sometimes venturing into the unknown. Even on the familiar path, you may come across something new, or see things from a different perspective, even though nothing has seemingly changed. You stand at the crossroads of free will and fate every time you make a choice, raising the question of whether you truly have any free will. Is free will only applicable to your mental and emotional state and how you respond to events, people, and inner dialogue? It seems this is the only real control you have most of the time. In this context, the Sagittarius new moon is particularly relevant, as Sagittarius is the natural philosopher of the zodiac, encouraging you to study and question fate vs. free will. The truth is, both free will and fate play a role in your life. You have the power to make choices and decisions that will shape your life, but you are also subject to the forces of fate. You may not be able to control your destiny, but you can control your thoughts and emotions. You can choose how you react to situations and interpret the events that occur in your life. Ultimately, it is up to you to decide how much control you have over your life. You can choose to embrace free will and take control of your thoughts and emotions, or you can accept fate and allow it to guide you. Have the courage to explore, ask questions and seek understanding. The choice to understand the deeper meaning behind this is yours. 1159

heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Sagittarius new moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. You can use different techniques to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 6-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile that corresponds to the current planetary places. For example, during the Sagittarius new moon, the Sun (Sun) and the Moon (High Priestess) are in Temperance (Sagittarius). Then find the Sun (Sun), Temperance (Sagittarius), and High Priestess (Moon), and place the Sun in position 1, High Priestess in position 2, and Temperance in position 3. For positions 4 and 5, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the new moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 6th position, select a card 1160 from the second pile, which contains the court cards and the Minor Arcana. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. Tarotscope Key 3. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in Ex: Temperance (Sagittarius) during the Sagittarius new moon 1. The Sun (Sun) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The tarot card that corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries 4. The tarot card that corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house 6. The tarot card corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign or a supporting card from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance 1161 Sagittarius (Nov. 22 - Dec. 21) & Sagittarius Rising - New moon in the 1st House Happy Birthday, Sagittarius! This New Moon in your sign is a great time to make a fresh start and create a new vision for yourself. It's time to think about what you want to do, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take in life. If you've had some setbacks this past year, now is the time to figure out how to face and solve any challenges. This is a time of rebirth and redirection. It may be a time of fresh beginnings and new opportunities, but it's also a time to be humble, listen to others, and accept the lessons you must learn. Don't be discouraged if you've faced some setbacks this past year - this is a time to strategize and figure out how to tackle any challenges you may have. Keep your expectations modest, keep your faith, and stay true to your path. This season's gifts, your lesson is humility and learning to listen to others. This is your light. You are wise, educated, and optimistic. Although you may experience a sense of loss or disappointment, more opportunities will show up for you to learn, grow, and expand beyond your comfort zone. Try not to miss the possibilities in a fog of depression, illusion, or that chronic itch for independence that you have. Hold on to your faith, and keep on your path of truth. Set intentions for a new self-image, improved social standing, or popularity. Think: "New Moon, New You." 1162
