heading: Sagittarius New Moon Ritual
body: Fig 73. Top view of an altar to Jupiter and Sagittarius [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Jupiter and your ritual candle(s) for Jupiter on the placement for Jupiter. Place The Wheel of Fortune, Temperance tarot cards on your altar, as well as an offering to Jupiter. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration St. Johns wort) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – Petition Jupiter when asking for justice, legal matters/contracts, to be seen fairly, for blessings both material and spiritual, good fortune, health, and prosperity. Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), 1187 and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. 1188 Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. 1189

heading: Exploring Sagittarius Season and New Moon through Journaling
body: Sagittarius is the sign of adventure. exploration and expansion, representing our desire for growth and understanding. During Sagittarius season or a Sagittarius full moon, the universe may bring up issues related to your personal growth and development. You can use tarot as a way to inspire journaling. Select a spread or layout that resonates with your current focus or intention. Shuffle the deck and draw a card, then reflect on its meaning and symbolism. Use the card as a starting point for your journaling and allow its imagery and message to inspire your thoughts and feelings. Explore the card's themes and messages in greater depth and consider how they relate to your experiences and challenges. Reflect on how the card may offer guidance or insights for your current situation and how you can integrate its message into your life. Light a blue or white candle and create an expansive atmosphere by using refreshing scents and uplifting music. Visualize yourself embracing your curiosity and desire for growth as you seek new experiences and broaden your understanding of the world. Take this opportunity to reflect on your personal growth and development. Open your journal and begin writing about your personal growth and development. You may also want to consider any challenges or obstacles you have faced in your journey towards self-discovery and growth, and brainstorm ways to overcome them. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you explore these themes. As you journey through Sagittarius season, it's a great time to reflect on your personal growth and development. By taking some time to journal about these topics, you can gain a deeper understanding of yourself and your goals. Here are some prompts to get you started: Expanding Your Horizons: Take some time to reflect on the new experiences and knowledge you are seeking out. Consider how you can use your natural curiosity and desire for growth to step outside of your comfort zone and pursue these things. What new experiences and knowledge are you seeking out? How are you stepping outside of your comfort zone to pursue these things? What new experiences and knowledge are you seeking out? How are you stepping outside of your comfort zone to pursue these things? Breaking Through Barriers: Are there any areas of your life where you feel stuck or stagnant? What are your long-term goals and how can you use your desire for growth and exploration to help you achieve them? Consider what steps you can take to embrace change and uncertainty in your journey towards growth and exploration. Dealing with Risk and Uncertainty: Growth and exploration often come with a level of risk and uncertainty. Take some time to reflect on how you handle these things and what strategies have been effective for you in the past. Consider ways to embrace risk and uncertainty as opportunities for growth and learning. How do you handle uncertainty or risk in your journey towards growth and exploration? What strategies have been effective for you in the past? Reflect on your choices: Reflecting on the choices you make in life can be a powerful exercise in understanding the cause and effect of your decisions. You can look back to a single moment in time, when you made a conscious or subconscious decision, and see how it has had a greater impact on your life. This choice point can be seen as a catalyst for both the creation and destruction of 1190 elements in your life, ultimately leading you to where you are today. It is important to take the time to contemplate the power of your decisions and how they shape your life. Journal about cause and effect: Think back to a time when you made a decision (conscious or subconscious) that had a great impact in your life. Reflect on this choice point and journal on how it helped both create and destroy elements in your life to make a path for the life you are living today Reflect on what it means to hold space: Holding space for someone is an act of profound respect and care. It is an acknowledgment that we are all connected and can grow and learn from one another. It is an invitation to be seen and heard, accepted and understood, and supported in our journey of self-discovery. It is a reminder that we are all worthy of love and belonging and can find strength and solace in the presence of another. Holding space for someone is an act of love. How can you hold space for your intentions? What does it mean to hold space for yourself and others? What does it mean to truly hold space for growth and expansion? How can you create more space and abundance in your life? How can you be honest and true to yourself and your vision? What prevents you from achieving your goals and sharing your vision with others? 1191 Sun in Gemini (The Lovers) 3rd House Full Moon in Sagittarius (Temperance) / 9th House

heading: Exploring the Gemini/Sagittarius Polar Axis
body: It is significant to note that each zodiac season highlights the polarities of the season and of the full moon. Sagittarius season will allow you to explore the polarity between the Twins, Gemini, and the Archer/Centuar, Sagittarius. The signs Gemini and Sagittarius represent different methods of absorbing information and gaining an understanding of the world. The Gemini/Sagittarius polarity is associated with learning, collecting, and assimilating information. As Sagittarius observes the big picture, the sandbox, Gemini focuses on the details that make up that picture, the grains of sand. In both cases, the objective is the same: to find the truth. Gemini is a dualistic sign. The Twins symbolize the interconnectedness of all things, and how we're never really separate. Gemini are Twins, the Two which are One. Gemini rules siblings, early environments, elementary education, your first language(s), and your neighborhood. Gemini teaches us about the activity of the mind, how we take in new experiences, and the everyday magick of communication and expression. Gemini uses language to give names to objects, creating two (the object + name) from the one (object). Gemini relates, bringing order to the chaos. Gemini teaches Sagittarius how to communicate. Sagittarius teaches us about Two becoming One. Sagittarius is the Centaur. The half-man, half-horse archer; symbolizes the Two as One. Sagittarius rules foreigners, foreign languages, education, and philosophy, and guides you on a journey to expand your worldview. Sagittarius depicts the Truth that we create for ourselves and the journey we take to discover this truth. Sagittarius reminds Gemini to not lose sight of the big picture. This full moon brings together the energies of Gemini (moon) and Sagittarius (sun). As a result of the Gemini moon, you are encouraged to pay attention to details and make distinctions. As a result of Sagittarius's influence, you can remain open-minded, expand your thinking, and tap into your intuition to process events as they unfold. 1192 In astrology, these signs represent the Third House of communication and the Ninth House of truth, forming an axis of the mind. Through this axis, you gain a more clear perspective on your life purpose and a deeper understanding of it. To achieve balance, it is necessary to let go of the lower vibrational habits of each sign overthinking, becoming scattered, relying too much on logic, or being too idealistic. By aligning yourself with their higher vibrations, you are better able to blend reason with intuition, resulting in a more balanced view of the world. Become familiar with these two aspects of the self - logical and intuitive. The ability to bridge these two powerful energies will enable you to gain a deeper understanding and insight into the world and your place in it. 1193 Gemini Full Moon The full moon's energy amplifies and enhances our energy, allowing us to be more creative and manifest our deepest desires by tapping into our creativity. We are celebrating our journey since the last new moon and reaping the rewards of our dedication to our intentions. At the same time, the full moon is also a time for reflection and adjustment. We can use its energy to realign ourselves with our intentions and make necessary changes to ensure we are on the right path. By syncing with the moon's rhythm, we connect with our community, nature, and the Divine, deepening our connection to our Higher Self and the world around us. Celebration and connection are the essence of this full moon, a time to honor life's cycle and our limitless potential. As we gather under the full moon, we clear away any lingering negativity and raise our energy to new heights. We gain clarity, set new intentions, and process the powerful symbols and messages the moon offers. Wishing you a happy Gemini full moon! The Gemini full moon usually occurs around the holiday season, when we are attempting to keep up with our "to-do" list. It is likely that this Gemini full moon will help you organize and think more clearly about your day. This of course will enable you to think in systems and organize your hectic holiday and year-end schedules, adapting to changes as you move from one task to another, and keeping a light perspective throughout. This Gemini full moon serves as a reminder that life is an ongoing learning process. Adaptability, curiosity, and connection are the hallmarks of Gemini. You will be able to think in systems and add much-needed organization to your hectic holiday schedule and year-end activities due to the moon. Embrace the Gemini spirit as you usher in a new year; be curious, meet new people, and celebrate the full moon with friends, old and new. The Gemini full moon wants you to cast aside the confines of rigid black-and-white thinking and discover the enchanting nuances of gray. This is a favorable moment to reconcile opposing perspectives and foster harmony in your inner dialogue and interpersonal connections. This full moon offers guidance as you navigate the path ahead and confidently embrace the changing year. As we all know, Gemini is the sign of the twins. Despite one part of this sign being playful and friendly, the other might be selfishly trying to get ahead through friendship. A Gemini is a trickster and a shapeshifter, able to adapt and change depending on the situation. Gossip is their known characteristic, and they cannot seem to control themselves. Additionally, while they are listening to one individual at the moment, they may share those secrets with someone else shortly after that. You should take extra care not to embody the shadow side of Gemini this full moon by gossiping, telling lies, or failing to follow through. This survival mechanism helps them get through life and take advantage of every opportunity to network and make friends. They typically succeed with this tactic until people realize they are superficial, fickle, and untrustworthy. Often Gemini doesn't see anything wrong with their behavior. They are, after all, friendly and accommodating. Gemini is known for its playful, curious, and light energy, which you can tap into right now. During this Gemini Full Moon, focusing can be challenging, but you can take advantage of your ideas and thoughts by writing them down. The power of Gemini energy lies in its ability to bring us together and facilitate the exchange of information. The benefits of having deep, meaningful conversations with friends cannot be overstated. Such discussions can help to challenge and expand our perspectives, opening our minds to new possibilities and helping us to grow. By engaging in thoughtful, empathetic 1194 conversations with those we trust, we can gain valuable insight and perspective on our own beliefs and actions. This can be particularly helpful when we are faced with difficult decisions or are trying to make positive changes in our lives. By listening to the perspectives of others and allowing ourselves to be open to their ideas, we can gain a deeper understanding of ourselves and the world around us, ultimately leading to personal growth and transformation. When we let this information in, we're open to new possibilities and breakthroughs. As this full moon is associated with hidden emotions and the unconscious, it is common to experience misunderstandings, loss, and betrayal. Explore the why behind any feelings of insecurity or triggers that surface at this time. Avoiding these issues will only cause more pain in the future. This full moon may leave you torn between wanting to stay in your comfort zone and wanting to change to improve your life. Take a moment to reflect on your most deeply held values and how they are perceived by those around you. After careful consideration, you may decide it is time to make a significant change, such as leaving a job or ending a relationship. During this Geminis full moon, you may feel pulled in different directions. While it can be exhilarating to have your mind ignited, it can also lead to some moments of scattered attention. Rather than feeling discouraged, I encourage you to embrace this restlessness. Listen to your inner voice and follow where your curiosity leads. There's no wrong way to be curious. By getting lost in curiosity, you'll gain a deeper understanding of the world around you and, in return, a deeper understanding of yourself. Whatever shifts are occurring in your life, reevaluate your purpose and place in the world and move forward in a way that truly aligns with your values and worth. 1195

body: Gemini full moon is a time to reflect on your communication, local community and connections with others. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Gemini full moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite 1198 tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cars from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Sagittarius Season, the sun is in Sagittarius (Temperance), opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Gemini (The Lovers). Begin by finding the Sun (Sun), Temperance (Sagittarius), High Priestess (Moon), and then The Lovers (Gemini). heading: Gemini (May 21 - June 20) & Gemini Rising - Full moon in the 1st House
body: The Gemini full moon illuminates your 1st house of Self. This is a time of celebration and a time to celebrate all that you are. You could be going through a transformation of Self; becoming more self-aware, and seeing yourself in an entirely new light. This full moon is a time to focus on new beginnings and release old unhealthy patterns. Focus on how you see yourself and want to be seen, rather than how others see you. This full moon may bring a deeper understanding of who you are, your transformation, and your strength. You are a lover of stories, information, words, and people. You are curious, inquisitive, friendly, witty, and always ready to see something new. But at the end of the day, your true passion lies in sharing what you discover with others, telling passionate tales, and spreading smiles. This is a perfect time to begin to tell and retell your story. Reclaim your story, and use this full moon to boldly tell your story. Sharing heals yourself and the collective. This full moon opposes the Sagittarius sun in your 7th house of relationships, contacts, and important agreements. You are being guided towards deepening your relationships and taking on more commitment. You might be entering a relationship, moving in with your partner, or taking on a business partner. If you are moving in with a partner or taking on a business partner, talk about how you see the relationship's future and best support each other’s goals. Regardless of which chapter you enter, don't be afraid of change - embrace the opportunity to co-create life with another and embark on life’s adventures in unison. 1201

heading: Taurus (April 20 - May 20) & Taurus Rising - Full moon in the 2nd house
body: The Gemini full moon illuminates your 2nd House of Disposable Income and Foundation. The full moon is the perfect time to take a step back and reflect on what matters most. Money can be a source of joy if you use it to align with your values and invest in things that bring you happiness. Celebrate your autonomy by making conscious decisions about where you spend your money. If you want an expert negotiator, look no further than a Gemini. From top-notch salespeople to masterful barters, Geminis know how to get what they want through their charm and wit. They are natural masters of the trade and know how to get creative to get the best possible outcome. The full moon in the second house is an opportunity to reflect on your financial decisions and ask yourself if you were acting from a place of abundance or scarcity. Ask yourself, when was the last time you felt lack? How did it motivate your decisions? Make sure you're making wise choices from a place of abundance and security. Let this full moon guide you to making more conscious choices for the future. The Gemini full moon reminds you that you are worthy of all the good that life has to offer. Believe in yourself and your abilities, and the universe will mirror that back to you. Ruled by Mercury, Gemini teaches you about the activity of the mind, how you take in new experiences, and the everyday magick of speaking your desires into existence. Take this time to speak your desires into existence, and watch as the universe responds in kind. The full moon is here to remind you that you are enough and worthy. This full moon's energy brings an excellent opportunity to reconnect with your finances, money, and material wealth. Let go of all the critical thoughts holding you back and start believing in yourself. What changes must you make to align yourself with your vision of your most abundant self? You may be reassessing how secure you feel financial, and take this time to see what steps you need to take to create more of a supportive financial foundation. With the full moon illuminating your 2nd house of finances as opposed to the Sun in your 8th house of shared resources, you'll have an excellent opportunity to reconnect with your shared resources, including your income, debts, loans, and mortgages. If you have joint finances, this could be a great time to discuss how they're organized. You can progress toward a more harmonious financial situation during this full moon. So seize the moment and start taking steps towards financial freedom. 1203

heading: Aries (March 21 - April 19) & Aries Rising - Full moon in the 3rd house
body: This Gemini full moon is a reminder of the power of words. Within each word lies healing magick just waiting to be unlocked. Speak with intention and clarity, and know that your words can bring connection, peace, joy, and the power to speak out against injustice. The Gemini full moon illuminates your 3rd House of early education, your understanding of expressing yourself, communication, community, siblings, and neighbors. Geminis' planetary ruler, Mercury, teaches of the voice's power to speak into existence; in other words, manifesting into reality. This bridging of the two dimensions (the twins) — thoughts and words being actualized onto the physical plane — is precisely what the Hermetic Principle refers to: "As above, so below." This Scorpio season has been truly transformative. As we resurface, we come out with new revelations and insights. This full moon is a time to process this information (a gift of Mercury) and determine how you want to apply it moving forward (The Magician). With the Sun in Sagittarius, the sign of truth and freedom, and the full moon in Gemini, the sign of communication and conversation.; these two luminaires remind you to speak your truth and honor the power and magic of words. By telling your truth, you show others that you're trustworthy. By speaking another's truth, you honor them and invite them to express themselves. Leverage this full moon energy to bring more honesty and connection into your life. This Gemini full moon is a reminder that you have the potential to create something unique and meaningful through conversations. It's an opportunity to connect and grow with those around you. To create a space for healing and transformation. As you grapple with complex and challenging topics, may you hold them with grace and compassion - for yourself and those you engage with. So whether it's with a family member, a friend, or a stranger, take some time to be present, and make space in your life for meaningful conversations. This full moon in Gemini invites you to revisit some of your most meaningful conversations. Because just like the moon, these conversations have the power to shine some light even on the darkest days. So take some time to be present in your conversations, and celebrate the magick of everyday interactions. After all, it's in your interactions with others that create space for healing. With the full moon in Gemini and the sun in Sagittarius, you're sure to see a turning point in several vital areas of your life. Your third House of communication will be energized, which bodes well for conversations, contracts, and negotiations. There are also opportunities to travel abroad or undertake something new, as the Sagittarius sun harmonizes with the ninth House of your higher vision and foreign travel. Take advantage of this opportunity to grow and expand your horizons. 1205

heading: Pisces (Feb 19th - March 20th) & Pisces Rising - Full moon in the 4th House
body: The Gemini full moon illuminates your 4th House of Home and Family. The full moon in the fourth house signals a time when your home, family, and security are brought into your awareness. The 4th house brings family situations to the surface intending to help you understand and learn from them. This full moon is the perfect time to identify any toxic family members in your life and ensure you have strong emotional boundaries. It can be hard to accept that some family members are unhealthy, but you must learn to set boundaries and take care of yourselves before you can help others. It's also possible you recently moved, need to move closer to family, or are settling into a new home. Or, you may establish different boundaries with family members and ask them not to enter your home and space. It's okay to want to help struggling family members, but don't let them hold you back from creating your own life and growing as a person. The full moon in Gemini is shining a spotlight on the fourth house. This area of life represents your home, family, and emotional security, and it's where crucial changes may be happening at this time. No matter what changes occur, keep your focus on your emotional foundation. The full moon in the 4th house and the Sun in your 10th is about finding balance in your personal and professional life. Your home is so much more than a physical space. It's the center of your emotional world, the sanctuary of your peace of mind, and reflects who you are. That's why it's so important to take care of it and make sure it's organized and clutter-free. So if you want to grow and succeed, it's important to take the time to organize your sanctuary and remove any emotional clutter. Don't let your home, emotional world, and family life get in the way. Create a space of peace and positivity, that will nurture and uplift you. 1207

heading: Aquarius (Jan 20th - Feb 18th) & Aquarius Rising - Full moon in the 5th House
body: The Gemini full moon illuminates your 5th house of fun, children, and creativity. This full moon illuminates the importance of believing in your divine creative gifts and visions. Tonight's full moon is all about igniting your inner creative spark. It's time to open yourself up to new possibilities. Try exploring a new approach if you feel stuck in your creative projects. Maybe you've been working on a big creative project and discover you need to try a new approach – a new medium, a new class, or a new hobby. There's so much beauty in being inspired and trying new things. So, tonight, open yourself up to the magic that surrounds you. Whatever your creative vision may be, don't be afraid to tap into it. Maybe you're already in the process of embracing a new hobby or reexploring old ones. Have you lost touch with the passion that used to define you? Now might be the perfect time to reconnect with what lights you up. We all have creative energy inside us, it's just a matter of unlocking it. So, take some time to explore your passions and find what truly brings you joy. Whether it's writing, painting, or something else, now is the time to follow your creative instincts and re-evaluate what brings you fulfillment. Don't be afraid to draw inspiration from your past, even if it's painful. This Gemini full moon is about embracing life's duality and allowing our different sides to coexist. Don't let fear or guilt keep you from integrating the different sides of yourself. You don't have to choose between your conservative, practical side and your inner artist. This Gemini full moon reminds you that you don't have to choose between stability and your passions. Embrace all of who you are to live your most fulfilling life. Don't be afraid to let your inner artist shine, even if it doesn't fit with what others expect or want from you. You are dynamic and multifaceted and it's time to honor that. 1209

This is a good time to release any daily habits or activities that harm your overall well-being. As we move into this lunation, take a moment to check in on yourself. How can you show up for others if you neglect your needs? Show up for yourself as you do for others. It's time to take a break and prioritize some much-needed self-care. Don't be afraid to say no to the wrong things, and yes to the things that will nourish your soul. You can't pour from an empty cup. Maybe you've been feeling a little overwhelmed lately, or you've been putting work above self-care. Either way, this lunation is a reminder that you need both. It's okay to take a break. If you're feeling depleted, anxious, or overwhelmed, give yourself permission to step away. Take some quiet time, do some deep breathing exercises, or even take the day off. Your mental health is just as important as your physical health, so don't be afraid to take a break and recharge your batteries. Make some time for self-care. Perhaps try some gentle energy practices like Qi Gong, Yoga, and Tai Chi to help you revitalize and inspire you. Reflect on your daily routines and ask yourself what shifts can be made to cultivate more health-conscious habits. Set yourself up for health and success. 1211

heading: Sagittarius (Nov 22nd - Dec 21st) & Sagittarius Rising - Full moon in the 7th House
body: The Gemini full moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. With the Sun in Sagittarius, the sign of truth and freedom, and the full moon in Gemini, the sign of communication and conversation. These two luminaires remind you to speak the truth and honor the power and magic of words. By speaking your truth, you show others that you're trustworthy. By speaking another's truth, you honor them and invite them to express themselves. Leverage this full moon energy to bring more honesty and connection into your relationships. This is an important time to slow down and be in the moment. Face the fears that are coming up around commitment or abandonment and work through them with support. Allow yourself to listen, and be open to truths revealed - yours and others. This full moon helps you recognize the gift of co-creating and commitment; it asks that you honor the commitment you made with others and your commitment to yourself. Relationships evolve, and it's possible you need to take this time to review your core values (having children, living close to family, stay-at-home mom or dad, selling your business, creating a non-for-profit, etc.) and see if the long-term relationship in your life has evolved with you. If not, can you both navigate the path forward to reach a place of shared core values? While staying true to who you are is important, it's also important to be respectful of what matters to those around you. Life is all about balancing relationships, both old and new. The full moon in the seventh house is a time to celebrate relationships that have served you well and to acknowledge when it's time to let go of those that don't. It's an opportunity to take stock of your relationships - the ones that are strong and balanced and the ones that may be out of balance or lack commitment. Take time to set healthy boundaries, let go of anything that no longer serves you, and reclaim your power. The next six months are a chance to explore what a healthy relationship based on trust, understanding, and empowerment looks like. 1213

heading: Scorpio (Oct 23rd - Nov 21st) & Scorpio Rising - Full moon in the 8th House
body: The Gemini full moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. It's a time when any secrets, gossip, addictions, or underhanded behavior will also come to light. This Gemini full moon is a time of revelation and insight. It's an opportunity to shine the light on the things that were hidden in the shadows of Scorpio season. With new knowledge and revelations, it empowers you to process this information and see how you want to put them into practice moving forward. This Gemini full moon is illuminating your 8th house, ruled by Scorpio and the house of shadow work. Shadow work is a powerful technique for harnessing our fear, channeling it into positive energy, and using it to manifest the life we want. Whether you're dealing with anxiety, depression, or anything else, start by doing a little journaling. Writing out your fears can help you process them, so you can get past them. The full moon in the eight house also illuminates what others have given to support you (or didn't give support), and signals a time when you can give back to those who have helped you along your journey or let go of the baggage that was given to you that you no longer need to carry. Any baggage that is not yours to carry only burdens your journey. This baggage can be debt you took on from a divorce, separation, family, ex-roommate, or friend. The baggage can be words or labels placed upon you that you no longer identify with or never were your truth. Take time to reflect on any debt or shared resources that are holding you back, and take steps and address how you can free yourself from these obligations. Honoring your values, reworking your finances, and exploring your senses and sensuality is most important to you now. This full moon invites you to honor your healing. Forgiving yourself for any generational conditioning that was passed down to you. Forgive yourself for what you didn't know before or what you didn't know you held power to do, and celebrate the new knowledge and understanding that has been revealed to you. May this full moon bring you peace and clarity on your path; illuminate the ways in which you've healed and how this healing has transformed you. 1215

heading: Libra (Sept 23rd - Oct 22nd) & Libra Rising - Full moon in the 9th House
body: The Gemini full moon illuminates your 9th house of the higher self. We often ask why bad things happen in the world and if there is a higher power that could prevent them. But faith isn't static. It ebbs and flows, with times of certainty and times of doubt. This year may have tested your faith, but it doesn't mean you have to lose it. Remember that questioning, understanding, and trusting the unknown is part of building faith - not just in something higher than yourself, but in your own power and strength. Have you ever looked at the night sky and felt a connection to something bigger? That's the power of this full moon. It's a reminder to go beyond the surface level and ask yourself what your life experiences mean. Life doesn't always make sense, but it's up to you to make meaning. Not all experiences are meant to build strength. Some just give you the information about what not to do again. Whether it's a relationship, a job, or anything else, it's important not to dwell on the past--instead use the information to make better choices going forward. Our memories can often hold onto more than just the good times. Sometimes, when you least expect it, an old issue from the past can be awakened. Emotions are amplified at this time, and your actions need to be aligned with logic and reason; not everything will make sense (to all your six senses). As it’s usually difficult to see the greater vision from inside the eye of the storm. But instead of trying to suppress your feelings, explore the fault lines of your emotions. Find the wisdom in the old tales that are being replayed now. Anchor yourself in your truth (as Sagittarius is the ruler of the 9th house), and your truth will guide you in taking the right action and navigating the unknown. Under this full moon, let the light of understanding guide you. Tap into that power and trust in the understanding that these experiences are here to inform, shape, define and guide you. 1217

heading: Virgo (Aug 23rd - Sept 22nd) & Virgo Rising - Full moon in the 10th House
body: The Gemini full moon illuminates your 10th house of career and public recognition. The full moon is here to light up your path to success! Now is the perfect time to take advantage of the spotlight and share your voice with the world. So don't be afraid to step out of your comfort zone and show off your knowledge. Whether it's through speaking at an event, writing for publication, or anything else you're passionate about, don't be afraid to take a chance and express yourself. Now is the time to make your mark. Remember to think outside the box to take your career or business to the next level. It's not just about who you know but who knows you. Growing your business network is the key to unlocking new opportunities and possibilities. It's not just about who you know, but what you can do together. Every connection can be an opportunity to collaborate, share ideas, and create new connections. This full moon is a social time, don't be afraid to make connections and build relationships. As your career evolves, it can be easy to get caught up in uncertainty. Sometimes it's easy to get stuck in our heads - overthinking and questioning ourselves. But don't let the noise of your thoughts keep you from advancing. When you start to feel the spiral of overthinking and questioning, take a deep breath and remember that it's okay to be a work in progress. Guided meditation can help as you attempt to stay centered and optimistic. You must keep yourself grounded and your home a sanctuary during these transitions. By taking the time to reflect on your needs within your home, you can then support your work or public life accordingly. You like being in leadership roles only when you can keep the more personal part of yourself 'behind the scenes.' Take time to reflect and reconnect with your inner self to better support your work or public life. This full moon is about stepping into greater responsibility. You may feel unsure of how to do this, or you may feel stuck or resistant to this shift. But ultimately, this full moon asks that you step into your greater purpose and take on more responsibility, whether in your current work or forging your own path. Your career and business need you to show up fully in day-to-day tasks and every aspect of your life. You cannot separate a part of yourself from your whole self. Especially when your career and business ask that you show up fully. Now is the time to release any resistance to integrating parts of your unique personality into your public-facing career persona. It's time to claim your power and step into your true potential. 1219

heading: Leo (July 23rd - Aug 22nd) & Leo Rising - Full moon in the 11th House
body: The Gemini full moon illuminates your 11th house of friendships and networks. The Gemini full moon is here, and it's time to take stock of your relationships. Who do you have in your life that brings out the best in you? Who is helping you reach your goals? Take this moment to reflect on the importance of the people around you and their impact on your journey. This is a time to reflect on the people and moments that bring contentment and fulfillment. Let the light of the Gemini full moon guide you. Reach out to those that bring joy, laughter, and love into your life. Let go of what doesn't serve you, and surround yourself with those who make you shine. This full moon can bring about gossip and heated arguments; sometimes, it is better just to walk than to fight with fools. Instead, you can focus on building more robust, meaningful relationships and social connections. Sometimes it's easy to get caught up in social media drama, so be honest with yourself about who your true friends are and stop allowing toxic people into your life (physically or digitally). It's time to release false friends, networks, and social platforms that aren't supportive of your mental health. The shadow of Gemini energy can have you constantly refreshing your social media feeds, obsessed with the latest news. This energy can leave you feeling more overwhelmed and confused rather than informed and connected. Social media and the internet have been incredible tools for breaking down barriers, staying in touch with long-distance friends, and helping you connect with others and other cultures. On the one hand, you've gotten so much by connecting with others online. But on the other hand, it's so easy to become distracted and consumed by it all. The constant dopamine hits and dopamine crashes can leave you feeling drained and unsatisfied. Constantly being "on" and "shareworthy" can be exhausting. But how much is too much? You can easily forget that technology is a tool, not an end in itself. It's essential to ensure you're using it to your benefit and not letting it take over your life. This full moon asks that you find a way to balance your need for social media and digital connection and your need for information. This is a time to fine-tune your social media presence (or altogether remove yourself from specific platforms). When you post something, you never know who might see it. And you never know what kind of impact it might have on your life or career. So take social media seriously. Be thoughtful with your words and careful about what you post. You never know when it might return to reward or bite you. The internet keeps receipts. Focus on what is working in your projects and relationships, and let go of anything holding you back. Don't be afraid to let your Leo light shine. You are multi-faceted, complex, and full of potential. Allow your strengths and the things that make you unique to be seen. Don't be afraid to express yourself authentically, even if it means you might face judgment or rejection. To find your true voice and make your mark in the world, you have to be brave. To find your creative voice, you must first be vulnerable. You have to trust yourself, your ideas, and your vision. You may have to stand alone for a while, but you are strong enough to do so. As a creative leader, it's your strength and courage to be vulnerable and stand firm in the face of opposition that will set you apart. Share your truth and vision with confidence - you have the power to manifest your message into reality. 1221

heading: Cancer (June 21 – July 22nd) & Cancer Rising - Full moon in the 12th House
body: The Gemini full moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Cancer, Luna is your ruler. The full moon naturally has a more powerful influence on your emotions and inner world. It illuminates your subconscious mind and is a perfect time to tune in to your intuition, a time for stillness within yourself and observation. Let the light of this full moon be your guide. It's a time to reflect on all the inner work you've been doing and to give yourself some much-needed rest and rejuvenation. This full moon reminds you that your inner work is worth it. You often spend long periods reflecting on your past and present, trying to make sense of the pieces to build something better for your future. Embrace the creative possibilities this moment brings and allow yourself to explore your dreams, illusions, and desires. Now is the time for deep reflection and spiritual purging. Take time to clear up any spiritual and emotional debt from the past year, and then focus on what you want to call in. Think about what you want. Write it down, meditate on it, and manifest it. Make space to invite positivity, love, and joy into your life. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces, with the ancient ruler of Jupiter corresponding to the Wheel of Fortune in the major arcana. This cosmic wheel symbolizes the ever-changing cycles of life and the endings that come with them. You can tap into its fortune if you remain in alignment with Universal energy but resist it, and you can experience turbulent waters. Life is all about flow, so remember to center yourself within this infinite energy and trust that it will guide you. This full moon offers an opportunity to step back and reflect on the past 12 months and prepare for what's to come. While it can be tempting to get stuck in the past, it's helpful to remember that everything in your life changes. It's important to honor that and to hold space for all the endings and new beginnings that lie ahead. Release your need to be in control, allow for endings, mourn if needed and allow yourself to flow with the current of whatever is unfolding, even if the destination is still unknown. By practicing breathwork, you can tap into this energy and release any trapped emotions or past struggles. Reflect on this full moon energy, and take the time to acknowledge what you're letting go of and embracing. Breathe deeply, and shift your focus to the present moment. With practice, you can let go of old patterns and trauma and make room for the new. Breathwork can bring profound healing to your spirit and body, especially when releasing trapped emotions and past challenges. Take a moment to connect with your breath, do 4-7-8 breathing the traditional way, empty your lungs of air, breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds, hold your breath for 7 seconds, exhale out of the mouth for 8 seconds, and repeat at least 4 times and work through this full moon energy. 1223

heading: Gemini Full Moon Ritual
body: “I release everything either known or unknown to me that has been blocking me from receiving, feeling, and walking in my strength and authority. I trust and discover strength in my body, mind, self, and spirit. I call in my power and walk in my strength.” - A prayer for release Fig 74. Top view of an altar Mercury & Gemini [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Mercury and your ritual candle(s) for Mercury on the placement for Mercury. Place The Magician & The Lovers tarot cards on your altar, as well as symbols for Mercury and 1225 offerings to Mercury. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration Dill, Cinnamon, Labradorite) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – You can petition Mercury to work on your behalf. Mercury rules travel and trade and is the go-between: a door opening. Petition Mercury to open up doors of communication, travel, job seeking/trade, and quick cash. Mercury also rules mental faculties, and increased focus, alertness, and luck. Mercury can work with any other influence. Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 1226 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. *** 1227 Capricorn Season: Dec. 22nd - Jan. 21st 10th house, Saturn Planetary Ruler Discipline, Focus, Goal-Setting & Long-Term Planning New Moon – Capricorn (ruled by Saturn) Full Moon – Cancer (ruled by Luna) Planet – Saturn Day of the Week – Saturday (ruled by Saturn) Magick Number – 3 Archetype – The Ruler, The Master Element – Earth Tarot – The Devil Body – knees, joints, skeletal system, and teeth Affirmation – I am dependable, I persist, I have endurance Theme – A new year is here and it's time to set some resolutions and long-term goals Focus – Develop your career, improving your status in society As we welcome Capricorn season, we embrace a period of accountability and pragmatism. With the winter chill enveloping us, the Capricorn spirit calls upon us to brace ourselves, establish a strong footing, and take the reins of our existence. This is an opportune moment to delineate our goals, concentrate on what truly matters, and remain conscientious of our commitments. It's a time to judiciously manage our resources, confront our anxieties with bravery and self-control, and carve a pathway towards success. Just as the earth enters a period of dormancy, readying itself for the frosty winter ahead, Capricorn season nudges us to strategize, budget, and prioritize, setting us up to not only survive but also flourish in the forthcoming months. With a blend of discipline, courage, and foresight, we can create a pathway towards success, regardless of how cold or dark it becomes. Embrace the wisdom that Capricorn offers, and cultivate the ability to maintain a steadfast focus on the achievement of your goals. As we step into the heart of Capricorn season, our focus shifts to the themes of growth, maturity, and accountable action. A time full of potential for personal development, the present moment asks that you to adopt a more mature outlook on your life's trajectory. It is an optimal moment to not just acknowledge the implications of your past and present decisions, but also to contemplate how these choices may pave the road toward your future. Presiding over this season, Saturn, the planetary ruler of Capricorn, unveils a previously shrouded reality you might have been tactfully sidestepping. In its unflinching clarity, Saturn brings your karmic balance to the forefront. Imagine karma as a fire: it can be a searing reminder of past errors, singeing you with its ruthless candor. However, when channelled wisely, it transforms into a comforting warmth that fosters growth and catalyzes metamorphosis. 1228 Saturn's influence offers a vital lens to comprehend this cyclical dance of cause and consequence. The Taskmaster serves as a stern yet nurturing guide, goading you to grapple with, assume responsibility for your misteps, and, in the same breath, rewarding your positive efforts. All this, while ensuring you persist on an uphill trajectory, propelling you toward a future ripe with growth, learned lessons and the promise of greater maturity. This is an optimal time to not just acknowledge the implications of your past and present decisions, but also to contemplate how these choices may pave the road toward your future. This is the season to tap into discipline and strategize a plan to manifest your greater vision. Set long-term goals and cultivate the focus and discipline needed to remain committed - even when faced with doubt. Trust in the teachings of Capricorn season, and in time, these lessons will help you manifest your greater vision. What is your desired intention? Why do you desire this intention? What does it give you? What area of my life needs the most improvement now? Where do I need to focus my energy? What do I want my life to look like in one year, five years, and ten years? What would need to change or give up to make room for this new goal? How can I create more patience in the process of my journey? How can commit to my bigger goals and vision? How can I shed any identities that no longer resonate with my spirit? I acknowledge the desire to establish more security and financial stability in my life 1229

heading: Capricorn Light & Shadow
body: Capricorn is a sign known for its ambition and practicality, but unevolved Capricorn energy can be governed by fear and a concern with status and image. In its shadow, Capricorn may be insecure and may adjust to others' belief systems out of a need for validation. This can lead to a suppression of emotions and a lack of authenticity. Unevolved Capricorn energy can also easily slip into fear and depression, as it may be prone to negative thinking and a lack of self-confidence. On the other hand, evolved Capricorn energy is self-controlled, goal-oriented, and successful. It brings structure and stability to areas of work and family, and is able to approach challenges with a level-headed and practical approach. Evolved Capricorn energy is able to rise above fear and insecurity, and instead focus on achieving its goals and building a solid foundation for itself and those around it. It is confident and able to navigate the challenges of life with grace and determination. If you find yourself struggling with unevolved Capricorn energy, try to focus on building self-confidence, setting and working towards achievable goals, and letting go of negative thinking patterns. Capricorn Light & Strength – long-term planning, responsible, budgeting, discipline Capricorn Shadow & Weakness – depressed, fearful, cold, mean, stubborn, narrowed point of view, scarcity mindset, pessimistic and unyielding Capricorn Season, The 10th House And Saturn Planetary Ruler - Celebrate Light Saturn, the taskmaster, teaches you the importance of time and structure. For any meaningful progress, you need to commit time and remain disciplined. Saturn reminds you that without time, our ability to measure cycles, progress, and evolution is limited. Let's use this time wisely as you mark a new year on the calendar and set your plans into motion. It’s time to strategize and plan for your future. The lord of time, Chronos, also known as Saturn, holds sway over Capricorn, time, and structure. Capricorn season is a time for observing and measuring the passage of time, marking the start of a new year on the Gregorian calendar. Saturn, the most distant planet visible to the naked eye, moves slowly across the sky, a fact that the ancient Greeks associated with old age, maturity, and the passing of time. Saturn, the Task Master, confronts us with our limitations, restrictions, and feelings of hopelessness. It reveals the obstacles we must overcome and the persistence required to do so. Saturn forces us to learn the lessons of our karmic debt and to master them in this lifetime, though be warned, for some of these lessons may take a lifetime to learn or their resolution may be delayed. Those with a strong Saturn in their natal chart are said to have already learned many lessons and possess the wisdom to handle the challenges of this lifetime. The 10th house in astrology is associated with the lord of time, Chronos or Saturn. This house is often associated with the sign of Capricorn and is considered the house of career, reputation, and public life. It represents the peak of the chart and the summit of our aspirations. This is the house of ambition, career, and the public image we present to the world. It is where we strive for recognition, status, and authority. It is where we find our calling in life and our sense of purpose. It is the house of Father Time, and the symbol of the old wise man, the patriarch of the 1230 zodiac. It represents the culmination of our efforts and the realization of our goals. It is a house of hard work, responsibility, and discipline. It is where we find our place in the world and our sense of belonging. The 10th house is the house of our legacy and our impact on the world. As the ruling planet of Capricorn, Saturn is considered a malefic planet, an unfavorable influence. Just as Saturn has a restrictive influence, the lack of light during winter, during Capricorn season, can also negatively affect our collective psyche. This is a time of year when the days grow shorter and the nights longer, temperatures drop, and our spirits can plummet as well. To counter the effects of seasonal depression, our ancestors celebrated the return of light during the darkest time of year through festivals such as Saturnalia, Yule, Hanukkah, Christmas, and Kwanzaa. One of the ancient pagan Roman festivals, Saturnalia, held in reverence of the god Saturn, spanned an entire week and overflowed with merriment, feasts, gift exchanges, and joyful revelry. The festivities began around December 17th in the Temple of Saturn and featured decorations of greenery, outdoor trees adorned with golden ornaments symbolizing the sun and stars, wreaths, and garlands hung in doorways and windows, much like the ornaments and decorations seen during the Christmas season. At the end of the Saturnalia celebrations, cerei, wax taper candles symbolizing the return of light after the solstice, were exchanged. Many cultures around the world celebrate the return of light during the darkest time of year through winter festivals that serve as times of cultural and communal light therapy. Hanukkah, for example, features eight days of light (eight symbolizing infinity) which evoke and symbolize the growth of light. Yule, observed on the day of the Winter Solstice (occurring annually on December 21 or 22), is also known as the Feast of Juul or Yule, which lasted for 12 days and celebrated the rebirth of the sun. Bonfires were lit during Yule, and some people light a yule log, a remnant of the bonfires set by European pagans, in their fireplace and decorate a Christmas tree with lights during Christmas. During an eclipse, the union of the masculine and feminine energies of Sol and Luna gives birth to light. It is during the Winter Solstice, the profound depths of the year, that the great womb of the Goddess brings forth this radiant illumination. The Italian phrase "dare alla luce" and the Castellano/Spanish phrase "dar a luz" embody the act of "giving to the light," which in English signifies "giving birth." From the Winter Solstice onwards, Sol and Luna collaboratively nurture the birth of light, and the days lengthen, generously bestowing upon us a greater abundance of luminosity. Truly, 'tis the season to revel in the return of light. These winter festivals, rooted in ancient traditions and symbolism, serve as timeless reminders of hope, renewal, and the enduring cycle of life. As we gather together and illuminate the darkness, we honor the interconnectedness of humanity and the universal longing for illumination. In this season of celebration, let us embrace the radiant glow that permeates our hearts and souls, as we cherish the power of light to dispel shadows, and inspire us to persevere through the darkest of times. 1231 Capricorn / The Devil The sixteenth key in the Major Arcana is the Devil, met by the Fool after discovering her newfound spirituality. The Devil asks that she relinquish the remaining pieces of her human, animalistic desires. The Devil is the embodiment of duality, the state of separation from Source; the opposite of being in our higher nature of unity consciousness. Planetary Ruler – ♄ Saturn Symbolism – The Devil represents the separation between our lower, animal nature and our higher selves; hence the figure with the lower body of a goat, and the upper body of a man. His curved horns point back to the earth and hint at being rooted in the material world. There is a reference here, as well, to the ancient Greek god, Pan. He sits upon a black square, which symbolizes the square of Saturn, the ruling planet of Capricorn. It can also represent a cube, which in alchemy symbolizes earth and the three dimensions. Saturn, the ruling planet of the earth sign, Capricorn, serves the magickal function of binding things together; hence, the man and woman are chained to the square of Saturn. This suggests that they have the power to slip free of the chains and to avail themselves of their animalistic drives; it is a matter of choice, discipline and willpower to do the work. On the spiritual level, a Kundalini awakening unites the higher and lower natures, integrating the divine with the human, or animalistic. The Devil represents the challenge and temptation one is faced with during this process of inner labor and spiritual transmutation. Astrology – The Devil corresponds to Capricorn and Capricorn season, the darkest parts of the winter in the northern hemisphere. Capricorn is also the sign of hard work, longevity, material possessions, success, wealth and determination, represented by the archetype of the mountain goat — climbing slowly and steadily towards its goal, tackling whatever obstacle or boulder gets in its way. The experience of eternal winter gifts us the wisdom of responsibility, practicality, determination, budgeting, and planning. Capricorn's long-term planning, budgeting, and discipline yields the resources to survive the bleak Winter. Saturn, the ruling planet of Capricorn, is considered a malefic planet, or an unfavourable influence. Just as Saturn has an unfavorable and constricting influence, the lack of light during the winter has an unfavorable influence on our collective psyche. During the Winter Solstice, the darkest time of year, the great womb ofthe Goddess gives birth to light. In Italian we say, “dare alla luce,” and in Castellano/Spanish, “dar a luz,” meaning “to give to the light.” In English, this translates to mean, "to give birth." So, from the Winter Solstice onwards, Sol and Luna give birth to light: Our days are longer, and each day we are 1232 gifted with more light. The planetary ruler, Saturn, teaches you to plan and dedicate yourself to long-term goals — progressing up the metaphorical mountain top — which speaks to the spiritual goal of raising your vibration, elevating your perspective, and allowing kundalini energy to ascend the chakras. Upright Meaning – Animalistic tendencies, lust, desire, obsession, fear, greed, seven deadly sins, alleviating suffering through distractions or indulging in narcotics, food, alcohol, sex, shopping, etc. Reversed – Exasperates energy of the upright meaning, repression of instincts, stunted personal development 1233

heading: Capricorn Season and Capricorn New Moon: Actions and Intentions
body: As the year comes to a close and the Capricorn new moon rises, it's time to set your sights on even higher levels of focus and achievement. The Capricorn new moon signals a turning point for you, as you take a step forward to reach for your goals and aspirations. It's a time to put in the hard work, to be disciplined and focused, to channel your ambitions towards clear and tangible goals. It's a time to trust your own wisdom and intuition as you move forward, leaving behind any need for external validation or guidance. It's a time to be true to yourself and speak your truth, even if it may be different from others. This is a time to stay the course and persevere, to let your actions speak louder than your words, and to manifest your desired future. With the energy of Saturn (also known as Chronos, the lord of time) guiding you, you are reminded that time is a powerful tool. Time can measure your progress, mark the evolution of new ideas, and help you cultivate personal growth. Saturn teaches that without time, you would not be able to cultivate progress and your own personal evolution. As you approach the new year and the end of another cycle, use this time to reflect on your progress and cultivate your evolution. It's never too late to make changes that will benefit you later in life. Drawing on the power of Capricorn energy as you approach the end of the year can help you stay focused and committed to maturing into a rewarding life. You know distractions will always try to take you away from your practice, but use them as a reminder to recommit to yourself. The Universe is here to give you what we ask for, but it will also test your dedication by giving you a distraction. So stay focused, remain committed - and show the world, and yourself, what you're capable of. I AM a powerful manifestation of my goals, aligning with the energy of Capricorn to bring them into fruition. I AM focused and determined, using my time wisely and efficiently to bring my vision to life. I AM mindful and present in each moment, cultivating discipline and understanding. I AM responsible with my resources and prioritize self-investment. I AM self-disciplined and in control of my destiny, prioritizing what matters and taking charge of my life. I AM open to re-calibrating and finding balance in times of diminished energy. I AM committed to taking care of my physical body, incorporating self-care routines for my skin, bones, teeth, and overall health. I AM grateful for the opportunities for growth and personal evolution offered by Capricorn season and the Capricorn New Moon. Create an altar – During the Capricorn Season it is a good time to create a sacred space for Saturn, the planetary ruler of Capricorn. To create an altar, you can gather items that have personal meaning or significance to you. You might also collect items that symbolize Saturn and Capricorn. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Observe – Observe and record any symbolisms or messages that you notice during this full moon. A journal is like a magick portal to your innermost thoughts and dreams. Every page is an invitation to explore, reflect, and express yourself in a meaningful way. Collect items – Grab a pen, paper, candles, incense, herbs, and symbolic objects to represent Saturn/Capricorn, like The Devil tarot cards and the Planetary Kamea for Saturn. 1234 Set Your Goals – Don't wait for the "someday" that may never come. It's time to turn your big goals into a reality. Take some time to think about what mountains you want to climb and what outcomes you want to achieve. Break your goals down into smaller, more manageable chunks – 10-year goals, 5-year goals, and 1-year goals – and create a plan to reach them. Visualize your desired outcome, then work backward to create a roadmap for getting there. Focus on Focusing – Practice mindfulness, meditation, and living in the present moment. These practices can help you cultivate discipline, focus, and understanding. Create a Budget – Invest in yourself so that you can weather any difficult times that come your way. Use Capricorn's energy to create a financial plan that helps you use your resources wisely and preserve them for the future. A spreadsheet of expenses is a great place to start. It's time to take control and find the security you need to thrive. Cultivate Self-Mastery – Don't let time slip away from you. Take control of your own destiny with self-discipline and effective time management skills. Cultivate your inner strength, prioritize what matters, and take charge of your life. Re-calibrate – If you're feeling low on energy, allow yourself time to adjust and channel the energy of the Capricorn season. Take a nap, rest, and sleep. Up Your Beauty Game – Capricorn rules over the skin, bones, teeth, knees, and chronic disease (health issues that require patience, persistence, and time to heal). This season, take some extra time for self-care and incorporate skin and teeth care into your daily routine. Oil pulling with coconut oil can be especially beneficial for your oral health, and it can also be used as a natural moisturizer for your skin. 1235 Capricorn New Moon: Constructing Success, Setting Goals and Building Structure The Capricorn New Moon brings about an opportunity for you to set your sights high and commit to grand objectives for the new year to come. Though the path to manifesting these aspirations may be filled with mountains to climb, effort, determination, and persistence, you should not let that discourage you from taking bold strides toward achieving these goals, particularly when it comes to your personal development and advancement. The wise Capricorn reminds you that maturing and growing often involves taking on more responsibility and having a reality check about what’s happening in your life. With more responsibility comes doubt, and doubt can be a tricky thing to navigate. But if you take the time to look more closely at your feelings of doubt, and understand the lessons it's trying to teach you, it can be a valuable tool. So ask yourself - what do my doubts and fears tell me? How can I use this knowledge to reach my goals? When doubt strikes, don't think of it as an obstacle. Instead, see it as a guide showing you the way toward success. Capricorn teaches you that structure and plans are necessary and valuable if obstacles arise. Capricorn can seem cold, mean, stubborn, and unyielding. It shows you where you feel limited. Where your perspective is narrow and pessimistic. It reveals the obstacles you must overcome and the persistence required. What do you want? Saturn, the planetary ruler of Capricorn, will remind you that hard work and perseverance are needed to get there. During Capricorn season and the new moon, you can feel stuck and limited in your perspective and physical reality. It's essential to take extra care of your health during this new moon. Through Capricorn, you materialize unresolved emotions through your body through sickness, bone, muscle, and joint issues. Keep moving. Keep calm through reading or listening to meditations and audiobooks. Make sure your mind stays focused on the positive, even for short moments throughout the day. Otherwise, you risk falling into the shadow of Capricorn, emotions of struggling, feeling overwhelmed, and defeated. To make sure you don't miss out on life's little joys, try looking at things with a broad perspective. Focus on the potential of the journey and release your need to control every detail. Relax into it and take joy in the challenge. Because no matter what comes at you, this too shall pass but the memories will stay forever. The Capricorn new moon is positive for career and family as it brings structure, stability, and the possibility of a promotion or raise. If you're transitioning with your career, stay focused on the goal even if you need to do some grunt work that isn't super inspiring. Capricorn brings you structure and stability in areas of work and family. That raise you've been wanting, or the business you've been working on, could be becoming a reality now. The Capricorn new moon will help you make changes that push you to grow past your fears and into a more mature version of yourself. Use this Capricorn energy to ground and stabilize. Life is a bit like a jigsaw puzzle. During the next few weeks, you'll be solidifying the pieces that fit together and letting go of those that don't. Some you'll try to hold on to, but only keep the ones that fit. This new moon is all about breaking down to build up. It's time to trust that the picture you create will be beautiful. You're saying goodbye to the superfluous and wasteful and hello to the essential, meaningful, and authentic. It's a chance to explore new possibilities and plant new seeds for your future. 1236
