heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Capricorn new moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. You can use different techniques to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 6-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Capricorn Season, the Sun is in Capricorn (The Devil), opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Capricorn (The Devil). Then find the Sun (Sun), The Devil (Capricorn), High Priestess (Moon), and place the Sun in position 1, the High Priestess in position 2, and The Devil in position 3. For positions 4 and 5, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the new moon (see below), and select the tarot 1237 card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 6th position, select a card from the second pile containing the court cards and the Minor Arcana. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. Tarotscope Key 3. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in Ex: The Devil (Capricorn) during Capricorn new moon 1. The Sun (Sun) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The tarot card that corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries 4. The tarot card that corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house 6. The tarot card corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign or a supporting card from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance 1238 Capricorn (Dec. 22 - Jan. 19) & Capricorn Rising - New moon in the 1st House Happy Birthday Capricorn! This New Moon in your home sign is creating some dynamic tension on how you communicate a new vision of yourself. Big changes are in store for you now in relationships and how you express yourself. The time has come for a full makeover of your identity and how you meet the world. The first house is the beginning of a new journey. Beginning are full of surprises, ups, downs, and turnarounds, but it is your unique journey. Make this time a priority to make decisions for yourself, not based on what you think/believe others want from you. Some decision you made about 6 months ago is now up for review and revision. Think about all that has transpired since then. Try not to allow any disappointments or grief to keep you from moving forward. You’re focused on yourself, your health, and what you need to do to make your desires a reality, and in doing so you may be in opposition to some important relationships in your life. This is the time to clarify what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize how to face and solve any challenges. With a New Moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This is a time of rebirth and redirection. This season gifts you a double dose of, “New Year. New Me!” This is a time for taking stock of your personal inventory. What literal and figurative lessons and blessings have you acquired over the past year? Use this season to map the next level of your experience and claim your grander visions. Tensions are high during any big life transitions, carve out time for rest and reflection. Allow these affirmations to empower you, “I permit myself to evolve. I am new.” How can I allow change to work its magick in my life? How can I shed identities that no longer resonate with my spirit?” 1239

The recent activity in your sign has brought about a powerful transformation within you, and you are now emerging with a renewed sense of self and purpose. The behind-the-scenes work you've been doing on yourself will soon be reflected in the external world as your inner growth and development manifest in tangible ways. Remember, what you value most about yourself is evident in the reality you are creating. Trust in the process, trust in yourself and the universe will align with your values and goals. Engage in creative endeavors that stimulate you financially and intuitively. You’re exploring how to create a solid foundation under your feet. That might feel counter-intuitive to your adventurous nature, but we all need comfort. Discover what foundation and comfort mean for you at this time. Ask yourself, How can I commit to intentionally spending and budgeting my finances? How can I invest in ventures that support and align my long-term future? How can I find innovative ways to commit to responsibility and eliminate blockages or doubts that arise on my journey? I affirm that I can manifest new work opportunities and create a life mixed with expansive and responsible nature. 1241

This is a powerful time to reflect on your communication style and consider ways to improve it. Take a class or workshop on communication or public speaking, as this can help you to be more authentic and true to yourself. Remember, it's not about being perfect but about being open to feedback and vulnerability. This is an important step towards growth. This new moon may bring challenges in expressing yourself; others may try to tell you that you are too intense, making you either explode or avoid important conversations completely. However, these challenges allow you to learn more about communication and your internal thought processes. Take time to reflect on your communication style, and trust in the power of your intuition to guide you. Your intention for this new moon is to improve your communication skills and to trust in the power of authentic expression to deepen your connections with others. Consider ways to share your passions and interests with others through creative and writing projects. Be mindful of your needs and communicate them directly and honestly, and surround yourself with those who can appreciate and support your unique talents and gifts. Trust in the power of your words and speak from the heart, releasing those who cannot understand or appreciate your beauty. Your intention for this New Moon is to communicate authentically, share your knowledge and skills with others, and trust in the power of your words to connect and inspire. 1243

You may be exploring the various contradictions and conflicts within yourself and what you need to feel happy and stable in your home life. During this time, you may be thinking about making changes to your living situation, such as moving or renovating your home. You may also be assessing what provides you with a sense of comfort and security, both emotionally and physically. This is also a time to consider how family fits into your long-term plans and goals. Trust in the process of building and strengthening your emotional foundation, even when it may test your patience. heading: Virgo (Aug 23rd - Sept 22nd) & Virgo Rising - New moon in the 5th House
body: The New Moon in Capricorn is illuminating your 5th house of fun, heart-centeredness, and children. This is a powerful time to tap into your creative energy and explore your passions and interests. Allow yourself to play and remember what it's like to be a child with curiosity and wonder. This can help to loosen any tension that's been building in your relationships and creativity. If you have a creative vision, now is a good time to connect with it and explore it. But remember that preparation is necessary to bring your ideas to fruition. Take some time to reflect on what you've learned about the power of creative energy and how you can create more space for the things you love. Consider committing to creative projects that align with your passions and interests, and find ways to make more time to express yourself. Your intention for this New Moon is to tap into your creative energy and to find ways to make more space for love, relationships, children, and self-expression. The 5th house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the Major Arcana. The Strength card reminds you of a sacred power, grounded in inner-strength and trust, that comes from emotional mastery. The Strength card of the Golden Eclipse tarot illustrates the Fool sitting poised, channeling the energy of the Universe. The lion is a metaphor for the primal energies of the emotional body, the flames referencing its burning passions. Strength symbolizes being in tune with your inner creative flow when time seems to stand still. It symbolizes the power of channeling Source. When you focus on creating from a place of pure presence, you can tap into a field of awareness that unlocks all the infinite possibilities of creation. Your work will come alive and flow through you—not just by you. Your intention for this New Moon is “Use your natural charm, faith, and courage to express to those you love, you feel.” 1247

heading: Leo (July 23rd - Aug 22nd) & Leo Rising - New moon in the 6th House
body: The Capricorn new moon activates your 6th house of health and being of service. Leo, you’re not one to feel restricted, but you might just need to slow down now and reevaluate your lifestyle and health habits. The 6th house is ruled by Virgo, and with the Capricorn new moon, ruled by Saturn, this energy can lead to feelings of shame as you navigate the path of self-care. Sometimes, the shame that arises doesn't have an obvious source. It can come from a minor mistake or be rooted in an incident from your past. The 6th house can cause you to be more self-critical, and no matter the source of shame it can be toxic. It can make your life feel impossible to navigate, often afraid to let anyone get close because of it. This new moon, your intention is to reflect on bringing balance into your life while resisting speaking to yourself in a voice that brings shame. You are worthy of love, and you deserve to feel safe and supported. So let yourself be vulnerable, and let those around you do the same. A new self-care regimen that will give you more energy and create more stability and routine in your life. “I transform and know myself more through a structured approach to my self-care.” The Capricorn new moon in your 6th house of work and daily routine is illuminating the importance of self-care and balance in your daily life. If you've been pushing yourself too hard and neglecting your well-being, this is a reminder to slow down and focus on creating a new self-care regimen that will give you more energy and stability. This includes not only taking care of your physical health but also creating a more harmonious and supportive work environment. It's important to find a balance between work and self-care and to make time for the things that nourish and support you. During this time, it's important to focus on self-care and creating a routine that balances work and personal needs. If you've been feeling overlooked or unacknowledged, it's important to address these feelings rather than ignore them. Unexpressed anger can manifest in negative ways, both physically and emotionally, so find healthy outlets for expression and clearly communicate your boundaries and needs to those around you. Anything arising right now is to help you break through disharmony and find your way back to health and service. The New Moon in Capricorn is shining a light on your work and service in the world. It's reminding you to take a step back and evaluate where your heart truly lies in terms of your career and how you can make a positive impact. This is also a time to focus on self-care and taking care of your physical and emotional well-being. It may be helpful to explore new practices such as Qi Gong, Yoga, or Tai Chi to increase your energy and vitality. The new moon is encouraging you to make time for yourself and to prioritize your health and creativity. Remember that when you take care of yourself, you will be better equipped to serve others. Your intention for this New Moon is to focus on yourself and your health and to let go of self-sacrifice tendencies so that you can create balance in your daily life and work. The sixth house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit. The Hermit symbolizes introspection for personal and spiritual development, taking space from a situation or person to gain perspective, a meeting with a wise person who aids one's journey, and that the answers you seek can be found within. Virgo and the Hermit observe. The Hermit encourages you to purify your mind - to look closely at yourself, so you can start taking note of the ways in which you give too much of yourself. With patience, contemplation, and observation, you can make small changes in your daily routines which can add up to create an impactful transformation. 1249

heading: Cancer (June 21 – July 22nd) & Cancer Rising - New moon in the 7th House
body: The new moon in Capricorn illuminates the paths of your relationships, dear one, as it awakens the energies of the 7th house. This is a time for deep introspection and reflection upon the ways in which your past actions and choices have shaped your journey through the realm of commitment. As the light of the new moon shines upon your heart, you may see how your reluctance to commit or make solid decisions has led you down paths of darkness and unhealthy relationships. But fear not, for this is a time of growth and evolution. Allow the light of this new moon to guide you as you learn to perceive commitment in a new light and embrace the beauty of true connection. Embrace the fears arising within you as you navigate the complexities of commitment and the potential for abandonment. Allow yourself to work through these fears with the support of those around you. Be authentic and true to yourself, and communicate your needs to those in your relationships. Honesty is a liberating act, and by being true to yourself, you will be able to create healthier relationships. Take the time to address the aspects of your relationships that are not working. Communication is key, make sure that you are putting in the effort to understand the other person's perspective. Focus on creating a sense of balance and reciprocity in your relationships. Remember that being human means being imperfect and that it is a part of life. Embrace the human experience, and do not judge yourself for your mistakes or shortcomings. The relationships in your life, whether in love or work, are at the forefront of your mind at this time. Any unresolved issues or imbalances that have been lingering will come to the surface for resolution or at least for open discussion. This season presents an opportunity for you to make the necessary changes to help you grow and evolve as a person and a partner. Truth and honesty are of the utmost importance in all relationships, and this is a time to bring everything to the table. Some of the information that comes to light may cause discomfort or pain, but see it as a necessary step towards intimacy or separation. On the other side of this process lies liberation. The other is a reflection of your own inner beauty. Both are part of the infinite. Reflect on how you have held space for your partner and close relationships, and how they have held space for you. Consider how your relationship with yourself and others has expanded over the past year. Have you been more open to new connections? As you set your intention for this new moon, remember that the new lessons about connection are here to inform you about your ability and desire to commit. Mastering the art of listening and sharing mutually is a skill that will serve you well in all your relationships. 1251

heading: Gemini (May 20th - June 20th) & Gemini Rising - New moon in the 8th House
body: The Capricorn new moon activates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. This is a time of transformation and growth, as you learn to trust in the natural unfolding of life. Your focus is on areas of intimacy and shared resources, as you delve deeper into understanding yourself and your inner resources. You may be exploring themes of loss, control, and surrender as you navigate through this uncertain time. The things that you once thought brought you security may no longer hold the same weight, as you learn to tap into your deeper inner resources to guide you through challenges. Trust in yourself and your abilities, as you navigate this transformative journey. The power dynamics in your life may force you to look within yourself and tap into that inner well of power and strength that you may not have known existed. Embrace the discomfort and let go of the small version of yourself. This season, you will be exploring the most intimate spaces of your soul, and it may be a time of transformation. Do not fear the unknown, for fear itself can be a gift that can help you to let go of the past, trust in yourself, and align with the flow of life. You are more powerful and capable than you realize, and being in connection with another may remind you of this, whether it is through a deep connection or a lesson of disempowerment. Power dynamics that haven't been addressed will now arise, asking for changes in your relationships. You may come face to face with how much you unconsciously depend on others to feel validated. Any unhealthy or abusive behaviors, whether within yourself or from others, need to be let go of, or you may experience some shocking moments that will force transformation. Be open to new solutions to old patterns, even if they may seem uncomfortable or painful. Remember, small steps are still steps forward, but no step at all will keep you stuck. Security is an inner construct that you have some control over, so build trust in yourself and trust outside of yourself will naturally follow. Your intention for this new moon is to take control of your inner security and trust in yourself and the universe. 1253

heading: Taurus (April 19th - May 20th) & Taurus Rising - New moon in the 9th House
body: The Capricorn new moon illuminates the path to your higher self, activating the energies of the 9th house of philosophy, greater wisdom, and higher learning. A call to explore foreign cultures, places, and deeper knowledge is resonating within you. Your deepest desires may be nurtured in these realms of discovery and growth. During this new moon, you may experience a sense of focus and stability, as the new moon in Capricorn aligns with your 9th House of Higher Self. This is a powerful time to tap into the mysteries of life and connect with the magick that lies beneath the surface. Incorporate daily spiritual practices into your life, and lean deeper into your intuition. Reflect on your vision and goals for your future self, and commit to taking steps towards achieving them. If you are feeling lost or directionless, it is easy to turn away from your spiritual practices. However, by actively engaging in and deepening your intuition and spiritual practices, you can gain a clearer understanding of your needs, your true path, and your potential. By setting an intention to strengthen your spirituality, new opportunities and paths may open up to you, bringing more light and understanding to your personal journey. If you are seeking to shift your energy and perspective, start by incorporating daily spiritual practices into your routine. Invest in yourself and listen to your intuition - these are powerful tools for creating an expansive and fulfilling life. Trust in the process and allow yourself to be guided by the wisdom of your inner self. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering our purpose or meaning, mindfulness of overindulging or drinking, moderation, the balance of passion and reason, and cultivating patience. Perhaps you find yourself eager to uncover the truth and wisdom behind the mysteries of life. You may be struggling to understand the greater meaning of life, asking questions such as "What is life? What did my soul come to learn in this lifetime?" You seek greater understanding and meaning in the everyday world, possibly through a spiritual lens. The search for true wisdom is not always straightforward, but delving into the mysteries of life can bring great rewards. Temperance, on a spiritual level, represents the potential for true communication with your Higher Self. When you are open to fate and curious about synchronicities, your Higher Self can make its presence known. The planetary ruler of Sagittarius/Temperance is Jupiter, which corresponds to the Wheel of Fortune. Themes associated with the Wheel of Fortune include change of fate, luck, expansion, destiny, positive karma, and the beginning or end of a cycle. This new moon encourages you to remain curious and open-minded to new chance encounters, invitations, and unexpected opportunities. As you set your intention for this new moon, consider how you can reconnect to your sense of purpose and spirituality so you can plan your path forward. 1255

heading: Aries (March 21st - April 19th) & Aries Rising - New moon in the 10th House
body: The Capricorn new moon illuminates the path of your career and public recognition, activating the energies of the 10th house. Your career is the main focus for you now, as you delve deeper into understanding yourself and your strengths. You may find yourself questioning whether all aspects of yourself are being honored and acknowledged in your current work. This introspection may lead you to explore new career paths that align with your true self and passions. This is an opportunity to assess if your current career path aligns with your values and goals and make changes accordingly. Embrace the journey and let the light of this new moon guide you toward a fulfilling and meaningful career. This Capricorn new moon and the energy of the Capricorn season may be pushing you to confront some difficult areas, particularly in your career and how you take responsibility for your life. Changes in status, responsibility, or direction may arise, even if they are unclear at the moment, but ultimately they are meant to help you grow. Your ability to feel secure and confident in your work will determine the outcome. To navigate this time, it's important to avoid scattered thinking and take a step back to focus on the long-range details. Make sure that whatever you put your energy into aligns with your values and is building toward your future. Use this time to figure out which direction you want to head in with your career and move forward. Consider setting intentions to commit to your career and support your professional growth. Seek support from podcasts, and books, or find a mentor to empower you to expand and step more into a public role. Get clear on your desires and what you need to do to take responsibility for making them a reality. This is an opportunity to take a step towards a new level of maturity and responsibility. Additionally, parents may be asking more of you in a time of need, remember where you came from and use that as a guidepost. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil/Capricorn speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. This card often symbolizes struggles with a moral dilemma- a choice between what feels good in the moment and what is truly right for you. It may also suggest that you feel overwhelmed by an internal struggle as you may not have clearly defined your values or beliefs and have adopted those of others that are leading you away from fulfillment. This is a time to set the intention to align your career with your core values and interests. Take the time to reflect on what truly matters to you and what you are passionate about. Identify the values that guide your decisions and make sure that your career choices align with them. This will help you to make choices that are in line with your true self, rather than feeling trapped by the expectations of others. 1257

heading: Pisces (Feb 19th - March 20th) & Pisces Rising - New moon in the 11th House
body: The new moon in Capricorn brings the spotlight to your friendships, activating the energies of the 11th house. This is a powerful time for connecting with others, building community, and networking. Opportunities for building new friendships, expanding your community, and finding support from others may present themselves now. By actively engaging with your community and seeing where your gifts and talents can be offered, you can take advantage of this energy to boost your career and success. It's important to stay focused on what is working in your projects and relationships and to address any issues that may not be working. During the previous month (Scorpio season and new moon highlighting your 10th house), you may have been facing challenges in your work and career. If you've been feeling like your dreams and goals aren't coming to fruition, it's time to take a step back and review your strategy or consider changing course. You may also be seeing progress in projects that you have been working on and manifesting them into reality. Friendships and social connections may also be shifting, and you may find yourself working with groups that are new and different for you. These changes may require you to adapt and adapt to new communities or locations, or you may realize that the current community and friends you're with are not aligned with your values. These changes are all a part of the process, and they help you explore new sides of yourself, and expose you to new ideas and visions. This season, take a moment to reflect on the kind of company and community you want to surround yourself with. Who aligns with your values and goals? Who are the people you want to have in your life and support you in your journey? Asking these questions will help you make conscious choices about the people and groups you want to be a part of, and ultimately, can help you advance your career and achieve success. 1259

heading: Aquarius (Jan 20th - Feb 18th) & Aquarius Rising - New moon in the 12th House
body: The Capricorn new moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. This energy is focused on exploring your internal landscape and expressing it through creative means. You may be feeling a sense of loss or uncertainty, but this is a time to tap into your spirituality and intuition for guidance. Use this time to connect with your spiritual and artistic side, let yourself dream and meditate, and be open to inspiration. It is important to be mindful of the fact that not everything may be clear or as it seems during this time. This new moon is a reminder to focus on your inner journey and the power of your subconscious. You may be receiving messages from past lives or ancestral lineage, and it may be a time for healing and clearing trauma. It is important to allow yourself to feel and process any emotions that come up and turn to your spiritual practices for support. Take time for self-care and regeneration, and trust in the process of endings and new beginnings. Trust in your purpose and hold it in your heart, regardless of the challenges you may be facing. Remember that everything is temporary and will pass and that this new moon is illuminating your 12th house of rest and reflection, encouraging you to take some time for yourself and recharge. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces and is associated with the planetary energies of Neptune (modern ruler) and Jupiter (ancient ruler). Neptune, also known as The Hanged Man, represents enlightenment, intuition, stillness, and meditation. This new moon may bring a sense of closure to a certain chapter in your life and force you to reflect on your past actions and experiences. It may also bring a moment of insight or inspiration, but it's important to let go of any expectations or attachments to the outcome. Jupiter, also known as The Wheel of Fortune, represents change, luck, and the beginning or end of a cycle. This new moon may bring unexpected opportunities or shifts in your life. It's important to take care of your health and well-being during this time and to make time for rest and restoration. Trust in the process and allow yourself to be guided by the wisdom of the universe. Your new moon's intention is to let go of expectations and to trust in the natural cycle of endings and beginnings. Allow your faith, trust, and creative expression to nurture you and guide you through this transition. 1261

heading: Capricorn New Moon Ritual
body: Fig 75. Top view of an altar to Saturn & Capricorn [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Saturn and your ritual candle(s) for Saturn on the placement for Saturn. Place the World and The Devil tarot card on your altar, as well as an offering to Saturn. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration elm and black tourmaline) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – Petition Saturn for discipline, structure, to bind yourself to a commitment, to keep a promise, focus/discipline/study, to stop gossip, to bind or restrict another person/or situation from harming you or a loved one. Time is precious, fleeting, and finite. It's the one resource you can't manufacture more of or store up for later - it's just here, now, and then gone. So how do you use whatever time you have in this life? You can ask Saturn, the planet of time, to grant you the gift of time. You can seek his help in giving you longevity or extra moments to do something meaningful. Saturn blesses you with the 1264 opportunity to use your time wisely and turn each moment into something meaningful. So, if you're running out of time, why not ask Saturn for more? Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. 1265 Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. 1266 Capricorn New Moon Meditation During this Capricorn new moon meditation we are going to explore an area of your life where you may be feeling, doubt, stuck or limited, or maybe there’s fears coming up around success or failure, or a fear of change or increased responsibility. Or maybe an experience of loss or abandonment, or another area of frustration in your life right now. In this meditation I’ll help you create a place of resource, or stability, and then help you locate your chosen issue in and around your body. We’ll see what sensations arise, what it has to share with you if anything, and what it needs to feel safe. At any point you can come back to your place of resource and if you’d like, you can bring that bit of resource and a sense of stability into your wounded place. Find a comfortable place to sit or lie down. Notice your breath, without trying to change it. Just notice. Is your breath shallow or deep. Are you breathing into your chest or your belly? Allow it to just be the way it is for the next few breaths. Now, if it feels comfortable, slow the breath down just a bit from your normal rhythm and begin breathing through your nose if you aren’t already. Inhaling in on 2 counts, exhaling out on 2 counts. Now if it feels comfortable, Inhale on 2 counts and exhale on 4 counts. Allowing the breath to find a new rhythm. I invite you to do this for 3 breaths. Inhaling on 2 counts, and exhaling on 4 counts. Now notice the weight of your body on whatever surface you’re on. Feel gravity pulling you down to earth. Notice if you’re holding any tension in your forehead or behind your eyes. Notice if there’s tension in your jaw, neck or shoulders. Allow the muscles to relax and breath into any areas of tension. If it feels helpful you can move your jaw or shoulders to release the tension. Now bring your awareness to you arms, elbows and hands and fingertips. Releasing any noticeable tension here. Bring your awareness to chest, back and torso. Breathing into any places that feel tight. Bring your awareness to your belly, lower back, and hips. Release any tension here, breathing into stuck places. Bring your awareness to your thighs and knees. Allow any tension her to melt away. Bring your awareness to your shins, feet and toes. Breathing into any places of tightness. Now bring your awareness and your breath to your heart center. Imagine golden light, and feelings of warmth, joy, and safely expanding in your heart center as you breath. You can think of place, person, animal or thing, that bring you a sense of comfort and safety to help with this. Extend this light and feelings of warmth to fill your entire body. Imagine this light now extending out to encompass and surround your body. Imagine this light expanding out to fill all corners of the room. This is your space of safety as we move through the journey together. To the best of your ability, cultivate a feeling of stability, confidence and joy. Allow yourself to sit in this space for a few breaths. Now from this empowered place, think of the issue that you’re feeling challenged with. See if you can create some space between yourself and the issue so that you can become a witness. Now if this issue had a place in or around your body, where would it be. (Notice where it shows up in or around your body.) Spend some time locating it. Notice places of tension or discomfort where you might be holding it. Meet his place with compassion and non-judgement. You can take a breath in to soften the tension. Now notice what sensations, colors, textures, images, or anything else that arises when you focus on this area. Ask this area if there’s anything it needs to release to help it feel lighter, more relaxed, less burdened, and invite it to release it if it feels safe and comfortable for you. If there’s resistance to release, just sit with this place, this part of you, maybe breathing into it if it’s comfortable, continuing to hold it in a space of compassion and non-judgement. And see if just by doing that, anything shifts or changes. 1267 Next, ask this area what it needs to feel healed, supported, safe, relaxed, empowered or anything else that would bring it closer to healing. Listen patiently for the answer. From your place of stability, confidence and joy, offer this part of you exactly what it asked for. It doesn’t need to come from you. It can come from the unlimited abundance of Universal Energy. Allow this part of you to absorb and receive what it needs. Give it some time to soak in this new quality of energy. And if it feels safe and comfortable, begin allowing yourself to receive this energy as well. Seeping into all the cells for your body. Washing over you like a soft warm breeze or gentle waterfall. Imagine all the limitless possibilities and versions of yourself. Choose the version of yourself and the quality of life that feels most nourishing and empowering and begin bringing that into your body and present moment. Imagine you’re tuning your own frequency to the frequency of Love, Health, Ease, and Abundance and allow those qualities in as well. heading: Exploring Capricorn Season And New Moon Through Journaling
body: Capricorn is the sign of discipline and structure, representing our ability to set goals and work towards achieving them. During Capricorn season or a Capricorn new moon, the universe may bring up issues related to your career and professional goals. You can use tarot as a way to inspire journaling. Select a spread or layout that resonates with your current focus or intention. Shuffle the deck and draw a card, then reflect on its meaning and symbolism. Use the card as a starting point for your journaling and allow its imagery and message to inspire your thoughts and feelings. Explore the card's themes and messages in greater depth and consider how they relate to your experiences and challenges. Reflect on how the card may offer guidance or insights for your current situation and how you can integrate its message into your life. Light a white candle and create a grounded atmosphere by using earthy scents and calming music. Visualize yourself focusing on your career and professional goals, and drawing strength from your dedication and discipline. Take this opportunity to reflect on your career and how you can work towards achieving your goals. Open your journal and begin writing about your career and professional goals. You may also want to consider any challenges or obstacles you have faced in your journey towards success, and brainstorm ways to overcome them. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you explore these themes. By taking some time to journal, you can gain a deeper understanding of your aspirations and how to work towards achieving them. Here are some prompts to get you started: Reflecting on Career Goals and Values: Take some time to consider what you want to achieve in your career and how you can align your values with your professional path. Write about your long-term career goals and how you are working towards achieving them. Explore any challenges or obstacles you have faced in your career, and brainstorm ways to overcome them. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you explore these themes. Prioritizing Your Values and Defining Success: What do you value in your career and how do you prioritize those values? How do you define success in your career and what steps are you taking to achieve it? Reflect on your personal definitions of success and how you can use your values to guide you towards your professional goals. Overcoming Setbacks and Staying Motivated: How do you handle stress or pressure in your career? What strategies have been effective for you in the past? How do you handle rejection or failure in your career? What strategies have you found helpful in overcoming these setbacks? How do you stay motivated and focused on your career goals, and what techniques do you use to stay on track? Are there any areas of your career where you feel stuck or unfulfilled? How can you make changes to overcome these challenges and move forward? Explore these themes and consider ways you can stay resilient and motivated as you work towards your professional goals. Balancing Work and Personal Life: How do you balance your work and personal life, and what strategies have you found helpful in achieving this balance? Reflect on your work-life balance and consider ways you can create a healthy balance between your professional and personal commitments. 1269 Sun in Capricorn (Devil) / 10th House Full Moon in Cancer (The Chariot) / 4th House

heading: Exploring the Capricorn/Cancer Polar Axis
body: Each zodiac season highlights season and full moon polarities. Capricorn / Cancer axis always gives you more of a push in a structured way than the others. As we enter the realm of Capricorn, the lord of time and structure, we are reminded of the importance of measuring and observing the passage of time. This is a season of reflection and assessment, where we take stock of our accomplishments and the progress we've made in our home, family, and career. It may be a time of challenge, as we confront areas where we feel we have not yet succeeded. But remember, dear one, that progress and growth are not always linear. Give yourself time, patience and grace as you reflect on your goals and realign your focus and efforts. As we enter Capricorn season, we are reminded of the importance of structure and responsibility in our lives. Ruled by the wise and disciplined Saturn, this is a time to take stock of our accomplishments and set new goals for the future. We are called to take charge of our own happiness and comfort, and to parent ourselves in a loving and nurturing way. At the same time, we must also learn to be vulnerable and open to receiving support from others. This is a time to find balance between self-sufficiency and interdependence, and to embrace the blessings that come from both. The Capricorn-Cancer polarity teaches you an important lesson - self-care needs no excuses. No more blaming others for not giving you the comfort, joy, and nurturance you require. No more forcing a situation to make others responsible. Take responsibility for creating your own happiness and don't forget that credit goes both ways - nurture yourself and nurture those who nurture you. 1270 Cancer Full Moon A full moon is a time of great power and potential, where the divine energy that flows through us all is amplified. It's a time to celebrate your goals and release anything that stands in your way of achieving them. It's also a time to gather with family and friends, share stories, process symbols, and connect with nature. The full moon is an invitation to move into a space of stillness, where you can take a moment to listen to your intuition and inner wisdom, process symbols, and connect with the divine. As the winter solstice approaches and the days begin to shorten, the Cancer full moon reminds us to find comfort in the stillness and darkness. It is a time to nurture and nourish our emotional selves, to reflect on the seeds we planted during the new moon cycle and them with the same care and attention you would give to a delicate plant in the dead of winter. The Cancer-Capricorn polarity reminds us that consistency is key in our personal growth and emotional development. It's not about stagnation, but rather creating a foundation of stability and security that allows us to weather the storms of change and uncertainty. Embrace this time to create boundaries and routines that will nourish and support you on your journey of self-discovery and growth. As the Cancer Full Moon illuminates the sky, let us turn our attention inward to the inner landscape of our hearts and emotions. In times of tumultuous change, it is all too easy to push ourselves too hard and neglect our own needs in the pursuit of serving others or chasing our dreams. But, it is essential that we recognize the importance of emotional stability and support, both for ourselves and for those around us. Take a moment to reflect on the things that bring you peace and a sense of security. What nourishes your soul and helps you to feel grounded? Perhaps it is spending time in nature, connecting with loved ones, or practicing self-care. Whatever it may be, dear ones, do not be afraid to put your own needs first. It is not selfish to take care of yourself, for when we are well, we are better able to serve and love those around us. The Cancer full moon reminds us of the deep well of intuition and emotions that we all possess. This is a powerful time for letting go and releasing old patterns, as well as the emotions we have been carrying within our bodies. The universe is inviting us to release these things and make space for new beginnings as we move deeper into the new year. Allow yourself to fully feel and process any emotions that arise, trust that they are guiding you towards a more authentic and true version of yourself. As the Cancer Full Moon reminds us of the importance of home and family, let us also remember that our body and inner world is our first and true home. Let us make space for ourselves, to pause, to reflect, and to nurture our souls. Embrace the power of self-care and remember, it is okay to say no. Sometimes, saying no to others is saying yes to yourself. Cancer, the nurturer of the zodiac, represents the mother, home, and the emotional foundation of our family life. It reminds us of the early childhood conditioning that shapes our understanding of give and take in our relationships. But, it is important to remember that Cancer energy can also manifest as co-dependency, oversensitivity, blame, and a victim mentality when it is out of balance. As we strive to find balance, let us call upon the ultimate mother figure within us, giving care and nurturance to others while also maintaining healthy boundaries and self-care. 1271 Caring for ourselves is not a luxury but a necessity. When you care for yourself, showing up for others meaningfully is easier. As we honor our own needs, we become better equipped to support and love those around us. This full moon asks you, are you ready to explore the hidden corners of your past and discover the secrets of your ancestral karma? To unearth the true meaning of home, in all its forms. The Cancer Full Moon is guiding us towards self-discovery and reflection. Take some time to delve into your past and current lives, to reconnect with your family and friends, to honor your culture and ancestral roots. Allow yourself to feel into what feels like home on the deepest level - the soul level. Create a safe inner space where you can feel held with love and comfort. As you bask in this feeling of home, comfort and security, you'll find that it recharges your energy and fills you up with its warmth. This is the time to tap into the deep connection to source that resides within each one of us. The eternal source that we all return to after our physical body expires. As you honor your past, you open the door to a deeper understanding of yourself and your place in the world. Let the Cancer Full Moon be your guide as you journey towards self-discovery and the true feeling of home. Feel into what feels like home in the deepest part of your being - the soul level. Create a safe inner space where you can feel held with love from within. Bask in this feeling of home - comfort, and security - as it recharges your energy and fills you up with its warmth. Feel the deep connection to Source that resides within each one of us – this eternal source that you return to after your physical body expires. The Cancer full moon is urging you to reconnect with your home: Home is not only a physical space or a place where love can be found. Home is your physical body and its connection to your emotional world, the place where your soul is birthed. Home is also your family lineage, the place from which you come. Remember that home is not only a physical place but it is also a feeling, a sense of security, and a connection to something greater than ourselves. And home is ultimately where you return to when your spirit departs from this world. This full moon brings about a powerful reminder that you cannot forget these multiple facets of what you call home. This full moon brings about a powerful reminder that you cannot forget these multiple facets of what you call home. Cancer reminds you to have a dialogue with yourself, to listen to your needs, and to take responsibility for your emotions. It's a balance between giving to yourself and giving to others. Cancer reminds you to continually check in with yourselves and explore how you are experiencing your needs and feelings. The Sun in Capricorn can help you to find a balance between nurturing yourself and nurturing your loved ones. When you are feeling negative emotions, it can be useful to ask: which of my needs are not being met? Are you inviting others to take responsibility for meeting your needs and feelings? Or are you taking too much responsibility for meeting others' needs and emotions? By exploring these questions, you can discover what steps need to be taken to create a healthy balance between self-care and care for those around you. This exploration of Cancer is also dancing with the polarity of the Sun in Capricorn, strong, stable earth energy that leads you into maturation through tests of responsibility, limitation, and resistance. Capricorn is also connected to your past through karmic lessons you need to experience to grow. In the Capricorn/Cancer polarity, you learn to parent yourself and take responsibility for creating comfort, happiness, and nurturance without blaming others for not giving you what you need. At the same time, you are also learning to open up, be vulnerable, and practice receiving the 1272 support that others are offering. You can't place blame on others if you aren't willing to acknowledge and accept the love they are trying to give. To achieve fulfillment and growth, you must learn to parent yourself, take responsibility for your comfort and happiness, and be open to receiving help and support from others. These lessons are like tests of responsibility, limitation, and resistance that help you mature. They also bring us closer to understanding your karmic pasts, how it informs the present moment, and how to use those lessons to elevate. The Cancer/Capricorn polarity teaches you an important lesson - self-care needs no excuses. No more blaming others for not giving you the comfort, joy, and nurturance you require. No more forcing a situation to make others responsible for your happiness. Take responsibility for creating your own happiness and don't forget that credit goes both ways - nurture yourself and nurture those who nurture you. This Full Moon brings the promise of stability into your life, but it also brings with it a powerful reminder to draw boundaries to protect yourself. This Full Moon reminds us of your karmic challenges around success, family, and home, so be mindful of these challenges in your relationships. Codependence can often be a theme that surfaces when the full moon is in a water sign. Water signs create thin, fluid, or sometimes non-existent boundaries - but this Full Moon is focused on helping you find grounding and stability in your life. It might mean recognizing which people and situations have been emotionally draining you and not making you feel nourished on the deepest levels. It could lead to major shifts in your relationships and a chance to renegotiate your intimate or work ties. If you've been working hard towards aligning yourself with your true path, this full moon will likely bring about important changes in your life that will ultimately fill you with great stability. As the stars align, have you ever felt as though you were wandering aimlessly, spinning your wheels without making any real progress? Those of you on your pre-destined path, know the feeling of fulfillment and stability that comes with doing work aligned with your truth. But, what happens when we stray from our path? When we find ourselves meandering off course, we may struggle to find solid ground beneath us. We may feel unsure of which way to turn, stuck and unable to move forward. Unfortunately, the energy of Saturn in Capricorn can be harsh in its delivery of lessons, guiding us back to alignment with our intended path. It is an energy of discipline and structure that helps us to focus on making mature decisions in our choices and gives us the stability we need for successful forward movement. So, if you have been straying from your divinely guided path, accept the lessons this energy provides you. It may seem challenging at first, but it will set you up for success in the long run. Trust in the universe and let the wisdom of the stars guide you back to your intended path, towards stability and fulfillment. This Cancer full moon is a reminder that your family dynamics, both past, and present, are in play. It's time to closely examine the early childhood conditioning influencing your current relationships. Familiarise yourself with attachment styles to gain insights into how you relate to others and the best way to care for yourself. As you navigate any challenges, keep returning to forgiveness - for yourself and others. Forgiveness and compassion is the signature of this Cancer full moon. Keep coming back to this as you move through any challenges. The Winter Solstice is a time of honoring the darkness and shadow within and without. You keep all your ancestors' struggles that brought you to this moment. As you reflect on the year that's 1273 passed, celebrate your successes, and find forgiveness for yourself and others. This may be a time of growing pains and significant change, but you can always choose to keep your heart open with love and compassion, bringing a little lightheartedness into every situation. Let's take this solstice to pause, reflect, and look ahead with optimism. 1274

heading: Cancer full moon actions & intentions
body: The Cancer Full Moon is a beautiful reminder to reconnect with your emotions and innermost desires. It is a time of healing, self-reflection, and creative exploration, allowing you to access the depths of your subconscious and emotional body, and discover what lies within. As you tap into this emotional energy, you can uncover unresolved emotions and emotional blockages holding you back from committing to relationships; business, personal and intimate relationships. Plus, with its energy, you can tap into your creativity and explore new ways of processing these emotions through art and music. Create an altar – During the Cancer full moon, it is a good time to create a sacred space for Luna the planetary ruler of Cancer. To create an altar, you can gather items that have personal meaning or significance to you. You might also collect items that symbolize Luna and Cancer. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Be mindful – Observing your thoughts, experiences, and observations in a journal can be a powerful way to gain insights into your own inner landscape. You might also consider using tarot cards or other divination tools to help you explore your inner world. Collecting items – pen, paper, tarot cards, candles, incense, and herbs can be a way to create a sense of ritual and intention as you work through your full moon intentions. You might also consider incorporating other elements, like crystals or sound healing tools, into your altar. Reflect on where you were six months ago – What you were manifesting and striving for Take stock of your progress and make any necessary adjustments. Trust your gut – Trusting your gut instincts and listening to your body's needs means paying attention to your inner wisdom and taking care of yourself physically and emotionally. This may involve setting aside time for self-care, listening to your body's cues for rest and nourishment, and following your instincts even when it feels uncomfortable. Process your emotions – Find a healthy balance between your emotions and your thoughts. Allowing yourself to feel and process your emotions in a healthy way, rather than suppressing them or letting them control you. This may involve seeking support from friends, loved ones, or a therapist, and finding healthy outlets for your emotions like exercise or creative expression. Take a moment to listen to your body and emotions. Pay attention to what is holding you back and where you feel most at home. Nurture family relationships – During this time of the Cancer full moon, focus on nurturing your family relationships and creating lasting memories. Remember that family relationships are built on love and care, so make time for the people who matter most to you. Be your own parent – With intention, practice self-love and nurture yourself as if you were your own parent. Take care of your physical and emotional needs and create a safe and supportive space for yourself. 1275 Creating a safe and nurturing home environment – Create a space where you feel physically and emotionally secure and supported. This can involve decluttering and organizing your physical space, setting boundaries with others, and making sure you have access to the resources and support you need. Fill your cup –Take the time to submerge yourself in compassion and emotional awareness. This can involve activities like self-care, therapy, or simply finding ways to connect with your emotions and those of others.

heading: Cancer full moon horoscopes & tarotscopes
body: Luna is the planetary ruler of Cancer, and this Cancer full moon may feel more significantly emotional. The Cancer full moon usually occurs around the turn of the year, either a few weeks before or after (Gregorian calendar), bringing a healthy dose of nurturing energy, a sense of comfort, and reflection. This full moon signals a time to recognize your emotional patterns and rhythms and find ways to harmonize with them. In all of her phases, Luna is a reminder that life is a natural pattern of cycles. This full moon is an opportunity to heal old wounds and reset your perspective. It's giving you the strength and insight you need to make the necessary shifts in your life so you can come into alignment with your most authentic self. This full moon calls upon you to take a deeper look at yourself and accept exactly where you are on your journey; assess your emotional landscape and see what sort of home you need to build to create the space you can best mature into and thrive. After a year filled with uncertainty and possibly some turmoil, it's essential to take this moment to connect with your inner world and home and reconnect with your inner peace. Use this Cancer full moon to release any tension in your home life. Make your house a place of refuge. A place where you can be supported and celebrated for who you are and where you can celebrate your loved ones and the unique contributions they make to your career and life. Full moons highlight polarities; with the full moon in Cancer opposing the sun in Capricorn, you are now experiencing the polarity of the axis of foundation, security, and external and internal structures that support your development. Cancer is the emotional foundation, while Capricorn is the outer structure. Both seek security. With the focus on these two natural oppositions, you are being asked to reflect on your emotional needs, relationships, and your ability to connect with others. How your home life and personal relationships support or undermine your career, material or practical goals, and overall if you are being emotionally fulfilled or drained by either. The Sun in Capricorn opposing the Moon in Cancer can create tension between your career goals and emotional needs. It's important to find a balance between the two so that you can maintain a healthy work-life balance. You don't want your home life and emotional needs to get neglected in favor of your career. You don't want to sabotage your career by leaving your emotional needs unchecked and potentially feeling burnt out or melting down. Cancer is a water sign ruled by the moon. This full moon could be a more emotionally sensitive time when you're highly attuned to everything around you. This can make you feel vulnerable and reactive to situations, so you must be aware of your feelings and how they impact your actions. Cancer's essence is nurturing, caring for, protecting, and supporting others. Cancer is ruled by the watery element of emotions. Everyone has emotions, but sometimes they overrule them with logic or thought. Emotions are powerful forces that can change your life. When you let your emotions guide you with compassion and understanding rather than judgment, they can lead you to people and places that can feel like home. They can guide you when you feel what your feelings are honestly telling you. This full moon is a time of reflection. You might feel nostalgic for a time in your life when you experienced nurturing love or other powerful feelings of belonging. You may also reflect on intense emotional attachments to important figures in your life who are now absent or have passed away. Or you can feel nostalgia for where you spent significant time during childhood. This full 1277 moon is a chance to reflect and take stock of your life, what you've learned, and what you want to keep or change to reach more emotional fulfillment and take steps to find closure where needed. You can use your horoscope as a guide to what area of your life is being illuminated and use that as a guide for your full moon ritual. If you are unfamiliar with the twelve houses and what it means to have your 1st or 2nd house illuminated by the new or full moon, read foundation two for the fundamentals.

heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Cancer full moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes. I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Begin by finding the Sun (Sun), The Devil (Capricorn), High Priestess (Moon), and then The Chariot (Cancer). Second, select the tarot cars from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Capricorn Season, the sun is in Capricorn (The Devil), opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Cancer (The Chariot). For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the full moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 7th position, select either a card representing your sun sign or a card from the second pile containing the court cards and the Minor Arcana. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. 1278 Tarotscope Key 2. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the sun is in 4. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in 6. The tarot card the corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house 7. The tarot card the corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign Ex: The Devil (Capricorn), during Capricorn season Ex: The Chariot (Cancer), during Cancer full moon Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries 1. The Sun (Sun) 3. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated or a supporting card, from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house 1279

heading: Cancer (June 21 – July 22nd) & Cancer Rising, Full moon in the 1st House
body: The Cancer full moon shines alight upon you, illuminating your 1st House of Self. This is a time to celebrate. Celebrate who you are and all that you can become. Embrace your growth, your courage, and your strength. See yourself in a new light, and marvel at your beauty, within and without. You are naturally highly empathetic — both interpersonal empathy, which involves understanding how another person feels, and emotional empathy, which consists in understanding how another person's feelings influence their behavior. Both are important, but if you aren't taking care of yourself—by regularly checking in with yourself on a physical level (e.g., via self-care practices), it can be harder to be emotionally present for those around you, especially if you're in a significant partnership. Taking the time to check in with yourself on a physical level can help you stay balanced and connected, so you can keep showing up for those you love in the best way possible. This full moon brings significant changes for your Cancer. Particularly in the relationship and home realm with the Cancer full moon in your 1st house. You might be committing more deeply to a partnership, moving in together, or working through parent/family dynamics. You, more than most, can end up in codependent relationships. You're learning to take on more responsibility than you're used to and navigating the needs of others while honoring your need for support and connection. Now's the time to review and come back to yourself if necessary. 1280

heading: Gemini (May 20th - June 20th) & Gemini Rising, Full moon in the 2nd House
body: The Cancer full moon illuminates your 2nd house of disposable income and foundation. This full moon is the perfect opportunity to reflect on what you value and what brings you joy. The full moon in the second house is a reminder to take stock of your financial decisions. It's an opportunity to look back on the choices you've made and to reflect on how fear-based or scarcity-driven thinking may have influenced them. By exploring your feelings about money, we can ensure that you make decisions from a place of abundance instead of scarcity. There's still time to make positive changes to create a secure financial future and ensure you don't let fear dictate your financial decisions. This full moon is the perfect time to look inward. This a reminder to reflect on what makes you feel secure. What brings you feelings of stability? During this full moon, you may realize that you've been resistant to building stability in your life. You may be holding traumatic experiences in your subconscious. Whether things that happened to you in the recent past or unresolved emotions, these unresolved energies can make it difficult for you to feel safe. As a result, you could be stuck in fight-or-flight mode, which prevents you from relaxing into a stable environment, and unable to receive the consistent stream of abundance you deserve. You can move on if you give yourself the time and space to process these complicated feelings. Money is more than just a physical exchange for your efforts - it's a representation of your worth, too. If you want to be successful, whether it means achieving your goals or creating a healthy, fulfilling life, you have to believe that you are worth it. It's time to start internalizing that you are worthy of financial and emotional stability and that success is achievable. And if you're having trouble believing in yourself, don't be afraid to ask for a mentor who can help guide you. The second house corresponds to The Hierophant in major arcana. The Hierophant teaches that there is more than just the material world; there is a divine ruler. As the High Priestess taught the Fool to discover spiritual wisdom from within, the Hierophant teaches the Fool to find spiritual wisdom from external sources: Spiritual leaders, mentors, ancestors, and community. The Hierophant's links to religion, knowledge, and traditions passed down through oral teachings parallel the "fixed" teachings that comprise our social and religious framework. The Hierophant teaches you to return to tradition; you may have expanded your horizons past your comfort zone, and now it's time to return to the familiar to re-frame your focus. Venus is the planetary ruler of the 2nd house, which corresponds to The Empress in the Major Arcana. During this full moon, you would benefit from the guidance of a financial planner, estate lawyer, or therapist. It's also possible your mother could play a significant role (alive or in memory) during this Cancer full moon. 1282

heading: Taurus (April 19th - May 20th) & Taurus Rising, Full moon in the 3rd House
body: The Gemini full moon illuminates your 3rd house of communication. Communication, studies, travel, and networking have been your main focus this full moon. Words have power. They have the power to shape and influence the world around you. Notice if the words you use to communicate your authentic self or if you have been stifling it to fit the status quo or stay small. Find your words. Your words can be powerful instruments of self-expression. Get creative and explore different ways of communication - writing, singing, public speaking - and discover the unique voice within you. Don't let anyone silence you, especially don't silence yourself. The 3rd house corresponds to The Lovers in the major arcana. The Lovers represent the union of duality, in this case, the union and marriage of verbal and nonverbal communication. Words can only get you so far. Sometimes, they just aren't enough. It's not just about the words you use but also your body language. Verbal communication is an important tool, and nonverbal communication can carry just as much weight. Think about your body language, facial expressions, and gestures when talking to someone. It all adds up to create a unique message that speaks volumes. You might reflect more on improving your non-verbal communication skills during this full moon. Improving and avoiding disengaged body language, avoiding eye contact, multitasking, allowing your computer, television, phone, game or book, etc., to get between you and the other person speaking. Your emotions are an essential part of your story. From sadness to joy, anger to gratitude, your feelings are the most potent form of communication. Emotional intelligence is the key to understanding yourself and empathizing with others. It's not just about recognizing and managing emotions; it's also about learning how to express your feelings healthily and positively. The full moon shines brightly, asking you to develop your emotional intelligence. Which requires practice and perseverance but, when mastered, can help you live a more meaningful, honest, and fulfilling life. The full moon in the 3rd house and The Lovers teaches lessons about communication. Ask yourself if you have expressed what you need to say to others, your partner, and even yourself. Does everyone have the necessary information to make honest choices for their emotional well-being, or are you holding back? Look within to determine whether you live in a state of self-love and acceptance. 1284

heading: Aries (March 21st - April 19th) & Aries Rising, Full moon in the 4th House
body: The Cancer full moon highlights your 4th house and brings awareness of home, family, and security. The 4th house is a Karmic house and brings family situations to the surface for deeper understanding to learn and then release. Home, family, work, and emotional support are the main focuses for you now, Aries, with the Cancer full moon in your 4th house. Success is important to you, but not at the expense of your home life and emotional stability. Life has a way of catching up to you. If you've been too busy tending to the outside world, now is the time to focus on your inner world. As your emotions resurface and demand attention, don't despair - this is a sign that it's time to start the healing process. The full moon in Cancer is a gentle reminder that home and family connections are essential for your emotional well-being. During this time, you can hang out with friends and family who listen without judgment, visit places that evoke positive memories from your past, and take time to reflect on the significant people in your life. Reconnecting with your roots - your family, friends, and the places that feel at home. Take this time for self-reflection and to appreciate the people and places that have left a lasting impression on your life. Appreciate their presence, their impact, and the love that remains even after they are gone. Take this moment to honor your loved ones and be intentional about creating meaningful connections with those still alive. Under this full moon, reflect on everything that brings togetherness. Your family roots shared experiences, and love for each other. The full moon is also a time of celebration, and you may be celebrating the birth of a newborn to your family or a job promotion. The full moon in Cancer signals a time to care for your emotional and career needs. It's not enough to be 'strong' or 'resilient' — you need healthy, nourishing relationships with the people around you. You need to feel safe and secure and trust yourself and others. You need to know that you will be taken care of when you need help and that others will be there for you. And above all, you need to feel loved and supported by those you count as close friends, family, and colleagues. If these things are missing in your life, you are likely feeling emotionally disconnected and burnt out. Use this full moon to release any tension with your home life, and bring yourself into balance and emotional fulfillment. The full moon in Cancer is a time to declutter your home; whether its emotionally charged items or a toxic dynamic in your family line, let go of anything that is no longer needed in order for you to feel relaxed and free. It’s time to take an honest look at what’s cluttering up your life and taking up valuable headspace. From physical items that have outstayed their welcome in your house to emotional baggage holding you back from living in the present. Declutter your home and let go of any charge or emotion attached to your family legacy. Tap into the liberating power of going through what needs to be released and make space for something new to come in. Just remember: you are not your home; you are not your body; you are not your possessions; you are not your jobs or status; you are not your relationships or circumstances. You are just you — pure consciousness — showing up here through all these layers of experience. 1286
