heading: Pisces (Feb 19th - March 20th) & Pisces Rising, Full moon in the 5th House
body: “What drains your spirit drains your body. What fuels your spirit fuels your body.” - Carolyn Myss Intimacy, romance, children, and creativity are themes for this Cancer full moon in your 5th house. Intimacy is part of your human nature. From birth, you're wired to crave connection and closeness with those around you. That's why it's so important to nurture your relationships and create moments of intimacy and togetherness. Our connection to each other is so powerful, even from the earliest stages of life. That's why volunteer cuddlers are such an important part of hospitals - they provide the love and care that helps babies in need grow and thrive. A hug is the intentional physical application of energetic connection, an endless cycle of interconnectedness. And yet, as adults, we forget the power of a hug, instead relying on superficial norms to guide our interactions. When was the last time you felt the warmth of a hug or the comfort of a hand on your shoulder? Are you missing the experience of touch? Are you spending most of the day alone or with limited interaction with others? You may have grown accustomed to following society's rules and put your need for physical contact and comfort last. During this full moon, begin reintroducing daily interactions and touch back into your everyday routine. Try to organize your daily life so that you receive human connection every day without having to purposely reach out for it. Because when you feel insecure about reaching out, it's usually the time when you need human connection the most. This full moon in the fifth house can signal the start of a new creative endeavor that has been gestating for some time. The fifth house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the major arcana. The Strength card reminds you of a sacred power grounded in inner Strength and trust that comes from emotional mastery. Intense feelings about your own worth and value may cause temporary emotional conflict. No matter how intense your emotions are, you have the power to use them as fuel for your creative fire. Tap into that deeper part of yourself and uncover the strength, creativity, and joy that lies inside. Tap into your inner child and explore the hobbies and pastimes that used to bring you joy. Let these be the spark that ignites your creative passions and fills you with light, and let your inner child run wild. 1288

heading: Aquarius (Jan 20th - Feb 18th) & Aquarius Rising, Full moon in the 6th House
body: The Cancer full moon illuminates your 6th house of health and being of service. This is an excellent time to refine any daily habits, routines, or activities that harm your overall emotional well-being. With the Sun in Capricorn, symbolizing work, and the Full Moon in Cancer, asking you to focus on rest and restoration. Work and rest aren't synonymous, but you're learning to balance both now with the Cancer full moon in your 6th house. Your health, work, and daily routines may be getting changed as new information comes through to challenge and evolve stuck patterns. Flexibility is your best friend. You might find remote work opportunities, create your own retreats, or help others create theirs. You may connect more within your local community through work or a new health or exercise routine. Anything arising right now is to help you break through disharmony and find your way back to health and service. If you've been giving too much, now's the time to focus on yourself, restore your sleep schedule, and find a routine that is helpful. The 6th house corresponds to the Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit signals a time to take space and remove oneself from the outside world's noise, distractions, and opinions. The Hermit signals a time to re-evaluate any challenging situations, relationship dynamics, or personal goals that require focus and attention. To be the best version of yourself, you need to take the time to "fill your own cup." Stop and ask yourself what you truly need, then do it. The Hermit is willing to explore the shadows and bring what is hidden into the light. Her lessons bring you to wholeness and authenticity. If you're feeling depleted, try taking some quiet time for yourself. If you're feeling anxious, try taking a few minutes to do some deep breathing. Sometimes you need to take a mental health break. Whether it's to disconnect from work or to process your emotions, taking time for yourself can be essential. The Cancer full moon is an opportunity to shed light on the emotional challenges preventing your body from feeling at ease. It's a time of self-exploration and self-care. Look inward to try and understand how your body responds to the stress and strain of life, what emotional wounds you're carrying, and how these emotions may affect your health. If health issues arise, it's time to find ways to reduce your stress and locate your internal focal point. Finding an inner sense of stability and connection to something higher than yourself will help ease your nerves. As you begin to feel a pull toward repressed emotions, it's essential to take care of yourself physically and emotionally and ensure you have a robust support system. Creating a safe space for yourself can help you process your feelings and find some relief. If you're an introvert, this may be especially important for you. Daily practices will also help anchor yourself and provide stress relief and stability. If you're experiencing loss or grief, find friends, family, and professionals who can support you. Emotional healing doesn't always come easily, so if you're having trouble processing your feelings, don't hesitate to seek help. There are many self-help tools available that can help guide you in the right direction. 1290

body: Create your tarotscopes for this full moon. The Magician (Mercury) 1. The Sun (Sun) 3. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The Hermit (Virgo/6th house) 7. The Star (Aquarius) {or extra card} 1291 Capricorn (Dec. 22nd - Jan. 21st) & Capricorn Rising, Full moon in the 7th House The Cancer full moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. This full moon may illuminate the ways you perceive commitment and emotional vulnerability. With the Sun in Capricorn, the sign of dedication, and the full moon in nurturing Cancer, you may deepen your commitment and find healing ways to share yourself in a relationship. On the other hand, you might be ready to free yourself from the responsibilities of a relationship, to find yourself again, taking space or fully separating from a relationship. If you are single, a full moon in your seventh house could be the ideal time to start dating again. The Cancer full moon is a time to rest, recharge, and rejuvenate. You're motivated to connect with others in ways that support your emotional health and emotional well-being. Balancing your emotional needs with the emotional needs of others is in focus for you now. When you are healthy, happy, and balanced, you are more likely to be able to focus on others and not get pulled in too many directions. Plus, taking care of yourself allows you to be in touch with your emotions, empathize better and understand what those closest to you are feeling without words. People need one another and knowing that you are cared for and understood can be incredibly healing. This is especially true within the context of trauma, where one can struggle to feel connected or understood by others. Trauma can leave you feeling alone and disconnected and lead to symptoms like anxiety, depression, and PTSD. When you have people in your life who care about you and who you feel safe and secure with, it can be a powerful way to build resilience. It also helps you to feel seen and valued, which is essential for healing. The Cancer full moon in the seventh house is an excellent time to re-examine your relationship's current situation. A full moon represents a peak in emotions and a time when you are more likely to feel comfortable being open and honest with your partner. If issues in your relationship need to be addressed, now is an excellent time to start that conversation. One potentially negative aspect of the Cancer full moon in the seventh house is a possible increase in feelings of neediness or jealousy. Be careful not to let feelings of jealousy get out of hand. Libra rules the 7th house and corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice wants you to find clarity, emotional balance, and fairness in relationships. Sometimes it's easier to be more compassionate to those in your intimate relationship than yourself. You can lend a sounding ear to your partner but then judge and criticize yourself for feeling emotional. Feeling bad is complicated enough on its own. Trying to repress or suppress those feelings only makes things worse. Instead, try accepting your emotions. Give yourself the same emotional support you would give another. Don't try to change or suppress your emotions - just allow them to be and allow yourself to feel them. Free up space to let your feelings pass through you without holding on to them or judging yourself for their intensity. If you're feeling stuck, ask yourself where you might be avoiding or denying the truth in your emotions. Then, take some time to look inside and get to the root of these issues. You can do this with the support of your friends and family and with a bit of self-compassion. 1292

heading: Capricorn & Capricorn Rising Tarotscopes

heading: Sagittarius (Nov 22nd - Dec 21st) & Sagittarius Rising, Full moon in the 8th House
body: The Cancer full moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. The full moon in the eight house illuminates what others have given to support you (or didn't give support) and signals a time when you can give back to those who have helped you along your journey or let go of the baggage that was given that you no longer need to carry. Know that you are valuable and worthy of love and connection. Be careful with debt and money during this time, and ensure you're handling your finances well. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to the Death card in the Major Arcana. The Death card signals a possible time that you're in a situation where fear is holding you in an emotional deadlock. It's even more likely that you're engaging in avoidance tactics and feeling energetically drained. The underlying lesson of Death is that if you let go of the fear of loss or missed opportunities, you will see that change is inevitable. It is up to you to surrender — which feels like Death to the human ego — rather than waste time in denial, avoidance, or pining for lost opportunities. The 8th house also contains themes of occult studies, symbolism, and searching for the meaning behind signs and symbols. However, sometimes, searching for meaning in everything is a coping mechanism against the fear of uncertainty. It's human nature to dislike uncertainty. It's tempting to want everything to have an order and a purpose, but that's impossible. Life can be unpredictable, And uncertainty is an inevitable part of life. How you cope makes all the difference. Accepting smaller moments of uncertainty, you can learn to build your courage and inner strength to help you face it confidently when uncertainty arrives in big ways—as it will eventually. 1294

You might be taking your creative works, expanding past your local community, and reaching an international one now. The Cancer full moon in the 9th house chart guides you to see the higher truths and deeper meanings in all things. You may be very interested in deepening your understanding of the world around you and the universe beyond it. This can come from many different sources, such as books, lectures, art, music, travel, and even meditation. It may also include formal schooling or learning from other mentors, teachers, or from a significant relationship in your life. Wisdom can be learned in relationships, not only through books and traveling. Communicating your emotional needs clearly and listening to others' points of view and feelings during conversations are essential. Keep your heart and mind open to new perspectives, and new worlds open up. In any case, you will likely focus on finding the truth and meaning in how you feel, what you do, and how you live. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius, corresponding to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Sagittarius assists in the search for meaning, truth, and wisdom from the darkness. The angel depicted on the Temperance card is a metaphor for the divine kundalini energy, teaching that death is not the end but the transformation of energy. The greater spiritual meaning is learned through the teachings of reincarnation. The question of greater purpose in life is answered by integrating lessons that must be mastered or repeated cyclically as karma. When the full moon is in the 8th house, more so than usual, you aspire to understand the truth and wisdom behind the mysteries. You may be struggling, seeking to understand the greater meanings of life, asking questions like, "what is life? What did my soul come to learn this lifetime?" You look for greater significance in the mundane day-to-day world, perhaps through something spiritual. You don't mind an easy life but want to feel spiritually fulfilled. 1296

heading: Libra (Sept 23rd - Oct 22nd) & Libra Rising, Full moon in the 10th House
body: The Cancer full moon illuminates your 10th house of career and public recognition. If you're in a career that you're happy with, you could be getting a promotion or going into business. If you've been unhappy with your work-life balance, you might be making decisions to change or being forced out of situations that aren't emotionally healthy for you anymore. The spotlight is shining brightly on your career right now, and it's the perfect time to share your voice with the world. Sometimes it can be challenging to keep your priorities straight amid work pressures and career building. Between juggling responsibilities at home and at work, it's easy to feel like you're spread too thin and aren't giving your full attention to anything. But, if you don't slow down to check in with your emotions, you'll be ignoring your needs, missing out on opportunities, and falling into unfulfilling patterns that lead you further away from emotional fulfillment. Listen to yourself, and give yourself the time you need to feel whole and emotionally centered. Explore what successful work-life balance feels for you and if you don't feel you've created it yet, take actionable steps toward it. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil/Capricorn speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. The Devil usually symbolizes struggles with a moral problem — a choice between lust or love; but mostly, it means you're overwhelmed with an international struggle. You may haven't defined your values or beliefs and have taken on the beliefs of others that are misleading you of your fulfillment. Perhaps you prefer to switch careers to focus more energy on your family. Maybe you prefer not to have children and find fulfillment in other areas of your life. Perhaps you have no idea what you want, and you need to take this time to discover your values. Happiness is an inside job, don't outsource your happiness. Make sure that you are in charge of your life and values system. And if one thing goes wrong, don't look for someone else to take responsibility for it. Whether it's your partners, kids, pets, or your job. It's important to remember that you are in charge of your happiness and value system. And it's never conditional on anyone else. It is not conditional on your spouse or kids calling you on your birthday. Everyone is an individual with their own values. Don't impose your expectations on them and then feel disappointed when it's not met. So take a moment to focus on yourself and what you truly value. Invest in what you can and what makes you feel happy and emotionally fulfilled. Why is this so important? Because if you don't take control of your happiness and make conscious decisions about how you want your life to look, things will always be out of your control. 1298

heading: Virgo (Aug 23rd - Sept 22nd) & Virgo Rising, Full moon in the 11th House
body: The Cancer full moon illuminates your 11th house of friendship. Good friends are good for your health, and this full moon illuminates the importance of those you surround yourself with. In recent years, you've become more aware of the importance of creating a supportive social network. Friends provide you with emotional support, a listening ear, and a shoulder (or couch) when times get tough. Your friends can also be an outlet for you to express yourself and feel accepted. Connecting with others can help you feel seen and valued. Which are one of the hallmarks of well-being. When you feel seen and valued, you are more likely to take care of yourself. You are more likely to neglect your needs when you feel unseen or devalued. It's time to reflect on your connections with the world around you. Technology has allowed you to create and share more information than ever before. But what about forging real, meaningful connections? Make an effort to reach out to those you care about, spend time with nature, and make that human-to-human connection. After all, we all crave authentic connection. The Cancer full moon reminds you that human connection is essential. Even when you feel insecure about reaching out, it's usually the moment when you need it the most. So take a few moments to organize your daily life so that you get regular human contact and interaction. It will do wonders for your mental and emotional well-being. 1300

heading: Leo (July 23rd - Aug 22nd) & Leo Rising, Full moon in the 12th House
body: The Cancer full moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Full moons can be a time of celebration; however, now may be a time to withdraw into a sanctuary of self-care and seclusion. With the Cancer full moon in your 12th house, you're discovering the best ways to take care of yourself and recharge when you feel overworked, fatigued, and anxious. You'll reconnect to your creativity when you carve out downtime for yourself, and it will remind you how much you love being in the spotlight. Perhaps you're making significant advances in your creative career or working through releasing some recent disappointments. Whichever it is, make sure your self-care habits are helping you through the stress and excitement. Emotional connections are like a lighthouse in the dark. When the waters get rough, their light shows you the way. They keep you grounded and give you a sense of belonging. They remind you that even in the midst of endings, there is still love. Emotional connection can assist in navigating endings. It's a feeling of comfort and belonging, knowing that someone else is there to support you and love you for who you are. Sometimes the most meaningful connections are with our Higher Self and Self. Feeling connected to yourself is the ultimate form of self-compassion, an essential part of feeling whole. If you're feeling disconnected or unsure about how to connect with your Higher Self, you can meditate, journal, or use tools such as tarot cards. Difficult experiences shape life, such as trauma and bereavement, and can impact physical health, emotional state, beliefs, behaviors, and relationship patterns. To move forward and begin anew, it's crucial to heal these traumas and address their roots. During this full moon, you may also be experiencing intense emotional attachments and memories towards certain people who have passed away or places that hold deep significance from your childhood. Remember that healing is a journey, and it's okay to reach out for support from those around you. You are not alone on this path of transformation and growth. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces and corresponds to The Moon in the Major Arcana. The Moon reminds you of the Law of Rhythm that governs natural development and the shifting of energies. The Cancer full moon in the 12th house signals a time of endings. Look up in the sky tonight, and you'll see a reminder that life is a beautiful pattern of cycles, which you are a part of. Everything in life has a beginning and an end, which is inevitable. You can learn how to navigate endings and loss by reflecting on your previous experiences. A reflection is a form of self-care, and it is a chance to process all the events in your life that impacted you and resulted in you starting over. Allow yourself to exist within the collective consciousness and experience the healing and regeneration that comes with osmosis. 1302

body: To align your intentions with the full moon, select a time after the full moon alignment. Not before. heading: Cancer Full Moon Ritual
body: “I release everything either known or unknown to me that has been blocking me from receiving, feeling, and walking in my strength and authority. I trust and discover strength in my body, mind, self, and spirit. I call in my power and walk in my strength.” - A prayer for release Fig 76. Top view of an altar to Luna & Cancer [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place your ritual candle in the placement for Luna. Next to the ritual candle, place the Kamea for Luna, The High Priestess and The Chariot from the Golden Eclipse Tarot. Place items that correspond to Cancer. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration lavender) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle 1306 Petition – Petition Luna to set intentions. Luna assists with fertility, intuition, illusion, dreams, lucid dreaming, illusion & glamour – being seen as you’d desire. Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. 1307 Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. *** 1308 Aquarius Season: Jan 20th - Feb 18th 11th House, Uranus & Saturn Planetary Rulers Uranus & Saturn, A time of natural ascension for the collective. We celebrate what we can share with our community and the world. “In order to claim our long-term goals we set during Capricorn season and the New Year we need to open up our frequency to channel the Divine to guide us to expand our thinking; and look to the future.” - Marie Satori The Water-Bearer – January 20 - February 18 New Moon – Aquarius (ruled by Saturn and Uranus) Full Moon – Leo (ruled by Sol) Planet – Saturn Day of the Week – Saturday (ruled by Saturn) Archetype – The Maverick, the Innovator Element – Air Tarot – The Star Body – Ankles, The calves Affirmation – The world needs my unique spark Theme – Humanitarian work, innovation, technology, community & friendships Focus – A time of natural ascension for the collective. We celebrate what we can share with our community and the world As the great wheel of the year spins once again, it signals the arrival of Aquarius season. A time of innovation and rebellion, when the very winds seem to be electrified by inspiration and new visions. During Capricorn season, you embarked on a challenging ascent, scaling the heights of your personal mountain (MC). Now, as you transition into Aquarius season, armed with the wisdom, knowledge, and structure acquired from that arduous journey, it is time to embrace a new phase. Having conquered the summit of your personal mountain, you now stand at its pinnacle, gazing upon the world below. It is a moment of reflection and realization that the time has come to descend, carrying with you the life force and insights you have gained along the way. As you traverse the path downwards, a new purpose arises—to share your hard-earned wisdom with your community, children, and the generations to come. Aquarius season beckons you to be a beacon of knowledge and inspiration, to contribute to the collective growth and evolution of society. Embrace the role of a mentor, a guide, and a torchbearer as you illuminate the way for others, instilling the seeds of progress and transformation. Your journey has equipped you with unique perspectives and experiences that can shape a better tomorrow. 1309 So, as you venture forth from the mountaintop, let the winds of Aquarius infuse you with their electrifying energy. Embrace the freedom to think differently, to challenge conventions, and to foster innovation. The world awaits your contributions, as you embark on this new chapter of sharing, inspiring, and nurturing the seeds of change. Aquarius, the Water-Bearer, bears a jug full of insight and pours all that he has gathered into the community. You too, may follow in his footsteps, using your experiences as an opportunity to fill your own "jugs", your mind, and act as vessels for sharing wisdom and your unique perspectives with those around you. As Aquarius, the sign of the Water-bearer, pours all that he's gathered in his journey back to the community, let it serve as a reminder that you are part of a global community, and that you must consider the needs and perspectives of all races and genders, your friends, and your family. Embrace the spirit of Aquarius season, and be open to innovation and rebellion, using the knowledge you've gained to not only better yourself but also to uplift and inspire those around you. Remember, the journey doesn't end with reaching the summit, but also in being a guide for the next generation. Remember, the journey does not conclude upon reaching the summit. As you stand at the peak of your personal mountain, allow yourself to become a guiding light for the next generation. Embody the transformative essence of Aquarius, nurturing and empowering others as they navigate their own paths. Embrace this Aquarius season with an open heart and mind, recognizing the boundless potential for positive change. Let your insights flow like water, enriching the lives of those you encounter, and together, let us create a future shaped by wisdom, innovation, and collective progress. Aquarius season brings with it the winds of innovation and progress. It is a time of advancement in technology and the power of community, as well as the pursuit of visionary and idealistic goals. Aquarius brings forth new inventions and systems, aiding in the propulsion of humankind towards a brighter future. Let's not just be a passenger on this journey but be a active participant in shaping the future. Aquarius, the Water-bearer, bears within him the element of life-affirmation and his actions are guided by altruistic intentions. He tirelessly works to create a better future for all. As we channel the energy of Aquarius, let us use it to ignite the sparks of innovation in your New Year's goals and long-term intentions. As you look towards the future, seeking new and imaginative ways to bring your new year goals and visions to the present moment. Aquarius inspires you to expand your dreams, to trust in your intuition and to know when to break free from the constraints of tradition and think outside the box. Together, let us embrace the spirit of Aquarius and strive for a future brimming with progress and innovation. Guided by the illuminating presence of the Water-bearer, let us share the life-affirming elements with all, shaping a world that embraces advancement, unity, and the realization of our collective potential. As the Sun transitions from Capricorn to Aquarius, a shift in energy accompanies it, ushering in the emergence of new concepts and mental frameworks within you. Aquarius season provides a supportive environment for expanding your dreams and encourages the use of intuition to discern when it's time to break free from the rules and structures learned during Capricorn 1310 season. This liberation opens the doors to thinking outside the box and embracing your authentic uniqueness. During Aquarius season, it's an opportune time to challenge society's predefined notions of success and forge your own path. You don't have to conform to the standard mold to be extraordinary. This is a period to uncover your distinct contributions to the collective, tapping into your unique frequency and vibration to foster innovation and see your own future. Use Aquarius season to claim your long-term goals and intentions from the previous season of Saturn and Capricorn. Open up your frequency and channel the Divine to help you expand your thinking and manifest your vision. How can I channel innovative and creative solutions? How can be more spontaneous, and allow for more synchronicities and fated events? How can I leverage technology for my growth and intentions? Where do I need to focus my energy? What special talents can I give back to the community? How well do I know the rules - and when are where can I break them? What does my life look like in the future? How can I shed any identities that no longer resonate with my spirit?

heading: Aquarius Light & Shadow
body: Aquarius is known for its innovative and unconventional energy, but unevolved Aquarian energy can manifest as emotionally detached, aloof, and rebellious. In its shadow, Aquarius may struggle to connect with others and feel isolated, living on the fringe of society with unique ideas and values. This can make it difficult for others to connect with them as well. Unevolved Aquarius energy may be closed-minded, condescending, inflexible, unreliable, and a know-it-all, lacking a sense of purpose or cause. On the other hand, evolved Aquarian energy is able to channel the Divine and expand its thinking, using its freedom-loving and nonconformist energy to disrupt old models and create an unconventional, inventive, and original philosophy for the future. This comes from a thirst for truth, learning, and understanding the deeper inner workings of life and others. Aquarius reminds us that we are all connected and that our minds have incredible healing power. If you find yourself struggling with unevolved Aquarian energy, try to focus on opening your mind, being more flexible and open to new ideas, and working on your social connections and relationships. Remember that you have the power to channel the Divine and use your unique perspective to make a positive impact on the world. Aquarius Light& Strength – clever, witty, original, inventive, innovative, intuitive, humanity Aquarius Shadow & Weakness – unemotional, stubborn, sarcasm, aloof, rebellious Aquarius Season, Uranus & Saturn Co-Planetary Rulers People with strong Aquarius or Uranus in their charts may often feel alienated or on the fringe of society, with their unique look, ideas, and values. This can make it difficult for them to feel connected to others and for others to connect with them 1311 The eleventh house of the cosmic wheel, ruled by the rebel sign of Aquarius and its ruling planets Saturn and Uranus, represents the house of groups, organizations, and charities. It is also known as the "house of the Good Daimōn," or conscience, that inner voice that guides us in quiet moments. Aquarius season is a time for celebrating what we can share with our community and the world, and for focusing on humanitarian work, innovation, and technology, as well as our friendships. Ruled by the rebel sign of Aquarius and its ruling planets Saturn and Uranus, this is a time to challenge anything that threatens your inherent human freedoms and to use your intellectualism, innovation, research, philanthropy, and social justice skills to bring about positive change and breakthroughs. Aquarius is co-ruled by two planets — Saturn and Uranus — and is associated with breaking free of the confines of the status quo. Aquarius is the rebel of the zodiac, future-minded in his thinking and ready to organize the masses to take on corrupt establishments. Anything that gets in the way of our inherent human freedoms will be challenged by Aquarius. Breakthroughs come as new insights bring awareness and take us to the edge of our tolerance. Anything that doesn’t align with our truth may suddenly break away, exposing the rebel within. With the innovative and advanced thinking energies we collectively channel during Aquarius season, many of us may find ourselves looking into new technologies, software, and products for innovation, research, and social improvements. Saturn is the planet of tasks, structure, and responsibility, and provides Aquarius’ commitment towards bettering the world. However, Uranus rules disruption and suddenness. Asking us to know the rules in order to break them. Aquarius characteristics such as intellectualism, innovation, research, philanthropy, and social justice showcase the water bearer’s natural ability to balance and transcend any emotion, experience or mental thought. Uranus is a newly discovered planet, for it needed the invention of the telescope to discover what always existed outside our present vision. Uranus is associated with the unseen aspects of life and future thinking. This season requires us to stretch beyond our current-day vision, and lean heavily into our intuitive and innovative abilities to see what could exist. The water bearer glyph are frequency waves (or waves of water) - Allow for channeled messages to ride these frequencies. The water bearer glyph are also considered waves of water -knowledge poured out upon the world." The Water bearer "represents the pouring out of knowledge from the superconscious mind to be shared with humanity.” Aquarius reminds you to listen to the channeled messages that come your way and to pour out your own knowledge and learnings for the betterment of your community. As you stretch beyond your current vision and tap into your intuitive and innovative abilities, this is also a time to cultivate your friendships and network with others. Remember to listen to your inner voice, or Good Daimōn, as you navigate this time of rebellion and innovation.Embrace the energies of Aquarius and use them to bring about positive change and breakthroughs for the betterment of all. 1312 Aquarius / The Star After the shock abates from the Tower, the Fool gains hope from the guiding light of The Star, the eighteenth key of the Major Arcana. As children we are taught to wish on stars, our first teachings and attempts of asking the Universe to grant our intentions. Here the Fool learns that making a wish is setting an intention with the Universe and making a commitment to her future self towards a realized manifestation. Planetary Ruler – ♄ Saturn, ♅ Uranus (Modern) Symbolism – The Star depicted is surrounded by seven small stars, representing the seven primary chakras being in balance. Aquarius — the water-bearer — is associated with the Star; hence, we see a woman of eternal youth and beauty carries two vessels carrying the Water of Life, one of which she pours out into a river, and the other onto land. This represents the union of masculine (i.e., the land) and feminine (i.e., the river), as she waters the female, emotional body and the male, physical body. Her long hair flows from pelvis to her crown, which is the energetic pathway for kundalini energy. In the sky is the eight-pointed star of Inanna, the Sumerian goddess and representation of Venus. Also called the Morning Star because she is visible just before sunrise, she is the third-brightest celestial body after the sun and the moon. She rules the Law of Attraction on all levels, which is why the Star card is considered to be indicative of one’s wishes and manifestations being granted. Astrology – The Star corresponds to Aquarius. Aquarius is the sign of innovation, future thinking, technology, vision, and idealistic goals. Aquarius, the Water-bearer, brings this life-affirming element to all. Altruistic in his intentions and always thinking about creating a better future. He creates inventions and systems that help move humankind forward. Aquarius supports us in expanding our dreams, and asks that we use our intuition to know when to break the rules and think outside the box. The star represents our hopes, while Aquarians — the Zodiac associated with The Star — are the innovators; so, with this card, the focus is on innovating an area of your life. Upright Meaning – Wish granted, hope, abundance, inspiration, entertainer, being on stage/entertainment, muse energy, rebirth of opportunity, rejuvenation of the spirit, broader vision of the future, drawing inspiration from the beauty that surrounds one, having faith in the future, calm that is necessary to connect with the soul, faith brings strength, free flow of energy 1313 Reversed – Imposter syndrome, feeling lack of inspiration or lack of luck, pessimism, doubt, fear keeping one from potential, inability to see the bigger picture, inability to appreciate signs of hope or synchronicities, the end of a fulfilling situation, project or partnership

heading: Aquarius Season and Aquarius New Moon: Actions and Intentions
body: Aquarius season pushes yous to be unique, free-spirited, spontaneous, and future-oriented. Aquarius season and the Aquarian new moon will help guide you in exploring new forms of study, technology, or ideas that expand your mind and heart. Use this Aquarius energy to innovate and think creatively. This is a time to explore the greater impact on the world stage. Ruled by Uranus, this New Moon will stretch you past your comfort zone and limitations. New insights will create breakthroughs and push you further toward your goal, but only when you give yourself the space to receive what’s trying to be channeled through you now. This Aquarius season teaches you that you can manifest incredible things if you look to the heavens for guidance. It’s time to open your mind to the Universe, let it inspire, and transform any stagnant energy blocking you from your true path. Embrace all that is new, as it can take you closer to claiming those long-term goals and intentions set in motion during Saturn & Capricorn Season. Channel the Divine to help you innovate and think of new ways to live your life. Freedom-loving and nonconformist Aquarius tears down and disrupts old models for an unconventional, inventive, and original idealistic philosophy for the future. This comes from their thirst for truth, learning, and understanding the inner workings of life and others. Leverage the energy of Aquarius season to think differently - seek innovative solutions to challenges you haven’t been able to solve - think outside of the box. This is a season to perform rituals to assist in networking, seeing into your own future, and disrupting outdated models in your life. I am strong, independent, and unique. I embrace my individuality and I have something unique to share with the world. I am worthy of love and connection, and I invite positive, nourishing relationships into my life. I am open to new experiences and ways of thinking, and I am excited to explore and learn about cutting-edge technologies. I actively seek out groups and communities that share my interests and values, and I

heading: am committed to making a positive impact on the world through my actions and intentions. I embrace my
body: spiritual side and make time for self-care practices such as yoga and meditation. I allow myself to be spontaneous and embrace the magic of synchronicity and fate. I am confident in my abilities and trust in the unfolding of my journey. Create an altar – During the Aquarius season it is a good time to create a sacred space for Saturn, the planetary ruler of Aries. To create an altar, you can gather items that have personal meaning or significance to you. You might also collect items that symbolize Saturn and Aquarius. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Observe – Observe and record any symbolisms or messages that you notice during this full moon. A journal is like a magick portal to your innermost thoughts and dreams. Every page is an invitation to explore, reflect, and express yourself in a meaningful way. Collect items – Grab a pen, paper, candles, incense, herbs, and symbolic objects to represent Saturn/Aquarius, like The Star, The Fool tarot cards and the Planetary Kamea for Saturn. 1314 Incorporate a spiritual and organic lifestyle – Practice yoga and meditation, and explore your spirituality. Be spontaneous – Embrace synchronicity and fate, and embrace the unexpected. Find groups and communities that share your interests – Connect with like-minded people and join their groups or communities. Aquarius rules over Humanitarian work: set intentions to support working or finding work as an UN worker, Foreign aid worker, Social worker, Health officer, Human resources specialist, Training coordinator, Social media communications officer, etc. Aquarius rules over networking: set intentions to increase your network, find a network / social group you want to belong to, increase your online network and social media presence. Aquarius rules over innovation & technology: set intentions to find work in emerging tech., raise capital to begin your own start-up, or discover innovating solutions using technology. Aquarius rules over friendships: set intentions to meet new people and find and make friends. 1315 Aquarius New Moon: The World Needs My Unique Light Under the influence of the new moon in Aquarius, you find yourself contemplating how you can make a profound impact on your global and local community. Throughout your journey on the cosmic wheel, you have accumulated wisdom, knowledge, and structure, which now converge with the new moon's arrival in Aquarius. This celestial event signifies that it is time to descend from the mountain you climbed during Capricorn season and generously share the wealth of wisdom you have gained with your community, children, and the generations to come. Aquarius, symbolized by the Waterbearer, epitomizes the spirit of this sign. With a tireless commitment to bettering the world, the Waterbearer brings forth the life-affirming element for all to partake. Technology, innovation, forward-thinking, and idealistic aspirations are all associated with Aquarius. As an inventor, Aquarius creates systems and inventions that contribute to the advancement of humanity. During this transformative period, Aquarius serves as a reminder that you are an integral part of a global community. It is essential to consider the diverse perspectives of all races, genders, as well as the well-being of your friends and family. This is a time for innovation, celebration, and embracing what you can contribute to your community and the wider world. New moons often mean beginnings and planting new seeds. During the new moon in Aquarius, you are contemplating how to make the greatest ripple effect in global and local communities. While you consider your work, you ask yourself if it is beneficial and helps the collective consciousness reach its highest potential. This new moon is asking you to think beyond immediate gratification and create a vision that reaches the world. The water-bearer is tuned into the future frequencies ahead of its time. For the greater good's evolution, Aquarius fights for freedom, sharing the truth of knowledge with all humanity. In the words of John 8:32, "And you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free." Aquarius is co-ruled by two planets — Saturn and Uranus — and is associated with breaking free of the confines of the status quo. Aquarians are future-minded and often connected with information, technology, humanitarian efforts, community, and networking. This mental connection can sometimes translate as downloads of psychic or spiritual knowledge. Let's consider thoughts and information as frequency, like radio. Aquarius can tune into different frequencies and receive information beyond what we can typically physically see and hear. Sometimes this can even be in the form of dreams or insights that eventually end up as new innovations, inventions, and technologies. With this Aquarian new moon energy, you are reflecting on your work and whether it's beneficial and helping the collective consciousness reach its highest potential. This new moon asks you to think beyond immediate gratification and create a vision that reaches the world. This could happen personally and collectively, as Aquarius is associated with the greater community. Aquarius is the rebel of the zodiac, ready to organize the masses to take on a corrupt establishment. This new Aquarius moon will challenge anything that gets in the way of your inherent human freedoms. You may come face to face with some social injustices and/or core wounds that need attention. The 11th sign of the cosmic wheel, Aquarius, rules the 11th house of friendship, community, and social interaction. Essentially, this energy is that of a rebel, a non-conformist who challenges oppressive societal norms and structures. Uranus, the planet of rebellion, freedom, and revolution, also rules this house. You need to be aware of rebelling just for the sake of it instead of for a more 1316 noble purpose. Aquarians are visionaries, and their ahead-of-the-time qualities often find it difficult to fit in. This energy may make you feel alienated or on the fringe of society with your unique looks, ideas, and values. This can make it difficult for you to feel connected to others and for others to connect with you. Remember, inventors and scientists who brought new and valuable ideas that have challenged current values have historically been cast aside, invalidated, and disgraced. However, they have been validated many years later, sometimes even after they've passed. Aquarius is ruled by Uranus and can be unpredictable and aloof regarding human connection. They are brilliant, intuitive, and inspired but may be challenged with emotional connection and expression. They tend to keep a distance from emotional experiences and intimacy, but this doesn't mean they are unfeeling. They may have a difficult time accessing and expressing their emotions. Aquarius/Uranus is also associated with traumatic experiences, which can cause dissociation and distancing of emotions so they can continue functioning. Sometimes the root of their distancing lies in a traumatic event, and sometimes it's just part of their personality. This new moon will explore what community you feel most comfortable in and what you need to change in your life, not yourself. This will enable you to feel like you can express the real you. Circumstances may suddenly change, and your perspective on reality might shift in uncomfortable ways. You may also be exploring novel forms of study or ideas that expand your mind. Breakthroughs are a signature Uranus/Aquarius trait, so whatever you're experiencing now, seek ways to support your nervous system. This energy can feel electrifying, uncomfortable, and yet exciting. New insights will create breakthroughs and push you further toward your goal. However, they will be effective only when you give yourself the space to receive what's trying to be channeled through you now. You may also find yourself in intensely uncomfortable situations that bring up past traumas, or you may be experiencing one. You must be aware of self-sabotage and addictive behavior that undermines your goals. If emotions are too strong, find healthy ways to handle them. If you're having difficulty managing this new moon energy, surround yourself with people and places that feel supportive. The Aquarius new moon invites you to fully embrace and express your individuality, even if others may see it as unconventional or controversial. The Aquarian new moon asks you to dare to be different. This lunar phase encourages you to fearlessly stand apart from the status quo that no longer serves your growth, embracing the truth of your authentic self at the core of your being. By tapping into the energy of the Aquarius new moon, you can ignite innovative solutions to long-standing challenges and experience healing, empathy, connection, and the co-creation of a more sustainable and compassionate existence. Within the Aquarian new moon lies an opportunity to tap into the vast power of universal energy, allowing it to guide you towards a life that resonates with your unique spirit. Have you ever felt a profound sense of peace when living in alignment with your deepest values? This is the essence of being Unbound. When your authentic spirit is alive and energized, it has the capacity to ripple positive change throughout your life, propelling you towards the manifestation of long-term goals and visions. Now is the perfect moment to attune yourself to the frequency of the Aquarian new moon, embracing its divine energy to expand your vision and bring your ideas and aspirations for the future into the present moment. In doing so, you can step forward into the new year with confidence and clarity, ready to forge a path that aligns with your truest essence. 1317

body: 1318 Tarotscopes for the Aquarius New Moon Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology with writing personalized horoscopes. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes. I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a variation of a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during the Aquarius new moon, the Sun (Sun) and the Moon (The High Priestess) are in Aquarius (The Star). Then find the Sun (Sun), High Priestess (Moon), and The Star (Aquarius), and place the Sun in position 1, High Priestess in position 2, and The Star in position 3. For positions 4 and 5, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the new moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 6th position, select a card from the second pile containing the Court Cards and the Minor Arcana, or place the tarot card corresponding to your sun sign. Use this placement to gain more insight into this new moon. 1319 Tarotscope Key 3. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in Ex: The Star (Aquarius) during Aquarius new moon 5. The tarot card that corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries 1. The Sun (Sun) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 4. The tarot card that corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house 6. The tarot card corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign or a supporting card from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance 1320 Aquarius (Jan. 20 - Feb. 18) & Aquarius Rising - New moon in the 1st House Happy Birthday Aquarius. The Aquarius new moon is in your 1st house of Self. As the solar return approaches and the personal new year dawns, it is a time for introspection and contemplation to consider the aspirations and goals you wish to manifest in the coming year. It is an opportunity to gain clarity about the things you desire to manifest in your life, the talents you wish to cultivate, and the direction in which you wish to steer your journey. It is a time to take stock of where you are and where you want to be, to chart a course that will guide you toward fulfilling your desires and realizing your goals. With a new moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This new moon is a reminder that your mind is a gift — not a prison. Yes, it can restrict your vision with doubt. But it can also open your world up to endless possibilities and help you see the possibilities in life. You can be the visionary of your own path, standing in your power to create a life that aligns with your soul's signature vibration. You are a humanitarian by nature, with the power to design a life that is free from external conditioning. This Aquarius new moon honors what makes you unique and different. The Aquarius new moon in your sign is a time of transformation. You may decide to make changes in your self-image; get into shape, lose or gain weight, or visit an optometrist or cosmetic surgeon to make changes in your appearance. If you are self-employed and your personality is your brand, this is also a time to redesign your website. Leverage your gifts to elevate you from the masses, stand out, and be recognized for your contributions. The Fool in the tarot represents the Spirit's descent into the physical realm, symbolizing the purity and potential of the soul. As the Fool begins her journey, she leans on her faith and trusts that the Universe will guide her. Uranus, her cosmic companion, imbues her with energy of rebellion, revolution, and change. The Fool is unafraid to take risks, innovate, and break through boundaries, embracing limitlessness and change. She represents faith over fear, daring to step into the unknown with confidence and trust in the journey ahead. The cosmic energy of the 1st house, ruled by the fiery and pioneering Aries, aligns with the Emperor card in the Major Arcana. Aries brings in the energy of new beginnings and karmic cycles, while the Emperor urges us to tap into our inner authority and find our individuality apart from external, socially defined norms. This is a powerful time to step into our personal power and take control of our lives, cultivating a strong sense of self and personal responsibility. As we trust in our inner guidance and let go of outdated patterns, we open ourselves to new opportunities for growth and self-discovery. This is a time to confidently assert ourselves and take charge of our lives 1321 Aquarius & Aquarius Rising Tarotscope Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (The High Priestess) are in Aquarius (The Star), illuminating the 1st House (Aries/The Emperor), with ruling planet Mars (The Tower). 3. The Star (Aquarius) / The Fool (Uranus) 5. The Tower (Mars) 1. The Sun (Sun) 4. The Emperor (Aries) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 6. {extra card} 1322 Capricorn (Dec. 22 - Jan. 19) & Capricorn Rising - New moon in the 2nd House The Aquarius new moon is in your 2nd House of Disposable Income and Foundation. Aquarius is a fixed sign, which really brings the energy of stability, determination, and depth. This is a time to create more stability in your life and take stock of the financial lessons (positive and negative) you’ve learned this past year. This new moon asks that you focus on building your skills and strengthening your knowledge in the areas of money management, investments, and budgeting. These essential foundations will enable you to live with confidence, knowing that you are taking the correct steps to secure your financial future. It's helpful to remember that financial growth is not a linear process. This new moon is the perfect time to tap into your creativity and manifest financial abundance, explore new business ventures and make the most of your talents, assets, and work. Leverage the power of this new moon to embark on a journey of wealth creation. The Aquarius new moon guides you to rebel against and free yourself from any critical thoughts that sabotage your self-worth and self-esteem. The 2nd house themes surround resources, wealth building, and assets. Your health is your most valuable asset. It’s the one thing you can’t buy or trade for - it’s yours and yours alone. Think of your body like a bank account – you’ve got to make regular deposits if you want it to grow. It’s easy to take it for granted, but when it starts to fail, so does your ability to succeed in life. The fuel that you feed your body is the currency with which you invest in your well-being. Look after yourself, and you’ll see returns that translate into a richer, healthier, and fuller life. Your health is the ultimate resource – put it first and watch the dividends grow. Aquarius energy wants to help evolve the collective, towards progress. The Aquarius new moon reminds you that as you plan for your future endeavors, use the knowledge and skills that you've developed to help others. Share your strategies for financial success and be a listening ear for those who seek your guidance. Not only will you be of service to others, but you'll cultivate a sense of good karma and wealth in the process. The Aquarius new moon in the second house is a time to set intentions for stable income and security. Be mindful if any financial planets, like Venus or Mercury, are retrograde at this time. It is not always possible to avoid making financial plans during a retrograde period. If a decision needs to be acted on at this time, quadruple-check any documents and contracts that need to be signed during a possible unstable cosmic window. The second house is ruled by Taurus and corresponds to The Hierophant in the Major Arcana. The Hierophant is often seen as the embodiment of structure and consistency— two powerful ingredients in achieving success and financial stability. Think of the Hierophant as your guide or mentor — someone who has the experience and knowledge to get you on the path to success. Your mentor can help you stay focused by helping you set clear goals and providing guidance, support, and motivation when things aren’t going your way. By having a mentor or financial advisor to lean on, you can save time and effort because instead of making costly mistakes along the way, you’ll have someone there to show you the right way. So if you’re looking for help in setting up proper financial goals, perhaps it's time to seek out a Hierophant-type figure who can provide much-needed direction and assistance. The more you commit to yourself in the next six months, the more you’ll see your investments, income, and self-worth grow. 1323

The Aquarius new moon dares you to be different. The new moon brings a chance for disruptive insight and a shift in perspective—a chance for you to explore a new perspective. This new moon comes with a special reminder to reach out to those who bring magick into your life. The Universe is supporting all paths that lead to communication, connection, and collaboration. This is a powerful time for manifesting your dreams, so why not use this new moon to reach out to those who can help make them happen? Whether it be old friends, colleagues, family—even strangers. Spend some time writing: letters, emails, PR releases or hellos expressing what you're creating and how they can be part of it. You may find your newest ally as soon as this lunar cycle wanes. The 3rd house is ruled by Gemini and corresponds to The Lovers in the Major Arcana. The Lovers symbolize choice commitment, negotiating, harmonious flow of energy, and connections. Aquarius is ruled by Uranus and corresponds to The Fool in the Major Arcana. Uranus brings us flashes of insight, awakenings, unexpected breakdowns, and breakthroughs, as well as a need for independence from tradition. Its electrifying energy speeds things up and stimulates innovation in even the most ‘ordinary’. You can tap into Uranus’s energy by breaking away from the rules and norms of society, allowing yourself to think independently, and embracing change and innovation take a leap of faith. Be creative, daring, and open-minded, and allow yourself to make mistakes and learn from them. This is the energy of The Fool / Uranus, and it’s one that can bring unexpected opportunities. The combination of The Lovers and The Fool is guiding you to go with the flow of whatever is unfolding; with each choice moment - choose yourself. In doing so, you foster more meaningful relationships and connections by being authentic in your choices. Mercury is the Planetary Ruler of Gemini and corresponds to The Magician. The Magician symbolizes manifestation, mastering of self, working with energy, powerful intention, skill and wisdom, creation, willpower, telepathic communication, and speaking or writing your desire into existence. The Magician is the master of the elements, showing tools necessary for creation, or the process of transmuting that which resides in our minds and intentions into material reality. The arrangement of these elements on the card reveals the path to manifestation: swords (i.e., thoughts), cups (i.e., emotion), wands (i.e., Spirit and action), coins (i.e., physical manifestation), which are translated into intention, feeling, spiritual correctness and action, and physical effort, respectively. This magickal combination is what is necessary to herald thought into the physical form; in other words, manifesting. It's time to channel your inner Magician. With focus and willpower, you have the ability to craft whatever it is you want in life - whether it be physical, emotional, or mental. So start putting yourself out there, socialize and make meaningful connections. Make sure you're open to feedback and collaboration (it will help you refine your ideas). Remain open-minded (Aquarius). You never know who you might meet that could help propel your vision forward. 1325

heading: Virgo (Aug 23 - Sept 22) & Scorpio Rising - New moon in the 6th House
body: The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 6th House of Health and Being of Service. This is the time to set intentions to cultivate healthy routines and daily habits which support your nervous system and overall well-being. The smallest of daily shifts can help build impactful change. Aquarius is co-ruled by Uranus and Saturn. Uranus' energy can be disruptive, which can cause anxiety when your body senses that something is shifting, and not quite right. This is a natural response. This new moon highlights the need to create a new self-care regimen that supports managing stress and anxiety. It's time to tune into your body and mind, and create positive daily rituals and daily routines that provide more freedom and choice while supporting your mental and physical health. In a world full of demands, it can be tough to find the balance between being productive and taking care of your mental health. The Aquarius new moon offers some ideas that can help you create daily practices to support your nervous system and give yourself freedom and choice: use technology like sleeping apps to track your sleep health; start each day with a cup of chamomile tea; use a meditation app or join a virtual meditation group; incorporate yoga or stretching into your daily routine. These small shifts can make all the difference in managing stress and staying healthy. Make sure you take the time to check in with yourself, recognize where you are overextending yourself, and practice self-care. The sixth house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit. The Hermit symbolizes introspection for personal and spiritual development, taking space from a situation or person to gain perspective, a meeting with a wise person who aids one's journey, and the answers you seek can be found within. Virgo and the Hermit observe. The Hermit encourages you to purify your mind to look closely at yourself, so you can start taking note of the ways in which you give too much of yourself. With patience, contemplation, and observation, you can make small changes in your daily routines which can add up to create an impactful transformation. 1331

heading: Leo (July 23 - Aug. 22) & Leo Rising - New moon in the 7th House
body: The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. Allowing you to heal, empathize with others and lead with your heart; in hopes of creating a more sustainable and compassionate existence. Aquarius is the water carrier, and the waters he carries are given freely to others without expectation. Embrace the power of an unbound life. Free yourself from expectations, relationships, and the status quo that are holding you back. Instead, focus on being true to your unique spirit and accepting the truth of who you are at your core. The Aquarius new moon in the seventh house can signal a time to set intentions to call in a new relationship, or create more harmony and balance in a relationship, or to open yourself up to explore commitments (marriage, engagement, moving in together, starting a business). The 7th house is ruled by Libra and corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice symbolizes cause and effect, the workings of destiny or karma, the consequences or rewards of past actions, law, trial, justice, truth, balance, achieving balance after tribulations, retribution, the law on your side, favorable outcome of judicial matters, responsible conduct, making well-balanced choices, and integrity. The Justice card indicates that you may be wrestling with how to appropriately handle an unjust situation. And, with the New Moon in Aquarius; Aquarius energy includes being fearless, independent, a rebel, and a warrior for social justice. You don’t always have to wait for someone else to bring justice. You can take the initiative to create it yourself. When faced with injustice, sometimes the best course of action may be simply to acknowledge mistreatment and move on. Other times, however, you can approach a situation with a plan, well-crafted arguments, and talking points that honor your personal values and make sure those who wronged you are held accountable. Whether tackling a business contract or navigating the conflicts of a past relationship; if you’re prepared to stand up for what’s right and get creative in finding solutions, you can achieve justice, correct the scales and find balance without having to wait for others. 1333

heading: Cancer (June 21 - July 22) & Cancer Rising - New moon in the 8th House
body: The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. The new moon in the eighth house signals a time to set intentions to learn or further develop your craft: tarot, astrology, and occult studies. The new moon in Aquarius is a time when you can more easily channel information that exists in the ether. During this new moon, take time to divine information that will support you in making decisions and navigating the next 6 months. This Aquarius new moon encourages you to tap into and strengthen your intuition. Aquarius is unique, a rebel and this energy shows you it takes courage to go off script, against the mainstream, and into the unknown. Like The Fool, which corresponds to Uranus, one of the Planetary Rulers of Aquarius - if you're ready to take a leap of faith and trust yourself, you'll find strength, self-reliance, and security on the other side. Every successful journey has moments of doubt and uncertainty. Yet, when you take ownership of your decisions and rely on your own intuition and judgment, you build self-reliance, security, and ultimately self-reliance. So dig deep, let your intuition guide you, and never stop developing the magick that lies within you. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to The Death tarot card. Death can symbolize change, transformation, rebirth, the end of a cycle, separation or 'death' from one's old self or old life. Death signals a time of spiritual and psychological rebirth where the spirit reconnects with the authentic self and the soul's purpose. It’s also a time when you are pushed to go deeper, opening the portal between the seen and unseen worlds. Gifting you access not only to your own potential for spiritual growth and healing - but also healing of your ancestors. Life is full of change. It is an undeniable fact of the human experience. As life changes, you can become entrenched in fear and anxiety over the loss of what has been or the opportunity cost of what could have been instead. In these moments, it is helpful to remember that death isn't an ending, but a transition. It's not about giving up on hope, but rather shifting your attention to what is available in the present moment, combined with intuition to fuel your choices. Let go of the fear of loss or missed opportunities and embrace the transformation that death brings. Surrendering to the unknown and trusting in your own resilience allows you to move forward a little bit wiser and better prepared for what lies ahead. 1335

heading: Gemini (May 21 - June 20) & Gemini Rising - New moon in the 9th House
body: The Aquarius new moon activates your 9th House of Higher Self. This is a powerful time to connect to life's mysteries and tap into the magick that lies beneath the surface. The Aquarian new moon asks you to question what you see, opening your eyes to the deeper meaning behind the events unfolding around you. Set intentions to meditate, deepen your relationship with your Higher Self and prioritize your spiritual and emotional wellness. The Aquarius new moon in your 9th house may be a sign that the Universe is opening the door to exciting new opportunities. Now is the perfect moment to explore foreign cultures, religions, and educational pursuits. You may even feel the desire to delve deeper into the topics of philosophy, publishing, or law. Going on an adventure can often be a liberating experience, leading to many unexpected discoveries. The Aquarius new moon could bring your attention to these topics and encourage you to explore them deeply. It is important to trust your intuition and take time to reflect during this period in order to gain knowledge and find meaning. The more you learn about Spirituality and life’s mysteries, the more you realize just how much there is to discover. That is the beauty of life - it's a never-ending journey of exploration, knowledge, and growth. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering our purpose or meaning, mindfulness of overindulging or drinking, moderation, the balance of passion and reason, and cultivating patience. It’s possible you aspire to understand the truth and wisdom behind the mysteries. It's possible that you are struggling, seeking to understand the greater meanings of life, asking questions like, “What is life? What did my soul come to learn this lifetime?” You are looking for greater meaning in the mundane world of the day-to-day, perhaps through something spiritual. The search for true wisdom isn't linear, but diving into the mysteries of life can bring tremendous rewards. Temperance, on a spiritual level, speaks of the potential for true communication with your Higher Self. When you are open to fate and curious about synchronicities, your Higher self can make its presence known. The planetary ruler of Sagittarius/Temperance is Jupiter, which corresponds to The Wheel of Fortune. The Wheel of Fortune themes includes a change of fate, luck, expansion, fate, destiny, positive karma, and the beginning or end of a cycle. This new moon encourages you to remain curious and open-minded to new chance encounters, invites, and unexpected opportunities. You know that feeling when the Universe is conspiring in your favor? This is the essence of the Aquarius new moon in the 9th house. This is a moment when saying ‘yes’ to a new opportunity, interview, helping someone, or a vacation could lead you on an adventure where you'll discover your new best friend, new career, life partner, new residency or something else entirely. This new moon reminds me of the saying, be careful what you wish for - you must just be limited yourself. This new moon’s energy is the perfect time to take a leap of faith and say yes to new opportunities, adventures, and people life has in store for you. 1337

heading: Taurus (April 20 - May 20) & Taurus Rising - New moon in the 10th House
body: The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 10th House of Career and Purpose. Aquarians are future-minded and often connected with information, technology, humanitarian efforts, community, and networking. Aquarius is the rebel that helps break down the oppressive norms that keep us in the status quo. The non-conformists push you to think differently and challenge what you know. The Aquarian new moon is a time to set intentions to see how leveraging emerging technology can advance your career. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn which corresponds to The Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil pushes you to grow past the fears of your lower nature, into a more mature version of yourself. The Devil speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. The Devil can symbolize struggles with a moral problem — a choice between lust or love, obsession or liberation; but mostly, it can indicate you’re overwhelmed with your international dialogue and finding it difficult to stay focused. During this time your thoughts can become a distraction. Also with the energy of The Devil tarot card, be mindful to not entertain any unhealthy workplace crushes or obsessions. Overthinking is an integral part of this Aquarian new moon energy. While this energy can help you think things through, it can also lead to emotional and mental exhaustion if you aren’t practicing awareness. The Devil can also create restlessness energy. So if you’re feeling bored or uninspired with the work you do, or your work surroundings (office), don’t be afraid to take initiative. Take it upon yourself to identify areas that need improvement, challenge outdated ideas, systems, and software (Aquarius), and help create solutions that will make the work you do, and the workplace more stimulating. The Aquarius new moon set intentions to come up with creative solutions and revamp your work and workplace. 1339
