heading: Aries (March 21 - April 19) & Aries Rising - New moon in the 11th House
body: The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 11th house of friendship. This new moon set the intention to call in people, places, and lifestyles that make you feel like your most authentic self. This new moon brings with it a powerful invitation to be more intentional with your relationships. It's time to surround yourself with those with a similar soul view and personal vibration. Let the energy of this powerful lunar phase draw you closer to those who will nurture and support you and understand and accept you for who you are. Make time for meaningful conversations and connections, because great things can happen when like minds come together. Surround yourself with people who lift you up, inspire you, and support your freedom. Breakthroughs are a signature Uranus/Aquarius trait, so whatever you're experiencing now, find ways to support your nervous system. The 11th house is ruled by Aquarius which corresponds to The Star. You’re feeling an extra dose of this Aquarian new moon energy. The Star symbolizes a wish granted, hope, inspiration, being on stage/entertainment, muse energy, a rebirth of opportunity, rejuvenation of the spirit, a broader vision of the future, drawing inspiration from the beauty that surrounds you, having faith in the future, calm that is necessary to connect with the soul, faith brings strength and free flow of energy. The Star is a card of one's wish is granted, as she rules over the Law of Attraction. You possess the power to create your reality, and that can start with being intentional with your thoughts, feelings, and who you surround yourself with. If you are an artist: writer, musician, artist, actor, etc. this is a time to set the intention to have yourself and your work seen. If you have an established network, use it. If you are starting to build your network and community - put energy into being seen, and discovered for your art and talents. The Star is asking you to re-align with your spark — something deeper than simply relaxing, or "taking space." You're being asked to take the steps to work on the inner parts of yourself that need your attention and that you've been deflecting or ignoring. 1341

The Emperor (Aries) 4.-empty(Aquarius/11th house) 1342 Pisces (Feb. 19 - March 20) & Pisces Rising - New moon in the 12th House The Aquarius new moon activates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Aquarius can tune into different frequencies and receive information beyond what one can physically see and hear. Sometimes this can even be in the form of dreams or insights that eventually end up as new innovations, inventions, and emerging technologies to help move humanity forward. Dreaming is an entryway to collective knowledge. During the Aquarius new moon, let's take a moment to honor this ancestral wisdom and access the limitless potential that lives within us. Set the intention to tune into your inner frequency and take a moment to listen; you have access now to the wisdom of lifetimes. Have you ever had a dream that felt like a download of ancient wisdom? Paying attention to your dreams during this new moon, can help unlock knowledge and possibly clarify your current reality. Giving you the insight you need to make the right choices. So if you find yourself receiving downloads of information from past or future lifetimes, don't be afraid to explore them. On a cellular level, you all hold memories of each of the lifetimes you have ever experienced as well as the lifetimes we one day are going to experience. Just as you can leverage Past Live Regression to guide you in achieving your goals. You can use Future Progression to guide you in seeing future obstacles and opportunities. Tuning into a future lifestyle frequency allow you to see what lies ahead you are better prepared to change the conditions that pave the way. Allow your Higher Self to guide you beyond your immediate awareness, to remain open to receiving innovative solutions to help guide you, from a future point in this lifetime frequency. Allow your future lifetime frequency to help bring your ideas and vision for the future to this present moment. Allow your Higher Self to support your big ideas. Discover insight to questions such as, “What hidden opportunities are around you that will further your current goals and vision?” The 12th house is ruled by Pisces and corresponds to The Moon in the Major Arcana. The Moon is associated with illusion, mysticism, and lunar magick. It can also be associated with confusion, emotionally charged dreams, a period of introspection, and the need to guard oneself against deception. During this time, it can be a struggle to differentiate between illusion and reality. The moon, Luna, is a reminder that life is a natural pattern of cycles. Rhythms exist throughout nature in the changing of the seasons and the different stages of natural development. The Moon represents this Law of Rhythm that governs the natural cycles of life. She embodies this rhythm in her lunar phases of mounting and diminishing waxing and waning energies. Remember that the moon is a mirror; she is a reflection of your Self, your fears, and your subconscious thoughts. Jupiter is the ancient planetary ruler of the 12th house, which corresponds to The Hanged Man. The Hanged Man symbolizes enlightenment, intuition, pause, meditation, and stillness. The Hanged Man, Neptune, Pisces, and the 12th house signal the end of a cycle; depending on where you are in your journey, this can be a time of positive or negative reflection. The Hanged Man asks you to face what you may have been avoiding. It requires you to release your fears of failure and of success; to release the pressure you place on yourself. This is also a time of contemplation, meditation, and rebirth. The Hanged Man, and this new moon, may force you to slow down, particularly if you aren't inclined to do so on your own. It’s important to take care of your health at this time; especially getting enough sleep and restoration. The Hanged Man may also represent a moment of brief enlightenment in which a spark of inspiration or knowledge comes from above. All 1343 you need to do is to sit in stillness. Your new moon intention, “I am a direct channel to universal consciousness, and I allow new information to guide me towards my next steps.” 1344

heading: Aquarius New Moon Ritual Timing
body: The power of manifestation, to give something form. A new cycle. The energy of new possibilities. Time to set your intentions for what you want to bring into your life. New moons often mean beginnings and planting new seeds. Each new moon is a new beginning. With each new beginning, we are asked to release unfinished business, draining distractions from the past - these are required to be neutralized or integrated into the new cycle for a healthy culmination and manifestation. Write down what you desire to manifest over the next six (6) to eighteen (18) months. Aquarian themes include humanitarian work, rebellion, innovation & technology, community & friendships. To align your intentions with the new moon, select a time after the new moon alignment. Not before. You want to have the moon ‘waxing’ / growing as you speak, write, and set your intentions. The most potent manifesting period is the eight ( 8 ) hour window* that follows the exact new moon alignment. * if you cannot perform your ritual within the first 8 hours. You still have 60 hours after the exact New Moon alignment for manifesting 1347

heading: Aquarius New Moon Ritual
body: Fig 77. Top view of an altar to Saturn & Capricorn [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Saturn and your ritual candle(s) for Saturn on the placement for Saturn. Place the World and The Star tarot card on your altar, as well as an offering to Saturn. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration pine and black tourmaline) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). 1348 Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. 1349 Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. 1350

heading: Exploring Aquarius Season and New Moon Through Journaling
body: Aquarius is the sign of innovation and individuality, representing our ability to break free from the constraints of society and think outside the box. During Aquarius season or an Aquarius new moon, the universe may bring up issues related to your unique identity and your place in the world. You can use tarot as a way to inspire journaling. Select a spread or layout that resonates with your current focus or intention. Shuffle the deck and draw a card, then reflect on its meaning and symbolism. Use the card as a starting point for your journaling and allow its imagery and message to inspire your thoughts and feelings. Explore the card's themes and messages in greater depth and consider how they relate to your experiences and challenges. Reflect on how the card may offer guidance or insights for your current situation and how you can integrate its message into your life. Light a white or purple candle and create an expansive atmosphere by using refreshing scents and uplifting music. Visualize yourself embracing your individuality and breaking free from societal norms as you explore your unique identity. Take this opportunity to reflect on your personal growth and development. Open your journal and begin writing about your unique identity and your place in the world. You may also want to consider any challenges or obstacles you have faced in your journey towards self-discovery and embracing your individuality, and brainstorm ways to overcome them. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you explore these themes. As you journey through Aquarius season, it's a great time to reflect on your unique identity and your place in the world. By taking some time to journal about these topics, you can gain a deeper understanding of yourself and your goals. Here are some prompts to get you started: Exploring Your Role in Humanitarian Causes: Take some time to reflect on your values and how they align with humanitarian causes. Consider what causes are important to you and how you can use your skills and resources to make a positive impact in the world. Write about any challenges you have faced in aligning your actions with your values, and brainstorm ways to overcome them. ● What are your long-term goals for making a positive impact in the world? ● How do you stay informed and engaged with humanitarian causes, and what strategies have you found helpful in staying motivated and committed to making a positive impact? ● How do you prioritize your time and resources when it comes to supporting humanitarian causes? ● What are some ways you have been able to make a difference in your community or globally, and what did you learn from these experiences? Exploring Your Values: Take some time to reflect on your values and how they shape your actions and decisions. Consider what you believe in most strongly and how you can align your actions with your values. Write about any conflicts you may have encountered between your values and your actions, and how you have navigated these challenges. ● Are there any societal norms or expectations that you feel pressure to conform to? ● How do you navigate these expectations and stay true to yourself? ● How do your values influence your relationships and your approach to life? ● How do you define your unique identity and how do you express it to the world? ● How do you strive for progress and innovation in your personal and professional life? 1351 Receiving and Using Feedback: We all receive feedback and criticism at various points in our lives. Take some time to reflect on your approach to receiving feedback and how you use it to learn and grow. Write about any challenges you have faced in accepting and using feedback, and brainstorm strategies for handling it in a positive and productive way. ● How have you incorporated feedback into your personal and professional growth? ● How do you handle criticism or feedback, and what strategies have you found helpful in learning and growing from it? ● Setting and Achieving Aspirations: Consider your long-term goals and the steps you are taking to achieve them. Write about any obstacles or challenges you have faced in pursuing your aspirations, and brainstorm ways to overcome them. ● What are your personal and professional aspirations, and how can you use your unique perspective and creativity to achieve them? ● How can you stay motivated and focused on your goals? ● What are your long-term goals and how can you use your individuality and innovative thinking to achieve them? Adapting to Change: Change is a constant in life, and it can be difficult to navigate at times. Take some time to reflect on how you handle unexpected changes or challenges, and what strategies you have found helpful in adapting and moving forward. heading: Exploring The Aquarius/Leo Polar Axis
body: The polarities of the full moon and season sun are highlighted in each Zodiac Season. The Aquarius / Leo axis represents rebellion verses validation. In exchange, Leo gives Aquarius permission to be childlike and express themselves without judgment. In order to achieve the greater good, Aquarius gives Leo the ability to think about others and to focus on the greater good. In addition to helping each other find balance in life, they acknowledge that the needs of the individual and those of the group are not mutually exclusive. By taking risks, stepping out of their comfort zones, and being open to new ideas, they can learn to take risks and expand their horizons. Their mutual goal is to remind one another that validation is not always necessary and that rebellion can be beneficial. As a result of the Aquarian energy, you are being encouraged to consider the most effective ways in which you can have a profound impact on your community and on the world. Aquarius season encourages you to look beyond your immediate gratification and to develop a vision that reaches out to the world. Leo's full moon reminds you to live from the heart, discover your passion, and pursue your goals. Generosity is the quality that Leo in his Light brings to the world. The warmth from a big open heart, like the Sun, that gives endlessly and unconditionally to those he cares for. With these energies in mind, be mindful of how you can make the most profound impact on your global and local communities. As you reflect on your work, ask yourself: am I helping the collective consciousness reach its highest potential? How can you use your skills and abilities to bring about positive change that supports collective consciousness reaching its highest potential? The polarity between Leo/Aquarius and Sol/Uranus (Aquarius is ruled by two planets: Uranus is the planetary ruler of the day, while Saturn is depicted as the planetary ruler of Aquarius in the evening) is the axis of individual/community, authority/freedom, the individual/the collective, the king/leader vs. community, performer vs. audience, power vs. individualism, self vs. duty, heart vs. the mind. 1353 Leo rules the heart and spine - the center of your physical being and the source of your spiritual light. By embracing all that Leo has to teach, you will learn that Light (Sol/Spirit) is Love (Heart). Leo and Aquarius want to shine a light on humanity, celebrate differences (Aquarius), and share Light/Love (Leo). Aquarius rules the nervous system - sending messages from the brain (air) to different body parts. The Leo/Aquarius axis is a time to align your mind with your heart and Spirit. It is time to channel Aquarius' higher mental capacities and adopt the unemotional and objective collective view; to see past the emotional wounds, to discover healing solutions. Leo reminds us of your expansiveness, generosity, and love capacity. Aquarius reminds you that you are connected to those around you and that your mind has incredible healing power. The Leo/Aquarius axis is a powerful combination of passionate creativity and progressive mindsets. By channeling this energy, you can make a difference in your own life and in the lives of others. Sol's Fire of Leo's enthusiasm can be combined with Aquarian's progressive mindset (Air) to connect deeper with your passions and create positive change. Harness the power of these energies become the leader, healer, and creator of your life and your community. Leo Full Moon Full moons are high tides of power, amplifying and creative. The full moon is a time to celebrate and harvest our previous new moon intentions; otherwise, the full moon is a time to make energetic adjustments to align ourselves with calling in our intentions. The full moon is a time of celebration and gathering. We sync to the cycle with community, nature, and Spirit. We gather to clear energy, raise energy, gain clarity, set intentions, process symbols, and connect with nature, the Divine, and our Higher Self. As the Full Moon in Leo lights the night sky, its luminous golden light envelops the collective in a warm embrace. Following a period of profound transformation and self-discovery, the energy of Leo bestows upon us a much-needed infusion of warmth and inspiration. Ruled by the Sun itself, Leo sets our souls ablaze, urging us to step boldly into the spotlight and let our inner radiance shine. This majestic sign reminds us to live from the depths of our hearts, to unearth our passions, and to wholeheartedly pursue the paths that ignite our spirits. The energy of Leo carries a profound sense of generosity, reminding us that creativity flows through our veins, an innate part of our being that deserves the time and space to be expressed. Under the Leo Full Moon, we are called to embrace the regal essence within ourselves, to honor our unique gifts, and to unleash our creative potential upon the world. This celestial energy ignites the flames of self-expression and encourages us to wholeheartedly share our authentic selves with others. It invites us to bask in the joy of creation, to dance with uninhibited passion, and to generously offer our creative contributions to the tapestry of existence. Let us embrace the fire of Leo and let it guide us towards our passions and desires. Let us be generous with ourselves and others, and remember that creativity, passion and play is a vital part of our being. Leo is the sign of creation, bringing loyalty, love, and generosity to all he touches. He brings with him the qualities of loyalty, love and generosity. He is the Sun, a magnanimous energy that radiates positivity and vitality. He is the light and fire that sustains life on this earth. In the embrace of Leo's energy, we find solace in the knowledge that regardless of the challenges we encounter, we can always rely on our inner strength and love. Leo reminds us of the deep interconnection that binds us all, as we are united by the very light and fire that burns within 1354 us. Through Leo's guidance, we are encouraged to embrace and nurture our own inner radiance, allowing it to guide us through any darkness we may encounter along our journeys. In the radiant light of Leo, you embody a divine connection, manifesting the essence of the Divine Light in this physical realm. Your unique imprint shapes the way you create and shape your life, driven by a profound longing to be seen, accepted, loved, and appreciated. When these fundamental social needs are unmet, it is only natural to react with impulsiveness and an earnest desire for validation and recognition. However, this unconscious drive, if left unchecked, can give rise to self-centeredness, selfishness, and a sense of entitlement, leading to dramatic actions and attitudes that may be justified from one's perspective. This represents the shadow side of Leo. Strive to balance the light and shadow of Leo within yourself, seeking to meet your basic social needs in a way that is loving and selfless, rather than driven by ego and selfishness. As the Leo Full Moon graces the sky during the Aquarius season, it illuminates a path of freedom and liberation that is unique to each individual. Time, as we know it, is not a linear construct, and the journey towards awakening does not come neatly packaged. During the Leo Full Moon, we are acutely aware of the highs and lows of our evolutionary path. We may find ourselves revisiting old patterns we thought we had already shed. However, it is important to recognize that we have evolved and transformed since then, armed with new perspectives and tools to navigate these past challenges in a fresh and empowering way. If you find yourself too fixated on ego gratification and the emotional reactions that come along with not getting your way, the shadow of Leo, you will miss this full moon's creative inspirations and solutions and are more likely to be met with uncomfortable and unexpected circumstances. As the world around us shifts and changes, it is important to find ways to discharge the excess energy that we may be feeling, whether it be excitement or anxiety. This will help us sustain the positive changes we are working towards and navigate these tumultuous times with greater clarity and grace. One way to achieve this is by grounding ourselves in daily practices that help us stay centered. Take things slow and steady, being mindful of the nuances and hidden information that we still need to be aware of. Whether it be through meditation, yoga, or nature walks, let us find ways to connect with the earth and let go of the excess energy. Remember that change can be intense, but it can also bring about growth and transformation. Trust in the journey and let your daily practices be a source of stability, helping you to navigate the present moment with grace and ease. The Leo full moon reminds you to live from your heart. Discover your passion and move in the direction of your desires. Generosity is the quality Leo in his Light brings to the world. It is also time to reconnect with those relationships that fuel you and inspire you to greatness. Be passionate and loyal toward the things that bring joy and growth into your life. 1355

Every stage of life is an opportunity to step into your power. We all have a little bit of wildness in us. heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Leo full moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck, or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cars from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Aquarius Season, the sun is in Aquarius (The Star), opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Leo (Strength). Then find the Sun (Sun), The Star (Aquarius), High Priestess (Moon), and then Strength (Leo). For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the full moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 7th position, select either a card representing your sun sign or a card from the second pile which contains the court cards and the Minor Arcana; use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. 1360 Tarotscope Key 2. Now you're heading into more of an internal and work-focused time. Liberation and freedom are your themes, and some big decisions in love, work, and home are taking place. Make your choices from a place of generosity, open-heartedness, and kindness. Listen to the guidance of your heart and trust your decisions. This Leo full moon can bring excess energy, making you feel stressed and overwhelmed. It's easy to fall into the trap of impulsive, ego-driven reactions. But these only make things worse. Instead, find creative ways to handle this excess energy. Take a walk, drive, draw or paint something, or practice calming breathing exercises. It can leave you feeling frazzled and stressed and prevent you from being truly productive. The full moon in Leo signals the importance of taking a step back and assessing which parts of your day are just chaotic movements that don't serve a greater purpose. During this full moon, take a step back and assess which parts of your day are truly necessary and which could be simplified. Once you identify those areas, you can work on streamlining them to make your days more productive, flow, and efficient. The space you create by removing unnecessary noise brings in an opportunity for more creative expression. You are discovering that your creative expression needs to be a part of your daily process. Can you also make it part of your work in a way that doesn't detract from the magick of the creative process? Make it a focus to find a solution to that question if you're feeling unfulfilled in your work situation. You tend to be on the more sensitive side, and ego conflicts at work can feel stressful and depleting. heading: Leo Full Moon Ritual
body: “I release everything either known or unknown to me that has been blocking me from receiving, feeling, and walking in my strength and authority. I trust and discover strength in my body, mind, self, and spirit. I call in my power and walk in my strength.” - A prayer for release Fig 78. Top view of an altar to Sol & Leo [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Sol and your ritual candle(s) for Sol on the placement for Sol. Place The Sun & Strength tarot cards on your altar, as well as symbols for Leo and offerings to Sol. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration Bay Leaves, Garnet) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – You can petition Sol to ask for rejuvenate your spirit, elevate your mood, combating the winter doldrums, re-build or build self-esteem, to be ‘seen’ by others, to be adored and in the spotlight. 1385 Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. 1386 Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. *** 1387 Pisces Season: Feb 19th - March 20th 12th house, Neptune & Jupiter (Ancient astrology) Planetary Ruler Karma, dream control is mind control and self-control “Everything flows, out and in; everything has its tides; all things rise and fall; the pendulum swing manifests in everything; the measure of the swing to the right is the measure of the swing to the left; rhythm compensates.” — THE KYBALION New Moon – Pisces (ruled by Jupiter, Neptune) Full Moon – Libra (ruled by Venus) Planet – Jupiter (Ancient astrology), Neptune (Modern astrology) Day of the Week – Thursday (ruled by Jupiter) Archetype – The Mystic Element – Water Tarot – The Moon Body – feet, toes, lymphatic system Affirmation – I am in flow. Yet, within the expansive nature of Pisces lies boundless beauty—a realm of interconnectedness, compassion, empathy, creativity, intuition, and nurturing care. As you navigate Pisces Season, allow yourself to surrender to the flowing currents of emotion and intuition. Embrace the vastness of the cosmos within and around you, recognizing your interconnectedness with all of existence. With gentle compassion and a tender heart, journey through the realms of Pisces, knowing that within its depths lies the transformative power to heal, to find solace, and to reconnect with the eternal love and beauty that is your true essence. 1388 Pisces is the 12th sign on the cosmic wheel and asks that you live in flow with the Universe and connect deeply with your emotional current. The experience of flowing with the emotional current can have you feeling elevated or pulled under, depending on your journey and evolution. Pisces is represented by two fishes swimming in opposite directions, one towards the euphoric highs, the other towards the sabotaging lows, symbolizing the conflict in our emotional currents. The Universe asks that you face what you may have been avoiding. It requires you to release your fear of failure, success, and the pressures you place on yourself. This is a time of contemplation, review, meditation, and rebirth. Pisces, the transformative energy of the zodiac, beckons us to confront and heal our karmic patterns and emotional wounds. It serves as the ultimate catalyst for shedding the layers of ego and outdated identities, preparing us for a rebirth as we enter the realm of Aries and embark on a journey of self-reinvention. In the realm of Pisces, healing becomes the greatest gift bestowed upon us, and consciously choosing the path of awareness over avoidance becomes our paramount choice. During Pisces Season, the collective focus shifts towards embracing and fully experiencing our emotions, surrendering to the ebb and flow of the emotional currents. It is a time of profound introspection and spiritual growth, as the Universe invites us to confront and release any fears or doubts that we have been evading. Whether it is the fear of failure or success, or the burdensome pressures we place upon ourselves, Pisces serves as a gentle reminder to let go and trust in the natural flow of life. As you traverse through Pisces Season, embrace the journey of deep reflection and allow your emotions to be felt and acknowledged. This period calls for courageous confrontations with your fears and doubts, fostering a space for their release and transformation. In this process, you will discover that within the depths of Pisces' realm lies a wellspring of inner resources awaiting your attention and trust. The placement of Pisces in your chart signifies where the most significant activity will take place. It's crucial to be mindful of the temptation to indulge in self-pity, depression, or addictive behaviors as a means of avoiding your emotions. Instead, embrace the energy of Pisces to find solace in rest, retreat, reflection, meditation, and the exploration of creative expressions. This season invites you to plunge into the depths of your emotional ocean, unlocking the wisdom and healing that transcends your current lifetime. In the moment before the rebirth of Aries season, you reconnect with the Source, tapping into the purest and most enlightened energy that resides within you. However, the path leading back to the Source often compels us to confront our pain, suffering, and unconscious aspects. Pisces may veil us in illusions, but it also has the potential to bestow complete awareness and clarity. Allow the messages and lessons to permeate every cell of your being. Within the realm between worlds that Pisces inhabits, profound healing unfolds at the deepest levels of our existence. The polarity between Virgo and Pisces revolves around balancing order (Virgo) and chaos (Pisces). Amidst the rise and fall of emotional waves, you seek stability by harmonizing disorganization with organization. This Pisces season, Pisces new moon and Aries's full moon ask that you reflect on where you are in your Spiritual and Evolutional Journey. Embrace the healing energy of Pisces, navigating the delicate balance between order and chaos, as you delve into the depths of your emotions. Allow healing to permeate every aspect of your being, as you connect with the timeless wisdom that transcends lifetimes. Embrace the lessons and 1389 messages that flow through the channels of your existence, preparing yourself for the potent shifts and transformations that lie ahead. Pisces season will guide you in exploring questions such as: Where do I need to focus my energy? How can I shed identities that no longer resonate with my spirit? What are my dreams and emotions trying to tell me? What literal and figurative lessons and blessings have I acquired over the past year? How can I channel my emotions to fuel my creativity? heading: Pisces Light & Shadow
body: Pisces is a deeply intuitive and empathetic sign, with a strong connection to the spiritual realm. However, when not fully evolved, Pisces energy can manifest as suffering, with thin boundaries that make them vulnerable to the emotional turmoil of the world around them. This can lead to a lack of personal responsibility and a tendency towards escapist behaviors and a victim mindset. On the flip side, when Pisces energy is fully evolved, it gives us access to the unseen worlds of healing and regeneration. It helps us to connect with the oneness of the cosmos and remember that we are more than just physical beings, coming from a place of love and beauty and returning there when our time in the physical form is complete. Evolved Pisces energy teaches us to tune in to our inner resources and trust in our own power and abilities. If you find yourself struggling with unevolved Pisces energy, try to focus on developing your personal responsibility and sense of agency. Work on setting healthy boundaries and finding healthy ways to cope with the emotional turmoil of the world around you. Remember that you have the ability to connect with the spiritual realm and tap into your inner resources for healing and growth. Pisces Light & Strength – Strong connection to the divine, intuitive, expansive, connected, compassionate, empathic, creative, intuitive, and caring Pisces Shadow & Weakness – Depression, addiction, lack of focus, lack of boundaries, victim mindset 1390 Pisces Season, The 12th House And Neptune, Jupiter (Ancient Astrology) As the celestial dance continues, you find yourself entering the realm of the 12th house, ruled by the sign of Pisces and known as the "house of the unconscious." It is a place of mystery and introspection, where your deepest emotions and hidden aspects reside. Pisces season invites you to surrender to the flow of life and trust in the wisdom of the universe; you may find yourself processing endings and obstacles you have been avoiding. The 12th house is often associated with endings and loss, reminding us that all things must come to an end and that change is a natural part of life. This can be a difficult time, but it is also an opportunity to let go of the past and make space for new beginnings. It is a realm of mystery and introspection, where we can explore the mysteries of the universe and the mysteries of our own being. Pisces asks you to experience life fully through your emotions, to feel the tides of life lift you up or pull you under, depending on where you are in your journey. It is a time to turn inward, to meditate and contemplate, and to trust in the wisdom of the cosmos as you embrace a new beginning. Embrace this opportunity to explore the depths of your soul and emerge renewed. This is a time of contemplation, meditation, and rebirth. Pisces / The Moon The Moon is the 17th key of the Major Arcana. If the Fool is the beginning of the Journey, and the Hermit is the peak of manifestation, then the Moon is the Path of Unfoldment." This path begins in the deep waters of the subconscious mind, where a thought emerges from the depths of the creative unconscious. There, the seed of thought and manifestation first breaks through to the material world. The Moon is a reflection of the Sun, and in alchemy, their marriage is the ultimate collapse of duality. The crescent moon symbolizes an eclipse, which is yet another alchemical symbol for the union of opposite masculine and feminine forces. Esoteric traditions purport that this merging of polar energy channels occurs where kundalini energy flows, which is represented by the flowing of energy up the road towards through the mountains, and the awakening individual, or 'kundalite,' experiences fleeting states of unity consciousness, or oneness with the Universe. Planetary Ruler – ♃ Jupiter (Ancient), ♆ Neptune (Modern) Symbolism – The Moon of the Golden Eclipse tarot illustrates a woman resting in the depths of her subconscious; symbolized by the woman's profile in the pool of the collective consciousness. Her watery hair flows onto land, creating a path of manifestation. Symbolizing one's subconscious thoughts and how these thoughts can unknowing guide and direct one's path and journey in life. Once on land, the Fool is asked to continue walking this path forward. This path runs between two animals — a wolf and a dog. These two animals are the same, yet different by 1391 conditioning; symbolizing the conscious and subconscious minds. The opposing animals and towers represent this energetic polarity of the wild vs. refined, intelligent application. The path forward is a balance of the two — a marriage of intuition and modern reason; the left and right brain hemispheres. The middle way never veers too far off course but balanced in the center pathway. Astrology – The moon, Luna, is a reminder that life is a natural pattern of cycles. Rhythms exist throughout nature in the changing of the seasons and the different stages of natural development. The Moon represents this Lawof Rhythm that governs over the natural cycles of life. She embodies this rhythm in her lunar phases of mounting and diminishing waxing and waning energies. She has the power over the cycle of the tides, and our own emotional waters. Incidentally, water is also a metaphor for the divine energy, where kundalini resides while she is still sleeping. The Moon corresponds to empathic, creative, and intuitive Pisces. Pisces gives access to the unseen worlds in which healing and regeneration occur, allowing you to be still within the oneness of the cosmos, remembering that we are more than just physical beings. We originate from a place of love and beauty, and will return to that when our time here in physical form is complete. Pisces reminds you to slow down, to take time for yourselves, and to meditate, rejuvenate, and heal from any emotional or physical challenges. The focus with Pisces is to feel your emotions deeply, and to exist in the flow of what the emotional currents bring. The moon also represents the path of unfoldment. The path of unfoldment begins in the deep waters of the subconscious mind, where the realm of dreams flows and intention originates from. But the Moon does not only represent our connection to our personal unconscious, but to Prakriti —The High Priestess and the Universal Collective Unconscious. In Kundalini yoga, one of the aims is to awaken prakriti in order to achieve balance alongside an awakened primal power. heading: Pisces Season and Pisces New Moon: Actions and Intentions
body: Pisces is the 12th sign in the twelve-wheel Cosmic being. Ruling the 12th house, the house of secrets, mysteries, and our subconscious (The Moon card in the Tarot). The 12th house signals an end of a cycle; depending on where you are in your journey, it can be a time of positive or negative reflection. As you enter Pisces season and the Pisces new moon, you are invited to dive deep into the realm of your subconscious. As you navigate the end of a cycle, you are called to reflect on your past actions and to take responsibility for the rewards and consequences that come with them. This is a time to set intentions for healing, self-discovery, and spiritual growth. I am in tune with my innermost desires and trust in the unfolding of my journey. I embrace my spirituality and practice self-care to nourish my mind, body, and soul. I am in flow with the universe, allowing myself to be guided by my intuition and creativity. I set healthy boundaries for myself and others, and honor my own needs and desires. I embrace my inner fantasies and find joy in the beauty and magic of the world around me. I am open to the abundance and abundance that the universe has to offer, and I am grateful for the blessings in my life. Create an altar – During the Pisces season it is a good time to create a sacred space for Jupiter, the planetary ruler of Pisces. To create an altar, you can gather items that have personal meaning or significance to you. You might also collect items that symbolize Jupiter and Pisces. Set up the altar in a space where you can sit and reflect, and take the time to meditate or journal in this space. Observe – Observe and record any symbolisms or messages that you notice during this full moon. A journal is like a magick portal to your innermost thoughts and dreams. Every page is an invitation to explore, reflect, and express yourself in a meaningful way. Collect items – Grab a pen, paper, candles, incense, herbs, and symbolic objects to represent Jupiter/Pisces, like The Moon, Temperance and The Hangedman (Neptune) tarot cards and the Planetary Kamea for Jupiter. Explore your creativity and intuition – Set an intention to tap into your creativity and follow your intuition during this time. This may involve trying new artistic or creative endeavors, engaging in activities that bring you joy and relaxation, or simply taking time to reflect on your innermost thoughts and feelings. Dive into your emotions and be vulnerable – Take this opportunity to explore your emotions and allow yourself to be vulnerable and open. This may involve seeking out therapy or other forms of support, sharing your feelings with trusted friends or loved ones, or simply taking time to process your emotions and learn from them. Cultivate a sense of connection and flow – Set an intention to cultivate a sense of connection and flow in your life. This may involve finding ways to connect more deeply with others, aligning your actions with your values and goals, or simply taking time to be present and mindful in the moment. 1393 Connecting with Higher Self and Intuition – I am confident that by channeling my emotional currents and finding balance, I can tune into my Higher Self and connect with my intuition and higher wisdom. I am committed to nurturing my inner self and practicing self-care, as I embark on my spiritual journey and seek a deeper connection to the divine. Exploring Lucid Dreaming and the Unconscious Mind – I set the intention to explore the world of lucid dreaming and tap into the depths of my unconscious mind. I am open to the possibilities that astral plane may bring, and I am willing to embrace any insights or revelations that may come to me through my dreams. I recognize the power of my own mind and the potential to use my dreams as a tool for personal growth and self-discovery. I am committed to cultivating a deeper understanding of my unconscious mind and the messages it may hold for me. heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Pisces new moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology with writing personalized horoscopes. You can use different techniques to write tarotscopes; the one I favor is to select tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements; mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a variation of a 6-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Pisces Season, the sun is in Pisces (The Moon), with the Moon (High Priestess) in Pisces (The Moon). Then find The Sun (Sun), The Hermit (Virgo), High Priestess (Moon), and the Moon (Pisces), and place The Sun in position 1, The Hermit in position 2, the High Priestess in position 3, and The Moon in position 4. 1397 For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the new moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 6th position, select a card from the second pile, which contains the court cards and the Minor Arcana. Use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. Tarotscope Key 3. heading: Pisces New Moon Ritual
body: Fig 79. Top view of an altar to Jupiter and Pisces [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Jupiter and your ritual candle(s) for Jupiter on the placement for Jupiter. Place The Wheel of Fortune, The Moon tarot cards on your altar, as well as an offering to Jupiter. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration St John’s wort) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – Petition Jupiter when asking for justice, legal matters/contracts, to be seen fairly, for blessings both material and spiritual, good fortune, health, and prosperity. Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A 1418 bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. 1419 Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. 1420

heading: Exploring Pisces Season and New Moon Through Journaling
body: Pisces is the sign of introspection, emotional depth, and spiritual connectedness. During Pisces season or a Pisces new moon, the universe may bring up issues related to your emotional and spiritual growth. You can use tarot as a way to inspire journaling. Select a spread or layout that resonates with your current focus or intention. Shuffle the deck and draw a card, then reflect on its meaning and symbolism. Use the card as a starting point for your journaling and allow its imagery and message to inspire your thoughts and feelings. Explore the card's themes and messages in greater depth and consider how they relate to your experiences and challenges. Reflect on how the card may offer guidance or insights for your current situation and how you can integrate its message into your life. Light a white candle and create a peaceful atmosphere by using calming scents and soothing music. Visualize yourself embracing your emotional depth and spiritual connectedness as you delve into your innermost thoughts and feelings. Take this opportunity to reflect on your emotional and spiritual growth. Open your journal and begin writing about your emotional and spiritual growth. You may also want to consider any challenges or obstacles you have faced in your journey towards self-discovery and growth, and brainstorm ways to overcome them. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you explore these themes. As you journey through Pisces season, it's a great time to reflect on your emotional and spiritual growth. By taking some time to journal about these topics, you can gain a deeper understanding of yourself and your goals. Here are some prompts to get you started: Reflecting on Your Emotional Landscape: Take some time to reflect on your emotional landscape and the different emotions you experience on a regular basis. Write about any patterns or themes you have noticed in your emotional responses, and how you have navigated them in the past. Consider any emotions that may be difficult for you to process or express, and brainstorm ways to better understand and manage them. Exploring Your Emotions: Take some time to reflect on your emotions and how they shape your actions and decisions. Consider any patterns or themes you have noticed in your emotional responses, and how you can work to better understand and manage your emotions. Write about any challenges you have faced in understanding and expressing your emotions, and brainstorm strategies for overcoming them. ● What are your most common emotional responses and how do they influence your behavior? Connecting with Your Inner Self: Pisces is a sign of introspection, representing our ability to delve into our innermost thoughts and feelings. Take some time to reflect on your inner self and your spiritual journey. Write about any challenges or obstacles you have faced in connecting with your inner self, and brainstorm ways to overcome them. Consider setting aside some time each day for quiet contemplation or meditation to help you connect with your inner self. Embracing Your Vulnerability: It can be difficult to open up and be vulnerable, but doing so can lead to deeper connections and a greater sense of self-awareness. Take some time to reflect on your 1421 willingness to be vulnerable and how you can work to embrace it. Write about any challenges you have faced in being vulnerable, and brainstorm strategies for overcoming them. Remember to be kind and compassionate towards yourself as you explore these themes. Dealing with Loss and Grief: Pisces is a sign of emotional depth, and it can be a time when we are faced with loss and grief. Take some time to reflect on how you cope with loss and grief, and what strategies have been helpful for you in the past. Write about any challenges you have faced in dealing with loss and grief, and brainstorm ways to find healing and closure. Exploring Lucid Dreams: Lucid dreaming is the ability to become aware that you are dreaming while you are still asleep. This can allow you to take control of your dreams and explore your subconscious mind in a new way. Take some time to reflect on your experiences with lucid dreaming, or consider trying to have a lucid dream for the first time. Write about your thoughts and feelings as you explore this realm of your mind. Consider setting an intention for your lucid dream, such as working through a personal issue or exploring a specific location. As you journal about your experiences with lucid dreaming, you may gain a deeper understanding of your subconscious mind and your own potential for growth and self-discovery. ● Have you had any particularly memorable or meaningful lucid dreams, and if so, what made them stand out? ● How do you feel while in a lucid dream, and how does it compare to your experiences in the waking world? ● Have you encountered any challenges or obstacles while trying to have a lucid dream, and if so, how have you tried to overcome them? ● How do you feel when you wake up from a lucid dream, and how do the insights or experiences you had in the dream carry over into your daily life? 1422 Sun in Pisces (The Moon) / 12th House Full Moon in Virgo (The Hermit) / 6th House

heading: Horoscopes & Tarotscopes for the Virgo full moon
body: Tarotscopes is a practice of combining tarot cards and astrology to write personalized horoscopes. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes; I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cars from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during Cancer Season, the sun is in Cancer (The Chariot), opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Virgo (The Hermit). Then find the Sun (Sun), The Chariot (Cancer), High Priestess (Moon), and then The Hermit (Virgo). For positions 5 and 6, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the full moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. For the 7th position, select either a card representing your sun sign or a card from the second pile, which contains the court cards and the Minor Arcana; use this placement to gain more insight into how to work with this planetary energy. 1428 Tarotscope Key 2. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the sun is in Ex: The Moon (Pisces), during Pisces season 1. The Sun (Sun) 4. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac sign the moon is in 6. The tarot card the corresponds to the planetary ruler of the house Ex: The Hermit (Virgo), during Virgo full moon Ex: The Tower (Mars), planetary ruler of Aries 3. The High Priestess (Moon) 5. The tarot card the corresponds to the zodiac ruler of the house that is illuminated Ex: The Emperor (Aries) ruler of the 1st house 7. The tarot card the corresponds to your zodiac sun / rising sign or a supporting card, from the court or minor arcana pile to represent what you want/need to know more of, ex: a card to represent your love life, career, finances, or general support guidance 1429 Virgo (Aug. 23 - Sept. 22) & Virgo Rising - Full moon in the 1st House The Virgo full moon is illuminating your 1st house of self. heading: Virgo Full Moon Ritual
body: “I release everything either known or unknown to me that has been blocking me from receiving, feeling, and walking in my strength and authority. I trust and discover strength in my body, mind, self, and spirit. I call in my power and walk in my strength.” - A prayer for release Fig 80. Top view of an altar Mercury & Virgo [ See 'Creating an Altar A Framework for Astrological Magick' for altar suggestions] Place the Kamea for Mercury and your ritual candle(s) for Mercury on the placement for Mercury. Place The Magician & The Hermit tarot cards on your altar, as well as symbols for Virgo & Mercury and offerings to Mercury. Ascendant (East): Aries, Fire: Candle, Oil Lantern Midheaven (South): Capricorn, Earth: Salt, Plants, Minerals or Crystals (in illustration Dill, Cinnamon, Agate) Descendant (West): Libra, Air: Powered or Cone Incense, Feather IC / Lower Heaven (North): Cancer, Water: Cup or Chalice of Spring Water Source / Sol (Center): Fire, Yellow or White Candle Petition – You can petition Mercury to work on your behalf. Mercury rules travel and trade and is the go-between: a door opening. Petition Mercury to open up doors of communication, travel, 1451 job seeking/trade, and quick cash. Mercury also rules mental faculties, and increased focus, alertness, and luck. Mercury can work with any other influence. Begin by taking a spiritual bath. Similar to how we cleanse and consecrate items for use on the altar, you must also purify your own energy. You bathe and prepare yourself in cleansing and energetic waters — setting yourself apart from the mundane 'ordinary' life. This spiritual bath can strengthen your connection to the natural world and the Universal Divine; by combining water's vibrational power and raising that water's energy with words (prayer), incense, oils, plants (herbs), and intentions. A cleansing can increase well-being and uplifts your spirit by washing away stagnation and negativity. It can remove obstacles that block success in achieving your intentions. A bath can be done in a traditional bath or by standing in a shower (and pouring the prepared spiritual bath water over one's head). Once you have finished your bath, it is time to create a sacred space. As with any spiritual/meditative practice or ritual, turn off your phone and create space to not be disturbed. Choose a ritual area in your home that is ideally free of clutter, distractions, and technology. You can use sage, palo santo, or even incense to smudge the air. You can also pour sea salt around the area, sweep it up, and discard it outside your home. Set the mood with incense, music, and the soothing sound of bells. Cleanse your ritual candle before dressing it with herbs and oils. As you light the incense, focus on your intention, pass the candle and a written manifestation of your desire through the smoke. Speak or read your intention out loud. Lastly, place your letter of intention in the bottom (underneath) of the bowl of water and place the candle inside the bowl (if using a pull-out candle in a glass jar). Light your candle and visualize yourself in the moment of your actualized and realized intention. 1. Find a quiet, distraction-free place to set up your altar. 2. Cleanse and consecrate all the items you will place on your altar using a method such as smoke, Florida Water, or a mixture of water and salt. Make sure to use new, cleansed candles. 3. Place consecrated items representing the four elements on your altar: Earth (crystals, herbs, salt in a dish), Water (small cup or bowl of spring water), Air (incense or feather), and Fire (candle). 4. Choose a candle and cleanse and dedicate it to your intention. 5. Set up an altar for the planetary god, goddess, or deity you petition, using the appropriate color cloth and other relevant items. 6. Ensure your altar is in a fire-safe area, not prone to wind disruptions. 7. Take a spiritual bath to cleanse and prepare yourself for the ritual. 8. Perform your spell or ritual by placing your written petition, the planetary sigil, kamea, or symbol representing the deity in the center of the altar, along with the candle and incense. 9. Pray. Ask for want you want, and feel it from the center of your being. 10. When finished, close down the ritual. Never blow out the candle. If you need to extinguish it, either snuff it out or pinch it out with moistened fingers. If you need to pinch the candle flame, say, "this light is out, but the intention carries on." Whenever you relight the candle, remember the feeling of the energy, and restate your intention. 11. Give Thanks. 12. When you have completed your ritual, appropriately dispose of the items. 1452 Methods for Grounding After Ritual Grounding is an important aspect of any magical ritual. It allows you to connect with the earth and release excess energy, helping you return to the mundane world. While not every ritual requires grounding, it can be beneficial if you feel overwhelmed with too much energy after a ritual. Here are some ways to ground yourself: Touch the ground physically, such as by walking barefoot. Visualize roots growing from your feet into the earth to bring balance. Eat or drink something grounding, like a warm meal, tea, or a snack. Engage in physical activity like going for a walk or run to dissipate excess energy. Troubleshooting Spell and Ritual Difficulties If you are having trouble with a spell or ritual, it could be due to a lack of focus or energy or because something in your life is blocking the spell – this could be due to past life issues, karmic debt, or negative energy. To address these issues, try using white or purple candles and performing a series of uncrossing baths and rituals on Thursdays (for Jupiter) for 3, 5, 7, or 13 days in a row. This may help to clear any obstacles and allow the spell or ritual to work more effectively. Understanding the Timeline of Ritual and Spell Results It's important to note that although a ritual or spell begins working immediately, you may not see results right away. According to the rule of three, results can take three days, three weeks, or three months to manifest. More extensive rituals may take up to a year to complete. Keep in mind that every situation is different, and results may vary. * *** * 1453 Tarot Spreads 1454 Card Yes/No Tarot Spread Tarot cards and consulting with spirits are often used by practitioners before performing a ritual to determine the likelihood of its success. One common way to do this is through a 13-card yes/no tarot spread. The framework of this tarot spread is to count up to 13 cards in three separate piles, looking for an Ace: Ace of Wands, Ace of Cups, Ace of Swords, or Ace of Pentacles. To begin, take one card at a time and place it face-up in a pile, counting until either an Ace is revealed or 13 cards have been drawn. If an upright Ace is revealed before reaching the number 13, restart the counting process in a new pile to the right until an upright Ace appears; stop at three piles. ● If you count to 13 and no Ace’s appear, restart the counting process in a new pile to the right. Count to 13, and repeat this for three piles. ● If an upright Ace is revealed before reaching the number 13, restart the counting process in a new pile to the right until another upright Ace appears; stop at three piles. ● If a reversed Ace (Ace of Cups, Swords, Wands, Pentacles) surfaces, the answer is a no. Reshuffle the tarot cards and ask another question to see how you may have better success for your desired outcome. Tip: When you’ve finished laying out the cards, you can read the top card on each pile as a three-card tarot spread for further insights on the likely outcome. Weak Yes: One upright Ace in the last pile; this outcome is a Yes, but it is considered a weaker Yes. You might need additional energy to support the work or to shorten the timeline. No: One reversed Ace in the second pile. The outcome is a No. You can look at the cards beneath the reversed Ace for supporting information on the block. 1455 No: One reversed Ace in the first pile. The outcome is No. You can look at the cards beneath the reversed Ace for supporting information on the block. Yes: Three upright Aces. This suggests a very successful outcome, with little resistance from Spirit. Maybe: Two upright Aces and the third Ace are reversed. This suggests that the outcome may be positive, but you may need to reconsider the type of ritual, or your approach. You can look at the cards beneath the reversed Ace for supporting information. Yes: Three upright Aces surfaced within the first six cards for each pile. When Aces surface quickly, in all three piles, it suggests tremendous positive, energetic support for your intention. 1456 Tarot Reading for Future Progression: Day, Week, Month, 6 Months, and One Year This tarot spread allows you to look into the future and see how the day, week, next few months or year may unfold. It can be particularly helpful when you are trying to plan and seeking guidance on what to expect in the early part of a new year. You can use this spread to get a sense of how events in your own life or your clients' lives may progress. There are different techniques you can use to write tarotscopes. I favor selecting tarot cards that correspond to the current planetary placements, mapping the cosmos here on earth. I use a 7-card spread as a framework, and if there is another significant planetary movement, ex: Mercury Rx, I’ll extend the spread accordingly. Begin by creating two piles. First, separate the Major Arcana cards into a separate pile from the Court and Minor Arcana cards from the Golden Eclipse tarot deck or another of your favorite tarot decks. Second, select the tarot cards from the Major Arcana pile corresponding to the current planetary places. For example, during the Taurus new moon, the Sun is in Taurus (The Hierophant), opposite the Moon (High Priestess) in Taurus (The Hierophant). Begin by finding the Sun (Sun), High Priestess (Moon), and The Hierophant (Taurus), and place the Sun in position 1, High Priestess in position 2, and The Hierophant in position 3. For positions 4 and 5, find which of your natal houses is being illuminated by the new moon (see below), and select the tarot card that represents the ruling zodiac sign and planet for the house. For example, Aries and Mars rule the 1st house, as Taurus and Venus rule the 2nd house. This happens three times a year, and each time it brings with it little snafus and challenges. From miscommunications and technological issues to transportation delays, Mercury Retrograde can create chaos in our lives. But even amid the madness, there is still an opportunity to be found. Instead of getting wrapped up in what you think should be happening, recognize these moments as a reminder to turn off the auto-pilot and be more present and aware of what is happening. The areas that are causing you the most challenges right now are the areas that need to be reworked. New information might come through that is painful to hear, encouraging you to review past choices and make more mature choices in the present and future moments. This is a time to reflect and learn from mistakes. Embrace the mishaps and make the most of every obstacle. And remember, dear ones, it's not personal. It's just a retrograde, another energetic cycle and rhythm of the Universe. Mercury Retrograde is a time to slow down, to listen to our intuition, to reflect on past decisions and to reassess our goals and our priorities. It is a time to reconnect with our inner selves and to align our actions with our true desires. Trust in the natural flow of the universe and have faith that all will align in the perfect time.
